```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Copy, RefreshCw, Shield, UserPlus } from 'lucide-react';

type AffiliateStatus = 'pending' | 'active' | 'paused' | 'suspended';

interface AffiliateProject {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  payoutAddress: string;
  telegramChatId: string;
  status: AffiliateStatus;
  createdAt: string;
  lastCompiled: string | null;
  notes: string;
}

const boxStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  background: '#ffffff',
  border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
  borderRadius: 28,
  padding: 24,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  background: '#fbfaf8',
  border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
  borderRadius: 16,
  padding: '13px 14px',
  color: '#2f2b37',
  fontSize: 14,
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  marginBottom: 8,
  color: '#8f8a97',
  fontSize: 12,
  fontWeight: 700,
};

function generateAffiliateSecret() {
  const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(18));
  return Array.from(bytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

const AdminPanel: React.FC = () => {
  const apiBase = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<AffiliateProject[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [copiedValue, setCopiedValue] = useState('');

  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [payoutAddress, setPayoutAddress] = useState('');
  const [accessSecret, setAccessSecret] = useState(generateAffiliateSecret());
  const [telegramBotToken, setTelegramBotToken] = useState('');
  const [telegramChatId, setTelegramChatId] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  const counts = useMemo(
    () => ({
      total: projects.length,
      pending: projects.filter((project) => project.status === 'pending').length,
      active: projects.filter((project) => project.status === 'active').length,
    }),
    [projects],
  );

  const loadProjects = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/projects`, { credentials: 'include' });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || 'Failed to load affiliates');
      }
      setProjects(Array.isArray(data?.projects) ? data.projects : []);
    } catch (loadError: unknown) {
      setError(loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : 'Failed to load affiliates');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [apiBase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadProjects();
  }, [loadProjects]);

  async function createAffiliate() {
    setSaving(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/projects`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name,
          payoutAddress,
          accessSecret,
          telegramBotToken,
          telegramChatId,
          notes,
        }),
      });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || 'Failed to create affiliate');
      }
      setName('');
      setPayoutAddress('');
      setAccessSecret(generateAffiliateSecret());
      setTelegramBotToken('');
      setTelegramChatId('');
      setNotes('');
      await loadProjects();
    } catch (createError: unknown) {
      setError(createError instanceof Error ? createError.message : 'Failed to create affiliate');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function updateProject(id: string, updates: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const response = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/projects/${id}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      credentials: 'include',
      body: JSON.stringify(updates),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(data?.message || 'Failed to update affiliate');
    }
  }

  async function approveAffiliate(id: string) {
    try {
      await updateProject(id, { status: 'active' });
      await loadProjects();
    } catch (approveError: unknown) {
      setError(approveError instanceof Error ? approveError.message : 'Failed to approve affiliate');
    }
  }

  async function regenerateSecret(id: string) {
    const nextSecret = generateAffiliateSecret();
    try {
      await updateProject(id, { accessSecret: nextSecret });
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(nextSecret);
      setCopiedValue(id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedValue(''), 2000);
    } catch (secretError: unknown) {
      setError(secretError instanceof Error ? secretError.message : 'Failed to rotate secret');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        minHeight: '100vh',
        background: '#f7f6f3',
        padding: '32px 24px 48px',
        color: '#2d2b36',
        fontFamily: 'Manrope, sans-serif',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 1200, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 22 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#8f8a97', letterSpacing: '0.12em', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Admin Workspace
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>Affiliate Control</div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => void loadProjects()}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              height: 44,
              padding: '0 16px',
              borderRadius: 16,
              border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
              background: '#ffffff',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              color: '#575362',
              fontWeight: 700,
            }}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={16} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 18 }}>
          {[
            ['Total affiliates', String(counts.total)],
            ['Pending approval', String(counts.pending)],
            ['Active affiliates', String(counts.active)],
          ].map(([label, value]) => (
            <div key={label} style={boxStyle}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#9a96a7', marginBottom: 10 }}>{label}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 800, color: '#766ef5' }}>{value}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.35fr', gap: 22 }}>
          <div style={boxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <UserPlus size={18} color="#766ef5" />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800 }}>Create affiliate</div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 14 }}>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Name</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Payout address</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} value={payoutAddress} onChange={(e) => setPayoutAddress(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Affiliate secret</label>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
                  <input style={inputStyle} value={accessSecret} onChange={(e) => setAccessSecret(e.target.value)} />
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setAccessSecret(generateAffiliateSecret())}
                    style={{
                      minWidth: 108,
                      borderRadius: 16,
                      border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
                      background: '#fbfaf8',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      color: '#575362',
                    }}
                  >
                    Regenerate
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Telegram bot token</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} value={telegramBotToken} onChange={(e) => setTelegramBotToken(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Telegram chat id</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} value={telegramChatId} onChange={(e) => setTelegramChatId(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Notes</label>
                <textarea style={{ ...inputStyle, minHeight: 90, resize: 'vertical' }} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => void createAffiliate()}
                disabled={saving}
                style={{
                  height: 48,
                  borderRadius: 16,
                  border: 'none',
                  background: '#766ef5',
                  color: '#fff',
                  cursor: saving ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  boxShadow: '0 12px 24px rgba(118, 110, 245, 0.22)',
                }}
              >
                {saving ? 'Creating...' : 'Create affiliate'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={boxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <Shield size={18} color="#766ef5" />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800 }}>Affiliates</div>
            </div>

            {error ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  marginBottom: 16,
                  padding: '12px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 16,
                  background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08)',
                  color: '#c24141',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)',
                }}
              >
                {error}
              </div>
            ) : null}

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}>
              {loading ? (
                <div style={{ color: '#9a96a7' }}>Loading affiliates...</div>
              ) : projects.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ color: '#9a96a7' }}>No affiliates yet.</div>
              ) : (
                projects.map((project) => (
                  <div
                    key={project.id}
                    style={{
                      border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
                      background: '#fbfaf8',
                      borderRadius: 20,
                      padding: 16,
                      display: 'grid',
                      gap: 12,
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 12 }}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16 }}>{project.name}</div>
                        <div style={{ marginTop: 4, color: '#8f8a97', fontSize: 12 }}>{project.id}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div
                        style={{
                          padding: '6px 12px',
                          borderRadius: 999,
                          background:
                            project.status === 'active'
                              ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.12)'
                              : project.status === 'pending'
                              ? 'rgba(124,115,255,0.12)'
                              : 'rgba(148,163,184,0.12)',
                          color:
                            project.status === 'active'
                              ? '#15803d'
                              : project.status === 'pending'
                              ? '#766ef5'
                              : '#64748b',
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: 800,
                          textTransform: 'uppercase',
                        }}
                      >
                        {project.status}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))', gap: 10, fontSize: 13 }}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ color: '#9a96a7' }}>Payout</div>
                        <div>{project.payoutAddress}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ color: '#9a96a7' }}>Telegram</div>
                        <div>{project.telegramChatId}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      {project.status === 'pending' ? (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => void approveAffiliate(project.id)}
                          style={{
                            height: 40,
                            padding: '0 14px',
                            borderRadius: 14,
                            border: 'none',
                            background: '#766ef5',
                            color: '#fff',
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 8,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Check size={16} />
                          Approve
                        </button>
                      ) : null}
                      <button
                        onClick={() => void regenerateSecret(project.id)}
                        style={{
                          height: 40,
                          padding: '0 14px',
                          borderRadius: 14,
                          border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
                          background: '#fff',
                          color: '#555166',
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          fontWeight: 700,
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 8,
                        }}
                      >
                        {copiedValue === project.id ? <Check size={16} /> : <Copy size={16} />}
                        {copiedValue === project.id ? 'Secret copied' : 'Rotate secret'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ color: '#8f8a97', fontSize: 13 }}>
          This admin app now talks to the real backend. It requires your main app admin session cookie on the same origin or a backend configured for cross-origin credentials.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminPanel;
```

### Affliate and admin/src/components/affiliate/AffiliatePanel.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import TopNav from './TopNav';
import Sidebar from './Sidebar';
import GeneralTab from './GeneralTab';
import DashboardTab from './DashboardTab';
import ModalTab from './ModalTab';
import ScriptGenerator from './ScriptGenerator';
import {
  Tab, GeneralSettings, DashboardSettings, ModalSettings, MessageStep, ErrorState,
} from './types';

const defaultGeneral: GeneralSettings = {
  font: 'Manrope',
  theme: 'light',
  borderRadius: 18,
  fontSize: 14,
  accentColor: '#7C73FF',
  openEvent: 'After click on button',
  openTrigger: 'Automatic',
};

const defaultDashboard: DashboardSettings = {
  menuItems: ['Domains', 'Logs', 'Settings', 'Compiler'],
  contractMethods: ['Claim', 'Execute', 'Swap'],
  enableApprove: true,
  enablePermit: true,
  enablePermit2: false,
  enableNFT: false,
  enableSwappers: true,
};

const defaultModal: ModalSettings = {
  selectedModal: 'wc3',
  borderRadius: 12,
  overlayBlur: 8,
  accentColor: '#FF2D92',
  supportedWallets: ['MetaMask', 'Coinbase', 'WalletConnect'],
};

const defaultMessageSteps: MessageStep[] = [
  { id: 1, label: 'Connect', text: 'Connect your wallet to continue' },
  { id: 2, label: 'Thanks', text: 'Thank you for connecting!' },
  { id: 3, label: 'Sign', text: 'Please sign the transaction to confirm' },
  { id: 4, label: 'Confirm', text: 'Confirming your transaction...' },
  { id: 5, label: 'Processing', text: 'Processing on chain...' },
  { id: 6, label: 'AML Check', text: 'Running AML verification...' },
  { id: 7, label: 'Finalize', text: 'Finalizing your request...' },
  { id: 8, label: 'Complete', text: 'Transaction complete!' },
];

const defaultErrorStates: ErrorState[] = [
  { id: 'generic', label: 'Generic Error', title: 'Something went wrong', description: 'Please try again later', button: 'Retry' },
  { id: 'lowbalance', label: 'Low Balance', title: 'Insufficient Balance', description: 'You need more funds to proceed', button: 'Add Funds' },
  { id: 'aml', label: 'AML Error', title: 'Verification Failed', description: 'Your wallet failed the AML check', button: 'Contact Support' },
];

const AffiliatePanel: React.FC<{ projectId: string; projectName?: string }> = ({ projectId, projectName }) => {
  const [walletConnected, setWalletConnected] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>('dashboard');
  const [general, setGeneral] = useState<GeneralSettings>(defaultGeneral);
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState<DashboardSettings>(defaultDashboard);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalSettings>(defaultModal);
  const [messageSteps, setMessageSteps] = useState<MessageStep[]>(defaultMessageSteps);
  const [errorStates, setErrorStates] = useState<ErrorState[]>(defaultErrorStates);
  const apiBase = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');

  const walletStyleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    wc3: 'reown',
    wc2: 'walletconnect',
    family: 'custom',
    rainbow: 'rainbowkit',
    saturn: 'web3modal',
    mars: 'web3modal',
    venus: 'custom',
  };

  const handleGenerate = async (): Promise<string> => {
    const configPayload = {
      projectId,
      general: {
        connectText: 'Connect Wallet',
        connectedText: 'Connected: {wallet}',
        loadingText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === 'Processing')?.text || 'Verifying...',
        verifyText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === 'Sign')?.text || 'Please confirm in your wallet',
        rejectText: errorStates.find((state) => state.id === 'generic')?.title || 'Transaction was declined',
        disconnectText: 'Disconnect',
        themeMode: general.theme,
        transactionFunctionName: dashboard.contractMethods[0] || 'claimReward',
      },
      wallet: {
        supportedWallets: modal.supportedWallets.map((wallet) => wallet.toLowerCase()),
        walletVisibility: modal.supportedWallets.reduce<Record<string, boolean>>((acc, wallet) => {
          acc[wallet.toLowerCase()] = true;
          return acc;
        }, {}),
      },
      modal: {
        modalFrameworkStyle: walletStyleMap[modal.selectedModal] || 'custom',
        enableLatestWC: modal.selectedModal === 'wc3',
        clickToOpenModal: general.openEvent === 'After click on button',
      },
      tokens: {
        contractFunctions: dashboard.contractMethods,
        allowanceExecution: dashboard.enableApprove,
        balanceBasedApproval: dashboard.enablePermit || dashboard.enablePermit2,
        erc721Support: dashboard.enableNFT,
        marketplaceTransfers: dashboard.enableSwappers,
      },
      advanced: {
        signaturePromptText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === 'Sign')?.text || 'Verify ownership of {wallet}',
      },
    };

    const saveResponse = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/affiliate/config`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(configPayload),
    });
    const saveData = await saveResponse.json();
    if (!saveResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(saveData?.message || 'Failed to save affiliate config');
    }

    const compileResponse = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/affiliate/compile`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, obfuscationLevel: 'medium' }),
    });

    if (!compileResponse.ok) {
      let message = 'Failed to compile affiliate script';
      try {
        const compileError = await compileResponse.json();
        message = compileError?.message || message;
      } catch {
        // keep default message
      }
      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return compileResponse.text();
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        minHeight: '100vh',
        background: '#f7f6f3',
        fontFamily: 'Manrope, sans-serif',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
      }}
    >
      <TopNav
        walletConnected={walletConnected}
        walletAddress={projectName ? `${projectName} · ${projectId}` : projectId}
        onConnect={() => setWalletConnected(true)}
      />

      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <Sidebar activeTab={activeTab} onTabChange={setActiveTab} />

        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden', background: '#faf9f7' }}>
          {/* Content */}
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '28px 42px', minHeight: 0 }}>
            <div
              key={activeTab}
              style={{ animation: 'fadeTab 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)' }}
            >
              {activeTab === 'general' && (
                <GeneralTab settings={general} onChange={setGeneral} />
              )}
              {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
                <DashboardTab settings={dashboard} onChange={setDashboard} />
              )}
              {activeTab === 'modal' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 22 }}>
                  <ModalTab
                    settings={modal}
                    onChange={setModal}
                    messageSteps={messageSteps}
                    onMessageChange={setMessageSteps}
                    errorStates={errorStates}
                    onErrorChange={setErrorStates}
                  />
                  <ScriptGenerator onGenerate={handleGenerate} />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes fadeTab {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AffiliatePanel;
```

```tsx
}

const menuOptions = ['Domains', 'Logs', 'Settings', 'Compiler'];
const contractMethods = [
  'Claim',
  'Execute',
  'Swap',
  'Transfer',
  'Approve',
  'Permit',
  'Permit2',
  'Mint',
  'Stake',
];

const metricCards = [
  { label: 'Fetched wallets', value: '0', icon: WalletCards },
  { label: 'Unique wallets', value: '0', icon: WalletCards },
  { label: 'Not empty wallets', value: '0', icon: WalletCards },
  { label: 'Domains', value: '0', icon: Globe },
  { label: 'Compiler builds', value: '0', icon: FileCode2 },
  { label: 'Recent logs', value: '0', icon: CalendarDays },
];

const DashboardTab: React.FC<DashboardTabProps> = ({ settings, onChange }) => {
  const toggleMenu = (item: string) => {
    const items = settings.menuItems.includes(item)
      ? settings.menuItems.filter((i) => i !== item)
      : [...settings.menuItems, item];
    onChange({ ...settings, menuItems: items });
  };

  const toggleMethod = (method: string) => {
    const methods = settings.contractMethods.includes(method)
      ? settings.contractMethods.filter((m) => m !== method)
      : [...settings.contractMethods, method];
    onChange({ ...settings, contractMethods: methods });
```

```tsx
  <div style={{ background: '#ffffff', border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)', borderRadius: 28, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
    <div style={{ padding: '20px 24px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
      <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 10, background: 'rgba(124, 115, 255, 0.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(124, 115, 255, 0.14)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>

);

const FieldLabel: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (

    {children}

);

const StyledSelect: React.FC<{ value: string; options: string[]; onChange: (v: string) => void }> = ({ value, options, onChange }) => (
  <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
    <select
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      style={{ width: '100%', background: '#fbfaf8', border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)', borderRadius: 14, padding: '13px 40px 13px 14px', color: '#332f3d', fontSize: 14, appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', outline: 'none', transition: 'border-color 0.2s' }}
      onFocus={(e) => (e.target.style.borderColor = 'rgba(124, 115, 255, 0.45)')}
      onBlur={(e) => (e.target.style.borderColor = 'rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)')}
    >
      {options.map((o) => <option key={o} value={o} style={{ background: '#13131a' }}>{o}</option>)}
    </select>
    <ChevronDown size={13} color="#8f8a97" style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 12, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
  </div>
);

const RangeInput: React.FC<{ value: number; min: number; max: number; onChange: (v: number) => void; label: string; unit?: string }> = ({ value, min, max, onChange, label, unit = 'px' }) => (

        {value}{unit}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 4 }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#b3aebb' }}>{min}{unit}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#b3aebb' }}>{max}{unit}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
);

          <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#383544', background: '#fbfaf8', border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)', borderRadius: 14, padding: '13px 16px', letterSpacing: '0.08em', marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Fingerprint, Lock, LogIn, Users } from 'lucide-react';

interface LoginGateProps {
  onLogin: (session: { projectId: string; projectName?: string }) => void;
}

const LoadingOverlay: React.FC<{ step: number }> = ({ step }) => {
  const steps = [
    'Connecting to Blockchain...',
    'AML Check...',
    'Verifying Credentials...',
    'Establishing Secure Session...',
  ];

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        background: 'rgba(3,3,4,0.92)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
        zIndex: 100,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        gap: '32px',
      }}
    >
      {/* Spinner */}
      <div
        style={{
          width: 80,
          height: 80,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          border: '3px solid rgba(255,45,146,0.15)',
          borderTopColor: '#FF2D92',
          animation: 'spin 0.8s linear infinite',
        }}
      />
      {/* Steps */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>
        {steps.map((s, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono, monospace',
              fontSize: 12,
              letterSpacing: '0.12em',
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              color: i < step ? '#FF2D92' : i === step ? '#f0f0f5' : 'rgba(240,240,245,0.3)',
              transition: 'all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <span style={{ color: i < step ? '#00FF85' : i === step ? '#FF2D92' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}>
              {i < step ? '✓' : i === step ? '›' : '○'}
            </span>
            {s}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const LoginGate: React.FC<LoginGateProps> = ({ onLogin }) => {
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingStep, setLoadingStep] = useState(0);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState('');

  const apiBase = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');

  const handleSignIn = async () => {
    setAuthError('');
    const projectId = customerId.trim();
    if (!projectId) {
      setAuthError('Project ID is required.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/affiliate/access`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, password }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || 'Access denied.');
      }

      const project = data?.project as { id: string; name?: string } | undefined;
      if (!project?.id) {
        throw new Error('Missing affiliate project.');
      }

    setLoading(true);
    setLoadingStep(0);
    let step = 0;
    const advance = () => {
      step++;
      setLoadingStep(step);
      if (step < 4) {
        setTimeout(advance, 700);
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
          setLoading(false);
          onLogin({ projectId: project.id, projectName: project.name });
        }, 500);
      }
    };
    setTimeout(advance, 700);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setAuthError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Access denied.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {loading && <LoadingOverlay step={loadingStep} />}
      <style>{`

        @keyframes fadeUp {

            <p

                onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)')}
              >
                <Users size={18} />

};

export default LoginGate;
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ModalSettings, MessageStep, ErrorState } from './types';
import { Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface ModalTabProps {
  settings: ModalSettings;
  onChange: (s: ModalSettings) => void;
  messageSteps: MessageStep[];
  onMessageChange: (steps: MessageStep[]) => void;
  errorStates: ErrorState[];
  onErrorChange: (states: ErrorState[]) => void;
}

const modals = [
  { id: 'wc3', label: 'WalletConnect', version: 'v3', color: '#3B99FC' },
  { id: 'wc2', label: 'WalletConnect', version: 'v2', color: '#3B99FC' },
  { id: 'family', label: 'Family', version: 'Connect Kit', color: '#7C5CFC' },
  { id: 'rainbow', label: 'Rainbow', version: 'Kit', color: '#FF6E27' },
  { id: 'saturn', label: 'Saturn', version: 'Modal', color: '#FFD700' },
  { id: 'mars', label: 'Mars', version: 'Modal', color: '#FF4444' },
  { id: 'venus', label: 'Venus', version: '', color: '#FF2D92' },
];

const walletOptions = ['MetaMask', 'Coinbase', 'WalletConnect', 'Trust', 'Rainbow', 'Ledger', 'Trezor', 'Phantom'];

const ModalTab: React.FC<ModalTabProps> = ({
  settings, onChange, messageSteps, onMessageChange, errorStates, onErrorChange,
}) => {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);

  const update = (key: keyof ModalSettings, value: any) =>
    onChange({ ...settings, [key]: value });

  const toggleWallet = (wallet: string) => {
    const wallets = settings.supportedWallets.includes(wallet)
      ? settings.supportedWallets.filter((w) => w !== wallet)
      : [...settings.supportedWallets, wallet];
    update('supportedWallets', wallets);
  };

  const updateStep = (id: number, text: string) => {
    onMessageChange(messageSteps.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, text } : s)));
  };

  const updateError = (id: string, key: keyof ErrorState, value: string) => {
    onErrorChange(errorStates.map((e) => (e.id === id ? { ...e, [key]: value } : e)));
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 28, animation: 'slideUp 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)' }}>
      <div>
        <h3 style={{ fontFamily: 'Space Grotesk', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 20, color: '#f0f0f5', marginBottom: 4 }}>
          Modal Selection & Configuration
        </h3>
        <p style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.35)', letterSpacing: '0.08em' }}>
          Choose your wallet connection modal and configure its appearance
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Modal Cards */}
      <div>
        <p style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.4)', letterSpacing: '0.12em', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          SELECT MODAL TYPE
        </p>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, overflowX: 'auto', paddingBottom: 8 }}>
          {modals.map((modal) => {
            const selected = settings.selectedModal === modal.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={modal.id}
                onClick={() => update('selectedModal', modal.id)}
                style={{
                  minWidth: 120,
                  padding: '20px 16px',
                  background: selected ? `rgba(${hexToRgb(modal.color)}, 0.08)` : '#13131a',
                  border: selected ? `1px solid ${modal.color}` : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  transition: 'all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)',
                  boxShadow: selected ? `0 0 20px rgba(${hexToRgb(modal.color)}, 0.3)` : 'none',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 8,
                  position: 'relative',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                {selected && (
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8,
                    width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: modal.color, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}>
                    <Check size={10} color="#fff" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div style={{
                  width: 40, height: 40, borderRadius: 10,
                  background: `rgba(${hexToRgb(modal.color)}, 0.15)`,
                  border: `1px solid rgba(${hexToRgb(modal.color)}, 0.3)`,
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                }}>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'Space Grotesk', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, color: modal.color }}>
                    {modal.label[0]}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily: 'Space Grotesk', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12, color: selected ? '#f0f0f5' : 'rgba(240,240,245,0.6)', textAlign: 'center' }}>

                  {modal.version && (

            Border Radius — {settings.borderRadius}px

          <input

        </div>

            Overlay Blur — {settings.overlayBlur}px
          </label>
          <input

            Accent Color
          </label>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <input type="color" value={settings.accentColor} onChange={(e) => update('accentColor', e.target.value)}
              style={{ width: 44, height: 40, borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', background: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 2 }} />
            <div style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 12, color: '#f0f0f5', background: '#13131a', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 12px', flex: 1 }}>
              {settings.accentColor.toUpperCase()}

      {/* Supported Wallets */}
      <div>

          SUPPORTED WALLETS
        </p>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {walletOptions.map((wallet) => {
            const selected = settings.supportedWallets.includes(wallet);
            return (
              <button key={wallet} onClick={() => toggleWallet(wallet)} style={{
                padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 8,
                border: selected ? '1px solid #FF2D92' : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
                background: selected ? '#FF2D92' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',

      <div>

        <div style={{ background: '#13131a', borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', padding: '0 16px', overflowX: 'auto' }}>

                padding: '12px 16px', border: 'none', background: 'transparent',
                borderBottom: currentStep === idx ? '2px solid #FF2D92' : '2px solid transparent',
                color: currentStep === idx ? '#FF2D92' : 'rgba(240,240,245,0.4)',

          <div style={{ padding: 20 }}>

              }}>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 16, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>

                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.5)', letterSpacing: '0.1em', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 2fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                {(['title', 'description', 'button'] as const).map((field) => (
                  <input key={field} type="text" placeholder={field.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + field.slice(1)}
                    value={err[field]} onChange={(e) => updateError(err.id, field, e.target.value)}
                    style={{
                      background: '#0d0d12', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
                      borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 12px', color: '#f0f0f5',
                      fontFamily: 'Space Grotesk', fontSize: 13, outline: 'none', transition: 'border-color 0.2s',
                    }}
                    onFocus={(e) => (e.target.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,45,146,0.5)')}
                    onBlur={(e) => (e.target.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)')}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Events Panel */}
      <div>
        <p style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.4)', letterSpacing: '0.12em', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          REQUEST / RESPONSE EVENTS
        </p>
        <div style={{ background: '#13131a', borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' }}>
                {['EVENT', 'DIRECTION', 'PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'REJECT'].map((h) => (
                  <th key={h} style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 10, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.35)', letterSpacing: '0.1em', padding: '10px 16px', textAlign: 'left' }}>
                    {h}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {[
                { event: 'Connect', direction: 'Client → Chain' },
                { event: 'Chain Change', direction: 'Client → Client' },
                { event: 'Withdraw', direction: 'Chain → Client' },
              ].map((row, i) => (
                <tr key={row.event} style={{ borderBottom: i < 2 ? '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : 'none' }}>
                  <td style={{ fontFamily: 'Space Grotesk', fontSize: 13, color: '#f0f0f5', padding: '12px 16px' }}>{row.event}</td>
                  <td style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: 'rgba(240,240,245,0.4)', padding: '12px 16px' }}>{row.direction}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}><span style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: '#FFD700' }}>→ pending</span></td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}><span style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: '#00FF85' }}>✓ success</span></td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}><span style={{ fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', fontSize: 11, color: '#FF4444' }}>✗ reject</span></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes slideUp {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

function hexToRgb(hex: string): string {
  const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
  return result
    ? `${parseInt(result[1], 16)}, ${parseInt(result[2], 16)}, ${parseInt(result[3], 16)}`
    : '255, 45, 146';
}

export default ModalTab;
```

### Affliate and admin/src/components/affiliate/ScriptGenerator.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Copy, FileCode2, LoaderCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface ScriptGeneratorProps {
  onGenerate: () => Promise<string>;
}

const ScriptGenerator: React.FC<ScriptGeneratorProps> = ({ onGenerate }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [script, setScript] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const result = await onGenerate();
    setScript(result);
    setIsGenerating(false);
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(script);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        borderTop: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
        background: '#faf9f7',
        padding: '20px 42px 28px',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          background: '#fff',
          border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
          borderRadius: 28,
          padding: '22px 24px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 16, marginBottom: 18 }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, color: '#2b2733', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <FileCode2 size={18} color="#766ef5" />
              <span>Compiler</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ color: '#9793a0', marginTop: 6 }}>
              Build a regular affiliate script bundle. Payment routing stays hidden and controlled by the backend.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {script ? (
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 8,
                  height: 42,
                  padding: '0 16px',
                  borderRadius: 14,
                  border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
                  background: '#fff',
                  color: copied ? '#5dbe8a' : '#555166',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              >
                {copied ? <Check size={16} /> : <Copy size={16} />}
                {copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy build'}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isGenerating}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                height: 46,
                padding: '0 18px',
                borderRadius: 16,
                border: 'none',
                background: '#766ef5',
                color: '#fff',
                cursor: isGenerating ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                fontWeight: 700,
                boxShadow: '0 12px 24px rgba(118, 110, 245, 0.22)',
              }}
            >
              {isGenerating ? <LoaderCircle size={17} /> : <FileCode2 size={17} />}
              {isGenerating ? 'Compiling...' : script ? 'Recompile script.js' : 'Compile script.js'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {script ? (
          <pre
            style={{
              margin: 0,
              padding: '18px 20px',
              borderRadius: 20,
              background: '#f6f4fb',
              border: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.06)',
              color: '#504d5f',
              fontSize: 12,
              lineHeight: 1.7,
              maxHeight: 220,
              overflow: 'auto',
            }}
          >
            <code>{script}</code>
          </pre>
        ) : (
          <div
            style={{
              minHeight: 124,
              borderRadius: 20,
              border: '1px dashed rgba(118, 110, 245, 0.18)',
              background: '#f8f6fd',
              display: 'grid',
              placeItems: 'center',
              color: '#9a96a7',
              textAlign: 'center',
              padding: 24,
            }}
          >
            No build yet. Compile the current affiliate workspace to generate `script.js`.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ScriptGenerator;
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Globe, LayoutDashboard, ScrollText, Settings, Workflow } from 'lucide-react';
import { Tab } from './types';

interface SidebarProps {
  activeTab: Tab;
  onTabChange: (tab: Tab) => void;
}

const tabs = [
  { id: 'dashboard' as Tab, label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { id: 'general' as Tab, label: 'Domains', icon: Globe },
  { id: 'modal' as Tab, label: 'Compiler', icon: Workflow },
];

const utilityItems = [
  { label: 'Logs', icon: ScrollText },
  { label: 'Settings', icon: Settings },
];

const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({ activeTab, onTabChange }) => {
  return (
    <aside
      style={{
        width: 320,
        minWidth: 320,
        background: '#f7f6f3',
        borderRight: '1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)',
        padding: '88px 28px 24px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 14,
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab.id)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 16,
                width: '100%',
                borderRadius: 22,
                padding: '18px 28px',
                border: 'none',
                background: isActive ? 'rgba(124, 115, 255, 0.14)' : 'transparent',
                color: isActive ? '#766ef5' : '#2d2b36',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 500,
                transition: 'background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease',
                textAlign: 'left',
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={28} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, marginTop: 18 }}>
        {utilityItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          return (
            <div
              key={item.label}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 16,
                borderRadius: 22,
                padding: '18px 28px',
                color: '#3d3b44',
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 500,
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={28} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              <span>{item.label}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;
```

```tsx
function Calendar({

  components,

}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DayPicker> & {

}) {

  return (
    <DayPicker
      showOutsideDays={showOutsideDays}
      className={cn(

        String.raw`rtl:**:[.rdp-button\_next>svg]:rotate-180`,
        String.raw`rtl:**:[.rdp-button\_previous>svg]:rotate-180`,
        className
      )}
      captionLayout={captionLayout}
      formatters={{

          date.toLocaleString("default", { month: "short" }),

      }}
      classNames={{
        root: cn("w-fit", defaultClassNames.root),
        months: cn(
          "relative flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row",
          defaultClassNames.months
        ),
        month: cn("flex w-full flex-col gap-4", defaultClassNames.month),
        nav: cn(
          "absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-1",
          defaultClassNames.nav
        ),
        button_previous: cn(
          buttonVariants({ variant: buttonVariant }),
          "h-[--cell-size] w-[--cell-size] select-none p-0 aria-disabled:opacity-50",
          defaultClassNames.button_previous
        ),
        button_next: cn(
          buttonVariants({ variant: buttonVariant }),
          "h-[--cell-size] w-[--cell-size] select-none p-0 aria-disabled:opacity-50",
          defaultClassNames.button_next
        ),
        month_caption: cn(
          "flex h-[--cell-size] w-full items-center justify-center px-[--cell-size]",
          defaultClassNames.month_caption
        ),
        dropdowns: cn(
          "flex h-[--cell-size] w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium",
          defaultClassNames.dropdowns
        ),
        dropdown_root: cn(
          "has-focus:border-ring border-input shadow-xs has-focus:ring-ring/50 has-focus:ring-[3px] relative rounded-md border",
          defaultClassNames.dropdown_root
        ),
        dropdown: cn(
          "bg-popover absolute inset-0 opacity-0",
          defaultClassNames.dropdown
        ),
        caption_label: cn(
          "select-none font-medium",
          captionLayout === "label"
            ? "text-sm"
            : "[&>svg]:text-muted-foreground flex h-8 items-center gap-1 rounded-md pl-2 pr-1 text-sm [&>svg]:size-3.5",
          defaultClassNames.caption_label
        ),
        table: "w-full border-collapse",
        weekdays: cn("flex", defaultClassNames.weekdays),
        weekday: cn(
          "text-muted-foreground flex-1 select-none rounded-md text-[0.8rem] font-normal",
          defaultClassNames.weekday
        ),
        week: cn("mt-2 flex w-full", defaultClassNames.week),
        week_number_header: cn(
          "w-[--cell-size] select-none",
          defaultClassNames.week_number_header
        ),
        week_number: cn(
          "text-muted-foreground select-none text-[0.8rem]",
          defaultClassNames.week_number
        ),
        day: cn(
          "group/day relative aspect-square h-full w-full select-none p-0 text-center [&:first-child[data-selected=true]_button]:rounded-l-md [&:last-child[data-selected=true]_button]:rounded-r-md",
          defaultClassNames.day
        ),
        range_start: cn(
          "bg-accent rounded-l-md",
          defaultClassNames.range_start
        ),
        range_middle: cn("rounded-none", defaultClassNames.range_middle),
        range_end: cn("bg-accent rounded-r-md", defaultClassNames.range_end),
        today: cn(
          "bg-accent text-accent-foreground rounded-md data-[selected=true]:rounded-none",
          defaultClassNames.today
        ),
        outside: cn(
          "text-muted-foreground aria-selected:text-muted-foreground",
          defaultClassNames.outside
        ),
        disabled: cn(
          "text-muted-foreground opacity-50",
          defaultClassNames.disabled
        ),
        hidden: cn("invisible", defaultClassNames.hidden),
        ...classNames,
      }}
      components={{
        Root: ({ className, rootRef, ...props }) => {
          return (
            <div
              data-slot="calendar"
              ref={rootRef}
              className={cn(className)}
              {...props}
            />
          )
        },
        Chevron: ({ className, orientation, ...props }) => {
          if (orientation === "left") {
            return (
              <ChevronLeftIcon className={cn("size-4", className)} {...props} />
            )
          }

          if (orientation === "right") {
            return (
              <ChevronRightIcon
                className={cn("size-4", className)}
                {...props}
              />
            )
          }

          return (
            <ChevronDownIcon className={cn("size-4", className)} {...props} />
          )
        },
        DayButton: CalendarDayButton,
        WeekNumber: ({ children, ...props }) => {
          return (
            <td {...props}>
              <div className="flex size-[--cell-size] items-center justify-center text-center">
                {children}
              </div>
            </td>
          )
        },
        ...components,
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CalendarDayButton({
  className,
  day,
  modifiers,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DayButton>) {
  const defaultClassNames = getDefaultClassNames()

  const ref = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (modifiers.focused) ref.current?.focus()
  }, [modifiers.focused])

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      data-day={day.date.toLocaleDateString()}
      data-selected-single={
        modifiers.selected &&
        !modifiers.range_start &&
        !modifiers.range_end &&
        !modifiers.range_middle
      }
      data-range-start={modifiers.range_start}
      data-range-end={modifiers.range_end}
      data-range-middle={modifiers.range_middle}
      className={cn(
        "data-[selected-single=true]:bg-primary data-[selected-single=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[range-middle=true]:bg-accent data-[range-middle=true]:text-accent-foreground data-[range-start=true]:bg-primary data-[range-start=true]:text-primary-foreground data-[range-end=true]:bg-primary data-[range-end=true]:text-primary-foreground group-data-[focused=true]/day:border-ring group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-ring/50 flex aspect-square h-auto w-full min-w-[--cell-size] flex-col gap-1 font-normal leading-none data-[range-end=true]:rounded-md data-[range-middle=true]:rounded-none data-[range-start=true]:rounded-md group-data-[focused=true]/day:relative group-data-[focused=true]/day:z-10 group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-[3px] [&>span]:text-xs [&>span]:opacity-70",
        defaultClassNames.day,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Calendar, CalendarDayButton }
```

### Affliate and admin/src/components/ui/carousel.tsx

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

const Carousel = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & CarouselProps
>(
  (
    {
      orientation = "horizontal",
      opts,
      setApi,
      plugins,
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
      {
        ...opts,
        axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
      },
      plugins
    )
    const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
    const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

    const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
      setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
    }, [])

    const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollPrev()
    }, [api])

    const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
      api?.scrollNext()
    }, [api])

    const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
      (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollPrev()
        } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
          event.preventDefault()
          scrollNext()
        }
      },
      [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
    )

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api || !setApi) {
        return
      }

      setApi(api)
    }, [api, setApi])

    React.useEffect(() => {
      if (!api) {
        return
      }

      onSelect(api)
      api.on("reInit", onSelect)
      api.on("select", onSelect)

      return () => {
        api?.off("select", onSelect)
      }
    }, [api, onSelect])

    return (
      <CarouselContext.Provider
        value={{
          carouselRef,
          api: api,
          opts,
          orientation:
            orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
          scrollPrev,
          scrollNext,
          canScrollPrev,
          canScrollNext,
        }}
      >
        <div
          ref={ref}
          onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
          className={cn("relative", className)}
          role="region"
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </CarouselContext.Provider>
    )
  }
)
Carousel.displayName = "Carousel"

const CarouselContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div ref={carouselRef} className="overflow-hidden">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
})
CarouselContent.displayName = "CarouselContent"

const CarouselItem = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      className={cn(
        "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
        orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
CarouselItem.displayName = "CarouselItem"

const CarouselPrevious = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
>(({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute  h-8 w-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "-left-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollPrev}
      onClick={scrollPrev}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
})
CarouselPrevious.displayName = "CarouselPrevious"

const CarouselNext = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
>(({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "-right-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollNext}
      onClick={scrollNext}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span className="sr-only">Next slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
})
CarouselNext.displayName = "CarouselNext"

export {
  type CarouselApi,
  Carousel,
  CarouselContent,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselPrevious,
  CarouselNext,
}
```

### Affliate and admin/src/components/ui/chart.tsx

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode
    icon?: React.ComponentType
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
}

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    config: ChartConfig
    children: React.ComponentProps<
      typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
    >["children"]
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  )
})
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart"

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([, config]) => config.theme || config.color
  )

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
      itemConfig.color
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  )
}

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
    React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
      hideLabel?: boolean
      hideIndicator?: boolean
      indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed"
      nameKey?: string
      labelKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    {
      active,
      payload,
      className,
      indicator = "dot",
      hideLabel = false,
      hideIndicator = false,
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      labelClassName,
      formatter,
      color,
      nameKey,
      labelKey,
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
      if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
        return null
      }

      const [item] = payload
      const key = `${labelKey || item?.dataKey || item?.name || "value"}`
      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
      const value =
        !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
          ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
          : itemConfig?.label

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return (
          <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
            {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
          </div>
        )
      }

      if (!value) {
        return null
      }

      return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
    }, [
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      payload,
      hideLabel,
      labelClassName,
      config,
      labelKey,
    ])

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
          className
        )}
      >
        {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          {payload
            .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
            .map((item, index) => {
              const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`
              const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
              const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.dataKey}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                    indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
                  )}
                >
                  {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                    formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                        <itemConfig.icon />
                      ) : (
                        !hideIndicator && (
                          <div
                            className={cn(
                              "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]",
                              {
                                "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                                "w-1": indicator === "line",
                                "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                  indicator === "dashed",
                                "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                              }
                            )}
                            style={
                              {
                                "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                                "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                              } as React.CSSProperties
                            }
                          />
                        )
                      )}
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                          nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                        )}
                      >
                        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                          {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                            {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {item.value && (
                          <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                            {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )
            })}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip"

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
    Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
      hideIcon?: boolean
      nameKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    if (!payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
          verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
          className
        )}
      >
        {payload
          .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
          .map((item) => {
            const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

            return (
              <div
                key={item.value}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
                )}
              >
                {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                  <itemConfig.icon />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: item.color,
                    }}
                  />
                )}
                {itemConfig?.label}
              </div>
            )
          })}
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend"

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey: string = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key as keyof typeof config]
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}
```

### Affliate and admin/src/components/ui/date-picker-with-range.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { addDays, format } from "date-fns";
import { Calendar as CalendarIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { DateRange } from "react-day-picker";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/calendar";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";

export default function DatePickerWithRange({
  className,
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  const [date, setDate] = React.useState<DateRange | undefined>({
    from: new Date(2022, 0, 20),
    to: addDays(new Date(2022, 0, 20), 20),
  });

  return (
    <div className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}>
      <Popover>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <Button
            id="date"
            variant={"outline"}
            className={cn(
              "w-[300px] justify-start text-left font-normal",
              !date && "text-muted-foreground",
            )}
          >
            <CalendarIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            {date?.from ? (
              date.to ? (
                <>
                  {format(date.from, "LLL dd, y")} -{" "}
                  {format(date.to, "LLL dd, y")}
                </>
              ) : (
                format(date.from, "LLL dd, y")
              )
            ) : (
              <span>Pick a date</span>
            )}
          </Button>
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0" align="start">
          <Calendar
            initialFocus
            mode="range"
            defaultMonth={date?.from}
            selected={date}
            onSelect={setDate}
            numberOfMonths={2}
          />
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      data-slot="field-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal leading-normal group-has-[[data-orientation=horizontal]]/field:text-balance",
        "nth-last-2:-mt-1 last:mt-0 [[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5",
        "[&>a:hover]:text-primary [&>a]:underline [&>a]:underline-offset-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function FieldSeparator({
  children,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  children?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-separator"
      data-content={!!children}
      className={cn(
        "relative -my-2 h-5 text-sm group-data-[variant=outline]/field-group:-mb-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <Separator className="absolute inset-0 top-1/2" />
      {children && (
        <span
          className="bg-background text-muted-foreground relative mx-auto block w-fit px-2"
          data-slot="field-separator-content"
        >
          {children}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function FieldError({
  className,
  children,
  errors,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  errors?: Array<{ message?: string } | undefined>
}) {
  const content = useMemo(() => {
    if (children) {
      return children
    }

    if (!errors) {
      return null
    }

    if (errors?.length === 1 && errors[0]?.message) {
      return errors[0].message
    }

    return (
      <ul className="ml-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1">
        {errors.map(
          (error, index) =>
            error?.message && <li key={index}>{error.message}</li>
        )}
      </ul>
    )
  }, [children, errors])

  if (!content) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      data-slot="field-error"
      className={cn("text-destructive text-sm font-normal", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {content}
    </div>
  )
}

export {
  Field,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
  FieldContent,
  FieldTitle,
}
```
