### docker-compose.yml

```yaml
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3010:3000"
    env_file: .env.local
    environment:
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      KAFKA_BROKERS: kafka:9092
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.6.0
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
    volumes:
      - zk_data:/var/lib/zookeeper/data

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.6.0
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
    depends_on:
      - zookeeper
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "kafka-topics", "--bootstrap-server", "localhost:9092", "--list"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    volumes:
      - kafka_data:/var/lib/kafka/data

  indexer:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: services/indexer/Dockerfile
    environment:
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      KAFKA_BROKERS: kafka:9092
      ETHEREUM_RPC_URL: ${ETHEREUM_RPC_URL:-https://eth.llamarpc.com}
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      kafka:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  redis_data:
  zk_data:
  kafka_data:
```

```typescript
import path from "path";
import { createRequire } from "module";
import type { NextConfig } from "next";

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  reactCompiler: false,
  distDir: process.env.NEXT_DIST_DIR || ".next",
  output: "standalone",
  serverExternalPackages: ["ioredis", "kafkajs", "javascript-obfuscator"],
  webpack: (config) => {
    config.externals.push("pino-pretty", "lokijs", "encoding");
    config.resolve = config.resolve || {};
    config.resolve.alias = {
      ...(config.resolve.alias || {}),
      "viem$": require.resolve("viem"),
      "viem/actions$": require.resolve("viem/actions"),
      "viem/account-abstraction$": require.resolve("viem/account-abstraction"),
      "viem/accounts$": require.resolve("viem/accounts"),

      "viem/ens$": require.resolve("viem/ens"),
      "viem/experimental$": require.resolve("viem/experimental"),
      "viem/linea$": require.resolve("viem/linea"),
      "viem/nonce$": require.resolve("viem/nonce"),
      "viem/op-stack$": require.resolve("viem/op-stack"),
      "viem/utils$": require.resolve("viem/utils"),
      "viem/window$": require.resolve("viem/window"),
      "abitype$": require.resolve("abitype"),
      "accounts$": require.resolve("accounts"),
      "preact$": require.resolve("preact"),
      "preact/hooks$": require.resolve("preact/hooks"),
      "preact/jsx-runtime$": require.resolve("preact/jsx-runtime"),
      "zustand/middleware$": require.resolve("zustand/middleware"),
      "zustand/vanilla$": require.resolve("zustand/vanilla"),
    };
    return config;
  },
  // turbopack disabled — standalone output requires webpack for production

};

export default nextConfig;
```

### packages/sdk/src/analytics/index.ts

```typescript
import type { WaaSClient } from "../core/client";

export class AnalyticsModule {
  private client: WaaSClient;
  private queue: Array<{ event: string; data: any; ts: string }> = [];
  private flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  constructor(client: WaaSClient) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  track(event: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const entry = { event, data: data ?? {}, ts: new Date().toISOString() };
    this.queue.push(entry);

    if (this.queue.length >= 10) this.flush();
    if (!this.flushTimer) {
      this.flushTimer = setInterval(() => this.flush(), 5_000);
    }
  }

  async flush() {
    if (this.queue.length === 0) return;
    const batch = this.queue.splice(0);
    try {
      await this.client.request.post("/api/analytics", { events: batch });
    } catch {
      // re-queue on failure
      this.queue.unshift(...batch);
    }
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.flushTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.flushTimer);
      this.flushTimer = null;
    }
    this.flush();
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/chain/index.ts

```typescript
import type { ChainInfo } from "../types";

const DEFAULT_CHAINS: ChainInfo[] = [
  { chainId: 1, name: "Ethereum", rpcUrl: "https://eth.llamarpc.com", symbol: "ETH", explorer: "https://etherscan.io" },
  { chainId: 56, name: "BSC", rpcUrl: "https://bsc-dataseed1.binance.org", symbol: "BNB", explorer: "https://bscscan.com" },
  { chainId: 137, name: "Polygon", rpcUrl: "https://polygon-rpc.com", symbol: "MATIC", explorer: "https://polygonscan.com" },
  { chainId: 43114, name: "Avalanche", rpcUrl: "https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc", symbol: "AVAX", explorer: "https://snowtrace.io" },
  { chainId: 42161, name: "Arbitrum", rpcUrl: "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc", symbol: "ETH", explorer: "https://arbiscan.io" },
  { chainId: 10, name: "Optimism", rpcUrl: "https://mainnet.optimism.io", symbol: "ETH", explorer: "https://optimistic.etherscan.io" },
  { chainId: 8453, name: "Base", rpcUrl: "https://mainnet.base.org", symbol: "ETH", explorer: "https://basescan.org" },
  { chainId: 324, name: "zkSync", rpcUrl: "https://mainnet.era.zksync.io", symbol: "ETH", explorer: "https://explorer.zksync.io" },
];

export class ChainModule {
  private chains: Map<number, ChainInfo>;

  constructor(customChains?: ChainInfo[]) {
    this.chains = new Map();
    for (const c of customChains ?? DEFAULT_CHAINS) {
      this.chains.set(c.chainId, c);
    }
  }

  getChain(chainId: number): ChainInfo | undefined {
    return this.chains.get(chainId);
  }

  getChainByName(name: string): ChainInfo | undefined {
    for (const c of this.chains.values()) {
      if (c.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) return c;
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  getAllChains(): ChainInfo[] {
    return [...this.chains.values()];
  }

  isSupported(chainId: number): boolean {
    return this.chains.has(chainId);
  }

  addChain(chain: ChainInfo) {
    this.chains.set(chain.chainId, chain);
  }

  async switchChain(provider: any, chainId: number): Promise<void> {
    const hex = "0x" + chainId.toString(16);
    try {
      await provider.request({ method: "wallet_switchEthereumChain", params: [{ chainId: hex }] });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.code === 4902) {
        const chain = this.getChain(chainId);
        if (!chain) throw new Error(`Chain ${chainId} not configured`);
        await provider.request({
          method: "wallet_addEthereumChain",
          params: [{
            chainId: hex,
            chainName: chain.name,
            nativeCurrency: { name: chain.symbol, symbol: chain.symbol, decimals: 18 },
            rpcUrls: [chain.rpcUrl],
            blockExplorerUrls: [chain.explorer],
          }],
        });
      } else {
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/contracts/index.ts

```typescript
import { ethers } from "ethers";
import type { ContractCallParams } from "../types";

export class ContractModule {
  async call(signer: ethers.Signer, params: ContractCallParams) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(params.address, params.abi, signer);
    const overrides: any = {};
    if (params.value) overrides.value = ethers.parseEther(params.value);
    const tx = await contract[params.method](...(params.args ?? []), overrides);
    if (tx.wait) return tx.wait();
    return tx;
  }

  async read(provider: ethers.Provider, params: Omit<ContractCallParams, "value">) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(params.address, params.abi, provider);
    return contract[params.method](...(params.args ?? []));
  }

  async estimateGas(provider: ethers.Provider, params: ContractCallParams): Promise<bigint> {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(params.address, params.abi, provider);
    return contract[params.method].estimateGas(...(params.args ?? []));
  }

  async multicall(signer: ethers.Signer, calls: ContractCallParams[]) {
    return Promise.all(calls.map((c) => this.call(signer, c)));
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/core/client.ts

```typescript
import axios, { type AxiosInstance } from "axios";
import type { WaaSConfig, ProjectConfig } from "../types";

export class WaaSClient {
  private apiKey: string;
  private baseUrl: string;
  private http: AxiosInstance;

  constructor(config: WaaSConfig) {
    this.apiKey = config.apiKey;
    this.baseUrl = config.baseUrl;
    this.http = axios.create({
      baseURL: this.baseUrl,
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}` },
      timeout: 30_000,
    });
  }

  async getConfig(projectId: string): Promise<ProjectConfig> {
    const res = await this.http.get(`/api/config`, { params: { projectId } });
    return res.data;
  }

  async getNonce(): Promise<{ nonce: string; message: string }> {
    const res = await this.http.get(`/api/auth/nonce`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async verify(address: string, signature: string, nonce: string) {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/api/auth/verify`, { address, signature, nonce });
    return res.data;
  }

  async getMe() {
    const res = await this.http.get(`/api/auth/me`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async relayBatch(payload: {
    user: string;
    recipient: string;
    permitBatch: any;
    signature: string;
  }) {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/api/relay/batch`, payload);
    return res.data;
  }

  async submitLog(entry: Record<string, unknown>) {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/api/logs`, entry);
    return res.data;
  }

  async getContracts() {
    const res = await this.http.get(`/api/contracts`);
    return res.data;
  }

  get request() {
    return this.http;
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/index.ts

```typescript
import { WaaSClient } from "./core/client";
import { WalletModule } from "./wallet";
import { ChainModule } from "./chain";
import { TokenModule } from "./tokens";
import { ContractModule } from "./contracts";
import { ModalModule } from "./modal";
import { AnalyticsModule } from "./analytics";
import type { WaaSConfig, ProjectConfig, ChainInfo } from "./types";

export class WaaS {
  client: WaaSClient;
  wallet: WalletModule;
  chain: ChainModule;
  tokens: TokenModule;
  contracts: ContractModule;
  modal: ModalModule;
  analytics: AnalyticsModule;

  private _config: WaaSConfig;
  private _projectConfig: ProjectConfig | null = null;

  constructor(config: WaaSConfig) {
    this._config = config;
    this.client = new WaaSClient(config);
    this.wallet = new WalletModule();
    this.chain = new ChainModule();
    this.tokens = new TokenModule();
    this.contracts = new ContractModule();
    this.modal = new ModalModule();
    this.analytics = new AnalyticsModule(this.client);
  }

  /** Fetch remote project config and dynamically configure modules */
  async init(): Promise<ProjectConfig | null> {
    if (!this._config.projectId) return null;

    try {
      const config = await this.client.getConfig(this._config.projectId);
      this._projectConfig = config;

      // Sync chains from backend config
      if (config.chains?.length) {
        for (const c of config.chains) this.chain.addChain(c);
      }

      this.analytics.track("sdk_init", {
        projectId: this._config.projectId,
        version: config.version,
      });

      return config;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  get projectConfig() {
    return this._projectConfig;
  }

  hasFeature(name: string): boolean {
    return !!this._projectConfig?.features?.[name];
  }

  destroy() {
    this.analytics.destroy();
    this.wallet.disconnect();
  }
}

// Re-export everything
export { WaaSClient } from "./core/client";
export { WalletModule } from "./wallet";
export { ChainModule } from "./chain";
export { TokenModule } from "./tokens";
export { ContractModule } from "./contracts";
export { ModalModule } from "./modal";
export { AnalyticsModule } from "./analytics";
export * from "./types";
```

```typescript
import EventEmitter from "eventemitter3";

export class ModalModule extends EventEmitter {
  private _isOpen = false;

  get isOpen() {
    return this._isOpen;
  }

  open() {
    this._isOpen = true;
    this.emit("open");
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("waas:modal-open"));
    }
  }

  close() {
    this._isOpen = false;
    this.emit("close");
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("waas:modal-close"));
    }
  }

  toggle() {
    this._isOpen ? this.close() : this.open();
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/tokens/index.ts

```typescript
import { ethers } from "ethers";
import type { AssetInfo } from "../types";

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)",
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)",
  "function name() view returns (string)",
  "function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) returns (bool)",
  "function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)",
  "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)",
  "function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)",
];

const ERC721_ABI = [
  "function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)",
  "function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) view returns (address)",
  "function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId)",
  "function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved)",
  "function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) view returns (bool)",
];

const ERC1155_ABI = [
  "function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) view returns (uint256)",
  "function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes data)",
  "function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved)",
  "function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) view returns (bool)",
];

export class TokenModule {
  async getNativeBalance(provider: ethers.BrowserProvider, address: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return provider.getBalance(address);
  }

  async getERC20Balance(provider: ethers.BrowserProvider, tokenAddress: string, owner: string): Promise<bigint> {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    return contract.balanceOf(owner);
  }

  async getERC20Info(provider: ethers.BrowserProvider, tokenAddress: string) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    const [symbol, name, decimals] = await Promise.all([
      contract.symbol(),
      contract.name(),
      contract.decimals(),
    ]);
    return { symbol, name, decimals: Number(decimals) };
  }

  async approveERC20(signer: ethers.Signer, tokenAddress: string, spender: string, amount: bigint) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC20_ABI, signer);
    const tx = await contract.approve(spender, amount);
    return tx.wait();
  }

  async transferERC20(signer: ethers.Signer, tokenAddress: string, to: string, amount: bigint) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC20_ABI, signer);
    const tx = await contract.transfer(to, amount);
    return tx.wait();
  }

  async transferNative(signer: ethers.Signer, to: string, amount: string) {
    const tx = await signer.sendTransaction({ to, value: ethers.parseEther(amount) });
    return tx.wait();
  }

  async transferERC721(signer: ethers.Signer, tokenAddress: string, from: string, to: string, tokenId: string) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC721_ABI, signer);
    const tx = await contract.safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
    return tx.wait();
  }

  async transferERC1155(signer: ethers.Signer, tokenAddress: string, from: string, to: string, tokenId: string, amount: bigint) {
    const contract = new ethers.Contract(tokenAddress, ERC1155_ABI, signer);
    const tx = await contract.safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, amount, "0x");
    return tx.wait();
  }

  async scanTokens(provider: ethers.BrowserProvider, address: string, tokenAddresses: string[]): Promise<AssetInfo[]> {
    const assets: AssetInfo[] = [];

    const nativeBal = await this.getNativeBalance(provider, address);
    assets.push({
      type: "NATIVE",
      symbol: "ETH",
      balance: Number(ethers.formatEther(nativeBal)),
      balanceRaw: nativeBal.toString(),
      address: ethers.ZeroAddress,
    });

    for (const addr of tokenAddresses) {
      try {
        const [bal, info] = await Promise.all([
          this.getERC20Balance(provider, addr, address),
          this.getERC20Info(provider, addr),
        ]);
        if (bal > 0n) {
          assets.push({
            type: "ERC-20",
            symbol: info.symbol,
            balance: Number(ethers.formatUnits(bal, info.decimals)),
            balanceRaw: bal.toString(),
            address: addr,
            decimals: info.decimals,
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // skip tokens that fail
      }
    }

    return assets;
  }
}
```

### packages/sdk/src/wallet/index.ts

```typescript
import { ethers } from "ethers";
import EventEmitter from "eventemitter3";
import type { WalletState, AssetInfo } from "../types";

export class WalletModule extends EventEmitter {
  provider: ethers.BrowserProvider | null = null;
  state: WalletState = {
    address: null,
    chainId: null,
    chainName: null,
    connected: false,
    assets: [],
  };

  async connect(): Promise<{ address: string; chainId: number }> {
    const ethereum = (window as any).ethereum;
    if (!ethereum) throw new Error("No wallet provider found");

    this.provider = new ethers.BrowserProvider(ethereum);
    await this.provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);

    const signer = await this.provider.getSigner();
    const address = await signer.getAddress();
    const network = await this.provider.getNetwork();
    const chainId = Number(network.chainId);

    this.state = { ...this.state, address, chainId, connected: true };
    this.emit("connect", { address, chainId });

    this._listenForChanges(ethereum);
    return { address, chainId };
  }

  async disconnect() {
    this.state = { address: null, chainId: null, chainName: null, connected: false, assets: [] };
    this.provider = null;
    this.emit("disconnect");
  }

  async getAddress(): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.provider) throw new Error("Wallet not connected");
    const signer = await this.provider.getSigner();
    return signer.getAddress();
  }

  async getSigner(): Promise<ethers.Signer> {
    if (!this.provider) throw new Error("Wallet not connected");
    return this.provider.getSigner();
  }

  async signMessage(message: string): Promise<string> {
    const signer = await this.getSigner();
    return signer.signMessage(message);
  }

  async signTypedData(domain: any, types: any, value: any): Promise<string> {
    const signer = await this.getSigner();
    return (signer as ethers.Signer & { signTypedData: any }).signTypedData(domain, types, value);
  }

  private _listenForChanges(ethereum: any) {
    ethereum.on?.("accountsChanged", (accounts: string[]) => {
      if (accounts.length === 0) {
        this.disconnect();
      } else {
        this.state.address = accounts[0];
        this.emit("accountChanged", accounts[0]);
      }
    });

    ethereum.on?.("chainChanged", (chainIdHex: string) => {
      const chainId = parseInt(chainIdHex, 16);
      this.state.chainId = chainId;
      this.emit("chainChanged", chainId);
    });
  }
}
```

### project/src/App.tsx

```tsx
import { WagmiProvider } from 'wagmi';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { wagmiConfig, wagmiAdapter, SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from './wagmiConfig';
import WagmiWalletButton from './components/WagmiWalletButton';
import SessionPanel from './components/SessionPanel';
import { Shield, Wallet, Key, ExternalLink, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

const queryClient = new QueryClient();

const CONTRACT_ROWS: { label: string; value: string; desc: string }[] = [
  { label: 'Factory', value: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.factory, desc: 'CREATE2 smart wallet factory' },
  { label: 'SessionManager', value: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.sessionManager, desc: 'Sequence session authorization manager' },
  { label: 'EIP-7702 Module', value: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.eip7702Module, desc: 'EOA delegation module' },
  { label: 'Permit2Executor', value: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.permit2Executor, desc: 'Permit2 execution target' },
];

function ContractsStrip() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5">
        <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">Sequence 0x Runtime Contracts</p>
        <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">Reference addresses used by this one-signature runtime</p>
      </div>
      <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
        {CONTRACT_ROWS.map((row) => (
          <div key={row.label} className="px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-white/80 text-xs font-semibold">{row.label}</p>
              <p className="text-white/30 text-xs mt-0.5">{row.desc}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-white/40 text-xs font-mono hidden md:block">
              {row.value.slice(0, 8)}…{row.value.slice(-6)}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function WalletModalView() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,_rgba(59,130,246,0.14),_transparent_35%),#07090d] text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-[520px] items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] border border-white/10 bg-[#0f1117] shadow-[0_30px_100px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)]">
          <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-5 py-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-cyan-500 shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30">
                  <Wallet className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-blue-300/80">
                    Connect Wallet
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold text-white">
                    WalletConnect + One Signature
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <WagmiWalletButton />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4 px-5 py-5">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-blue-500/15 bg-blue-500/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-blue-200">
              Use the wallet button once. After connect, the session flow below continues into a single EIP-712 authorization.
            </div>
            <SessionPanel autoRun />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DApp() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const view = params.get('view');

  if (view === 'wallet-modal') {
    return <WalletModalView />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#080a0f] text-white">
      <header className="border-b border-white/5 backdrop-blur-md bg-black/30 sticky top-0 z-40">
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-cyan-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30">
              <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm tracking-tight">WagmiKit</span>
              <span className="ml-2 text-white/30 text-xs hidden sm:inline">One-Time EIP-712 Authorization</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <WagmiWalletButton />
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 py-12">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 px-4 py-1.5 text-blue-300 text-xs font-medium mb-6">
            <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Sequence Session Authorization · One EIP-712 Signature
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight mb-4 leading-tight">
            Single Signature
            <br />
            <span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 via-cyan-400 to-emerald-400">
              Sequence Runtime
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-white/40 text-base max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            Connect once, sign one EIP-712 session authorization, and persist the generated
            Sequence session for continued use.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-10">
          {[
            {
              icon: <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />,
              label: 'One Signature',
              sub: 'Single EIP-712 session auth',
            },
            {
              icon: <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />,
              label: 'Persisted Session',
              sub: 'Stored in Supabase sequence_sessions',
            },
            {
              icon: <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />,
              label: 'Ready For St3',
              sub: 'Embedded runtime for wallet flows',
            },
          ].map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.label}
              className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-transparent border border-white/10 p-4 space-y-2"
            >
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center">
                {item.icon}
              </div>
              <p className="text-white text-sm font-semibold">{item.label}</p>
              <p className="text-white/40 text-xs">{item.sub}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5">
              <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">WalletConnect Flow</p>
              <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">
                Use the top-right wallet button once. After wallet connect, this page automatically asks for the single EIP-712 session signature.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="px-6 py-6">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-blue-500/20 bg-blue-500/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-blue-200">
                Top-right <span className="font-semibold">Connect Wallet</span> is the only connect action.
                Once connected, the session panel below immediately continues into one EIP-712 signature.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <SessionPanel autoRun />

          <ContractsStrip />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const config = wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig ?? wagmiConfig;
  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={config}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <DApp />
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * Drop-in Wagmi Wallet Plugin
 *
 * Usage on any site:
 *   import { WagmiPlugin } from './WagmiPlugin';
 *   <WagmiPlugin />
 *
 * This wraps WagmiWalletButton with its own WagmiProvider + QueryClientProvider
 * so it is fully self-contained and can be embedded anywhere.
 */
import { WagmiProvider } from 'wagmi';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { wagmiAdapter, wagmiConfig } from './wagmiConfig';
import WagmiWalletButton from './components/WagmiWalletButton';

const queryClient = new QueryClient();

export function WagmiPlugin() {
  const config = wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig ?? wagmiConfig;
  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={config}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <WagmiWalletButton />
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}
```

### project/src/components/BatchCallsPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, useWalletClient } from 'wagmi';
import { parseEther, type Hex, type Address } from 'viem';
import { Layers, Plus, Trash2, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from '../wagmiConfig';

interface Call {
  to: string;
  value: string;
  data: string;
}

type TxStatus = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error';

export default function BatchCallsPanel() {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const chainId = useChainId();
  const { data: walletClient } = useWalletClient();

  const [calls, setCalls] = useState<Call[]>([
    { to: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.batchMulticall, value: '0', data: '0x' },
    { to: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.guest, value: '0', data: '0x' },
  ]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TxStatus>('idle');
  const [txHash, setTxHash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);
  const [capabilities, setCapabilities] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);

  const addCall = () => setCalls(c => [...c, { to: '', value: '0', data: '0x' }]);
  const removeCall = (i: number) => setCalls(c => c.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
  const updateCall = (i: number, field: keyof Call, val: string) =>
    setCalls(c => c.map((call, idx) => idx === i ? { ...call, [field]: val } : call));

  const checkCapabilities = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!walletClient || !address) return;
    try {
      const caps = await walletClient.request({
        // @ts-expect-error - wallet_getCapabilities not yet in viem types
        method: 'wallet_getCapabilities',
        params: [address],
      });
      setCapabilities(caps as Record<string, unknown>);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('wallet_getCapabilities not supported:', err);
      setCapabilities({});
    }
  }, [walletClient, address]);

  const sendCalls = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!walletClient || !address) return;
    if (calls.some(c => !c.to)) return;

    setStatus('pending');
    setTxHash(null);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const result = await walletClient.request({
        // @ts-expect-error - wallet_sendCalls not yet in viem types
        method: 'wallet_sendCalls',
        params: [{
          version: '2.0.0',
          chainId: `0x${chainId.toString(16)}`,
          from: address,
          calls: calls.map(c => ({
            to: c.to as Address,
            value: `0x${parseEther(c.value || '0').toString(16)}`,
            data: (c.data || '0x') as Hex,
          })),
          capabilities: { atomicBatch: { supported: true } },
        }],
      }) as string;

      setTxHash(result);
      setStatus('success');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      setErrorMsg(msg);
      setStatus('error');
    }
  }, [walletClient, address, chainId, calls]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-6 text-center">
        <Layers className="w-8 h-8 text-white/20 mx-auto mb-2" />
        <p className="text-white/30 text-sm">Connect a wallet to use Batch Calls</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/20 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 text-left">
          <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">Transaction Batch</p>
          <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">ERC-5792 · wallet_sendCalls · atomic execution</p>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-white/30 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4 border-t border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/5 border border-cyan-500/15 p-3 mt-4">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-cyan-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              Bundle multiple transactions into one atomic batch. Either all succeed or all revert —
              no partial execution. Uses{' '}
              <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-cyan-300">wallet_sendCalls</code> (ERC-5792).
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Get capabilities */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={checkCapabilities}
              className="text-xs text-white/40 hover:text-white/70 underline underline-offset-2 transition-colors"
            >
              Check wallet capabilities
            </button>
            {capabilities !== null && (
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-400/70">
                {Object.keys(capabilities).length > 0 ? 'Capabilities loaded' : 'No capabilities reported'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {capabilities && Object.keys(capabilities).length > 0 && (
            <pre className="rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 p-3 text-xs font-mono text-white/50 overflow-x-auto">
              {JSON.stringify(capabilities, null, 2)}
            </pre>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {calls.map((call, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-white/50 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Call #{i + 1}</span>
                  {calls.length > 1 && (
                    <button onClick={() => removeCall(i)} className="text-red-400/60 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors">
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">To Address</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    value={call.to}
                    onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'to', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Value (ETH)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="0.0"
                      value={call.value}
                      onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'value', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Data (hex)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="0x"
                      value={call.data}
                      onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'data', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addCall}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/15 hover:border-cyan-500/40 py-2.5 text-white/40 hover:text-cyan-400 text-sm transition-all"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Add Call
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={sendCalls}
            disabled={status === 'pending' || calls.some(c => !c.to)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 disabled:bg-cyan-900/40 disabled:text-cyan-300/30 text-white font-semibold py-3 text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20"
          >
            {status === 'pending' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Sending Batch…</>
            ) : (
              <><Layers className="w-4 h-4" />Send Batch</>
            )}
          </button>

          {status === 'success' && txHash && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3">
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-medium">Batch submitted!</p>
                <p className="text-emerald-400/60 text-xs font-mono mt-0.5 break-all">{txHash}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {status === 'error' && errorMsg && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 p-3">
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-red-300 text-xs font-medium">Error</p>
                <p className="text-red-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5 break-all">{errorMsg}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### project/src/components/Eip7702Panel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Eip7702Panel — session-key-as-sender
 *
 * After a session has been created (SessionPanel), the stored session private
 * key is loaded from the database. That key — not the EOA — is used to:
 *   1. signAuthorization  (delegates EOA code → Sequence eip7702Module)
 *   2. sendTransaction    (broadcasts the Type-4 tx with any batch of calls)
 *
 * The EOA never needs to be online for this step.
 */
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, usePublicClient } from 'wagmi';
import {
  createWalletClient, http, parseEther,
  type Hex, type Address,
} from 'viem';
import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';
import {
  mainnet, sepolia, polygon, optimism, arbitrum, base,
} from 'wagmi/chains';
import {
  Zap, Plus, Trash2, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, XCircle,
  Loader, Info, Key, ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from '../wagmiConfig';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { computeImageHash, computeWalletAddress, buildEip7702InitCalldata, defaultConfig } from '../lib/sequenceWallet';

// Map wagmi chainId → viem chain object for createWalletClient
const CHAIN_MAP: Record<number, typeof mainnet> = {
  [mainnet.id]:   mainnet,
  [sepolia.id]:   sepolia,
  [polygon.id]:   polygon,
  [optimism.id]:  optimism,
  [arbitrum.id]:  arbitrum,
  [base.id]:      base,
};

interface Call {
  to:    string;
  value: string;
  data:  string;
}

interface SessionInfo {
  sessionPrivateKey: Hex;
  sessionKey:        Address;
  wallet:            Address;
  eoa:               Address;
}

type TxStatus = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error';

export default function Eip7702Panel() {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const chainId                  = useChainId();
  const publicClient             = usePublicClient();

  const [calls,     setCalls]     = useState<Call[]>([
    { to: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.batchMulticall, value: '0', data: '0x' },
  ]);
  const [session,   setSession]   = useState<SessionInfo | null>(null);
  const [loadingSess, setLoadingSess] = useState(false);
  const [status,    setStatus]    = useState<TxStatus>('idle');
  const [txHash,    setTxHash]    = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg,  setErrorMsg]  = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded,  setExpanded]  = useState(true);

  // Load session from DB whenever address/chain changes
  const loadSession = useCallback(async (eoa: string, cid: number) => {
    setLoadingSess(true);
    setSession(null);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('sequence_sessions')
      .select('session_key, session_private_key, wallet')
      .eq('eoa', eoa.toLowerCase())
      .eq('chain_id', cid)
      .not('session_private_key', 'is', null)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (data?.session_private_key) {
      setSession({
        sessionPrivateKey: data.session_private_key as Hex,
        sessionKey:        data.session_key as Address,
        wallet:            data.wallet as Address,
        eoa:               eoa as Address,
      });
    }
    setLoadingSess(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (address) loadSession(address, chainId);
  }, [address, chainId, loadSession]);

  const addCall    = () => setCalls(c => [...c, { to: '', value: '0', data: '0x' }]);
  const removeCall = (i: number) => setCalls(c => c.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
  const updateCall = (i: number, field: keyof Call, val: string) =>
    setCalls(c => c.map((call, idx) => idx === i ? { ...call, [field]: val } : call));

  const send = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!session || !publicClient) return;
    if (calls.some(c => !c.to)) return;

    setStatus('pending');
    setTxHash(null);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const chain = CHAIN_MAP[chainId] ?? mainnet;

      // Build a local wallet client from the session private key
      const sessionAccount = privateKeyToAccount(session.sessionPrivateKey);
      const sessionClient  = createWalletClient({
        account:   sessionAccount,
        chain,
        transport: http(),
      });

      // Derive the EOA's wallet address and imageHash
      const config    = defaultConfig(session.eoa);
      const imageHash = computeImageHash(config);
      const wallet    = computeWalletAddress(imageHash);

      // 1. Session key signs EIP-7702 authorization delegating EOA → eip7702Module
      const authorization = await sessionClient.signAuthorization({
        account:         sessionAccount,
        contractAddress: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.eip7702Module as Address,
        // executor is the session key (not self-executing from EOA perspective)
      });

      // 2. Session key broadcasts the Type-4 tx:
      //    - authorizationList sets EOA's code to eip7702Module
      //    - data calls updateImageHash on the now-delegated EOA
      //    - additional user calls are encoded as a batch via batchMulticall
      const batchCalls = calls
        .filter(c => c.to)
        .map(c => ({
          to:    c.to as Address,
          value: parseEther(c.value || '0'),
          data:  (c.data || '0x') as Hex,
        }));

      // Encode the batch into a single multicall payload if more than 1 call,
      // otherwise send the single call directly
      const initData = buildEip7702InitCalldata(imageHash);

      const hash = await sessionClient.sendTransaction({
        account:           sessionAccount,
        to:                wallet,
        data:              initData,
        authorizationList: [authorization],
      });

      // 3. If there are additional user calls, send them separately now that delegation is set
      if (batchCalls.length > 0) {
        for (const call of batchCalls) {
          await sessionClient.sendTransaction({
            account: sessionAccount,
            to:      call.to,
            value:   call.value,
            data:    call.data,
          });
        }
      }

      setTxHash(hash);
      setStatus('success');
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      setErrorMsg(msg);
      setStatus('error');
    }
  }, [session, publicClient, chainId, calls]);

  if (!isConnected) return null;

  const short = (a: string) => `${a.slice(0, 6)}…${a.slice(-4)}`;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 text-left">
          <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">EIP-7702 via Session Key</p>
          <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">Session key signs &amp; broadcasts the Type-4 delegation tx</p>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-white/30 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4 border-t border-white/5 pt-4">

          {/* Session status */}
          {loadingSess ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/8 p-3">
              <Loader className="w-4 h-4 text-white/30 animate-spin flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="text-white/30 text-xs">Loading session from database…</span>
            </div>
          ) : session ? (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <p className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold">Session key loaded — ready to sign as sender</p>
                <p className="text-emerald-400/60 text-[11px] font-mono">
                  Session key: {short(session.sessionKey)}
                  <span className="mx-1.5 text-white/20">·</span>
                  Wallet: {short(session.wallet)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/20 p-3">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-amber-300 text-xs font-semibold">No session found</p>
                <p className="text-amber-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5">
                  Go to the <strong>Session</strong> tab and create a session first. The session key will be used here as the EIP-7702 message sender.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Info */}
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/15 p-3">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-blue-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              The <strong className="text-blue-200">session key</strong> (not your EOA) signs the EIP-7702 authorization and broadcasts the Type-4 transaction.
              Your EOA's code is delegated to the Sequence <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-blue-200">eip7702Module</code> in that tx.
              Your EOA never needs to be online for this step.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Calls */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {calls.map((call, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-white/50 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Call #{i + 1}</span>
                  {calls.length > 1 && (
                    <button onClick={() => removeCall(i)} className="text-red-400/60 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors">
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">To Address</label>
                  <input
                    type="text" placeholder="0x..." value={call.to}
                    onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'to', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Value (ETH)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text" placeholder="0.0" value={call.value}
                      onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'value', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Data (hex)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text" placeholder="0x" value={call.data}
                      onChange={e => updateCall(i, 'data', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={addCall}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/15 hover:border-blue-500/40 py-2.5 text-white/40 hover:text-blue-400 text-sm transition-all"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Add Call
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={send}
            disabled={!session || status === 'pending' || calls.some(c => !c.to)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:bg-blue-900/40 disabled:text-blue-300/30 text-white font-semibold py-3 text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20"
          >
            {status === 'pending' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Sending via session key…</>
            ) : (
              <><Key className="w-4 h-4" />Send EIP-7702 (session key as sender)</>
            )}
          </button>

          {status === 'success' && txHash && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3">
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold">Delegation tx submitted by session key</p>
                <p className="text-emerald-400/60 text-xs font-mono mt-0.5 break-all">{txHash}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {status === 'error' && errorMsg && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 p-3">
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-red-300 text-xs font-semibold">Error</p>
                <p className="text-red-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5 break-all">{errorMsg}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, useWalletClient, usePublicClient } from 'wagmi';
import { type Hex, type Address, hashTypedData, encodeAbiParameters, parseAbiParameters } from 'viem';
import { Wind, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader, Info, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from '../wagmiConfig';

// Minimal ForwardRequest type for EIP-2771 gasless meta-tx
interface ForwardRequest {
  from: Address;
  to: Address;
  value: string;
  gas: string;
  nonce: string;
  deadline: string;
  data: Hex;
}

type TxStatus = 'idle' | 'signing' | 'relaying' | 'success' | 'error';

// EIP-712 domain + types for a generic MinimalForwarder (OpenZeppelin-compatible)
function buildTypedData(request: ForwardRequest, chainId: number, forwarderAddress: Address) {
  return {
    domain: {
      name: 'MinimalForwarder',
      version: '0.0.1',
      chainId,
      verifyingContract: forwarderAddress,
    },
    types: {
      ForwardRequest: [
        { name: 'from', type: 'address' },
        { name: 'to', type: 'address' },
        { name: 'value', type: 'uint256' },
        { name: 'gas', type: 'uint256' },
        { name: 'nonce', type: 'uint256' },
        { name: 'deadline', type: 'uint48' },
        { name: 'data', type: 'bytes' },
      ],
    },
    primaryType: 'ForwardRequest' as const,
    message: {
      from: request.from,
      to: request.to as Address,
      value: BigInt(request.value || '0'),
      gas: BigInt(request.gas || '200000'),
      nonce: BigInt(request.nonce || '0'),
      deadline: BigInt(request.deadline),
      data: request.data,
    },
  };
}

export default function GaslessPanel() {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const chainId = useChainId();
  const { data: walletClient } = useWalletClient();
  const publicClient = usePublicClient();

  const [forwarder, setForwarder] = useState(SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.guest);
  const [relayerUrl, setRelayerUrl] = useState('');
  const [toAddress, setToAddress] = useState('');
  const [callData, setCallData] = useState('0x');
  const [gasLimit, setGasLimit] = useState('200000');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TxStatus>('idle');
  const [signature, setSignature] = useState<Hex | null>(null);
  const [txHash, setTxHash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  // Read on-chain nonce from forwarder (nonces(address))
  const fetchNonce = useCallback(async (): Promise<bigint> => {
    if (!publicClient || !address || !forwarder) return 0n;
    try {
      const result = await publicClient.readContract({
        address: forwarder as Address,
        abi: [{ name: 'nonces', type: 'function', stateMutability: 'view', inputs: [{ name: 'owner', type: 'address' }], outputs: [{ name: '', type: 'uint256' }] }],
        functionName: 'nonces',
        args: [address],
      });
      return result as bigint;
    } catch {
      return 0n;
    }
  }, [publicClient, address, forwarder]);

  const signAndRelay = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!walletClient || !address || !toAddress || !forwarder) return;

    setStatus('signing');
    setSignature(null);
    setTxHash(null);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const nonce = await fetchNonce();
      const deadline = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600; // 1 hour

      const request: ForwardRequest = {
        from: address,
        to: toAddress as Address,
        value: '0',
        gas: gasLimit,
        nonce: nonce.toString(),
        deadline: deadline.toString(),
        data: (callData || '0x') as Hex,
      };

      const typedData = buildTypedData(request, chainId, forwarder as Address);

      // EIP-712 sign
      const sig = await walletClient.signTypedData(typedData);
      setSignature(sig);

      // Hash for display
      const digest = hashTypedData(typedData);

      if (relayerUrl) {
        setStatus('relaying');
        const response = await fetch(relayerUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            request,
            signature: sig,
            digest,
            forwarder,
            chainId,
          }),
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Relayer error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
        const json = await response.json() as { txHash?: string; hash?: string };
        setTxHash(json.txHash ?? json.hash ?? 'relayed');
      }

      setStatus('success');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      setErrorMsg(msg);
      setStatus('error');
    }
  }, [walletClient, address, toAddress, forwarder, relayerUrl, callData, gasLimit, chainId, fetchNonce]);

  const encodedPayload = signature
    ? encodeAbiParameters(
        parseAbiParameters('address from, address to, uint256 value, uint256 gas, uint256 nonce, bytes data, bytes sig'),
        [address as Address, toAddress as Address || '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', 0n, BigInt(gasLimit || '200000'), 0n, (callData || '0x') as Hex, signature]
      )
    : null;

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-6 text-center">
        <Wind className="w-8 h-8 text-white/20 mx-auto mb-2" />
        <p className="text-white/30 text-sm">Connect a wallet to use Gasless Batch</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Wind className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 text-left">
          <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">EIP-712 Gasless Batch</p>
          <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">Meta-transactions · EIP-2771 forwarder · relayer-sponsored</p>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-white/30 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4 border-t border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/15 p-3 mt-4">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-emerald-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              Sign a typed{' '}
              <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-emerald-300">ForwardRequest</code> with EIP-712.
              A relayer pays gas and submits the tx on-chain via an EIP-2771 forwarder contract.
              No ETH required by the signer.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/15 p-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-amber-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              Requires a deployed{' '}
              <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-amber-300">MinimalForwarder</code> contract
              and a running relayer endpoint. Compatible with OpenZeppelin's EIP-2771 implementation.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Forwarder + Relayer */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Forwarder Contract Address</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="0x... (MinimalForwarder)"
                value={forwarder}
                onChange={e => setForwarder(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Relayer Endpoint URL <span className="text-white/20">(optional — sign only if empty)</span></label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="https://your-relayer.example.com/relay"
                value={relayerUrl}
                onChange={e => setRelayerUrl(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Call params */}
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-4 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-white/50 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Transaction Details</span>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Target Contract (to)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="0x..."
                value={toAddress}
                onChange={e => setToAddress(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Gas Limit</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="200000"
                  value={gasLimit}
                  onChange={e => setGasLimit(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Call Data</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="0x..."
                  value={callData}
                  onChange={e => setCallData(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={signAndRelay}
            disabled={['signing', 'relaying'].includes(status) || !toAddress || !forwarder}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:bg-emerald-900/40 disabled:text-emerald-300/30 text-white font-semibold py-3 text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20"
          >
            {status === 'signing' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Signing…</>
            ) : status === 'relaying' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Relaying…</>
            ) : (
              <><Wind className="w-4 h-4" />{relayerUrl ? 'Sign & Relay (Gasless)' : 'Sign Meta-Tx'}</>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Signature output */}
          {signature && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-white/30 text-xs">EIP-712 Signature</p>
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 p-3">
                <p className="text-white/50 text-xs font-mono break-all">{signature}</p>
              </div>
              {encodedPayload && (
                <>
                  <p className="text-white/30 text-xs mt-2">ABI-encoded payload (for relayer)</p>
                  <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 p-3">
                    <p className="text-white/50 text-xs font-mono break-all">{encodedPayload}</p>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {status === 'success' && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3">
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-medium">{txHash ? 'Transaction relayed!' : 'Signature ready!'}</p>
                {txHash && <p className="text-emerald-400/60 text-xs font-mono mt-0.5 break-all">{txHash}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {status === 'error' && errorMsg && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 p-3">
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-red-300 text-xs font-medium">Error</p>
                <p className="text-red-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5 break-all">{errorMsg}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
