### project/src/components/Permit2Panel.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, useWalletClient, usePublicClient } from 'wagmi';
import { type Address, type Hex, maxUint160, maxUint48 } from 'viem';
import { Key, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader, Info, AlertTriangle, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from '../wagmiConfig';

// Canonical Permit2 address — Sequence 0x singleton
const PERMIT2_ADDRESS: Address = SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.permit2 as Address;

// EIP-712 types for Permit2 PermitSingle
const permit2Types = {
  PermitSingle: [
    { name: 'details', type: 'PermitDetails' },
    { name: 'spender', type: 'address' },
    { name: 'sigDeadline', type: 'uint256' },
  ],
  PermitDetails: [
    { name: 'token', type: 'address' },
    { name: 'amount', type: 'uint160' },
    { name: 'expiration', type: 'uint48' },
    { name: 'nonce', type: 'uint48' },
  ],
} as const;

const permit2Abi = [
  {
    name: 'allowance',
    type: 'function',
    stateMutability: 'view',
    inputs: [
      { name: 'user', type: 'address' },
      { name: 'token', type: 'address' },
      { name: 'spender', type: 'address' },
    ],
    outputs: [
      { name: 'amount', type: 'uint160' },
      { name: 'expiration', type: 'uint48' },
      { name: 'nonce', type: 'uint48' },
    ],
  },
  {
    name: 'permit',
    type: 'function',
    stateMutability: 'nonpayable',
    inputs: [
      { name: 'owner', type: 'address' },
      { name: 'permitSingle', type: 'tuple', components: [
        { name: 'details', type: 'tuple', components: [
          { name: 'token', type: 'address' },
          { name: 'amount', type: 'uint160' },
          { name: 'expiration', type: 'uint48' },
          { name: 'nonce', type: 'uint48' },
        ]},
        { name: 'spender', type: 'address' },
        { name: 'sigDeadline', type: 'uint256' },
      ]},
      { name: 'signature', type: 'bytes' },
    ],
    outputs: [],
  },
] as const;

type TxStatus = 'idle' | 'fetching' | 'signing' | 'submitting' | 'success' | 'error';

interface AllowanceInfo {
  amount: bigint;
  expiration: bigint;
  nonce: bigint;
}

export default function Permit2Panel() {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const chainId = useChainId();
  const { data: walletClient } = useWalletClient();
  const publicClient = usePublicClient();

  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [spender, setSpender] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [expiration, setExpiration] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TxStatus>('idle');
  const [signature, setSignature] = useState<Hex | null>(null);
  const [txHash, setTxHash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [allowance, setAllowance] = useState<AllowanceInfo | null>(null);
  const [submitOnChain, setSubmitOnChain] = useState(false);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const fetchAllowance = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!publicClient || !address || !token || !spender) return;
    setStatus('fetching');
    try {
      const result = await publicClient.readContract({
        address: PERMIT2_ADDRESS,
        abi: permit2Abi,
        functionName: 'allowance',
        args: [address, token as Address, spender as Address],
      });
      setAllowance({ amount: result[0], expiration: result[1], nonce: result[2] });
      setStatus('idle');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setStatus('idle');
    }
  }, [publicClient, address, token, spender]);

  const signPermit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!walletClient || !address || !token || !spender) return;

    setStatus('signing');
    setSignature(null);
    setTxHash(null);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const nonce = allowance?.nonce ?? 0n;
      const sigDeadline = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600);
      const permitAmount = amount ? BigInt(amount) : maxUint160;
      const permitExpiration = expiration
        ? BigInt(expiration)
        : maxUint48;

      const permitSingle = {
        details: {
          token: token as Address,
          amount: permitAmount,
          expiration: permitExpiration,
          nonce: Number(nonce),
        },
        spender: spender as Address,
        sigDeadline,
      };

      const sig = await walletClient.signTypedData({
        domain: {
          name: 'Permit2',
          chainId,
          verifyingContract: PERMIT2_ADDRESS,
        },
        types: permit2Types,
        primaryType: 'PermitSingle',
        message: permitSingle,
      });

      setSignature(sig);

      if (submitOnChain) {
        setStatus('submitting');
        const hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
          address: PERMIT2_ADDRESS,
          abi: permit2Abi,
          functionName: 'permit',
          args: [address, {
            details: {
              token: token as Address,
              amount: permitAmount,
              expiration: permitExpiration,
              nonce: Number(nonce),
            },
            spender: spender as Address,
            sigDeadline,
          }, sig],
        });
        setTxHash(hash);
      }

      setStatus('success');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      setErrorMsg(msg);
      setStatus('error');
    }
  }, [walletClient, address, token, spender, amount, expiration, chainId, allowance, submitOnChain]);

  const formatAmount = (val: bigint) => {
    if (val === maxUint160) return 'Max (unlimited)';
    return val.toString();
  };

  const formatExpiry = (val: bigint) => {
    if (val === maxUint48) return 'No expiry';
    const d = new Date(Number(val) * 1000);
    return d.toLocaleString();
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-6 text-center">
        <Key className="w-8 h-8 text-white/20 mx-auto mb-2" />
        <p className="text-white/30 text-sm">Connect a wallet to use Permit2</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isWorking = ['fetching', 'signing', 'submitting'].includes(status);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 text-left">
          <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">Permit2</p>
          <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">Uniswap Permit2 · signature-based token approvals · gasless</p>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-white/30 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4 border-t border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/15 p-3 mt-4">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-amber-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              Permit2 replaces{' '}
              <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-amber-300">approve()</code> with a signed message.
              No gas for the user, expirable allowances, and works with any ERC-20. Canonical address on all chains:{' '}
              <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded text-amber-300 font-mono">0x0000…cBA3</code>
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Permit2 contract link */}
          <a
            href={`https://etherscan.io/address/${PERMIT2_ADDRESS}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-white/30 hover:text-white/60 transition-colors"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
            View Permit2 contract on Etherscan
          </a>

          {/* Inputs */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">ERC-20 Token Address</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="0x... (token to approve)"
                value={token}
                onChange={e => setToken(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Spender Address</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="0x... (contract allowed to spend)"
                value={spender}
                onChange={e => setSpender(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Amount <span className="text-white/20">(wei, blank = max)</span></label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="max"
                  value={amount}
                  onChange={e => setAmount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Expiration <span className="text-white/20">(unix, blank = max)</span></label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="no expiry"
                  value={expiration}
                  onChange={e => setExpiration(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-sm placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Current allowance */}
          {token && spender && (
            <button
              onClick={fetchAllowance}
              disabled={status === 'fetching'}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-white/40 hover:text-white/70 underline underline-offset-2 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {status === 'fetching' ? <Loader className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" /> : null}
              Fetch current Permit2 allowance
            </button>
          )}

          {allowance && (
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3 space-y-1.5">
              <p className="text-white/40 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Current Allowance</p>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-white/40">Amount</span>
                <span className="text-white/70 font-mono">{formatAmount(allowance.amount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-white/40">Expiration</span>
                <span className="text-white/70">{formatExpiry(allowance.expiration)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-white/40">Nonce</span>
                <span className="text-white/70 font-mono">{allowance.nonce.toString()}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Submit on-chain option */}
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer group">
            <div
              onClick={() => setSubmitOnChain(v => !v)}
              className={`w-9 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center transition-colors ${submitOnChain ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-white/10'}`}
            >
              <span className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ml-0.5 ${submitOnChain ? 'translate-x-4' : ''}`} />
            </div>
            <span className="text-white/50 text-xs group-hover:text-white/70 transition-colors">
              Submit permit on-chain after signing <span className="text-white/30">(costs gas)</span>
            </span>
          </label>

          {submitOnChain && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/15 p-3">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-amber-300/60 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                On-chain submission requires the token to already be approved for Permit2 first
                (one-time <code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded">approve(Permit2, max)</code>).
                After that, all future permits are gasless for the user.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={signPermit}
            disabled={isWorking || !token || !spender}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:bg-amber-900/40 disabled:text-amber-300/30 text-white font-semibold py-3 text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20"
          >
            {status === 'signing' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Signing Permit…</>
            ) : status === 'submitting' ? (
              <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Submitting On-chain…</>
            ) : (
              <><Key className="w-4 h-4" />Sign Permit2</>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Signature output */}
          {signature && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-white/30 text-xs">Permit2 Signature (EIP-712)</p>
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 p-3">
                <p className="text-white/50 text-xs font-mono break-all">{signature}</p>
              </div>
              <p className="text-white/20 text-xs">
                Pass this signature + permit params to any Permit2-aware contract's
                {' '}<code className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded">permitTransferFrom()</code> or similar function.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {status === 'success' && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3">
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-medium">
                  {txHash ? 'Permit submitted on-chain!' : 'Signature ready!'}
                </p>
                {txHash && <p className="text-emerald-400/60 text-xs font-mono mt-0.5 break-all">{txHash}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {status === 'error' && errorMsg && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 p-3">
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-red-300 text-xs font-medium">Error</p>
                <p className="text-red-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5 break-all">{errorMsg}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### project/src/components/SequenceConnectButton.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, usePublicClient, useWalletClient, useDisconnect } from 'wagmi';
import { useAppKit } from '@reown/appkit/react';
import { type Address, type Hex } from 'viem';
import { privateKeyToAccount, generatePrivateKey } from 'viem/accounts';
import {
  computeImageHash, computeWalletAddress, buildSessionAuthMessage,
  defaultConfig, defaultSession, isDeployed,
} from '../lib/sequenceWallet';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  Shield, ShieldCheck, Loader, ChevronDown, LogOut, Copy,
  CheckCheck, Key, AlertTriangle, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface SequenceSessionData {
  eoa:              Address;
  wallet:           Address;
  imageHash:        Hex;
  sessionKey:       Address;
  sessionPrivateKey: Hex;
  sessionSig:       Hex;
  chainId:          number;
  isDeployed:       boolean;
  dbId:             string | null;
}

export interface SequenceConnectButtonProps {
  label?:     string;
  compact?:   boolean;
  onSession?: (data: SequenceSessionData) => void;
  onError?:   (err: Error) => void;
  className?: string;
}

type Step = 'idle' | 'computing' | 'signing-session' | 'saving' | 'ready' | 'error';

const STEP_MSG: Partial<Record<Step, string>> = {
  computing:        'Computing wallet…',
  'signing-session':'Sign: session auth…',
  saving:           'Saving…',
};

export default function SequenceConnectButton({
  label     = 'Connect & Authorize',
  compact   = false,
  onSession,
  onError,
  className = '',
}: SequenceConnectButtonProps) {
  const { address, isConnected }  = useAccount();
  const { disconnect }            = useDisconnect();
  const { open }                  = useAppKit();
  const chainId                   = useChainId();
  const { data: walletClient }    = useWalletClient();
  const publicClient              = usePublicClient();

  const [step,     setStep]     = useState<Step>('idle');
  const [session,  setSession]  = useState<SequenceSessionData | null>(null);
  const [errMsg,   setErrMsg]   = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showMenu, setShowMenu] = useState(false);
  const [copied,   setCopied]   = useState(false);
  const menuRef  = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hasRun   = useRef(false);

  const addrRef    = useRef(address);
  const wcRef      = useRef(walletClient);
  const pcRef      = useRef(publicClient);
  const cidRef     = useRef(chainId);
  const cbRef      = useRef(onSession);
  const errCbRef   = useRef(onError);
  useEffect(() => { addrRef.current  = address;      }, [address]);
  useEffect(() => { wcRef.current    = walletClient; }, [walletClient]);
  useEffect(() => { pcRef.current    = publicClient; }, [publicClient]);
  useEffect(() => { cidRef.current   = chainId;      }, [chainId]);
  useEffect(() => { cbRef.current    = onSession;    }, [onSession]);
  useEffect(() => { errCbRef.current = onError;      }, [onError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setShowMenu(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    hasRun.current = false;
    setSession(null);
    setStep('idle');
    setErrMsg(null);
  }, [address]);

  const runFlow = useCallback(async () => {
    const addr = addrRef.current;
    const wc   = wcRef.current;
    const pc   = pcRef.current;
    const cid  = cidRef.current;

    if (!addr || !wc || !pc || hasRun.current) return;
    hasRun.current = true;

    setErrMsg(null);
    setSession(null);
    setStep('computing');

    const config    = defaultConfig(addr as Address);
    const imageHash = computeImageHash(config);
    const wallet    = computeWalletAddress(imageHash);

    // Check deployment
    const bytecode = await pc.getBytecode({ address: wallet }).catch(() => null);
    const deployed  = isDeployed(bytecode as Hex | null);

    // Single EIP-712 signature
    setStep('signing-session');
    const sessionPrivateKey = generatePrivateKey();
    const sessionKey        = privateKeyToAccount(sessionPrivateKey).address as Address;
    const nonce             = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
    const sc                = defaultSession(sessionKey, []);
    let sessionSig: Hex;
    try {
      const msg = buildSessionAuthMessage(cid, wallet, sc, nonce);
      sessionSig = await wc.signTypedData({
        account:     addr as Address,
        domain:      msg.domain,
        types:       msg.types,
        primaryType: msg.primaryType,
        message:     msg.message,
      }) as Hex;
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
      setErrMsg(e.message);
      setStep('error');
      errCbRef.current?.(e);
      hasRun.current = false;
      return;
    }

    setStep('saving');
    const { data: saved } = await supabase
      .from('sequence_sessions')
      .insert({
        eoa:                 addr.toLowerCase(),
        wallet:              wallet.toLowerCase(),
        image_hash:          imageHash,
        session_key:         sessionKey.toLowerCase(),
        session_private_key: sessionPrivateKey,
        chain_id:            cid,
        signature:           sessionSig,
        deadline:            sc.deadline,
        nonce:               Number(nonce),
        permissions:         sc.permissions.map(p => ({
          target:     p.target,
          valueLimit: p.valueLimit.toString(),
          deadline:   p.deadline,
        })),
        is_deployed: deployed,
      })
      .select('id')
      .maybeSingle();

    const result: SequenceSessionData = {
      eoa:              addr as Address,
      wallet,
      imageHash,
      sessionKey,
      sessionPrivateKey,
      sessionSig,
      chainId:          cid,
      isDeployed:       deployed,
      dbId:             saved?.id ?? null,
    };
    setSession(result);
    setStep('ready');
    cbRef.current?.(result);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && walletClient && !hasRun.current) runFlow();
  }, [isConnected, walletClient, runFlow]);

  const short      = (a: string) => `${a.slice(0, 6)}…${a.slice(-4)}`;
  const isRunning  = ['computing', 'signing-session', 'saving'].includes(step);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <button
        onClick={() => open({ view: 'Connect' })}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 active:scale-95 text-white font-semibold ${compact ? 'px-4 py-2 text-xs' : 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm'} shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/25 transition-all duration-150 ${className}`}
      >
        <Shield className={compact ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'} />
        {label}
      </button>
    );
  }

  if (isRunning) {
    return (
      <button disabled className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-900/50 border border-blue-500/20 text-blue-300/70 font-semibold ${compact ? 'px-4 py-2 text-xs' : 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm'} ${className}`}>
        <Loader className={`animate-spin ${compact ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'}`} />
        {STEP_MSG[step] ?? 'Working…'}
      </button>
    );
  }

  if (step === 'error') {
    return (
      <button
        onClick={() => { hasRun.current = false; setStep('idle'); runFlow(); }}
        title={errMsg ?? undefined}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-red-900/30 border border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-900/50 text-red-300 font-semibold ${compact ? 'px-4 py-2 text-xs' : 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm'} transition-all ${className}`}
      >
        <AlertTriangle className={compact ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'} /> Retry
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`} ref={menuRef}>
      <button
        onClick={() => setShowMenu(v => !v)}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0f1117] hover:bg-[#181c27] border ${session ? 'border-emerald-500/30 hover:border-emerald-400/40' : 'border-white/10'} text-white font-medium ${compact ? 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-2.5 text-sm'} shadow-lg transition-all duration-150`}
      >
        {session ? <ShieldCheck className={`text-emerald-400 ${compact ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'}`} /> : <Shield className={`text-white/40 ${compact ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'}`} />}
        <span className="font-mono">{short(address!)}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`text-white/30 transition-transform ${compact ? 'w-3 h-3' : 'w-3.5 h-3.5'} ${showMenu ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {showMenu && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-72 rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 shadow-2xl z-[100] overflow-hidden" style={{ boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)' }}>
          {session && (
            <div className="px-4 py-4 border-b border-white/5 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span className="text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold">Session Active</span>
              </div>
              {[
                { label: 'EOA',         val: short(session.eoa)       },
                { label: 'Wallet',      val: short(session.wallet)    },
                { label: 'Session Key', val: short(session.sessionKey)},
                { label: 'Status',      val: session.isDeployed ? 'Deployed' : 'Not deployed', color: session.isDeployed ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-amber-400' },
                { label: 'Chain',       val: String(session.chainId)  },
                { label: 'Expires',     val: 'Never'                  },
              ].map(r => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="text-white/30">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className={`font-mono ${r.color ?? 'text-white/60'}`}>{r.val}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="p-2 space-y-0.5">
            {session && (
              <>
                <button onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(session.wallet); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">
                  {copied ? <CheckCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  Copy wallet address
                </button>
                <a href={`https://etherscan.io/address/${session.wallet}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">
                  <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /> View on Explorer
                </a>
                <button
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (session?.dbId) await supabase.from('sequence_sessions').delete().eq('id', session.dbId);
                    hasRun.current = false; setStep('idle'); setShowMenu(false); runFlow();
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all"
                >
                  <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" /> New session key
                </button>
              </>
            )}
            <button onClick={() => { disconnect(); setShowMenu(false); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-red-400/70 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/5 transition-all">
              <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" /> Disconnect
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### project/src/components/SessionPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAccount, useChainId, usePublicClient, useWalletClient } from 'wagmi';
import { type Address, type Hex } from 'viem';
import { generatePrivateKey, privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';
import {
  computeImageHash,
  computeWalletAddress,
  buildSessionAuthMessage,
  defaultConfig,
  defaultSession,
  isDeployed,
  NO_EXPIRY,
} from '../lib/sequenceWallet';
import { SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS } from '../wagmiConfig';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  Shield, Key, Zap, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader, Copy,
  CheckCheck, ChevronDown, RefreshCw, Plus, Trash2, ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, Info,
} from 'lucide-react';

type FlowStep = 'idle' | 'computing' | 'signing-session' | 'saving' | 'done' | 'error';

interface FlowState {
  imageHash:         Hex     | null;
  walletAddress:     Address | null;
  isDeployed:        boolean;
  sessionKey:        Address | null;
  sessionPrivateKey: Hex     | null;
  sessionSig:        Hex     | null;
  savedId:           string  | null;
  error:             string  | null;
}

const INIT: FlowState = {
  imageHash:         null,
  walletAddress:     null,
  isDeployed:        false,
  sessionKey:        null,
  sessionPrivateKey: null,
  sessionSig:        null,
  savedId:           null,
  error:             null,
};

const STEP_LABELS: Record<FlowStep, string> = {
  idle:             '',
  computing:        'Computing wallet address…',
  'signing-session':'Sign session key authorization (EIP-712)…',
  saving:           'Saving session to database…',
  done:             'Session created — persists to database',
  error:            'Error',
};

function CopyButton({ value, className }: { value: string; className?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(value); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); }}
      className={className}
    >
      {copied ? <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
    </button>
  );
}

function AddressRow({ label, value, mono = true, color = 'text-white/70' }: {
  label: string; value: string; mono?: boolean; color?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2.5 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0">
      <span className="text-white/40 text-xs flex-shrink-0">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
        <span className={`text-xs truncate ${mono ? 'font-mono' : ''} ${color}`}>
          {value.length > 42 ? `${value.slice(0, 10)}…${value.slice(-8)}` : value}
        </span>
        <CopyButton value={value} className="flex-shrink-0 text-white/30 hover:text-white transition-colors" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface SessionResult {
  eoa:              Address;
  wallet:           Address;
  imageHash:        Hex;
  sessionKey:       Address;
  sessionPrivateKey: Hex;
  sessionSig:       Hex;
  chainId:          number;
  dbId:             string | null;
}

export default function SessionPanel({
  autoRun = false,
  onSession,
}: {
  autoRun?: boolean;
  onSession?: (s: SessionResult) => void;
}) {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const chainId                  = useChainId();
  const { data: walletClient }   = useWalletClient();
  const publicClient             = usePublicClient();

  const [step,         setStep]         = useState<FlowStep>('idle');
  const [state,        setState]        = useState<FlowState>(INIT);
  const [expanded,     setExpanded]     = useState(true);
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
  const [extraTargets, setExtraTargets] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newTarget,    setNewTarget]    = useState('');
  const [pastSessions, setPastSessions] = useState<{
    id: string; eoa: string; wallet: string; session_key: string; chain_id: number;
    deadline: number; created_at: string; is_deployed: boolean;
  }[]>([]);
  const [loadingHistory, setLoadingHistory] = useState(false);
  const autoRunLockRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const runningRef = useRef(false);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (eoa?: string) => {
    setLoadingHistory(true);
    let query = supabase
      .from('sequence_sessions')
      .select('id, eoa, wallet, session_key, chain_id, deadline, created_at, is_deployed')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(20);

    if (eoa) {
      query = query.eq('eoa', eoa.toLowerCase());
    }

    const { data } = await query;
    setPastSessions(data ?? []);
    setLoadingHistory(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadHistory(address); }, [address, loadHistory]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setState(INIT);
    setStep('idle');
    runningRef.current = false;
    autoRunLockRef.current = null;
  }, [address, chainId]);

  const run = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!address || !walletClient || !publicClient || runningRef.current) return;
    runningRef.current = true;
    setState(INIT);
    setStep('computing');

    const config    = defaultConfig(address as Address);
    const imageHash = computeImageHash(config);
    const wallet    = computeWalletAddress(imageHash);

    // Check deployment
    const bytecode = await publicClient.getBytecode({ address: wallet }).catch(() => null);
    const deployed  = isDeployed(bytecode as Hex | null);
    setState(s => ({ ...s, imageHash, walletAddress: wallet, isDeployed: deployed }));

    // Sign session auth (single EIP-712 signature)
    setStep('signing-session');
    const sessionPrivKey = generatePrivateKey();
    const sessionAccount = privateKeyToAccount(sessionPrivKey);
    const sessionKey     = sessionAccount.address as Address;

    const defaultTargets: Address[] = [
      SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.batchMulticall as Address,
      SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.guest          as Address,
      SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.sessionManager as Address,
      ...extraTargets.filter(t => t.startsWith('0x') && t.length === 42).map(t => t as Address),
    ];

    const sc    = defaultSession(sessionKey, defaultTargets);
    const nonce = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));

    let sessionSig: Hex;
    try {
      const msg = buildSessionAuthMessage(chainId, wallet, sc, nonce);
      sessionSig = await walletClient.signTypedData({
        account:     address as Address,
        domain:      msg.domain,
        types:       msg.types,
        primaryType: msg.primaryType,
        message:     msg.message,
      }) as Hex;
    } catch (err) {
      setState(s => ({ ...s, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) }));
      setStep('error');
      runningRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setState(s => ({ ...s, sessionKey, sessionPrivateKey: sessionPrivKey, sessionSig }));

    setStep('saving');
    const { data: saved, error: dbErr } = await supabase
      .from('sequence_sessions')
      .insert({
        eoa:                 address.toLowerCase(),
        wallet:              wallet.toLowerCase(),
        image_hash:          imageHash,
        session_key:         sessionKey.toLowerCase(),
        session_private_key: sessionPrivKey,
        chain_id:            chainId,
        signature:           sessionSig,
        deadline:            sc.deadline,
        nonce:               Number(nonce),
        permissions:         sc.permissions.map(p => ({
          target:     p.target,
          valueLimit: p.valueLimit.toString(),
          deadline:   p.deadline,
        })),
        is_deployed: deployed,
      })
      .select('id')
      .single();

    if (dbErr) {
      setState(s => ({ ...s, error: dbErr.message }));
      setStep('error');
      runningRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    setState(s => ({ ...s, savedId: saved?.id ?? null }));
    setStep('done');
    onSession?.({
      eoa:              address as Address,
      wallet,
      imageHash,
      sessionKey,
      sessionPrivateKey: sessionPrivKey,
      sessionSig,
      chainId,
      dbId:             saved?.id ?? null,
    });
    loadHistory(address);
    runningRef.current = false;
  }, [address, walletClient, publicClient, chainId, extraTargets, loadHistory, onSession]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRun || !isConnected || !walletClient || !address) return;
    const connectionKey = `${address.toLowerCase()}:${chainId}`;
    if (autoRunLockRef.current === connectionKey) return;
    if (step !== 'idle') return;
    autoRunLockRef.current = connectionKey;
    run();
  }, [autoRun, isConnected, walletClient, address, chainId, step, run]);

  const isRunning  = ['computing', 'signing-session', 'saving'].includes(step);
  const isFinished = step === 'done';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
        <button
          onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
          className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors"
        >
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 text-left">
            <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">Session Key</p>
            <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">
              One EIP-712 signature → persistent session key stored in DB
            </p>
          </div>
          <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-white/30 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
        </button>

        {expanded && (
          <div className="px-6 pb-6 border-t border-white/5 space-y-5 pt-4">

            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/15 p-3">
              <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-blue-300/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                Creates a <strong className="text-blue-300">session key</strong> authorized to act on your behalf.
                Requires <strong className="text-blue-200">1 EIP-712 signature</strong> from your EOA.
                The session key + private key are stored persistently in the database,
                but this runtime now creates a <strong className="text-blue-200">fresh session every time</strong>
                you run it. The EIP-7702 tab uses the latest created session key as the transaction sender.
              </p>
            </div>

            {!isConnected && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-amber-200">
                Use the top-right <strong>Connect Wallet</strong> button first. This panel always stays visible and the
                history below shows recorded sessions even before the next connect.
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Steps */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {([
                { id: 'computing',        label: 'Compute',     icon: <Zap       className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
                { id: 'signing-session',  label: 'Sign',        icon: <Key       className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
                { id: 'saving',           label: 'Save',        icon: <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
              ] as const).map((s, idx) => {
                const order: FlowStep[] = ['computing', 'signing-session', 'saving', 'done'];
                const ci   = order.indexOf(step);
                const done   = isFinished || ci > idx + 1;
                const active = step === s.id;
                return (
                  <div key={s.id} className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-center transition-all ${
                    active ? 'bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/30' :
                    done   ? 'bg-emerald-500/5 border-emerald-500/20' :
                             'bg-white/[0.02] border-white/10'
                  }`}>
                    <div className={`flex items-center justify-center mb-1 ${active ? 'text-blue-400' : done ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-white/20'}`}>
                      {active ? <Loader className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : done ? <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : s.icon}
                    </div>
                    <p className={`text-[10px] font-medium leading-tight ${active ? 'text-blue-300' : done ? 'text-emerald-300' : 'text-white/25'}`}>{s.label}</p>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Results */}
            {(state.imageHash || state.sessionKey) && (
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/30 border border-white/8 divide-y divide-white/5 px-4">
                {state.walletAddress && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2.5 border-b border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-white/40 text-xs flex-shrink-0">Wallet (CREATE2)</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      {state.isDeployed
                        ? <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                        : <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0" />}
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-white/70 truncate">{state.walletAddress}</span>
                      <CopyButton value={state.walletAddress} className="text-white/30 hover:text-white" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {state.sessionKey        && <AddressRow label="Session Key"     value={state.sessionKey}         color="text-emerald-300/80" />}
                {state.sessionPrivateKey && <AddressRow label="Session Privkey" value={state.sessionPrivateKey}  color="text-amber-300/80" />}
                {state.sessionSig        && <AddressRow label="Session Sig"     value={state.sessionSig}         color="text-white/50" />}
                {state.savedId           && <AddressRow label="DB Record"       value={state.savedId}            mono={false} color="text-white/50" />}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Status */}
            {step !== 'idle' && (
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs ${
                isFinished  ? 'bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300' :
                step === 'error' ? 'bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 text-red-300' :
                                   'bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/15 text-blue-300/70'
              }`}>
                {isFinished ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" /> :
                 step === 'error' ? <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" /> :
                                    <Loader className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 animate-spin" />}
                <span>{step === 'error' ? state.error : STEP_LABELS[step]}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Advanced */}
            <div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowAdvanced(v => !v)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-white/30 hover:text-white/60 text-xs transition-colors"
              >
                <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform ${showAdvanced ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                Advanced: extra permission targets
              </button>
              {showAdvanced && (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/8 p-4">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {extraTargets.map((t, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="flex gap-2">
                        <span className="flex-1 text-xs font-mono text-white/50 bg-black/20 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 truncate">{t}</span>
                        <button onClick={() => setExtraTargets(a => a.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))} className="text-red-400/60 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors px-2">
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="text" placeholder="0x… contract address" value={newTarget}
                        onChange={e => setNewTarget(e.target.value)}
                        className="flex-1 bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white/80 text-xs font-mono placeholder-white/20 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors"
                      />
                      <button
                        onClick={() => { if (newTarget.startsWith('0x') && newTarget.length === 42) { setExtraTargets(a => [...a, newTarget]); setNewTarget(''); } }}
                        className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white/50 hover:text-white transition-all"
                      >
                        <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="text-white/30 text-xs mb-1">Default targets (always included)</p>
                    {[
                      { label: 'BatchMulticall', addr: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.batchMulticall },
                      { label: 'Guest Module',   addr: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.guest },
                      { label: 'SessionManager', addr: SEQUENCE_CONTRACTS.sessionManager },
                    ].map(t => (
                      <div key={t.addr} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="text-white/30">{t.label}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-white/20">{t.addr.slice(0, 10)}…</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Action */}
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                if (!isConnected) return;
                if (isFinished && state.savedId) {
                  await supabase.from('sequence_sessions').delete().eq('id', state.savedId);
                }
                setState(INIT);
                setStep('idle');
                runningRef.current = false;
                autoRunLockRef.current = null;
                run();
              }}
              disabled={isRunning || !isConnected}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:bg-blue-900/40 disabled:text-blue-300/30 text-white font-semibold py-3 text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20"
            >
              {isRunning ? (
                <><Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Running…</>
              ) : !isConnected ? (
                <><Shield className="w-4 h-4" />Connect Wallet First</>
              ) : isFinished ? (
                <><RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />New session</>
              ) : (
                <><Shield className="w-4 h-4" />Create Session</>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* History */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-white/40" />
            <div>
              <span className="text-white/70 text-sm font-semibold">Session History</span>
              <p className="text-white/25 text-[10px] mt-0.5">
                {address ? 'Showing sessions for the connected wallet' : 'Showing the most recent recorded wallet sessions'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => loadHistory(address)} className="text-white/30 hover:text-white transition-colors">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loadingHistory ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
        {pastSessions.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="px-6 py-6 text-center text-white/25 text-xs">No sessions yet</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
            {pastSessions.map(s => {
              const matchesConnected = !!address && s.eoa === address.toLowerCase();
              return (
                <div key={s.id} className="px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 hover:bg-white/[0.02]">
                  <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 ${s.deadline >= NO_EXPIRY ? 'bg-emerald-400' : 'bg-amber-400'}`} />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-white/60 text-xs font-mono truncate">{s.wallet}</p>
                      {matchesConnected && (
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-blue-400/20 bg-blue-400/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-blue-300">
                          Connected
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-white/25 text-[10px] mt-0.5">
                      EOA {s.eoa.slice(0, 8)}…{s.eoa.slice(-6)} · Chain {s.chain_id} ·{' '}
                      {s.deadline >= NO_EXPIRY
                        ? <span className="text-emerald-400/70">Never expires</span>
                        : <span className="text-amber-400/70">Expires {new Date(s.deadline * 1000).toLocaleString()}</span>}
                      {s.is_deployed && <span className="ml-2 text-emerald-400/50">· deployed</span>}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <a href={`https://etherscan.io/address/${s.wallet}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-white/20 hover:text-white/50 transition-colors">
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </a>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### project/src/components/TelegramPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAccount } from 'wagmi';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  Send, Bell, BellOff, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader, Copy,
  CheckCheck, ChevronDown, RefreshCw, Info, ExternalLink,
  Zap, Shield, Activity, Settings2, Eye, EyeOff,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface TelegramConfig {
  id:         string;
  bot_token:  string;
  chat_id:    string;
  alerts_on:  boolean;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface TelegramEvent {
  id:           string;
  event_type:   string;
  payload:      Record<string, unknown>;
  message_text: string;
  sent_at:      string;
  delivered:    boolean;
  error:        string | null;
}

const EVENT_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  session_created:    '🔐',
  eip7702_delegated:  '⚡',
  tx_submitted:       '📤',
  test:               '✅',
};

const EVENT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  session_created:   'Session Created',
  eip7702_delegated: 'EIP-7702 Delegated',
  tx_submitted:      'Transaction Submitted',
  test:              'Test Alert',
};

function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const mins = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (mins < 1)  return 'just now';
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs  < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(hrs / 24)}d ago`;
}

export default function TelegramPanel() {
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();

  const [config,       setConfig]       = useState<TelegramConfig | null>(null);
  const [events,       setEvents]       = useState<TelegramEvent[]>([]);
  const [loadingCfg,   setLoadingCfg]   = useState(false);
  const [loadingEvts,  setLoadingEvts]  = useState(false);
  const [saving,       setSaving]       = useState(false);
  const [testing,      setTesting]      = useState(false);
  const [toggling,     setToggling]     = useState(false);
  const [saveOk,       setSaveOk]       = useState(false);
  const [saveErr,      setSaveErr]      = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testResult,   setTestResult]   = useState<'success' | 'error' | null>(null);

  const [botToken,     setBotToken]     = useState('');
  const [chatId,       setChatId]       = useState('');
  const [showToken,    setShowToken]    = useState(false);
  const [copied,       setCopied]       = useState(false);
  const [activeTab,    setActiveTab]    = useState<'setup' | 'events' | 'commands'>('setup');

  const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL as string;
  const webhookUrl  = `${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/telegram-bot`;

  const loadConfig = useCallback(async (eoa: string) => {
    setLoadingCfg(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('telegram_config')
      .select('id, bot_token, chat_id, alerts_on, updated_at')
      .eq('eoa', eoa.toLowerCase())
      .maybeSingle();
    if (data) {
      setConfig(data);
      setBotToken(data.bot_token);
      setChatId(data.chat_id);
    }
    setLoadingCfg(false);
  }, []);

  const loadEvents = useCallback(async (eoa: string) => {
    setLoadingEvts(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('telegram_events')
      .select('id, event_type, payload, message_text, sent_at, delivered, error')
      .eq('eoa', eoa.toLowerCase())
      .order('sent_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(20);
    setEvents(data ?? []);
    setLoadingEvts(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (address) {
      loadConfig(address);
      loadEvents(address);
    }
  }, [address, loadConfig, loadEvents]);

  // Realtime subscription for new events
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!address) return;
    const channel = supabase
      .channel('telegram-events')
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event:  'INSERT',
        schema: 'public',
        table:  'telegram_events',
        filter: `eoa=eq.${address.toLowerCase()}`,
      }, payload => {
        setEvents(prev => [payload.new as TelegramEvent, ...prev.slice(0, 19)]);
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [address]);

  const save = async () => {
    if (!address || !botToken.trim() || !chatId.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveOk(false);
    setSaveErr(null);

    const row = {
      eoa:        address.toLowerCase(),
      bot_token:  botToken.trim(),
      chat_id:    chatId.trim(),
      alerts_on:  config?.alerts_on ?? true,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const { error } = config
      ? await supabase.from('telegram_config').update(row).eq('id', config.id)
      : await supabase.from('telegram_config').insert(row);

    if (error) {
      setSaveErr(error.message);
    } else {
      setSaveOk(true);
      await loadConfig(address);
      setTimeout(() => setSaveOk(false), 3000);
    }
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const test = async () => {
    if (!address) return;
    setTesting(true);
    setTestResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/telegram-notify`, {
        method:  'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type':  'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          eoa:        address.toLowerCase(),
          event_type: 'test',
          payload:    { eoa: address },
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      setTestResult(data.delivered ? 'success' : 'error');
      await loadEvents(address);
    } catch {
      setTestResult('error');
    }
    setTesting(false);
  };

  const toggleAlerts = async () => {
    if (!address || !config) return;
    setToggling(true);
    const newVal = !config.alerts_on;
    await supabase
      .from('telegram_config')
      .update({ alerts_on: newVal, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', config.id);
    setConfig(c => c ? { ...c, alerts_on: newVal } : c);
    setToggling(false);
  };

  const copy = (v: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(v);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-10 text-center">
        <Send className="w-10 h-10 text-white/15 mx-auto mb-4" />
        <p className="text-white/40 text-sm">Connect your wallet to set up Telegram alerts</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header card */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#229ED9]/15 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
              <Send className="w-4 h-4 text-[#229ED9]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-white font-semibold text-sm">Telegram Dashboard</p>
              <p className="text-white/40 text-xs mt-0.5">Alerts · Commands · Live feed</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {config && (
            <button
              onClick={toggleAlerts}
              disabled={toggling}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                config.alerts_on
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                  : 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white/40 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10'
              }`}
            >
              {toggling ? <Loader className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> :
               config.alerts_on ? <Bell className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <BellOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              {config.alerts_on ? 'Alerts on' : 'Alerts off'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex border-t border-white/5">
          {(['setup', 'events', 'commands'] as const).map(tab => (
            <button
              key={tab}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
              className={`flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-semibold capitalize tracking-wide transition-all ${
                activeTab === tab
                  ? 'text-[#229ED9] border-b-2 border-[#229ED9] bg-[#229ED9]/5'
                  : 'text-white/30 hover:text-white/60 border-b-2 border-transparent'
              }`}
            >
              {tab === 'setup'    && <Settings2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1.5 -mt-0.5" />}
              {tab === 'events'   && <Activity  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1.5 -mt-0.5" />}
              {tab === 'commands' && <Send      className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1.5 -mt-0.5" />}
              {tab}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── SETUP TAB ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'setup' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* How-to guide */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-[#229ED9] flex-shrink-0" />
              <p className="text-white/80 text-sm font-semibold">Setup Guide</p>
            </div>
            <ol className="space-y-3">
              {[
                { n: '1', text: 'Open Telegram and message @BotFather', sub: 'Send /newbot, choose a name and username' },
                { n: '2', text: 'Copy the bot token BotFather gives you', sub: 'Paste it in the Bot Token field below' },
                { n: '3', text: 'Start your new bot and get your Chat ID', sub: 'Message the bot, then paste your chat ID below' },
                { n: '4', text: 'Set the webhook so the bot receives commands', sub: `POST to https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/setWebhook?url=${encodeURIComponent(webhookUrl)}` },
              ].map(s => (
                <li key={s.n} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[#229ED9]/20 text-[#229ED9] text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">{s.n}</span>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-white/70 text-xs font-medium">{s.text}</p>
                    <p className="text-white/30 text-[11px] mt-0.5">{s.sub}</p>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>

            {/* Webhook URL copy */}
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/30 border border-white/8 p-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] font-mono flex-1 truncate">Webhook: {webhookUrl}</p>
              <button onClick={() => copy(webhookUrl)} className="text-white/30 hover:text-white flex-shrink-0 transition-colors">
                {copied ? <CheckCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Config form */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4">
            <p className="text-white/70 text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
              <Settings2 className="w-4 h-4 text-white/40" /> Configuration
            </p>

            {loadingCfg ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-4">
                <Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-white/30" />
                <span className="text-white/30 text-xs">Loading config…</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Bot Token</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <input
                      type={showToken ? 'text' : 'password'}
                      value={botToken}
                      onChange={e => setBotToken(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="123456789:ABCdef…"
                      className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 pr-10 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/15 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#229ED9]/50 transition-colors"
                    />
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowToken(v => !v)}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white/25 hover:text-white/60 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {showToken ? <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white/25 text-[10px]">From @BotFather — stored server-side only</p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-white/40 text-xs block">Chat ID</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={chatId}
                    onChange={e => setChatId(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="-100123456789 or 123456789"
                    className="w-full bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono placeholder-white/15 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#229ED9]/50 transition-colors"
                  />
                  <p className="text-white/25 text-[10px]">Your personal chat ID or a group/channel ID</p>
                </div>

                {saveErr && (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 p-3">
                    <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <p className="text-red-300 text-xs">{saveErr}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                  <button
                    onClick={save}
                    disabled={saving || !botToken.trim() || !chatId.trim()}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#229ED9] hover:bg-[#1d8bbf] disabled:bg-[#229ED9]/20 disabled:text-[#229ED9]/30 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 text-sm transition-all"
                  >
                    {saving ? <Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> :
                     saveOk  ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />       : <Settings2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    {saving ? 'Saving…' : saveOk ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Config'}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={test}
                    disabled={testing || !config}
                    title={!config ? 'Save config first' : 'Send a test alert'}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 disabled:opacity-30 border border-white/10 text-white/70 font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 text-sm transition-all"
                  >
                    {testing ? <Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    Test
                  </button>
                </div>

                {testResult && (
                  <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs ${
                    testResult === 'success'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
                      : 'bg-red-500/5 border border-red-500/20 text-red-300'
                  }`}>
                    {testResult === 'success'
                      ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                      : <XCircle    className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />}
                    {testResult === 'success'
                      ? 'Test alert delivered! Check your Telegram.'
                      : 'Test failed — check your bot token and chat ID.'}
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Alert types */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-3">
            <p className="text-white/70 text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
              <Bell className="w-4 h-4 text-white/40" /> Alert Types
            </p>
            {[
              { icon: <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />,  label: 'Session Created',     desc: 'New session key authorized by your EOA',      bg: 'bg-blue-500/10',    border: 'border-blue-500/20' },
              { icon: <Zap    className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />, label: 'EIP-7702 Delegation', desc: 'Type-4 tx delegates EOA code to Sequence module', bg: 'bg-amber-500/10',   border: 'border-amber-500/20' },
              { icon: <Send   className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />,  label: 'Tx Submitted',        desc: 'Any transaction broadcast by session key',    bg: 'bg-cyan-500/10',    border: 'border-cyan-500/20' },
            ].map(a => (
              <div key={a.label} className={`flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl ${a.bg} border ${a.border} px-4 py-3`}>
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                  {a.icon}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-white/80 text-xs font-semibold">{a.label}</p>
                  <p className="text-white/40 text-[11px] mt-0.5">{a.desc}</p>
                </div>
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── EVENTS TAB ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'events' && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5">
            <p className="text-white/70 text-sm font-semibold">Alert History</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => address && loadEvents(address)}
              className="text-white/30 hover:text-white transition-colors"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loadingEvts ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {loadingEvts ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-8">
              <Loader className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-white/30" />
              <span className="text-white/30 text-xs">Loading events…</span>
            </div>
          ) : events.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-6 py-10 text-center">
              <Activity className="w-8 h-8 text-white/10 mx-auto mb-3" />
              <p className="text-white/25 text-sm">No alerts yet</p>
              <p className="text-white/15 text-xs mt-1">Events appear here in real-time as they happen</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
              {events.map(e => (
                <div key={e.id} className="px-5 py-4 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <span className="text-lg flex-shrink-0 leading-none mt-0.5">
                      {EVENT_ICONS[e.event_type] ?? '📡'}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-white/80 text-xs font-semibold">
                          {EVENT_LABELS[e.event_type] ?? e.event_type}
                        </span>
                        <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${
                          e.delivered
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                            : 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-400'
                        }`}>
                          {e.delivered ? 'delivered' : 'failed'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-white/25 text-[10px] ml-auto">{timeAgo(e.sent_at)}</span>
                      </div>
                      {e.error && (
                        <p className="text-red-400/60 text-[10px] mt-0.5 font-mono">{e.error}</p>
                      )}
                      {/* Show key payload fields */}
                      <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5">
                        {Object.entries(e.payload).filter(([k]) => ['chain_id','mode','eoa'].includes(k)).map(([k, v]) => (
                          <span key={k} className="text-[10px] text-white/25 font-mono">
                            {k}: {String(v).length > 12 ? `${String(v).slice(0,6)}…${String(v).slice(-4)}` : String(v)}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── COMMANDS TAB ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'commands' && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0f1117] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#229ED9]/5 border border-[#229ED9]/20 p-3">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-[#229ED9] flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-[#229ED9]/70 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              Send these commands directly to your bot in Telegram.
              The bot must be set up with the webhook URL (see Setup tab) to respond.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            {[
              { cmd: '/start',     desc: 'Welcome message and help',                  icon: '👋' },
              { cmd: '/status',    desc: 'Show wallet link status and event count',    icon: '📊' },
              { cmd: '/sessions',  desc: 'List 5 most recent session keys',            icon: '🔑' },
              { cmd: '/events',    desc: 'Show last 10 alerts delivered',              icon: '📋' },
              { cmd: '/alert_on',  desc: 'Enable all Telegram alerts',                 icon: '🔔' },
              { cmd: '/alert_off', desc: 'Disable all Telegram alerts',                icon: '🔕' },
              { cmd: '/help',      desc: 'Show all available commands',                icon: '❓' },
            ].map(c => (
              <div
                key={c.cmd}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/8 px-4 py-3 group hover:bg-white/[0.05] transition-colors"
              >
                <span className="text-base flex-shrink-0">{c.icon}</span>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <code className="text-[#229ED9] text-xs font-mono font-semibold">{c.cmd}</code>
                  <p className="text-white/40 text-[11px] mt-0.5">{c.desc}</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copy(c.cmd)}
                  className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-white/30 hover:text-white transition-all"
                >
                  <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-xl bg-black/30 border border-white/8 p-4 space-y-2">
            <p className="text-white/40 text-xs font-semibold mb-3">Webhook Registration</p>
            <p className="text-white/30 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
              To register the webhook with Telegram, open this URL in your browser after saving your bot token:
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-black/30 rounded-lg p-2.5 mt-2">
              <code className="text-white/30 text-[10px] flex-1 break-all leading-relaxed">
                {`https://api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_TOKEN>/setWebhook?url=${webhookUrl}`}
              </code>
              <button
                onClick={() => copy(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${botToken || '<YOUR_TOKEN>'}/setWebhook?url=${webhookUrl}`)}
                className="text-white/20 hover:text-white flex-shrink-0 transition-colors"
              >
                <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
