```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Copy, ExternalLink, RefreshCw, Frame, Code2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

function buildHtmlSnippet(url: string, height: number, referrerPolicy: string, sandbox: boolean) {
  const attrs = [
    `src="${url}"`,
    `title="Embedded Site"`,
    `style="width:100%;height:${height}px;border:0;display:block;"`,
    `loading="lazy"`,
    `referrerpolicy="${referrerPolicy}"`,
  ];

  if (sandbox) {
    attrs.push(`sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups"`);
  }

  return `<iframe\n  ${attrs.join("\n  ")}\n></iframe>`;
}

export default function EmbedToolPage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("https://demo.trails.build/widget");
  const [height, setHeight] = useState("800");
  const [referrerPolicy, setReferrerPolicy] = useState("no-referrer");
  const [sandbox, setSandbox] = useState(false);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  const parsedHeight = Number.parseInt(height, 10) || 800;

  const snippet = useMemo(() => {
    return buildHtmlSnippet(url.trim(), parsedHeight, referrerPolicy, sandbox);
  }, [url, parsedHeight, referrerPolicy, sandbox]);

  const bookmarklet = useMemo(() => {
    const js = `
      (function(){
        var target = prompt("Enter a URL to embed:", "${url.trim()}");
        if(!target) return;
        var w = window.open("", "_blank");
        if(!w) return alert("Popup blocked");
        w.document.write('<!doctype html><html><head><title>Embed Preview</title><style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#0b0b10}iframe{width:100%;height:100vh;border:0;display:block}</style></head><body><iframe src="' + target.replace(/"/g, "&quot;") + '" referrerpolicy="${referrerPolicy}"></iframe></body></html>');
        w.document.close();
      })();
    `.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    return `javascript:${encodeURIComponent(js)}`;
  }, [url, referrerPolicy]);

  async function copyText(value: string, label: string) {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    toast.success(`${label} copied`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-[1500px] mx-auto">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
          Embed Tool
        </Badge>
        <h1 className="font-display text-3xl uppercase tracking-wide">Paste Any URL And Build The Iframe</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">
          Use this page as your reusable embed workbench for other projects and websites that allow iframe rendering.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[420px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              <Frame className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              Builder
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Paste a URL, change the iframe options, preview it, then copy the generated snippet.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-5 p-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="embed-url">URL</Label>
              <Input
                id="embed-url"
                value={url}
                onChange={(event) => setUrl(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="https://example.com/widget"
                className="rounded-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="embed-height">Height</Label>
                <Input
                  id="embed-height"
                  value={height}
                  onChange={(event) => setHeight(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="800"
                  className="rounded-none font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="embed-referrer">Referrer Policy</Label>
                <Input
                  id="embed-referrer"
                  value={referrerPolicy}
                  onChange={(event) => setReferrerPolicy(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="no-referrer"
                  className="rounded-none font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/20 p-3">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm">Use sandbox</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Enable only if you need tighter restrictions.</p>
              </div>
              <Switch checked={sandbox} onCheckedChange={setSandbox} />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button onClick={() => setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1)} className="rounded-none gap-2">
                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
                Refresh Preview
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="rounded-none gap-2" asChild>
                <a href={url.trim()} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Open URL
                </a>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">Live Preview</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>The site below is embedded exactly the same way your own project would embed it.</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            <iframe
              key={`${url}-${parsedHeight}-${referrerPolicy}-${sandbox}-${refreshKey}`}
              src={url.trim()}
              title="Embed Preview"
              style={{ width: "100%", height: parsedHeight, border: 0, display: "block" }}
              referrerPolicy={referrerPolicy as React.HTMLAttributeReferrerPolicy}
              sandbox={sandbox ? "allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups" : undefined}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              <Code2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              Generated Iframe Snippet
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <Textarea value={snippet} readOnly className="min-h-[220px] rounded-none font-mono text-xs" />
            <Button onClick={() => void copyText(snippet, "Iframe snippet")} className="rounded-none gap-2">
              <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />
              Copy Snippet
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">Bookmarklet</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Save this as a bookmark. When you click it later, it asks for a URL and opens a new embed preview window.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <Textarea value={bookmarklet} readOnly className="min-h-[220px] rounded-none font-mono text-xs" />
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button onClick={() => void copyText(bookmarklet, "Bookmarklet")} className="rounded-none gap-2">
                <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />
                Copy Bookmarklet
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="rounded-none" asChild>
                <a href={bookmarklet}>Run Bookmarklet</a>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  LayoutTemplate,
  Sparkles,
  Wand2,
  MonitorPlay,
  Copy,
  Save,
  Database,
  RefreshCw,
  FileCode2,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Play,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { ActionEmbed } from "@/components/frontpage/action-embed";
import { CompileOutput } from "@/components/compile/compile-output";
import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import {
  buildCompilePostBodyFromFrontpage,
  deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage,
} from "@/lib/frontpage-compile-sync";
import type { CompileConfig } from "@/lib/compile-config-store";
import { ECOSYSTEM_OPTIONS } from "@/lib/ecosystems";
import type { Ecosystem } from "@/lib/types";
import {
  FRONT_PAGE_CONFIG_KEY,
  type FrontpageAction,
  type FrontpageConfig,
} from "@/lib/frontpage-config";
import type { OperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";

type AbiFunction = {
  type: "function";
  name: string;
  stateMutability?: "pure" | "view" | "nonpayable" | "payable";
  inputs?: Array<{ name?: string; type: string }>;
  outputs?: Array<{ name?: string; type: string }>;
};

type ContractListItem = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  relativePath: string;
};

type SavedImport = ContractListItem & {
  source: "saved";
  abi: unknown[];
  addressHint?: string;
  savedAt: string;
};

const SAVED_IMPORTS_KEY = "stealth-v26-contract-imports";

const HERO_PRESETS = {
  mint: {
    badge: "Mint Page",
    title: "Mint directly from your site",
    copy: "Use one clear CTA, one wallet connection flow, and one contract action instead of exposing the full ABI.",
    cta: "Mint now",
  },
  buy: {
    badge: "Buy Page",
    title: "Turn your contract into a purchase flow",
    copy: "Keep the UI focused on one user goal and route the interaction through a clean action card.",
    cta: "Buy now",
  },
  claim: {
    badge: "Claim Page",
    title: "Create a clear claim experience",
    copy: "Present one explicit onchain action and keep the copy aligned with what the wallet will actually ask for.",
    cta: "Claim now",
  },
  stake: {
    badge: "Stake Page",
    title: "Launch a staking action panel",
    copy: "Use a compact, dark operator-style layout that matches the rest of StealthV26.",
    cta: "Stake now",
  },
  generic: {
    badge: "Generic Action",
    title: "Map any contract write to a public CTA",
    copy: "Build one focused frontpage action and ship it into any page or route with a single embed component.",
    cta: "Execute action",
  },
  eip712: {
    badge: "EIP-712 Sign",
    title: "Collect an explicit typed signature",
    copy: "Use a transparent typed-data action for consent, login, or structured approvals where the user sees exactly what they are signing.",
    cta: "Sign typed data",
  },
} as const;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function isFunction(x: unknown): x is AbiFunction {
  return isRecord(x) && x.type === "function" && typeof x.name === "string";
}

function getFunctionKey(fn: AbiFunction) {
  return `${fn.name}(${(fn.inputs || []).map((input) => input.type).join(",")})`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return error.message;
  }
  return "Something went wrong.";
}

function buildTypedDataAction(id: string): Extract<FrontpageAction, { kind: "typedDataSign" }> {
  return {
    kind: "typedDataSign",
    id,
    title: "Sign explicit typed data",
    description: "Use this for transparent login or consent flows where the user clearly understands what they are signing.",
    ctaLabel: "Sign consent",
    domainJson: JSON.stringify(
      {
        name: "StealthV26",
        version: "1",
        chainId: 1,
        verifyingContract: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
    typesJson: JSON.stringify(
      {
        Consent: [
          { name: "user", type: "address" },
          { name: "session", type: "string" },
        ],
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
    primaryType: "Consent",
    messageJson: JSON.stringify(
      {
        user: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
        session: "frontpage-access",
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
  };
}

function pickArtifactAbi(value: unknown): unknown[] | null {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return null;
  if (Array.isArray(value.abi)) return value.abi;
  if (isRecord(value.output) && Array.isArray(value.output.abi)) return value.output.abi;
  if (isRecord(value.artifact) && Array.isArray(value.artifact.abi)) return value.artifact.abi;
  return null;
}

function pickArtifactAddressHint(value: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return undefined;
  if (typeof value.address === "string") return value.address;
  if (typeof value.contractAddress === "string") return value.contractAddress;
  if (isRecord(value.networks)) {
    for (const network of Object.values(value.networks)) {
      if (isRecord(network) && typeof network.address === "string") return network.address;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function buildSavedImport(params: {
  name: string;
  relativePath: string;
  abi: unknown[];
  addressHint?: string;
}): SavedImport {
  return {
    id: `saved-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    name: params.name,
    relativePath: params.relativePath,
    source: "saved",
    abi: params.abi,
    addressHint: params.addressHint,
    savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export default function FrontpagePage() {
  const {
    generalConfig,
    setGeneralConfig,
    setWalletConfig,
    setModalConfig,
    setTokensConfig,
    setAdvancedConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
  } = useStore();
  const [ecosystem, setEcosystem] = useState<Ecosystem>(generalConfig.ecosystem);
  const [solanaCluster, setSolanaCluster] = useState(generalConfig.solanaCluster);
  const [solanaProgramId, setSolanaProgramId] = useState(generalConfig.solanaProgramId);
  const [solanaRpcUrl, setSolanaRpcUrl] = useState(generalConfig.solanaRpcUrl);
  const [tronNetwork, setTronNetwork] = useState(generalConfig.tronNetwork);
  const [tronContractAddress, setTronContractAddress] = useState(generalConfig.tronContractAddress);
  const [tronRpcUrl, setTronRpcUrl] = useState(generalConfig.tronRpcUrl);
  const [contractAddress, setContractAddress] = useState("");
  const [chainId, setChainId] = useState("1");
  const [abiText, setAbiText] = useState("");
  const [functions, setFunctions] = useState<AbiFunction[]>([]);
  const [selectedFunctionKey, setSelectedFunctionKey] = useState("");
  const [heroBadge, setHeroBadge] = useState<string>(HERO_PRESETS.mint.badge);
  const [heroTitle, setHeroTitle] = useState<string>(HERO_PRESETS.mint.title);
  const [heroCopy, setHeroCopy] = useState<string>(HERO_PRESETS.mint.copy);
  const [ctaLabel, setCtaLabel] = useState<string>(HERO_PRESETS.mint.cta);
  const [paramsJson, setParamsJson] = useState("[]");
  const [valueWei, setValueWei] = useState("");
  const defaultTypedAction = useMemo(() => buildTypedDataAction("typed-sign-primary"), []);
  const [typedActionEnabled, setTypedActionEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [typedActionTitle, setTypedActionTitle] = useState(defaultTypedAction.title);
  const [typedActionDescription, setTypedActionDescription] = useState(defaultTypedAction.description);
  const [typedActionCta, setTypedActionCta] = useState(defaultTypedAction.ctaLabel);
  const [typedPrimaryType, setTypedPrimaryType] = useState(defaultTypedAction.primaryType);
  const [typedDomainJson, setTypedDomainJson] = useState(defaultTypedAction.domainJson);
  const [typedTypesJson, setTypedTypesJson] = useState(defaultTypedAction.typesJson);
  const [typedMessageJson, setTypedMessageJson] = useState(defaultTypedAction.messageJson);
  const [configText, setConfigText] = useState("");
  const [compileFromFrontpageBusy, setCompileFromFrontpageBusy] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [artifactList, setArtifactList] = useState<ContractListItem[]>([]);
  const [savedImports, setSavedImports] = useState<SavedImport[]>([]);
  const [selectedArtifactId, setSelectedArtifactId] = useState("");
  const [artifactBusy, setArtifactBusy] = useState(false);
  const [operationalConfig, setOperationalConfig] = useState<OperationalConfig | null>(null);

  const selectedFunction = useMemo(
    () => functions.find((fn) => getFunctionKey(fn) === selectedFunctionKey),
    [functions, selectedFunctionKey],
  );

  const generatedConfig = useMemo<FrontpageConfig>(() => {
    const currentChainId = Number(chainId || "1");
    const actions: FrontpageAction[] = [];

    if (selectedFunction) {
      actions.push({
        kind: "contractWrite",
        id: "primary-contract-action",
        title: ctaLabel,
        description: heroCopy,
        ctaLabel,
        chainId: Number.isNaN(currentChainId) ? 1 : currentChainId,
        contractAddress,
        methodAbi: selectedFunction,
        paramsJson,
        valueWei: valueWei || undefined,
      });
    }

    if (typedActionEnabled) {
      actions.push({
        kind: "typedDataSign",
        id: "typed-sign-primary",
        title: typedActionTitle,
        description: typedActionDescription,
        ctaLabel: typedActionCta,
        domainJson: typedDomainJson,
        typesJson: typedTypesJson,
        primaryType: typedPrimaryType,
        messageJson: typedMessageJson,
      });
    }

    return {
      version: 1,
      ecosystem,
      operational: operationalConfig ?? undefined,
      ecosystemConfig: {
        solana: {
          cluster: solanaCluster,
          programId: solanaProgramId,
          rpcUrl: solanaRpcUrl || undefined,
        },
        tron: {
          network: tronNetwork,
          contractAddress: tronContractAddress,
          rpcUrl: tronRpcUrl || undefined,
        },
      },
      hero: {
        badge: heroBadge,
        title: heroTitle,
        copy: heroCopy,
      },
      chainId: Number.isNaN(currentChainId) ? 1 : currentChainId,
      contractAddress,
      actions,
    };
  }, [
    chainId,
    contractAddress,
    ctaLabel,
    ecosystem,
    solanaCluster,
    solanaProgramId,
    solanaRpcUrl,
    tronContractAddress,
    tronNetwork,
    tronRpcUrl,
    operationalConfig,
    heroBadge,
    heroCopy,
    heroTitle,
    paramsJson,
    selectedFunction,
    typedActionCta,
    typedActionDescription,
    typedActionEnabled,
    typedActionTitle,
    typedDomainJson,
    typedMessageJson,
    typedPrimaryType,
    typedTypesJson,
    valueWei,
  ]);

  const previewConfig = useMemo<FrontpageConfig>(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(configText) as FrontpageConfig;
    } catch {
      return generatedConfig;
    }
  }, [configText, generatedConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function loadSavedCompileConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/compile-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: CompileConfig };
        if (!res.ok || !data.config || !active) return;

        setGeneralConfig(data.config.general);
        setWalletConfig(data.config.wallet);
        setModalConfig(data.config.modal);
        setTokensConfig(data.config.tokens);
        setAdvancedConfig(data.config.advanced);
        setPayoutConfig(data.config.payout);
      } catch {
        // Keep defaults when no saved config is available.
      }
    }

    void loadSavedCompileConfig();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [
    setAdvancedConfig,
    setGeneralConfig,
    setModalConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
    setTokensConfig,
    setWalletConfig,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setConfigText(JSON.stringify(generatedConfig, null, 2));
  }, [generatedConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadOperationalConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/operational-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: OperationalConfig };
        if (!active || !res.ok || !data.config) return;
        setOperationalConfig(data.config);
      } catch {
        // Leave operational config unset if unavailable.
      }
    }
    void loadOperationalConfig();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SAVED_IMPORTS_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return;
      setSavedImports(
        parsed.filter((item): item is SavedImport => {
          return (
            isRecord(item) &&
            item.source === "saved" &&
            typeof item.id === "string" &&
            typeof item.name === "string" &&
            typeof item.relativePath === "string" &&
            Array.isArray(item.abi) &&
            typeof item.savedAt === "string"
          );
        }),
      );
    } catch {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(SAVED_IMPORTS_KEY);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.localStorage.setItem(SAVED_IMPORTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(savedImports));
  }, [savedImports]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedArtifactId || !contractAddress) return;
    setSavedImports((current) =>
      current.map((item) =>
        item.id === selectedArtifactId ? { ...item, addressHint: contractAddress } : item,
      ),
    );
  }, [contractAddress, selectedArtifactId]);

  function applyPreset(preset: keyof typeof HERO_PRESETS) {
    const item = HERO_PRESETS[preset];
    setHeroBadge(item.badge);
    setHeroTitle(item.title);
    setHeroCopy(item.copy);
    setCtaLabel(item.cta);
    if (preset === "eip712") {
      setTypedActionEnabled(true);
      setTypedActionTitle(item.title);
      setTypedActionDescription(item.copy);
      setTypedActionCta(item.cta);
    }
  }

  function parseAbi() {
    setError(null);
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(abiText);
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        throw new Error("ABI must be a JSON array.");
      }
      const writableFunctions = parsed
        .filter(isFunction)
        .filter((fn) => !["view", "pure"].includes(fn.stateMutability || "nonpayable"));
      setFunctions(writableFunctions);
      setSelectedFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0] ? getFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0]) : "");
      setStatus(`Loaded ${writableFunctions.length} writable functions.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      setStatus("");
    }
  }

  async function loadArtifacts() {
    setArtifactBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/contracts", { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load artifacts");
      setArtifactList(Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : []);
      setStatus(`Loaded ${Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items.length : 0} contract artifacts.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      setStatus("");
    } finally {
      setArtifactBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function loadSelectedArtifact() {
    if (!selectedArtifactId) return;
    setArtifactBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const saved = savedImports.find((item) => item.id === selectedArtifactId);
      if (saved) {
        setAbiText(JSON.stringify(saved.abi, null, 2));

        if (typeof saved.addressHint === "string") {
          setContractAddress(saved.addressHint);
        }

        const writableFunctions = saved.abi
          .filter(isFunction)
          .filter((fn: AbiFunction) => !["view", "pure"].includes(fn.stateMutability || "nonpayable"));

        setFunctions(writableFunctions);
        setSelectedFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0] ? getFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0]) : "");
        setStatus(`Loaded saved ABI from ${saved.name} with ${writableFunctions.length} writable functions.`);
        return;
      }

      const res = await fetch(`/api/contracts/${selectedArtifactId}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load artifact");
      const abi = data?.abi;
      if (!Array.isArray(abi)) {
        throw new Error("Artifact ABI is not an array.");
      }

      setAbiText(JSON.stringify(abi, null, 2));

      if (typeof data?.addressHint === "string") {
        setContractAddress(data.addressHint);
      }

      const writableFunctions = abi
        .filter(isFunction)
        .filter((fn: AbiFunction) => !["view", "pure"].includes(fn.stateMutability || "nonpayable"));

      setFunctions(writableFunctions);
      setSelectedFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0] ? getFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0]) : "");
      const savedImport = buildSavedImport({
        name: data?.name || "artifact",
        relativePath: data?.relativePath || `artifact/${selectedArtifactId}.json`,
        abi,
        addressHint:
          contractAddress || (typeof data?.addressHint === "string" ? data.addressHint : undefined),
      });
      setSavedImports((current) => [savedImport, ...current]);
      setSelectedArtifactId(savedImport.id);
      setStatus(`Loaded ABI from ${data?.name || "artifact"} with ${writableFunctions.length} writable functions.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      setStatus("");
    } finally {
      setArtifactBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function importArtifactFiles(fileList: FileList | null) {
    if (!fileList?.length) return;

    setArtifactBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const files = Array.from(fileList);
      const imported: SavedImport[] = [];

      for (const file of files) {
        const raw = await file.text();
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
        const abi = pickArtifactAbi(parsed);

        if (!abi) {
          throw new Error(`No ABI found in ${file.name}`);
        }

        const artifactName =
          (isRecord(parsed) && typeof parsed.contractName === "string" && parsed.contractName) ||
          (isRecord(parsed) && typeof parsed.name === "string" && parsed.name) ||
          file.name.replace(/\.json$/i, "");

        imported.push(
          buildSavedImport({
            name: artifactName,
            relativePath: `imports/${file.name}`,
            abi,
            addressHint: pickArtifactAddressHint(parsed),
          }),
        );
      }

      setSavedImports((current) => [...imported, ...current]);
      setSelectedArtifactId(imported[0]?.id || "");
      if (imported[0]) {
        setAbiText(JSON.stringify(imported[0].abi, null, 2));
        if (typeof imported[0].addressHint === "string") {
          setContractAddress(imported[0].addressHint);
        }
        const writableFunctions = imported[0].abi
          .filter(isFunction)
          .filter((fn: AbiFunction) => !["view", "pure"].includes(fn.stateMutability || "nonpayable"));
        setFunctions(writableFunctions);
        setSelectedFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0] ? getFunctionKey(writableFunctions[0]) : "");
      }
      setStatus(`Imported ${imported.length} contract JSON file${imported.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} into shared saved imports.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      setStatus("");
    } finally {
      setArtifactBusy(false);
    }
  }

  }, []);

  function saveConfig() {
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(configText) as FrontpageConfig;
        const res = await fetch("/api/config", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ frontpage: parsed }),
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to save config.");
        }

        window.localStorage.setItem(FRONT_PAGE_CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(parsed));
        setStatus("Saved frontpage config to the server. Open /frontpage/runtime to use it.");
        setError(null);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      }
    })();
  }

    setTypedActionEnabled(true);

  function applyConfigToCompiler() {
    const derived = deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage(previewConfig);
    setGeneralConfig(derived.general);
    setTokensConfig(derived.tokens);
    setAdvancedConfig(derived.advanced);
    setStatus("Loaded current frontpage config into the integrated script builder.");
    setError(null);
  }

  async function compileAndPublishFromFrontpage() {
    setCompileFromFrontpageBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/compile-config", { cache: "no-store" });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: CompileConfig; message?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.config) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Could not load saved compile settings (wallet / modal / payout).");
      }
      const body = buildCompilePostBodyFromFrontpage(data.config, previewConfig);
      const compileRes = await fetch("/api/compile", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const compileData = (await compileRes.json()) as { message?: string; publishedBuild?: { url?: string } };
      if (!compileRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(compileData?.message || "Compilation failed.");
      }
      applyConfigToCompiler();
      const artifact = compileData?.publishedBuild?.url;
      setStatus(
        artifact
          ? `SDK compiled and published from this frontpage. Artifact: ${artifact}`
          : "SDK compiled and published from this frontpage.",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = getErrorMessage(err);
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setCompileFromFrontpageBusy(false);
    }
  }

                  Save this config for the runtime page or embed it directly into any route.
                </CardDescription>

              <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
                <Textarea value={configText} onChange={(e) => setConfigText(e.target.value)} rows={24} className="rounded-none font-mono text-xs" />
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                  <Button className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs" onClick={saveConfig}>
                    <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Save runtime config
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                    onClick={() => setConfigText(JSON.stringify(generatedConfig, null, 2))}
                  >
                    Regenerate
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Runtime route: /frontpage/runtime
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="preview">
          <ActionEmbed config={previewConfig} />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="embed">
          <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
              <CardTitle className="font-display uppercase tracking-wide">Embed On Any Page</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Import the reusable embed component and paste this config into any route inside St3.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <pre className="overflow-auto rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/60 p-4 text-xs font-mono leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                {embedSnippet}
              </pre>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="script" className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <CardTitle className="font-display uppercase tracking-wide">Integrated Script Builder</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>
                    Keep the frontpage builder and SDK compiler on the same route: use{" "}
                    <span className="text-foreground font-medium">Compile &amp; publish</span> to POST{" "}
                    <code className="text-primary">/api/compile</code> with the current preview merged into your saved
                    wallet/modal settings, or sync fields first then use the full builder below.
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Button
                    className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                    disabled={compileFromFrontpageBusy}
                    onClick={() => void compileAndPublishFromFrontpage()}
                  >
                    <Play className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    {compileFromFrontpageBusy ? "Compiling..." : "Compile & publish"}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                    onClick={applyConfigToCompiler}
                  >
                    <ShieldCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Use Current Page Config
                  </Button>
                  <Button asChild variant="outline" className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs">
                    <a href="/compile">
                      <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Open Full Compile
                    </a>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <CompileOutput />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/app/frontpage/runtime/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ActionEmbed } from "@/components/frontpage/action-embed";
import { FRONT_PAGE_CONFIG_KEY, getDefaultFrontpageConfig, type FrontpageConfig } from "@/lib/frontpage-config";

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return error.message;
  }
  return "Something went wrong.";
}

export default function FrontpageRuntimePage() {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<FrontpageConfig>(getDefaultFrontpageConfig());
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function loadConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/config", { cache: "no-store" });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = (await res.json()) as { frontpage?: FrontpageConfig };
          if (active && data.frontpage) {
            setConfig(data.frontpage);
            return;
          }
        }

        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(FRONT_PAGE_CONFIG_KEY);
        if (!raw || !active) return;
        setConfig(JSON.parse(raw) as FrontpageConfig);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(err));
      }
    }

    void loadConfig();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  if (error) {
    return <div className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</div>;
  }

  return <ActionEmbed config={config} />;
}
```

### src/app/login/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Shield, KeyRound, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("admin");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadSession() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { authenticated?: boolean };
        if (!active) return;
        if (data?.authenticated) {
          router.replace("/affiliates");
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        // stay on page
      } finally {
        if (active) setChecking(false);
      }
    }
    void loadSession();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [router]);

  async function handleLogin() {
    setError("");
    if (!username.trim()) {
      setError("Admin username is required.");
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setError("Admin passphrase is required.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/access", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ username: username.trim(), password }),
      });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { message?: string };
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message || "Login failed");

      toast.success("Admin session active");
      router.push("/affiliates");
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Login failed";
      setError(message);
      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[calc(100vh-8rem)] max-w-6xl items-center justify-center px-4">
      <div className="grid w-full gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="w-fit rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
              Admin Access
            </Badge>
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-4xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              Global Login
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="max-w-xl text-sm font-mono">
              Sign in with your private admin username and long passphrase to access contracts, compile, domains, settings, and deployment controls.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6 p-6">
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
              <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/30 p-4">
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-primary">
                  <Shield className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest">Secure Session</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Server-signed admin cookie using your configured username and passphrase.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/30 p-4">
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-primary">
                  <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest">No Wallet Required</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">This path is for your personal admin access, separate from wallet auth.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/30 p-4">
                <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-primary">
                  <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest">Destination</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Successful login goes straight into the admin affiliate dashboard.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-2xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              Sign In
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Use `ADMIN_LOGIN_USERNAME` and `ADMIN_LOGIN_PASSPHRASE`.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="admin-username">Admin Username</Label>
              <Input
                id="admin-username"
                name="username"
                autoComplete="username"
                value={username}
                onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="admin"
                className="rounded-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="admin-password">Admin Passphrase</Label>
              <Input
                id="admin-password"
                name="password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                value={password}
                onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter" && !busy && !checking) {
                    void handleLogin();
                  }
                }}
                placeholder="Enter your 32-word passphrase"
                className="rounded-none"
              />
            </div>

            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p> : null}

            <Button onClick={() => void handleLogin()} disabled={busy || checking} className="w-full gap-2 rounded-none">
              <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
              {checking ? "Checking session..." : busy ? "Signing in..." : "Login"}
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const typeColors: Record<LogEntry["type"], string> = {
  connection: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
  signature: "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
  approval: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30",
  transfer: "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30",
  chain_switch: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
  error: "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30",
  disconnect: "bg-zinc-500/20 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-500/30",
};

export default function LogsPage() {
  const { logs } = useStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [chainFilter, setChainFilter] = useState<string>("all");

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return logs.filter((log) => {
      const matchSearch =
        !search ||
        log.message.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        log.wallet.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        log.domain.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
      const matchType = typeFilter === "all" || log.type === typeFilter;
      const matchChain = chainFilter === "all" || log.chain === chainFilter;
      return matchSearch && matchType && matchChain;
    });
  }, [logs, search, typeFilter, chainFilter]);

  const typeCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    logs.forEach((log) => {
      counts[log.type] = (counts[log.type] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return counts;
  }, [logs]);

  const chains = useMemo(() => [...new Set(logs.map((l) => l.chain))], [logs]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Logs</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            Session metadata, network activity, and interaction flow tracking
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2">
            <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Export
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Type Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7 gap-3">
        {Object.entries(typeCounts).map(([type, count]) => (
          <Card
            key={type}
            className={`cursor-pointer transition-all ${
              typeFilter === type ? "ring-2 ring-primary" : ""
            }`}
            onClick={() => setTypeFilter(typeFilter === type ? "all" : type)}
          >
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <p className="text-lg font-bold">{count}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground capitalize">{type.replace("_", " ")}</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
            <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search logs by message, wallet, or domain..."
                className="pl-9 text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Filter className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Select value={typeFilter} onValueChange={setTypeFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px]">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Event Type" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Types</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="connection">Connection</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="signature">Signature</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="approval">Approval</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="transfer">Transfer</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="chain_switch">Chain Switch</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="error">Error</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="disconnect">Disconnect</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select value={chainFilter} onValueChange={setChainFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px]">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Chain" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="all">All Chains</SelectItem>
                  {chains.map((chain) => (
                    <SelectItem key={chain} value={chain}>
                      {chain}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              {filteredLogs.length} results
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Log Table */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Event Log</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <ScrollArea className="h-[600px]">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs w-[100px]">Type</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs">Message</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs">Wallet</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs">Chain</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs">Domain</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-xs w-[160px]">Timestamp</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {filteredLogs.map((log) => (
                  <TableRow key={log.id} className="text-xs">
                    <TableCell>
                      <span
                        className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                          typeColors[log.type]
                        }`}
                      >
                        {log.type.replace("_", " ")}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-medium max-w-[250px] truncate">
                      {log.message}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                      {log.wallet}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
                        {log.chain}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground max-w-[140px] truncate">
                      {log.domain}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString([], {
                        month: "short",
                        day: "numeric",
                        hour: "2-digit",
                        minute: "2-digit",
                        second: "2-digit",
                      })}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </ScrollArea>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```
