```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Download, Copy, Check, Play, FileCode2, Shield, Zap, ExternalLink, Rocket, TestTube } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import Link from "next/link";
import { getEcosystemLabel } from "@/lib/ecosystems";

const FRAMEWORK_LABELS = {
  reown: "Reown",
  web3modal: "Web3Modal",
  walletconnect: "WalletConnect",
  rainbowkit: "RainbowKit",
  sequence: "Sequence",
  custom: "Custom",
} as const;

function getFrameworkDescription(framework: keyof typeof FRAMEWORK_LABELS) {
  if (framework === "rainbowkit") {
    return "Compile guidance is tailored for a React page using wagmi + RainbowKit. The generated SDK stays available as a fallback helper layer.";
  }

  if (framework === "custom") {
    return "Compile output keeps the SDK hooks and lets you trigger the wallet popup from your own UI.";
  }

  return "Generate a plug-and-play JavaScript module with popup-based wallet connection and a compact connect button that can be appended to any page.";
}

function getEcosystemDetails(general: ReturnType<typeof useStore.getState>["generalConfig"]) {
  if (general.ecosystem === "solana") {
    return `Cluster: ${general.solanaCluster}${general.solanaProgramId ? ` • Program: ${general.solanaProgramId}` : ""}`;
  }

  if (general.ecosystem === "tron") {
    return `Network: ${general.tronNetwork}${general.tronContractAddress ? ` • Contract: ${general.tronContractAddress}` : ""}`;
  }

  return `${general.connectText} on ${general.themeMode} theme`;
}

function getQuickIntegrationSnippet(framework: keyof typeof FRAMEWORK_LABELS, connectClass: string, connectText: string) {
  if (framework === "rainbowkit") {
    return `// app/providers.tsx
import "@rainbow-me/rainbowkit/styles.css";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { getDefaultConfig, RainbowKitProvider, ConnectButton } from "@rainbow-me/rainbowkit";
import { WagmiProvider } from "wagmi";

const config = getDefaultConfig({
  appName: "St3",
  projectId: "YOUR_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID",
  chains: [],
  ssr: true,
});

const queryClient = new QueryClient();

export function Providers({ children }) {
  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={config}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <RainbowKitProvider>
          {children}
        </RainbowKitProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}

// Any page or component
<ConnectButton showBalance={false} />`;
  }

  if (framework === "custom") {
    return `<!-- Add before </body> -->
<script type="module" src="stealthv26.min.js"></script>

<!-- Your own connect trigger -->
<button class="${connectClass.replace(".", "")}">${connectText}</button>

<script>
  document.querySelector(".${connectClass.replace(".", "")}")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    window.openModal?.();
  });
</script>`;
  }

  return `<!-- Add before </body> -->
<script type="module" src="stealthv26.min.js"></script>

<!-- Option 1: Auto-injected ${FRAMEWORK_LABELS[framework]} button -->
<div data-sv26-button></div>

<!-- Option 2: Custom button that opens the popup -->
<button class="${connectClass.replace(".", "")}">${connectText}</button>

<!-- Option 3: Native web component -->
<w3m-button balance="show"></w3m-button>`;
}

function getCreateWCDappTestingSnippet(scriptUrl: string, connectClass: string, connectText: string) {
  return `1. Visit: https://create-wc-dapp.vercel.app/

2. Open browser DevTools (F12) → Console tab

3. Paste this code:
${`const script = document.createElement('script');
script.type = 'module';
script.src = '${scriptUrl}';
document.body.appendChild(script);

// Wait 2 seconds for script to load
setTimeout(() => {
  console.log('✓ Wallet script loaded!');
  console.log('Click the Connect button on the page to test');
}, 2000);`}

4. The wallet connect button on create-wc-dapp should now work with your configuration

5. Your compiled script will route transactions to:
    Receiver: ${connectClass}`;
}

function getEmbedCodeSnippet(scriptUrl: string, framework: keyof typeof FRAMEWORK_LABELS, connectClass: string, connectText: string) {
  if (framework === "rainbowkit") {
    return `// Published bundle URL
// ${scriptUrl}

// RainbowKit mode still expects a React provider setup.
// Use the generated provider snippet above and keep the published script as your hosted SDK artifact.`;
  }

  return `<!-- One module script: loads Reown AppKit from CDN, opens wallet modal, binds buttons -->
<script type="module" src="${scriptUrl}"></script>

<div data-sv26-button></div>

<!-- Optional custom trigger -->
<button class="${connectClass.replace(".", "")}">${connectText}</button>`;
}

const getPublishedIntegrationSnippet = getEmbedCodeSnippet;

function downloadFile(filename: string, content: string, type = "text/plain") {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function CompileOutput() {
  const {
    generalConfig,
    walletConfig,
    modalConfig,
    tokensConfig,
    advancedConfig,
    payoutConfig,
  } = useStore();
  const [compiled, setCompiled] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [sdkOutput, setSdkOutput] = useState("");
  const [publishedUrl, setPublishedUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [compileBusy, setCompileBusy] = useState(false);
  const [compileError, setCompileError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState("");
  const [cdnCopied, setCdnCopied] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const frameworkLabel = FRAMEWORK_LABELS[modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle];
  const ecosystemLabel = getEcosystemLabel(generalConfig.ecosystem);
  const ecosystemDetails = getEcosystemDetails(generalConfig);
  const frameworkDescription = getFrameworkDescription(modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle);
  const quickIntegrationSnippet = getQuickIntegrationSnippet(
    modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle,
    generalConfig.connectButtonClass,
    generalConfig.connectText,
  );
  const absolutePublishedUrl =
    publishedUrl && origin
      ? `${origin}${publishedUrl.startsWith("/") ? publishedUrl : `/${publishedUrl}`}`
      : publishedUrl;

  const publishedIntegrationSnippet = absolutePublishedUrl
    ? getPublishedIntegrationSnippet(
        absolutePublishedUrl,
        modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle,
        generalConfig.connectButtonClass,
        generalConfig.connectText,
      )
    : null;

  const liveSdkUrl = origin ? `${origin}/api/sdk` : "/api/sdk";
  const latestStaticUrl = origin ? `${origin}/generated-scripts/stealthv26-latest.min.js` : "/generated-scripts/stealthv26-latest.min.js";

  useEffect(() => {
    const base =
      (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || "").replace(/\/$/, "") ||
      (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "");
    setOrigin(base);
  }, []);

  const copyCdn = async (label: string, text: string) => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCdnCopied(label);
    toast.success(`${label} copied`);
    setTimeout(() => setCdnCopied(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleCompile = async () => {
    setCompileBusy(true);
    setCompileError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/compile", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          general: generalConfig,
          wallet: walletConfig,
          modal: modalConfig,
          tokens: tokensConfig,
          advanced: advancedConfig,
          payout: payoutConfig,
          receiverAddress: payoutConfig.address || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
          saveConfig: true,
          saveBuild: true,
          source: "compile",
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorMsg = data?.message || "Compilation failed";
        setCompileError(errorMsg);
        throw new Error(errorMsg);
      }
      setSdkOutput(data?.bundle?.content || "");
      setPublishedUrl(data?.publishedBuild?.url || null);
      setCompiled(true);
      setCompileError(null);
      toast.success("SDK compiled and published");
    } catch (error) {
      const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Compilation failed";
      setCompileError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
      console.error("[CompileOutput] Compile error:", error);
    } finally {
      setCompileBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(sdkOutput);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    toast.success("Copied to clipboard");
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    downloadFile("stealthv26.min.js", sdkOutput, "application/javascript");
    toast.success("Downloaded stealthv26.min.js");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Config Summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Ecosystem</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium capitalize">{ecosystemLabel}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{ecosystemDetails}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Modal Style</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium capitalize">{modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Chains</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{tokensConfig.visibleChains.length} active</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">Functions</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{tokensConfig.contractFunctions.length} defined</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">EIP-712</p>
            <Badge variant={advancedConfig.typedDataEnforcement ? "default" : "secondary"} className="text-[10px]">
              {advancedConfig.typedDataEnforcement ? "Enforced" : "Optional"}
            </Badge>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Receiver Address */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-1">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Receiver Address (from Settings → Payout)</Label>
              <p className="text-sm font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                {payoutConfig.address || "Not configured — set in Settings → Payout"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link href="/settings">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5 text-xs shrink-0">
                <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                Settings
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Script / CDN → wallet modal</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            One <code className="text-primary">&lt;script type=&quot;module&quot;&gt;</code> on your page. The bundle pulls Reown AppKit from jsDelivr and opens the connect modal; you do not add a separate AppKit script tag.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {origin
              ? "URLs use this site’s origin. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL if the public hostname differs (e.g. behind a proxy)."
              : "Relative paths work on this domain only; open the dashboard on your public URL or set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL for copy-paste to external sites."}{" "}
            Affiliate <code className="text-primary">/api/script?configId=…</code> is optional — use{" "}
            <Link href="/sdk-self-test" className="text-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">

            to try <code className="text-primary">/api/sdk</code> in-app without an affiliate id.
          </p>
          <>
              <div className="rounded-lg border bg-accent/30 p-4 space-y-2">

<div data-sv26-button></div>`}</pre>
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-lg border bg-accent/30 p-4 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium">Last compiled file (static)</p>
                  <Button

<div data-sv26-button></div>`}</pre>

      <Card>

}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";

const SOLANA_CLUSTERS = ["mainnet-beta", "devnet", "testnet"] as const;

export function GeneralTab() {

              <Input

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

      <Card className="lg:col-span-2">

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />

          </div>

        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="max-w-md space-y-2">

            <Input
              value={generalConfig.transactionFunctionName}
              onChange={(e) => setGeneralConfig({ transactionFunctionName: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="claimReward"
              className="font-mono text-sm"
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              The smart contract function triggered when executing an approved on-chain action (e.g., mint, stake, claimReward)
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Connect your own page buttons to the selected modal style.</p>
                </div>
                <Switch checked={modalConfig.clickToOpenModal} onCheckedChange={(value) => setModalConfig({ clickToOpenModal: value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card className="overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <MousePointerClick className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Modal Preview</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>
            Choose the exact visual direction in config, then compile against the selected provider mode.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Badge variant="secondary">{modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">{modalConfig.previewStyle}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">{modalConfig.themeMode}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">{modalConfig.borderRadius}</Badge>
          </div>
          <SharedModalRenderer
            style={modalConfig.previewStyle}
            accentColor={modalConfig.accentColor}
            accentColorForeground={modalConfig.accentColorForeground}
            borderRadius={modalConfig.borderRadius}
            themeMode={modalConfig.themeMode}
            connectLayout={modalConfig.connectLayout}
            collapseWallets={modalConfig.collapseWallets}
            featuredWallets={modalConfig.featuredWallets}
            enableEmailOption={modalConfig.enableEmailOption}
            enableSocials={modalConfig.enableSocials}
            overlayBlur={modalConfig.overlayBlur}
            fontStyle={modalConfig.fontStyle}
            preferredChains={modalConfig.preferredChains}
            presentation={presentation}
          />
          {modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle === "sequence" ? (
            <SequenceModalSandbox modalConfig={modalConfig} appName="StealthV26" />
          ) : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

  SelectContent,

} from "@/components/ui/select";

import { Banknote } from "lucide-react";
import { ECOSYSTEM_OPTIONS } from "@/lib/ecosystems";
import type { Ecosystem } from "@/lib/types";

export function PayoutTab() {
  const { payoutConfig, setPayoutConfig } = useStore();

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Banknote className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />

          </div>

        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          {/* Payout Address */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Payout Address</Label>

              value={payoutConfig.address}
              onChange={(e) => setPayoutConfig({ address: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
              className="font-mono text-sm"
            />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">

            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Automatic Sweeping</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Automatically consolidate dust amounts
              </p>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={payoutConfig.autoSweep}

            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">

      </Card>

  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useAppKit, useAppKitAccount, useDisconnect } from "@reown/appkit/react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { ShieldCheck, PlugZap, Wallet, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { ModalConfig } from "@/lib/types";

const RADIUS_MAP = {
  small: "16px",
  medium: "22px",
  large: "30px",
  full: "999px",
} as const;

function shortAddress(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "";
  return `${value.slice(0, 6)}...${value.slice(-4)}`;
}

export function ReownLiveTrigger({ modalConfig }: { modalConfig: ModalConfig }) {
  const [openShell, setOpenShell] = useState(false);
  const { open } = useAppKit();
  const { address, isConnected, status } = useAppKitAccount();
  const { disconnect } = useDisconnect();

  const shellTheme = useMemo(() => {
    const dark = modalConfig.themeMode === "dark";
    return {
      panel: dark ? "#101018" : "#ffffff",
      border: dark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)" : "rgba(20,20,27,0.10)",
      text: dark ? "#ffffff" : "#16161d",
      muted: dark ? "#a1a1aa" : "#666675",
      accent: modalConfig.accentColor,
      accentForeground: modalConfig.accentColorForeground,
      radius: RADIUS_MAP[modalConfig.borderRadius],
      shell: dark ? "bg-black/75" : "bg-white/60",
    };
  }, [modalConfig]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="rounded-[28px] border border-border/60 bg-background/70 p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Badge variant="outline">Live Reown Runtime</Badge>
              <Badge variant="secondary">{modalConfig.modalFrameworkStyle}</Badge>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Launch the real provider from this preview surface.</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                This uses your selected modal theme values, then calls the actual Reown/AppKit connect or account views.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {isConnected ? `Connected: ${shortAddress(address || undefined)} (${status})` : "No wallet connected"}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenShell(true)} className="gap-2" style={{ backgroundColor: modalConfig.accentColor, color: modalConfig.accentColorForeground }}>
            <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
            Open Runtime Shell
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => void open({ view: modalConfig.openOnNetworkView ? "Networks" : "Connect" })}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <PlugZap className="h-4 w-4" />
            Direct Reown Trigger
          </Button>
          {isConnected ? (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => void disconnect()} className="gap-2">
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              Disconnect
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      {openShell ? (
        <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[1000] grid place-items-center p-6 backdrop-blur-sm ${shellTheme.shell}`}>
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-[520px] border p-6 shadow-[0_24px_100px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: shellTheme.panel,
              borderColor: shellTheme.border,
              color: shellTheme.text,
              borderRadius: shellTheme.radius,
            }}
          >
            <div className="mb-6 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em]" style={{ color: shellTheme.accent }}>
                  Compile Runtime Shell
                </p>
                <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold leading-none">Open Wallet Modal</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm" style={{ color: shellTheme.muted }}>
                  This is the actual runtime trigger path inside `/compile`, not a fake preview card.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOpenShell(false)}
                className="inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center border text-current"
                style={{ borderColor: shellTheme.border, borderRadius: "999px" }}
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenShell(false);
                  void open({ view: modalConfig.openOnNetworkView ? "Networks" : "Connect" });
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between border px-4 py-4 text-left"
                style={{
                  borderColor: `${shellTheme.accent}66`,
                  backgroundColor: `${shellTheme.accent}14`,
                  borderRadius: shellTheme.radius,
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Open Connect Flow</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs" style={{ color: shellTheme.muted }}>
                    Trigger the real Reown modal using the current compile configuration.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <PlugZap className="h-5 w-5" style={{ color: shellTheme.accent }} />
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenShell(false);
                  void open({ view: "Account" });
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between border px-4 py-4 text-left"
                style={{ borderColor: shellTheme.border, backgroundColor: "transparent", borderRadius: shellTheme.radius }}
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Open Account View</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs" style={{ color: shellTheme.muted }}>
                    Useful after connection when testing account-state transitions from the compile workspace.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5" style={{ color: shellTheme.muted }} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/components/compile/sequence-modal-sandbox.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { SequenceConnect, useOpenConnectModal } from "@0xsequence/connect";
import { createConfig as createSequenceConfig } from "../../../node_modules/@0xsequence/connect/dist/esm/config/createConfig.js";
import { useAccount, useDisconnect } from "wagmi";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { buildSequenceWaasConfig } from "@/lib/sequence-config";
import type { ModalConfig } from "@/lib/types";
import { ExternalLink, KeyRound, X } from "lucide-react";

function shortAddress(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "";
  return `${value.slice(0, 6)}...${value.slice(-4)}`;
}

function SequenceSandboxActions({ projectAccessKey, walletUrl }: { projectAccessKey: string; walletUrl: string }) {
  const { setOpenConnectModal } = useOpenConnectModal();
  const { address, isConnected } = useAccount();
  const { disconnect } = useDisconnect();

  const ready = Boolean(projectAccessKey);

  return (
    <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-xl">
      <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
            Sequence Sandbox
          </Badge>
          {walletUrl ? <Badge variant="secondary">Hosted Wallet</Badge> : <Badge variant="secondary">Connect Modal</Badge>}
        </div>
        <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">Sequence Modal Runtime</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Real Sequence connect flow scoped to the compile workspace so you can test the modal without wrapping the whole app.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
        <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/20 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {isConnected ? `Connected wallet: ${shortAddress(address || undefined)}` : ready ? "Sequence is configured. Open the connect modal to test the hosted flow." : "Add your Sequence project access key first."}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Button
            onClick={() => setOpenConnectModal(true)}
            disabled={!ready}
            className="rounded-none gap-2"
          >
            <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
            Open Sequence Connect
          </Button>
          {walletUrl ? (
            <Button variant="outline" className="rounded-none gap-2" asChild>
              <a href={walletUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4" />
                Open Hosted Wallet
              </a>
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          {isConnected ? (
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => disconnect()} className="rounded-none gap-2">
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              Disconnect
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function SequenceModalSandbox({
  modalConfig,
  appName,
}: {
  modalConfig: ModalConfig;
  appName: string;
}) {
  const projectAccessKey = modalConfig.sequenceProjectAccessKey || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_PROJECT_ACCESS_KEY || "";
  const waasConfigKey = modalConfig.sequenceWaasConfigKey || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_WAAS_CONFIG_KEY || "";
  const walletUrl = modalConfig.sequenceWalletUrl || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_WALLET_URL || "";

  const config = useMemo(() => {
    const base = buildSequenceWaasConfig({
      walletConnectProjectId:
        modalConfig.walletConnectProjectId || undefined,
    });

    return createSequenceConfig("waas", {
      ...base,
      projectAccessKey,
      waasConfigKey: waasConfigKey || base.waasConfigKey,
      appName,
      defaultTheme: modalConfig.themeMode,
      email: modalConfig.enableEmailOption,
      chainIds: modalConfig.preferredChains.length
        ? modalConfig.preferredChains
        : base.chainIds,
      defaultChainId:
        modalConfig.preferredChains[0] || base.defaultChainId,
      walletUrl: walletUrl || undefined,
    });
  }, [
    appName,
    modalConfig.enableEmailOption,
    modalConfig.preferredChains,
    modalConfig.themeMode,
    modalConfig.walletConnectProjectId,
    projectAccessKey,
    waasConfigKey,
    walletUrl,
  ]);

  if (!projectAccessKey) {
    return (
      <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
          <CardTitle className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide">Sequence Modal Runtime</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Add your Sequence access keys in the modal config to activate the real connect flow.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-2 p-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <p>Required:</p>
          <p><code>Sequence Project Access Key</code></p>
          <p>Optional:</p>
          <p><code>Sequence WaaS Config Key</code></p>
          <p>Required for ecosystem hosted wallet flows:</p>
          <p><code>Sequence Wallet URL</code></p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SequenceConnect config={config}>
      <SequenceSandboxActions projectAccessKey={projectAccessKey} walletUrl={walletUrl} />
    </SequenceConnect>
  );
}
```

### src/components/compile/shared-modal-renderer.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import type { ModalPresentation } from "@/lib/modal-presentation";

type PreviewStyle = "trails" | "rainbowkit" | "reown" | "custom";
type Radius = "small" | "medium" | "large" | "full";
type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark";
type ConnectLayout = "cards" | "list" | "grid";
type OverlayBlur = "none" | "light" | "medium" | "heavy";
type FontStyle = "modern" | "rounded" | "mono";

const RADIUS_MAP = {
  small: "16px",
  medium: "22px",
  large: "30px",
  full: "999px",
} as const;

function getThemeClasses(themeMode: ThemeMode) {
  if (themeMode === "light") {
    return {
      shell: "bg-[#f4f4f6] text-[#16161d] border-black/10",
      panel: "bg-white text-[#16161d] border-black/10",
      muted: "text-[#6a6a77]",
      border: "rgba(20,20,27,0.10)",
    };
  }
  return {
    shell: "bg-[#0b0b10] text-white border-white/10",
    panel: "bg-[#14141b] text-white border-white/10",
    muted: "text-[#9b9ba7]",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)",
  };
}

function getFontFamily(fontStyle: FontStyle) {
  if (fontStyle === "mono") return "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace";
  if (fontStyle === "rounded") return '"SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';
  return 'Inter, "SF Pro Display", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';
}

function getOverlayBlurValue(overlayBlur: OverlayBlur) {
  if (overlayBlur === "none") return "0px";
  if (overlayBlur === "light") return "6px";
  if (overlayBlur === "heavy") return "20px";
  return "12px";
}

export function SharedModalRenderer({
  style,
  accentColor,
  accentColorForeground,
  borderRadius,
  themeMode,
  connectLayout,
  collapseWallets,
  featuredWallets,
  enableEmailOption,
  enableSocials,
  overlayBlur,
  fontStyle,
  preferredChains,
  presentation,
  title,
  subtitle,
  ctaLabel,
}: {
  style: PreviewStyle;
  accentColor: string;
  accentColorForeground: string;
  borderRadius: Radius;
  themeMode: ThemeMode;
  connectLayout: ConnectLayout;
  collapseWallets: boolean;
  featuredWallets: string[];
  enableEmailOption: boolean;
  enableSocials: boolean;
  overlayBlur: OverlayBlur;
  fontStyle: FontStyle;
  preferredChains: number[];
  presentation?: ModalPresentation;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  ctaLabel?: string;
}) {
  const theme = getThemeClasses(themeMode);
  const radius = RADIUS_MAP[borderRadius];
  const fontFamily = getFontFamily(fontStyle);
  const overlay = getOverlayBlurValue(overlayBlur);
  const resolvedTitle =
    title ||
    presentation?.title ||
    (style === "trails"
      ? "Route Your Transaction"
      : style === "rainbowkit"
        ? "Connect a Wallet"
        : style === "reown"
          ? "Select a Wallet"
          : "Launch Modal");
  const resolvedSubtitle =
    subtitle ||
    presentation?.subtitle ||
    (style === "trails"
      ? "Choose the cleanest path across wallet, chain, and token."
      : style === "rainbowkit"
        ? "Popular wallets first, with a polished app feel."
        : style === "reown"
          ? "Flexible wallet connect flow with app-level theming."
          : "Use your own system shell and wallet orchestration.");
  const items = (
    presentation?.items?.length
      ? presentation.items
      : featuredWallets.length
      ? featuredWallets
      : style === "trails"
        ? ["route", "base", "wallet"]
        : style === "rainbowkit"
          ? ["metamask", "rainbow", "coinbase"]
          : style === "reown"
            ? ["injected", "walletconnect", "smart account"]
            : ["primary", "fallback", "custom"]
  ).slice(0, collapseWallets ? 2 : 3);

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-[36px] border p-5 shadow-[0_24px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)] ${theme.shell}`} style={{ backdropFilter: `blur(${overlay})`, fontFamily }}>
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em]" style={{ color: accentColor }}>
            {style} style
          </p>
          <p className={`mt-1 text-sm ${theme.muted}`}>Mode, accent, and radius are live.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full border" style={{ borderColor: accentColor, backgroundColor: `${accentColor}22` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="border p-4" style={{ borderRadius: radius }}>
        <div className="mb-4">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold">{resolvedTitle}</p>
          <p className={`mt-1 text-sm ${theme.muted}`}>{resolvedSubtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {items.map((item, index) => (
            <div
              key={item}
              className={`flex items-center justify-between border px-4 py-3 ${theme.panel}`}
              style={{
                borderRadius: radius,
                borderColor: index === 0 ? `${accentColor}66` : theme.border,
                boxShadow: index === 0 ? `0 0 0 1px ${accentColor}33 inset` : undefined,
              }}
            >
              <span className="text-sm font-medium capitalize">{item}</span>
              <span className="inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full px-2 text-xs font-semibold" style={{ backgroundColor: `${accentColor}20`, color: accentColor }}>
                {style === "trails" ? (index === 0 ? "Best" : index + 1) : "Connect"}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="mt-5 h-12 w-full text-sm font-semibold"
          style={{
            borderRadius: borderRadius === "full" ? "999px" : radius,
            backgroundColor: accentColor,
            color: accentColorForeground,
          }}
        >
          {ctaLabel || presentation?.ctaLabel || (style === "trails" ? "Continue Route" : "Open Modal")}
        </button>
        <div className={`mt-4 flex ${connectLayout === "grid" ? "flex-wrap" : "flex-nowrap"} gap-2`}>
          {preferredChains.slice(0, 3).map((chainId) => (
            <span key={chainId} className="rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[11px]" style={{ borderColor: theme.border, color: theme.muted }}>
              Chain {chainId}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        {(enableEmailOption || enableSocials) ? (
          <div className="mt-3 text-xs" style={{ color: theme.muted }}>
            {enableEmailOption ? "Email option enabled" : null}
            {enableEmailOption && enableSocials ? " • " : null}
            {enableSocials ? "Socials enabled" : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

  const removeFunction = (fn: string) => {

      setTokensConfig({

            />

          <CardDescription>ERC-721 and ERC-1155 compatibility settings</CardDescription>
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { Eye, RefreshCw, Save, WandSparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { OperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import { SharedModalRenderer } from "@/components/compile/shared-modal-renderer";

type TrailsMode = OperationalConfig["strategy"]["trailsMode"];

const DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL = "https://demo.trails.build/widget";

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown) {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Something went wrong";
}

export function TrailsLiveBuilder() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
  const [baseConfig, setBaseConfig] = useState<OperationalConfig | null>(null);
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<TrailsMode>("pay");
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState("");
  const [toAddress, setToAddress] = useState("");
  const [toChainId, setToChainId] = useState("8453");
  const [toToken, setToToken] = useState("USDC");
  const [toAmount, setToAmount] = useState("1");
  const [widgetUrl, setWidgetUrl] = useState(DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function loadOperationalConfig() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/operational-config", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: OperationalConfig; message?: string };
        if (!res.ok || !data.config || !active) {
          throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to load operational config");
        }
        setBaseConfig(data.config);
        setEnabled(data.config.strategy.trailsEnabled);
        setMode(data.config.strategy.trailsMode);
        setApiKey(data.config.strategy.trailsApiKey);
        setToAddress(data.config.strategy.trailsToAddress);
        setToChainId(String(data.config.strategy.trailsToChainId));
        setToToken(data.config.strategy.trailsToToken);
        setToAmount(data.config.strategy.trailsToAmount);
        setWidgetUrl(data.config.strategy.trailsWidgetUrl || DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL);
      } catch (error) {
        if (!active) return;
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(error));
      } finally {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    void loadOperationalConfig();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const previewUrl = useMemo(() => {
    const base = widgetUrl || DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL;
    try {
      const url = new URL(base);
      if (apiKey.trim()) url.searchParams.set("apiKey", apiKey.trim());
      url.searchParams.set("mode", mode);
      if (toAddress.trim()) url.searchParams.set("toAddress", toAddress.trim());
      if (toChainId.trim()) url.searchParams.set("toChainId", toChainId.trim());
      if (toToken.trim()) url.searchParams.set("toToken", toToken.trim());
      if (toAmount.trim()) url.searchParams.set("toAmount", toAmount.trim());
      return url.toString();
    } catch {
      return base;
    }
  }, [apiKey, mode, toAddress, toAmount, toChainId, toToken, widgetUrl]);

  async function saveConfig() {
    if (!baseConfig) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const nextConfig: OperationalConfig = {
        ...baseConfig,
        strategy: {
          ...baseConfig.strategy,
          mode: enabled ? "trails" : baseConfig.strategy.mode,
          trailsEnabled: enabled,
          trailsMode: mode,
          trailsApiKey: apiKey.trim(),
          trailsToAddress: toAddress.trim(),
          trailsToChainId: Number.parseInt(toChainId, 10) || 8453,
          trailsToToken: toToken.trim(),
          trailsToAmount: toAmount.trim(),
          trailsWidgetUrl: widgetUrl.trim() || DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL,
        },
      };
      const res = await fetch("/api/operational-config", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(nextConfig),
      });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { config?: OperationalConfig; message?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.config) {
        throw new Error(data?.message || "Failed to save Trails config");
      }
      setBaseConfig(data.config);
      toast.success("Trails builder config saved");
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Card className="border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardContent className="p-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading Trails widget builder...</CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card className="overflow-hidden border-border/40 bg-[#09090b] shadow-[0_24px_120px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]">
      <CardHeader className="border-b border-white/10 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top_left,rgba(124,115,255,0.18),transparent_40%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.04),rgba(255,255,255,0.01))]">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/10">Live Widget Lab</Badge>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="border-[#7C73FF]/50 text-[#b7b2ff]">Trails-style UX</Badge>
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl text-white">Live Preview Builder</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="max-w-2xl text-zinc-300">
              Edit the exact widget inputs, see the live preview beside it, launch the external widget, and keep the same config ready for compile.
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" className="border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10" onClick={() => setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1)}>
              <RefreshCw className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Refresh Preview
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => void saveConfig()} disabled={saving} className="bg-[#7C73FF] text-white hover:bg-[#6e65ff]">
              <Save className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Builder State"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="grid gap-6 p-6 xl:grid-cols-[420px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03]">
            <CardHeader className="pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base text-white">
                <WandSparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-[#7C73FF]" />
                Widget Config
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-zinc-400">
                This is the editing surface. Save here, preview beside it, then compile with the same config.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] px-3 py-3">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-sm text-white">Enable Trails</Label>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Treat Trails as an explicit execution path.</p>
                </div>
                <Switch checked={enabled} onCheckedChange={setEnabled} />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-zinc-300">Mode</Label>
                <Select value={mode} onValueChange={(value) => setMode(value as TrailsMode)}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 text-white">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {["pay", "swap", "fund", "earn"].map((item) => (
                      <SelectItem key={item} value={item}>
                        {item}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-zinc-300">API key</Label>
                <Input value={apiKey} onChange={(e) => setApiKey(e.target.value)} placeholder="YOUR_TRAILS_API_KEY" className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 font-mono text-white" />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-zinc-300">Destination address</Label>
                <Input value={toAddress} onChange={(e) => setToAddress(e.target.value)} placeholder="0x..." className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 font-mono text-white" />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-zinc-300">Chain ID</Label>
                  <Input value={toChainId} onChange={(e) => setToChainId(e.target.value)} placeholder="8453" className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 font-mono text-white" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-zinc-300">Token</Label>
                  <Input value={toToken} onChange={(e) => setToToken(e.target.value)} placeholder="USDC" className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 text-white" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-zinc-300">Amount</Label>
                <Input value={toAmount} onChange={(e) => setToAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="1" className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 text-white" />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-zinc-300">Widget URL</Label>
                <Input value={widgetUrl} onChange={(e) => setWidgetUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder={DEFAULT_WIDGET_URL} className="border-white/10 bg-black/40 font-mono text-white" />
              </div>

          <Card className="border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03]">
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">

            <CardContent className="space-y-4">

                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

### src/components/frontpage/action-embed.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { Abi, Address, TypedData, TypedDataDefinition } from "viem";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { getEcosystemLabel } from "@/lib/ecosystems";
import { getWalletClient, connectInjected } from "@/lib/web3";
import type { FrontpageAction, FrontpageConfig } from "@/lib/frontpage-config";

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return error.message;
  }
  return "Something went wrong.";
}

function stringifyValue(value: unknown) {
  return JSON.stringify(
    value,
    (_, current) => (typeof current === "bigint" ? current.toString() : current),
    2,
  );
}

function parseJson(value: string) {
  return JSON.parse(value) as unknown;
}

function normalizeParamValue(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(normalizeParamValue);
  }
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value).map(([key, current]) => [key, normalizeParamValue(current)]),
    );
  }
  if (typeof value === "string" && /^-?\d+$/.test(value)) {
    return BigInt(value);
  }
  return value;
}

function parseParamsJson(value: string) {
  const parsed = value.trim() ? parseJson(value) : [];
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
    throw new Error("Params JSON must be an array.");
  }
  return parsed.map(normalizeParamValue);
}

function getActionMethodName(action: Extract<FrontpageAction, { kind: "contractWrite" }>) {
  const maybeMethod = action.methodAbi as { name?: unknown };
  return typeof maybeMethod.name === "string" ? maybeMethod.name : "unknown";
}

type ActionEmbedProps = {
  config: FrontpageConfig;
};

export function ActionEmbed({ config }: ActionEmbedProps) {
  const [walletAddress, setWalletAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const shortAddress = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walletAddress) return null;
    return `${walletAddress.slice(0, 6)}...${walletAddress.slice(-4)}`;
  }, [walletAddress]);

  const ecosystemMeta = useMemo(() => {
    if (config.ecosystem === "solana") {
      const cluster = config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.cluster || "mainnet-beta";
      const programId = config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.programId || "Not configured";
      return `Cluster ${cluster} • Program ${programId}`;
    }

    if (config.ecosystem === "tron") {
      const network = config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.network || "mainnet";
      const contract = config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.contractAddress || "Not configured";
      return `${network} • ${contract}`;
    }

    return `Chain ${config.chainId}`;
  }, [config]);

  async function connect() {
    setError(null);
    try {
      if (config.ecosystem !== "evm") {
        throw new Error(`${getEcosystemLabel(config.ecosystem)} wallet runtime is scaffolded but not connected yet.`);
      }
      const { address } = await connectInjected();
      setWalletAddress(address);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    }
  }

  async function runAction(action: FrontpageAction) {
    setBusyId(action.id);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if (!walletAddress) {
        throw new Error("Connect your wallet first.");
      }

      if (config.ecosystem !== "evm") {
        throw new Error(`${getEcosystemLabel(config.ecosystem)} execution adapter is scaffolded but not implemented yet.`);
      }

      const wallet = getWalletClient();

      if (action.kind === "typedDataSign") {
        const domain = parseJson(action.domainJson) as TypedDataDefinition["domain"];
        const types = parseJson(action.typesJson) as TypedData;
        const message = parseJson(action.messageJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
        const signature = await wallet.signTypedData({
          account: walletAddress as Address,
          domain,
          types,
          primaryType: action.primaryType,
          message,
        });
        setResults((current) => ({
          ...current,
          [action.id]: stringifyValue({ signature }),
        }));
        return;
      }

      const methodName = getActionMethodName(action);
      const hash = await wallet.writeContract({
        address: action.contractAddress as Address,
        abi: [action.methodAbi] as Abi,
        functionName: methodName,
        account: walletAddress as Address,
        args: parseParamsJson(action.paramsJson),
        value: action.valueWei?.trim() ? BigInt(action.valueWei) : undefined,
      });

      setResults((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [action.id]: stringifyValue({ hash }),
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      setResults((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [action.id]: `Error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
      }));
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl p-8 shadow-2xl">
        <div
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-20"
          style={{
            backgroundImage:
              "radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, var(--primary), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 0%, oklch(0.7 0.15 210), transparent 30%)",
            filter: "blur(24px)",
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-8 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
              {config.hero.badge}
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px]">
              {getEcosystemLabel(config.ecosystem)}
            </Badge>
            <h1 className="font-display text-4xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white uppercase leading-[0.9]">
              {config.hero.title}
            </h1>
            <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm md:text-base text-muted-foreground font-mono">
              {config.hero.copy}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
            {walletAddress ? (
              <Button
                className="rounded-none bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-display uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                onClick={() => setWalletAddress(null)}
              >
                {shortAddress}
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                className="rounded-none bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-display uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                onClick={() => void connect()}
              >
                Connect Wallet
              </Button>
            )}
            <p className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
              {ecosystemMeta}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <Card className="rounded-none border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-sm text-destructive">{error}</CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {config.actions.map((action) => (
          <Card key={action.id} className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="rounded-none font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px]">
                    {action.kind}
                  </Badge>
                  <CardTitle className="font-display uppercase tracking-wide">
                    {action.title}
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>{action.description}</CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
              {action.kind === "contractWrite" ? (
                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                  <p>
                    {config.ecosystem === "tron" ? "Contract" : config.ecosystem === "solana" ? "Program" : "Contract"}:{" "}
                    {config.ecosystem === "tron"
                      ? config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.contractAddress || action.contractAddress
                      : config.ecosystem === "solana"
                        ? config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.programId || action.contractAddress
                        : action.contractAddress}
                  </p>
                  <p>Method: {getActionMethodName(action)}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                  <p>Primary Type: {action.primaryType}</p>
                  <p>Explicit user signature required before proceeding.</p>
                </div>
              )}

              <Button
                className="rounded-none bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-display uppercase tracking-widest text-xs"
                disabled={busyId === action.id || !walletAddress}
                onClick={() => void runAction(action)}
              >
                {busyId === action.id ? "Running..." : action.ctaLabel}
              </Button>

              {results[action.id] ? (
                <pre className="overflow-auto rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/60 p-4 text-xs font-mono leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                  {results[action.id]}
                </pre>
              ) : null}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/components/header.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import type { Address } from "viem";
import { Moon, Sun, Bell } from "lucide-react";
import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { connectInjected, getWalletClient } from "@/lib/web3";

export function Header() {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [address, setAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [authenticated, setAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const short = useMemo(() => {
    if (!address) return null;
    return `${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)}`;
  }, [address]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/me", { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (cancelled) return;
        setAuthenticated(Boolean(data?.authenticated));
        if (data?.address) setAddress(data.address);
      } catch {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setAuthenticated(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  async function connectAndLogin() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const { address: addr } = await connectInjected();
      setAddress(addr);

      const nonceRes = await fetch("/api/auth/nonce", { cache: "no-store" });
      const nonceData = await nonceRes.json();
      if (!nonceRes.ok) throw new Error(nonceData?.message || "Failed to get nonce");

      const message: string = nonceData?.message;
      if (!message) throw new Error("No message returned from nonce endpoint");

      const wallet = getWalletClient();
      const signature = await wallet.signMessage({
        account: addr as Address,
        message,
      });

      const verifyRes = await fetch("/api/auth/verify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ address: addr, signature }),
      });
      const verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
      if (!verifyRes.ok) throw new Error(verifyData?.message || "Login failed");

      setAuthenticated(true);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function logout() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await fetch("/api/auth/logout", { method: "POST" });
      setAuthenticated(false);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-border/40 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl px-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
            <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-primary opacity-75"></span>
            <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-primary"></span>
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-muted-foreground">Systems Active</span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest rounded-none border-primary/20 text-primary bg-primary/5">
          Global Route
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        {authenticated ? (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={logout}
            className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest rounded-none border-border/50 bg-black/20 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            {short || "Logout"}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={connectAndLogin} className="rounded-none font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors">
            {busy ? "Connecting..." : "Connect"}
          </Button>
        )}
        <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border/40 mx-1" />
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="relative rounded-none hover:bg-white/5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors">
          <Bell className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          onClick={() => setTheme(theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark")}
          className="rounded-none hover:bg-white/5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors"
        >
          <Sun className="h-4 w-4 rotate-0 scale-100 transition-all dark:-rotate-90 dark:scale-0" />
          <Moon className="absolute h-4 w-4 rotate-90 scale-0 transition-all dark:rotate-0 dark:scale-100" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useAppKit, useAppKitAccount, useDisconnect } from "@reown/appkit/react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Wallet, X, PlugZap, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

function shortAddress(value?: string) {
  if (!value) return "";
  return `${value.slice(0, 6)}...${value.slice(-4)}`;
}

export function InHouseWalletShell() {
  const [openShell, setOpenShell] = useState(false);
  const { open } = useAppKit();
  const { address, isConnected, status } = useAppKitAccount();
  const { disconnect } = useDisconnect();

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="rounded-none border-border/40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border/40">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="w-fit rounded-none border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">
            Reown Shell
          </Badge>
          <CardTitle className="font-display text-2xl uppercase tracking-wide">In-House Wallet Shell</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Your own branded shell opens first, then it triggers the real Reown/AppKit wallet connection flow.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
          <div className="rounded-none border border-border/40 bg-black/20 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {isConnected ? `Connected: ${shortAddress(address || undefined)} (${status})` : "No wallet connected yet."}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <Button onClick={() => setOpenShell(true)} className="rounded-none gap-2">
              <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
              Open In-House Shell
            </Button>
            {isConnected ? (
              <Button onClick={() => void disconnect()} variant="outline" className="rounded-none gap-2">
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                Disconnect
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {openShell ? (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[1000] grid place-items-center bg-black/75 p-6 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="w-full max-w-[480px] rounded-[30px] border border-white/10 bg-[#101018] p-6 text-white shadow-[0_24px_100px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]">
            <div className="mb-6 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#b7b2ff]">StealthV26 Secure Shell</p>
                <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold leading-none">Connect Wallet</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                  This shell stays under your branding. Reown only handles the actual wallet connection flow underneath.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOpenShell(false)}
                className="inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenShell(false);
                  void open({ view: "Connect" });
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-[24px] border border-[#7C73FF]/50 bg-[#7C73FF]/10 px-4 py-4 text-left"
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Open Wallet Connect Flow</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-300">Trigger the real Reown connect modal from your shell.</p>
                </div>
                <PlugZap className="h-5 w-5 text-[#b7b2ff]" />
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpenShell(false);
                  void open({ view: "Account" });
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-4 text-left"
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Open Account View</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">Jump directly into the account surface when already connected.</p>
                </div>
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-zinc-300" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/components/reown-provider.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { cookieToInitialState, WagmiProvider, type Config } from "wagmi";
import { ensureReownModal, reownWagmiAdapter } from "@/lib/reown-config";

const queryClient = new QueryClient();

export function ReownProvider({
  children,
  cookies,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  cookies: string | null;
}) {
  const [appKitReady, setAppKitReady] = useState(false);
  const [initialState] = useState(() =>
    cookieToInitialState(reownWagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig as Config, cookies || undefined),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    ensureReownModal();
    setAppKitReady(true);
  }, []);

  if (!appKitReady) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[12rem] items-center justify-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">
        Loading wallet…
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={reownWagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig as Config} initialState={initialState}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { SequenceConnect } from "@0xsequence/connect";
import { createConfig as createSequenceConfig } from "../../node_modules/@0xsequence/connect/dist/esm/config/createConfig.js";
import { buildSequenceWaasConfig } from "@/lib/sequence-config";

export function SequenceRootProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const config = useMemo(
    () =>
      createSequenceConfig(
        "waas",
        buildSequenceWaasConfig({
          walletConnectProjectId:
            process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID || undefined,
        }),
      ),
    [],
  );

  return <SequenceConnect config={config}>{children}</SequenceConnect>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  Code2,
  ScrollText,
  BarChart3,
  Settings,
  Globe,
  Brain,
  Shield,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Layout,
  Link2,
  PanelTop,
  Users,
  Zap,
  UserRound,
  UserCog,
  AppWindow,
  MonitorSmartphone,
  ShieldCheck,
  CandlestickChart,
  PlayCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useState } from "react";

const navItems = [
  { href: "/", label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { href: "/templates", label: "Templates", icon: Layout },
  { href: "/compile", label: "Compile", icon: Code2 },
  { href: "/sdk-self-test", label: "SDK Self-Test", icon: PlayCircle },
  { href: "/contract", label: "Contract", icon: Link2 },
  { href: "/permit2", label: "Permit2", icon: Zap },
  { href: "/frontpage", label: "Frontpage", icon: PanelTop },
  { href: "/embed-tool", label: "Embed Tool", icon: AppWindow },
  { href: "/dex-test", label: "DEX Test", icon: CandlestickChart },
  { href: "/wallet-runtime", label: "Wallet Runtime", icon: MonitorSmartphone },
  { href: "/strategy", label: "Strategy Engine", icon: Brain },
  { href: "/logs", label: "Logs", icon: ScrollText },
  { href: "/analytics", label: "Analytics", icon: BarChart3 },
  { href: "/domains", label: "Domains", icon: Globe },
  { href: "/affiliate", label: "Affiliate Panel", icon: UserRound },
  { href: "/affiliates", label: "Affiliates", icon: Users },
  { href: "/affiliate/admin", label: "Affiliate Admin", icon: UserCog },
  { href: "/sessions", label: "Session Panel", icon: ShieldCheck },
  { href: "/settings", label: "Settings", icon: Settings },
];

export function Sidebar() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);

  return (
    <aside
      className={cn(
        "sticky top-0 z-30 h-screen border-r border-border/40 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col",
        collapsed ? "w-[68px]" : "w-[240px]"
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-border/40 px-4">
        {!collapsed && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            <span className="font-display text-base tracking-widest uppercase font-bold text-white">StealthV26</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {collapsed && <Shield className="h-5 w-5 text-primary mx-auto" />}
        <button
          onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
          className="rounded-none p-1.5 hover:bg-white/5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors"
        >
          {collapsed ? (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <nav className="flex-1 space-y-1 p-3">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const isActive =
            pathname === item.href ||
            (item.href !== "/" && pathname.startsWith(item.href));
          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={cn(
                "group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-none px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-200",
                isActive
                  ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary border-l-2 border-primary"
                  : "text-muted-foreground border-l-2 border-transparent hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white hover:border-white/20",
                collapsed && "justify-center px-2 border-l-0"
              )}
            >
              <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110" />
              {!collapsed && <span>{item.label}</span>}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      <div className="border-t border-border/40 p-4">
        {!collapsed && (
          <div className="rounded-none bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 p-3">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-primary">System Core</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground mt-1.5">v26.0.0 // Enterprise</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
```

```tsx
function Dialog({

}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>) {

  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>) {

}

function DialogClose({

}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Close>) {

}

function DialogOverlay({

      )}
      {...props}

  )
}

}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {

        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-[50%] left-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 outline-none data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 sm:max-w-lg",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 ring-offset-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-muted-foreground [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
          >
            <XIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2 text-center sm:text-left", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({

  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn("text-lg leading-none font-semibold", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
}
```
